chapters.title: Chapter 101: Life Aura Surges Once More
paragraphs: The degree to which the Luo Family valued Yang Fan was equally puzzling to him.
Setting aside the strategic-grade buildings and the ten thousand Divinity Points, they had now even forced their own family’s Prodigy daughter into his bed just to win him over.
Things having come to this, Yang Fan didn’t know how to repay them.
Since it wasn’t harmful to him at the moment, he, being thick-skinned, accepted it calmly.
If he truly became capable in the future, he would simply give back to them then.
Yang Fan turned his gaze to his watch and found that there were five emails in total.
“Congratulations on ranking in the top ten of the Luo Family; a reward of 1 billion Faith Points has been issued.”
“Congratulations on ranking first in the Luo Family Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle; a reward of 10 billion Faith Points has been issued.”

“First Middle School Academic Affairs Office: Congratulations to student Yang Fan for ranking first in this Divine Kingdom Resource Collection; a special reward of one B-Grade Building, the immortal nurturing tower, has been granted.”
“Luo Family Resource Reward: One B-Grade Building Alchemy Tower and ten thousand Divinity Points.”
“Federal Government Official Email: One A-Grade Resource Building, Spiritual Vein (This message has been classified; burn after reading).”
Yang Fan’s consciousness submerged into his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Yang Yi and Yang Er were already waiting for him.
“Congratulations, Master, on becoming a Human Race Prodigy,” the two voices rang out simultaneously.
As Yang Fan’s Intelligent Life, they naturally knew everything that had happened.
“What exactly is the evaluation for a Human Race Prodigy?” Yang Fan asked curiously.

“The Federal Government divides the geniuses of the entire Human Race into six evaluation levels: Peerless Prodigy, Human Race Prodigy, and the four grades of geniuses: A, B, C, and D. According to historical records, those who obtain the Human Race Prodigy evaluation and do not perish prematurely have a minimum strength of a Fourth-Order God and a maximum strength of an Eighth-Order God,” Yang Yi replied.
A look of realization flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes.
No wonder the Luo Family’s attitude toward him had changed so drastically.
Currently, the strongest member of the Luo Family was Luo Hai, a Tier 3 God.
Gods from the first to third order are considered low-order gods.
Once they break through to the fourth order, they cross a chasm; the Divine Kingdom undergoes a qualitative change, and they become Mid-tier Gods.
Being able to rely on a Mid-tier God would naturally allow the Luo Family to reach a higher level in the future.
“As expected of the Luo Family Head, he really acts with swiftness and resolution,” Yang Fan admired inwardly.
To the Luo Family, he was just a son-in-law, a relationship separated by a layer.
But the other party’s bet was certainly decisive enough.
Thinking about this was useless.
If he truly became an existence beyond the Luo Family’s reach in the future, for the sake of Luo Rou and Luo Bing, he would naturally help.
If his strength wasn’t enough, then the Luo Family’s investment would be considered a waste.
Regardless, there was no loss for the current Yang Fan; he might as well accept it with peace of mind.
With a thought from Yang Fan, three cards floated before his eyes.
The buildings loaded in the cards were the Alchemy Tower, the immortal nurturing tower, and the Spiritual Vein.
“Help me retrieve the specific information,” Yang Fan ordered.
Blue light projected from Yang Yi’s eyes, and three light screens subsequently appeared in front of Yang Fan.

“Alchemy Tower: B-Grade Functional Building, used to assist believers in Medicinal Pill refinement. A stable heat source system is constructed within the tower, allowing for precise control over temperature, spiritual power, and medicinal property changes, significantly reducing uncertainty during the Alchemy process. With the support of the Alchemy Tower, the success rate of pill refinement can be increased by approximately 40%, while effectively reducing furnace explosions and loss of medicinal properties. Its interior features layered refinement zones that can automatically match the optimal environment based on the rank of the Medicinal Pill, achieving large-scale and standardized Alchemy. Applicable to Cultivation system Divine Kingdoms, it can significantly enhance the output efficiency and quality of Medicinal Pills, serving as an important building to support high-level Cultivation and resource cycling.”

“immortal nurturing tower: B-Grade Building. The tower contains one hundred thousand seats, which can slowly improve the Cultivation Aptitude of believers, increasing Cultivate speed by 70%, the success rate of Realm Breakthroughs by 30%, and reducing the rate of Heart Demon emergence by 20%... Applicable to Cultivation system Divine Kingdoms, it offers immense benefits to believers below the Golden Core level.”
“Spiritual Vein: A-Grade Resource Building.
A core resource point condensed by heaven and earth, possessing the ability to stably produce Spirit Stones.
It can produce one million Spirit Stones every thirty years.
Spirit Stones are a basic resource for Cultivation Divine Kingdoms, suitable for the daily Cultivate of believers at the Qi Refining Realm and above.

They can replace part of the environmental Spiritual Qi, significantly enhancing Cultivate efficiency, and are the core material for maintaining the operation of the Divine Kingdom’s Cultivation system.
The internal circulation of the Spiritual Vein is self-contained, capable of continuously converting heaven and earth energy into usable resources.
Simultaneously, it provides a buff effect to the surrounding environment, increasing local Spiritual Qi concentration and speeding up Cultivate and recovery rates.
Its output is stable and its uses are broad, possessing value for Cultivate, trade, and reserves.
It is a foundational pillar for constructing resource systems and economic cycles.
As the scale of the Divine Kingdom expands, its strategic significance will continue to grow.
[Evaluation]: A top-tier resource point with long-term stable supply capability, belonging to the core buildings of a Divine Kingdom.”
After reading the introductions, Yang Fan also roughly understood the functions of these three buildings.
To refine Medicinal Pills, believers must first break through to the Qi Refining Realm.
This Alchemy Tower seemed more like something prepared for him after he became a Demigod powerhouse; for now, it was just a decoration.
Last time in the school storehouse, Yang Fan had taken a fancy to the immortal nurturing tower.
This building was of great benefit to Yang Fan’s current Divine Kingdom, as it could significantly increase the believers’ Cultivate speed.
Although each immortal nurturing tower only had 100,000 seats, he could entirely let the high-level believers enter it to Cultivate.
Perhaps with some luck, a fifth-tier believer might cross the boundary and break through to the Qi Refining Realm.
As for the A-Grade Resource Building, the Spiritual Vein, Yang Fan’s expression was a bit regretful.
What he needed most right now were buildings that could speed up believer Cultivate; he already had far too many of these resource-type buildings in his Divine Kingdom.
Combined with the ten thousand Divinity Points given by the Luo Family, his Divine Kingdom’s funds were currently inexhaustible.
Now, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was like a mountain of gold.
Even if he mined all the gold and forged it into weapons for his believers to wear, he wouldn’t be able to consume it all.
The resource output within the Divine Kingdom already far exceeded the believers’ own expenditures.
Yang Fan sighed: “Yang Yi, what is the specific value of Spirit Stones?”
“One divinity point can purchase ten thousand Spirit Stones.”
“In other words, I’ve essentially gained another hundred Monkey Wine Springs?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but say.
Yang Yi nodded.

“Congratulations, Master. With this Spiritual Vein, the Divine Kingdom’s environment will be significantly improved. Before Master breaks through to become a God, there will also be a major source for the Spirit Stones required by the believers.”
Yang Fan waved his hand.
“Go ahead and load these three buildings into suitable locations in the Divine Kingdom.”
Upon receiving the order, the cards in Yang Fan’s hand turned into streaks of light and disappeared.
The Alchemy Tower, Spiritual Vein, and immortal nurturing tower simultaneously landed on Penglai Island.
In the next moment, the entire world shook violently.
The Spiritual Vein took root, and a large amount of pure Spiritual Qi gushed from the ground, spreading like a tide.
The already dense Immortal Qi was pushed up another level; the air almost solidified, and with every breath, spiritual power circulated spontaneously.
Immediately after, the Alchemy Tower began to operate.
The heat source and Spiritual Qi within the tower intersected, forming a stable and efficient energy cycle.
A milky-white light slowly spread from the immortal nurturing tower.
Wherever it passed, vegetation grew wildly, Spirit Plants transformed, and the aura of living beings noticeably strengthened.
At this moment—the life aura of the Divine Kingdom surged once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Someone from Taichu City
paragraphs: Worthy of being an A-grade building rewarded by the Federal Government; as the Spiritual Vein took root in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan, as the god, could feel the overall environment of the Divine Kingdom rise to another level.
This change was even more intense than the appearance of Penglai Island.
Although the Spiritual Vein was rated as a resource-type building, its function was not limited to producing Spirit Stones.
With the current environment of the Divine Kingdom, the cultivation speed of all living beings would rise to another level.
Sensing the massive change within the Divine Kingdom, a hint of joy appeared on Yang Fan’s face.

“In the long run, the benefits of this Spiritual Vein are immeasurable. If there were a few more, even if the believers were sleeping, their Physical Bodies would grow stronger and stronger under the nourishment of Spiritual Qi.”
The Divine Kingdom’s environment was too important for believers; a building like the Spiritual Vein that could drastically change the environment was definitely a top-tier treasure.
With Intelligent Life like Yang Yi and Yang Er around, Yang Fan didn’t need to worry about the detailed work in the Divine Kingdom.
Therefore, he didn’t choose to issue a Divine Decree and instead returned directly to reality.
Pushing open the door, Yang Fan did not find Luo Bing.
In the living room downstairs, only his parents and Luo Rou were present.
“Husband, you’re awake? How did you sleep last night?” Luo Rou said obediently.
Yang Fan’s expression was a bit awkward; he suddenly felt like he had been caught in the act of an affair.
Perhaps sensing Yang Fan’s unease, Luo Rou stepped forward and said gently, “It’s alright, as long as you have me in your heart, husband.”
Yesterday at the Luo Family’s ancestral grounds, Luo Chengfeng had already told Luo Rou the full story.
Regarding this matter, Luo Rou might have felt somewhat uncomfortable deep down, but she wouldn’t throw a tantrum.
The strong naturally possessed more resources, whether it was Divine Kingdom buildings, various supplies, or spouses.
Although the Human Race had federal laws, the core essence was still built on the foundation of the respect for strength.
As a wife, it was impossible to want one’s husband to be powerful while also expecting him to be perfectly faithful.
The essence of the world remained an exchange of value.
Currently, Luo Rou and Yang Fan were husband and wife in name, but in reality, it was more like a vassal relationship.
Not just her, but even the Luo Family had to follow Yang Fan’s wishes now.
“Prodigy of the Human Race”—with this title alone, Yang Fan’s future value exceeded that of the entire Family.
Having grown up in a large Family since childhood, Luo Rou’s vision naturally saw further than those ordinary women.
To be a virtuous wife, not to cause trouble for her husband, and not to question matters far beyond her ability.
Only then would the future be better for her and the child in her womb.
Sun Rong stood up to help Luo Rou sit down, then turned to look at Yang Fan, her gaze filled with too many emotions.
The child she gave birth to seemed to have talent that was a bit too good; even as a mother, she felt a slight sense of distance when looking at Yang Fan now.
“Fan’er, I heard from Little Rou’s grandfather that you’re leaving Yang County today?” Sun Rong asked.
“Most likely, but I don’t know the specific time either.”
“Then when will you be back?”
“I’m not sure, but our Family can meet frequently in the Virtual World.”
“We can’t always be in the Virtual World; we’ve lived in the real world for so many years, it’s still different.” Sun Rong sighed.
The downside of a son being too outstanding was that he would travel far away.
Just then, the doorbell rang outside.
Yang Tiexin hurriedly ran over to open the door.
Seeing the figure at the door, Yang Fan hurriedly bowed in greeting: “Student Yang Fan greets the Principal.”
As a student of No.
1 High School, Yang Fan naturally knew Hong Bing.
“No need for such formalities. This is County Magistrate Wang,” Hong Bing introduced.
“Coun... County Magistrate!” Yang Tiexin, standing closest, subconsciously took a step back, swallowing repeatedly.
Having lived in the Mingyue Community before, they could only see such big figures on television.
He didn’t expect to have the honor of meeting him in person today.

“Since there is a risk of assassination by alien races for a Prodigy of the Human Race, according to policy regulations, we cannot tell too many people. Only Principal Hong and I have come to see off the great Genius of our Yang County,” Magistrate Wang Yun said with a smile.
Yang Fan said, feeling overwhelmed by the favor, “County Magistrate Wang and Principal Hong are too kind. I am merely a Divine Being and do not deserve such attention from two Seniors.”

“There’s no need to belittle yourself. The evaluation by the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life won’t be wrong. As long as you don’t fall in the future, your achievements will surely surpass the two of us. Before you leave, I hope that after you achieve success, you can remember that you came from this remote place called Yang County. Within the scope of your future abilities, I hope you can help your hometown,” Magistrate Wang Yun said softly.
“I will,” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
Just then, Magistrate Wang Yun subconsciously raised his head: “It’s here.”
Suddenly!
The sky cracked open.
A spatial rift was forcibly torn open by some kind of power above the Yangcheng Villa.
The edges of the rift presented a strange geometric structure; light was stretched and distorted, and energy runes faintly flickered within.
The next moment, a huge black shadow slowly “squeezed” out from the rift.
It was a future creation that completely transcended recognition.
It was streamlined as a whole yet had sharp edges, entirely black, with dark red energy patterns flowing on the surface from time to time, as if blood were flowing through metal.
The space around the hull continued to distort, as if it didn’t belong to this dimension.
“Buzz—”
A low-frequency vibration spread out.
The sky over the entire Yang County became heavy and oppressive at this moment.
Whether in the Virtual World or in reality, everyone felt this massive change and came to the windows to look up at the miracle.
That megastructure finally hovered directly above the Yangcheng Villa area.
The spatial rift slowly closed behind it, leaving only the distorted sky that had yet to settle.
The next moment, a gap opened at the front of the hull.
A figure stepped out slowly.
She wore a red and black robe, the hem fluttering gently with the fluctuations of the Void Realm, and a divine radiance faintly flowed around her.
“Fellow Daoist, you’re just here to pick someone up, there’s no need to be so ostentatious!” Magistrate Wang Yun looked up and frowned.
“This is the decision of the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life. If you are dissatisfied, you can appeal.”
The woman’s voice in the sky was cold; facing Magistrate Wang Yun and Principal Hong, her tone was full of arrogance.
“Where is His Highness Yang Fan?” the woman asked again.
Yang Fan had just looked up and hadn’t spoken yet when a light blue beam of light shone on him.
“Identity verification complete. Your Highness, please follow me.”
Yang Fan only felt a gentle force supporting his body, slowly flying towards the hull in the sky.
The other party took Yang Fan directly into the interior of the hull.
Then, the giant object turned in the sky, space fluctuated, and it instantly tore through, disappearing from the sky over Yang County.
Hong Bing said with a sour face, “We’re all Tier 3 Gods, what’s she so arrogant for? I really want to have a fight with her.”

“Forget it. Looking at the clothes this person is wearing, she should be a permanent resident of Taichu City. Don’t look at our identical Realms; the combined foundations of our two Divine Kingdoms might not even be as deep as hers. We can’t beat her,” Magistrate Wang Yun gave a bitter smile.
“This kid is really being taken seriously; even the Guide is a Tier 3 God like us. What kind of hidden talent do you think he has?”
“Who knows? Let’s first think about how to deal with the Mayor’s inquiry!”

Then, the giant object turned in the sky, space fluctuated, and it instantly tore through, disappearing from the sky over Yang County.
Hong Bing said with a sour face, “We’re all Tier 3 Gods, what’s she so arrogant for?
I really want to have a fight with her.”
“Forget it.
Looking at the clothes this person is wearing, she should be a permanent resident of Taichu City.
Don’t look at our identical Realms; the combined foundations of our two Divine Kingdoms might not even be as deep as hers.
We can’t beat her,” Magistrate Wang Yun gave a bitter smile.
“This kid is really being taken seriously; even the Guide is a Tier 3 God like us.
What kind of hidden talent do you think he has?”
“Who knows?
Let’s first think about how to deal with the Mayor’s inquiry!”

chapters.title: Chapter 103: Tenfold Time Sequence S-rank
paragraphs: At the Luo Family grounds, Luo Mingxuan stared blankly at the spot where the giant object had disappeared from the sky.
“You understand now, don’t you? The Family has decided to invest everything into Yang Fan. Forget about you; even your mother and I are worth less than him now,” Luo Xuan comforted him.
“Do I really have to leave?” Luo Mingxuan asked, unwilling to accept it.
Without the Family, he would have no stable supply of resources.
How would his Divine Kingdom develop in the future?

“It’s non-negotiable. I’ll find a distant county-level city for you to live in and buy you a villa. In the future, you... forget it, it doesn’t matter anymore.” Luo Xuan waved his hand, his gaze turning colder.
Luo Mingxuan was considered the most talented among his descendants, but he hadn’t expected the boy to cause such a disaster under his pampering.
Now that this child was essentially ruined, he had to consider starting over with a new one.
Seeing his father’s attitude, Luo Mingxuan lowered his head, a trace of resentment flashing in his eyes.
Virtual World, Class 1’s classroom.

“Student Yang Fan has been admitted to Primordial Academy without examination. The College Entrance Examination is coming up soon, so you all must work hard as well. After all, you were once high school classmates, and there is some sentiment there,” Cao Wang announced.
The students in the class looked at each other, their eyes filled with shock, envy, and a hint of regret.
The terrifying scene in the sky earlier had already spread through the class group.
Primordial Academy had sent a Tier 3 God to personally welcome Yang Fan; the level of importance they placed on him was clear.
The development of a Divine Kingdom depends on talent, and even more so on resources.
There was no doubt that in the future, Yang Fan would be an existence they could only look up to.
The problem was, eighty to ninety percent of the class had targeted Yang Fan before.
Sentiment my ass!
At this moment, someone looked at Li Tianheng with a hint of blame in their eyes.
“It’s one thing for you to do it, but you dragged us along to bully him. Now look—there’s no chance of benefiting from his success in the future.”
Li Tianheng stared down at his desk, his eyes hollow, motionless.
Inside the hull of the space vessel, there was a sense of nothingness, with countless electronic data points flowing continuously across the surrounding walls.
“Your Highness, my name is Tang Yue. I will be responsible for your safety until you achieve a Breakthrough to godhood.”
Unlike the tone she used when speaking with Hong Bing, Tang Yue’s voice was now very soft.
“Why do you call me ‘Your Highness’?”

“It is the rule of Taichu City. According to the potential ratings of the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life, those at the Prodigy level are to be addressed as ‘Your Highness’,” Tang Yue explained patiently.
Yang Fan looked at her in confusion.
“I’m curious, why did I receive such a rating?”

“According to the Divine Kingdom Awakening records, Your Highness’s talent is an F-rank Resource Talent. However, after reviewing your past performance, the Intelligent Life concluded that Your Highness 100% possesses a hidden talent, and of a high rank at that.”
As Tang Yue finished speaking, Yang Fan felt as if his heart had been squeezed.
His SSS-rank Talent was his greatest secret.
Could it be about to be exposed?
Taichu City was different from Yang County; it was one of the most prosperous cities in the entire Human Federation, home to countless high-order gods.
Yang Fan was now somewhat worried that Primordial Academy would have a way to detect his talent.
It wasn’t that Yang Fan didn’t trust the human higher-ups, but some secrets became less safe the more people knew them.

Tang Yue didn’t notice anything wrong with Yang Fan and continued to explain, “Hidden talents cannot be detected directly. Sometimes even the gods themselves might not be aware of them. It’s normal for Your Highness not to understand your own potential.”
“One might not even notice it themselves?” Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
He had known about his SSS-rank Talent since his Divine Kingdom Awakening; it was just that it couldn’t be detected by the outside world once hidden.
From the looks of it, his talent might not be as simple as the hidden talent she mentioned.

“Correct. Due to the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom’s laws, even the Federation’s highest Intelligent Life cannot precisely detect a hidden talent. It can only infer the specific talent through other evidence using big data.”
“For example, by analyzing the gene sequences of believers, the age of fossils, tree rings, and changes in the soil and air within the Divine Kingdom, a general conclusion can be reached.”
As Tang Yue spoke, she took out an electronic tablet from her pocket and held it before Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Federal Citizen Yang Fan. Detected talent: F-rank Resource. Total resource investment in the Divine Kingdom: Low. Judgment: The hidden talent is highly likely related to the flow of time.”
Looking at the content on the panel, Yang Fan’s heart leaped into his throat once again.
The inference alone had already guessed his talent almost exactly.
As expected of the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life; its computing power was terrifying.

Tang Yue said calmly, “Yang County is approximately 2 billion light-years away from Taichu City. The ship needs to traverse the Dark Universe, which will take a total of one day. Before then, I will help you test your talent.”
“How?”
“I have brought the equipment. Your Highness, please sit inside and follow the instructions of the Intelligent Life.”
Tang Yue pointed toward the hemispherical space in the center.
Yang Fan took a deep breath.
With a thought, he paused his Evolution Talent and stepped inside.
“Verifying identity: Federal Citizen Yang Fan. Identity verification successful. Please release the restrictions on your Divine Kingdom.”
As Yang Fan released the restrictions, a large number of mini-robots suddenly appeared within his Divine Kingdom.

“Soil collection successful. Ore collection successful. Water source collection successful. Divine Kingdom air negative pressure absorption in progress. Blood extraction from Mortal, First-Order, Second-Order, Third-Order, Fourth-Order, and Fifth-Order believers completed...”
One notification after another rang in Yang Fan’s ears.
Such a massive workload was entirely completed in just a few breaths.
“All data collection complete. Analysis beginning.”
“Analysis concluded. Federal Citizen Yang Fan possesses an S-rank Talent: Tenfold Time Sequence.”
Then, the machine Yang Fan was in stopped rotating, and the hatch opened.
Outside, Tang Yue was looking at the information on her tablet.
Her expression showed no surprise; instead, she had a “just as I thought” look.
“Your Highness, these are your current identity details.”
Looking at the content on the tablet, the worry in Yang Fan’s heart eased considerably.
“Name: Yang Fan;”
“Status: Primordial Academy Student (Divine Being);”
“Talent: Tenfold Time Sequence (S-rank);”
“Evaluation: Human Race Prodigy (Information locked).”
His SSS-rank Talent hadn’t been discovered; instead, it had been mistaken for another talent.
Tenfold Time Sequence—just by looking at the name, Yang Fan could guess its general nature.
Since the Divine Kingdom Awakening, hadn’t his Divine Kingdom been developing at ten times the speed of others?
From this, it was clear that the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life really was something; it had grasped the general situation of his Divine Kingdom so easily.
Perhaps it was because the effect of his current Evolution Talent was similar to Tenfold Time Sequence that the Intelligent Life had made an error in judgment.
“Congratulations, Your Highness. The S-rank Talent, Tenfold Time Sequence, provides a massive advantage in the early stages of a Divine Kingdom’s development.”
“What are the effects of this talent?” Yang Fan asked curiously.
“During this year since your Divine Kingdom Awakening, Your Highness should have felt that the development speed of your Divine Kingdom is far faster than that of others, right?”
“Yes.” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
On the surface, Yang Fan feigned a look of sudden realization, but internally, he was in a completely different state of mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: A City in Reality
paragraphs: Under the acceleration of the ten-fold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was completely aware of the changes in his Divine Kingdom; far from feeling strange, it was entirely under his control.

“Once the Tenfold Time Sequence talent is activated, the flow of time in the Divine Kingdom becomes different from others. For ordinary gods, one day in the real world is one year in the Divine Kingdom, but for Your Highness, the believers in your Divine Kingdom can have ten years of Cultivation time.”
“However, this talent also has a massive flaw, which is the excessive consumption of resources.”

“This talent draws a vast amount of energy from the Divine Kingdom. Except for the believers, other living creatures and plants will die in large numbers. If used improperly, it could even cause the overall collapse of the Divine Kingdom.”

“According to records, there was once a student in our academy who forcibly used this talent despite insufficient resources, leading to the collapse of their Divine Kingdom and their death, his Dao extinguished.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan feigned an enlightened expression on the surface, but waves of shock surged within his heart.
Compared to the S-rank Talent Tenfold Time Sequence, his Evolution Talent could be said to have virtually zero consumption.
With Yang Fan’s current strength, he still only needed one thousand Faith Points a day to activate his Evolution Talent.
What was 1,000 Faith Points?
To the current Yang Fan, how was it any different from no consumption at all?
The S-rank Talent Tenfold Time Sequence seemed more like draining other energies from the Divine Kingdom to accelerate the growth of believers.

In contrast, the Evolution Talent seemed to accelerate the evolution of the entire Divine Kingdom under higher-dimensional rules; not just the believers, but even the plants, soil, and rocks were evolving.
These two talents appeared similar on the surface, but in reality, the difference was immense.
One was like pulling up seedlings to help them grow, increasing the believers’ strength, while the other fundamentally pushed the continuous development of the entire Divine Kingdom.
“As expected of an SSS-rank Talent, it truly is extraordinary!” Yang Fan marveled in his heart.

Seeing Yang Fan in deep thought, Tang Yue thought he was worried about his Divine Kingdom collapsing and couldn’t help but comfort him: “Your Highness, there is no need to worry. The resource consumption of your talent is related to the overall strength of your Divine Kingdom.”
“The stronger the strength, the greater the energy consumption. Before your Breakthrough to becoming a god, there is absolutely no need to worry.”

“I suggest that Your Highness purchase more resource-type buildings before graduation, especially resource points like Spiritual Veins that can continuously produce Spiritual Qi and even change the environment of the entire Divine Kingdom. This will better protect your Divine Kingdom.”
“Thank you,” Yang Fan nodded.
Thinking of the Spiritual Vein in his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan could guess now.
The Federation’s Intelligent Life had likely already reached this conclusion, which was why it had rewarded him with a Spiritual Vein.
The spaceship journey only took one day.
With Yang Fan’s current physique, he wouldn’t feel sleepy even if he didn’t sleep for a night.
Along the way, he asked about many rules of Taichu City and obtained a lot of useful information.
What shocked Yang Fan the most was that for an S-rank Talent like his, Primordial Academy recruited over a thousand such people every year.
While Yang Fan was shocked by the sheer number of Human Race Prodigies, he also felt much more at ease.
It seemed that in a gathering place for Prodigies like Primordial Academy, even if he was misunderstood as having an S-rank Talent, it was no big deal.

In a remote place like Yang County, the status of a Human Race Prodigy was like being under a spotlight, but in the eyes of the high-level gods in Taichu City, it was more like being a young person worth nurturing.

“Your Highness, we will arrive at Taichu City shortly. This is the Access Key. Whether in the real world or the Virtual World, an Access Key is required to enter Taichu City. You can store it in your Divine Kingdom.” Tang Yue took out a chip the size of a fingernail and handed it to Yang Fan.
“Has Your Highness purchased any Intelligent Life?”
“Yes,” Yang Fan nodded.

“This USB drive contains all the information about Taichu City, including detailed explanations of the Primordial Academy, Primordial Battlefield, and the Alien Divine Kingdom zone. You can have your Intelligent Life learn from it to help you adapt to Taichu City faster.”
“Thank you!”
With a slight vibration, Yang Fan felt a flash of light in his eyes, and the front door of the cabin slowly opened.
Yang Fan stepped out.
In the next instant, the world before his eyes completely changed.
Taichu City was not as tranquil as expected.
As far as the eye could see, it was a nearly boundless steel metropolis.
Buildings towering into the clouds pierced the sky, their exterior walls flowing with light and data; the entire city seemed like a massive machine in operation.
In mid-air, countless levitation tracks crisscrossed, and flying vehicles streaked past like meteors, trailing tails of light.
What was even more shocking were the people.
On the streets, the flow of people was like a tide.
This wasn’t a virtual projection or a remote consciousness connection; it was a real, dense, and almost crowded crowd in reality.
The sounds of trading, bargaining, and mechanical prompt tones intertwined, forming a noisy yet highly orderly wave.

Some people opened holographic interfaces on the street to exchange resources; others carried physical containers to deliver high-value materials on the spot; there were even many gods’ auras moving low-profile through the crowd.
Information was flowing, resources were flowing, and wealth was flowing.
And everything was happening in reality.
It was completely different from the silence of the outside world, which was immersed in the Virtual World.
Yang Fan stood there, momentarily dazed, somewhat shocked, but mostly confused.

Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, Tang Yue smiled and said, “Taichu City is actually a planet located in the central region of the Human Federation. Primordial Academy is at the center of this planet, and what you see now is the Trading District.”
“Trading just like this?” Yang Fan’s heart was full of confusion.
“You want to ask why it’s not done in the Virtual World, right?”
“Yes, the efficiency is too low.” Yang Fan didn’t understand.
“There are many reasons. Private transactions can avoid taxes and save on transaction fees, and what is traded here are not ordinary materials, but strategic-grade resources.”
“Rare things are expensive; there are some items that cannot be bought even if you have Divinity Points.”

“Your Highness should cherish the time spent studying here. The Access Key for Taichu City will expire after graduation. By then, if you want to come here to trade again, it will be extremely difficult.”
Following Tang Yue, Yang Fan soon arrived at a small, detached courtyard.

At this moment, Tang Yue glanced at the residence with some envy and then said, “Your Highness, I live in a high-rise residence two blocks away. If you need to go to the Trading District or have any other needs to go out, just contact me directly. I will protect your safety. As for this area, it is the school zone, and no one dares to cause trouble here.”

“Finally, I have one more piece of advice for Your Highness. Your talent requires a large amount of resource support. If any companies want to sign a contract with you, you can choose to agree. Perhaps your freedom will be restricted in the future, but only by becoming stronger as quickly as possible can you go further.”
Yang Fan nodded, then watched as the other party hailed a taxi and left.
Even though a Tier 3 God could fly through the air, because Taichu City had a no-fly rule, she actually had to take public transportation like an ordinary Mortal.
Yang Fan was quite shocked by this.
To think that a Tier 3 God, who would be like a local tyrant in Yang County and could decide the fate of many with a single word, was like an ordinary worker here in Taichu City.
Even so, she still seemed proud to be able to reside in Taichu City.
When she was in the outside world, facing a powerhouse of the same Realm like Hong Bing, she had still acted in an overbearing manner.

To think that a Tier 3 God, who would be like a local tyrant in Yang County and could decide the fate of many with a single word, was like an ordinary worker here in Taichu City.
Even so, she still seemed proud to be able to reside in Taichu City.
When she was in the outside world, facing a powerhouse of the same Realm like Hong Bing, she had still acted in an overbearing manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: A Ruthless Way of Cultivation
paragraphs: The interior decoration of the detached small courtyard was very simple.
Aside from its large size, the decoration style was almost comparable to the layout of the Mingyue Community.
“Is Primordial Academy afraid we’ll indulge in enjoyment and wants us to be ascetic monks?” Yang Fan smiled bitterly.
As for his living environment in reality, Yang Fan didn’t care much.
Anyway, if he had any mental needs, he could solve them in the Virtual World.
“Yang Yi, have you finished processing the specific information about Taichu City?” Yang Fan asked as he entered the room.
“Reporting to Master, I have finished browsing.”
“Highlight the key points.”

“To cultivate the strong, the Federal Government spent heavily to build Primordial Star; the entire planet exists to serve Primordial Academy. Unlike other universities’ methods of cultivating students, there are no teachers to attend classes and no competitions between classmates here. The school adopts a completely free-range education.”
Yang Fan frowned upon hearing this.
“Then what am I here to learn?”
“It’s not that Master needs to learn, but your believers do. The believers need to attend classes to learn knowledge.”
“What do you mean? Can’t believers not enter the real world?” Yang Fan said in surprise.

According to the rules of the Divine Kingdom, inanimate objects within the Divine Kingdom, such as buildings and grain, can be manifested into reality through blank cards, but living beings with a Soul cannot.
If it were possible, the massive population would have caused the entire world to collapse long ago.

“It’s not reality, but a school established through the Virtual World. There, believers from high-level Divine Kingdoms teach knowledge. This includes Cultivation Techniques, Martial Skills, Blacksmiths, Alchemists, Alchemy Art, Mechanics... However, the fees for the Primordial Academy are very high and require a large amount of Divinity Points,” Yang Yi explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but feel that it was very novel.
He didn’t need to attend classes, but his believers did.
This teaching method directly overturned Yang Fan’s perception of university education.
On second thought, Yang Fan could understand.
If there were high-level believers giving guidance, the believers in his Divine Kingdom might be able to Breakthrough the Qi Refining Realm faster.

“Similar to the Divine Kingdom Battlefield Master experienced at Yang County No. 1 Middle School, Primordial Academy has also constructed a Primordial Battlefield in the Virtual World. The number of believers is set to ten million to fight against the Alien Army. The Primordial Battlefield tests the comprehensive strength of a god’s believers, using this to rank all the students of Primordial Academy. Rankings that enter the top one million, one hundred thousand, ten thousand, and one hundred will receive resource rewards respectively. This is also the only reward Primordial Academy openly gives to its students.”
“According to the regulations, Master needs to go to the Primordial Battlefield for the first test within three days.”
Yang Fan nodded in understanding.
“What are the graduation requirements for Primordial Academy?”

“There are two ways to graduate from Primordial Academy. The first is to Breakthrough to become a First-Order God, which results in automatic graduation. The second is to stay in Taichu City for four years. At that time, regardless of your strength, you will be forced to graduate and leave Taichu City.”
“I see,” Yang Fan sighed.
This Primordial Academy indeed believes in absolute freedom.
Even if you choose to play in Taichu City for four years, the school won’t care, and you can still graduate.
However, judging from what Tang Yue just said, living in Taichu City itself is a huge fortune.
It’s difficult even for gods to enter this place.
Presumably, no fool would choose to waste four years of their life here.

“The third most important area is the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone. This is a place where the Human Race specifically keeps alien gods in captivity, and their coordinates are completely open to students. You can choose to fight against real alien gods and even seize the other party’s Divine Kingdom Foundation.”

“Primordial Academy’s special reminder: Once you choose to participate in the war, the school’s gods will not interfere. The winner gets all of the opponent’s legacy, while the loser’s Divine Kingdom Foundation is seized, resulting in death and the dissipation of their Dao.”
“Primordial Academy requires strength to reach the Demigod level to be eligible to enter the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone. Master does not need to concern himself with this for now.”
Primordial Academy not only kept alien gods in captivity but also allowed its students to fight them on equal terms.
Hearing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but get a case of goosebumps.
With such a cruel education method, he wondered how many Geniuses died every year.
Perhaps for Primordial Academy, those Geniuses who hadn’t grown up were just a number.
Yang Fan thought back to when he took the midterm exam at Yang County No.
1 Middle School, and everyone felt that the assessment method Hong Bing chose was too cruel.
Now it seemed that Primordial Academy was the true place for raising Gu, even treating its own students and alien gods as equals.
“The cultivation method is ruthless enough!” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Although he sighed a bit, Yang Fan wasn’t worried.
This Alien Divine Kingdom Zone wasn’t mandatory; if he felt it was dangerous, he could simply lie flat.

“Finally, there are the trading channels of the entire Taichu City. In the outside world, if you want strategic-grade buildings, you must obtain them through pioneering by plundering the core assets of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom. But in Taichu City, they can be obtained through purchase or barter.”
“However, the items traded within Taichu City are not connected to the network and require offline transactions,” Yang Yi continued.
“In addition, I also found the official group chat for this year’s Primordial Academy freshmen and have already added Master to it.”
Yang Fan opened his wristwatch upon hearing this and indeed found 99+ messages.
“Taichu Freshmen Group (10000+)”
Opening the group chat, Yang Fan saw messages constantly scrolling across the screen.
“Everyone joining the group now must be from the early admissions batch, right?”

“This Taichu City is really amazing. I just saw an S-Rank Building in the trading area. But the other party saw that I was only a Divine Being and wasn’t even interested in giving a quote, so they told me to get lost.”
“Have you guys been to the Primordial Battlefield? My rank is actually over two million. I’m so bummed.”
“Is anyone organizing a dinner?”
There were too many people in the group, and most were just chatting back and forth without any useful information.
Yang Fan closed the group chat, put on his helmet, and entered the Virtual World.
As his permissions increased, the category classifications in the Virtual World had now changed.
Besides the existing sections like the Mall, God Forum, and Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, a label for ‘Taichu City’ had been added at the very top.
Yang Fan could feel that as long as he lightly tapped the three words ‘Taichu City’, his consciousness could enter it.
“As expected of Taichu City, it was actually listed as a separate section in the Virtual World,” Yang Fan sighed.
Just then, he suddenly received an invitation from Luo Rou.
Tapping the coordinates, Yang Fan’s consciousness was directly teleported into the room at the Yangcheng Villa.
“Husband, have you already arrived at Taichu City?” Luo Rou came over and asked, hugging Yang Fan’s shoulder.
Yang Fan nodded.
“I arrived not long ago and only now have time to log into the Virtual World.”
“That’s a legendary city. Even the god Elders of the Luo Family have never been there. What’s different about it?” Luo Rou was like a curious baby at this moment.
“It’s hard to evaluate!” Yang Fan said.
The buildings in Taichu City weren’t very fancy and even seemed a bit ordinary compared to its reputation.
However, the way Primordial Academy cultivated its students and the liveliness there were indeed different from the outside world.
Like in Yang County, it was hard to see people on the streets because everyone’s primary way of life was in the Virtual World.
When Yang Fan was in his third year of high school, he didn’t even go to school a few times a year.
But Taichu City was so lively; it was almost like a wet market.
There were too many things to complain about, and Yang Fan didn’t know how to explain it to Luo Rou.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Primordial Academy Company Recruitment
paragraphs: “Husband, I have good news! My Divine Realm has just recovered!” Luo Rou said with a face full of joy.
“Is that so? That’s great!” Yang Fan was not too surprised; given his current status, Luo Rou’s value within the Luo Family had also soared.

“The Family Head went to Tiannan City to invite a Fourth-rank God to help. Once that lord’s believers entered my Divine Realm, with just a gentle wave, all the poison from the Death Spider Emperor was purified by a soft power...”
Luo Rou was perhaps too excited and spoke at great length with Yang Fan.
After comforting Luo Rou, Yang Fan entered Taichu City.
According to the regulations of Primordial Academy, he had to participate in the Primordial Battlefield as soon as possible.
The Virtual World fully manifested the entire Taichu City, though this place was quite different from reality; the biggest difference was the lack of liveliness and the complete absence of sound.
With a thought from Yang Fan, his consciousness was drawn into the Primordial Battlefield.
“Freshman Yang Fan, participating for the first time. Do you wish to connect your Divine Realm and manifest your believers immediately?” the voice of the Intelligent Life echoed in his mind.
“Yes.” Yang Fan nodded; he had already had Yang Yi arrange the army.
Forty-six Fifth-rank creatures, fifty thousand Fourth-rank creatures, two million Third-rank creatures, and nearly eight million Second-rank creatures.
This was the strongest population currently in Yang Fan’s Divine Realm.
Since this was the Virtual World and believers would not suffer any actual damage, Yang Fan naturally deployed his strongest forces.
“Yang Er, you will take command next,” Yang Fan ordered.

Although Yang Er was an exploration-type high-level Intelligent Life, commanding ten million believers in battle was more than enough for him—at least, he was much stronger at it than Yang Fan himself.
Countless alien beings appeared opposite the army.
Apes, wolf demons, tigers, lions...
The alien beings seemed endless: 10 million, 20 million, 30 million...
“Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array, Defend.” Yang Er divided the believer army into ten teams, using the power of the Formation to block the alien army.
The beings manifested by the Virtual World were extremely realistic; flesh and blood flew where they clashed, and the thick smell of blood instantly permeated the entire battlefield.
In less than ten breaths, the war was already over.
The ten million believers manifested by Yang Fan had all fallen.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help but be stunned.
“The intensity of this Primordial Battlefield is this high?”
At the very beginning, those alien beings were only First-rank, but after one breath, they all became Second-rank, then Third-rank.
What was even more terrifying was that their numbers were simply endless, basically four to five times his own military force.
If he hadn’t comprehended the Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array, Yang Fan even doubted whether these ten million believers could have lasted for five breaths.
While he was reflecting, the prompt from the Intelligent Life here also echoed in his mind.
“Current assessment concluded:
Student: Yang Fan
Identity: Divine Being
Divine Realm Talent: Tenfold Time Sequence
School Ranking: 8.42 million
First-time Experience Reward: 1,000 years of free course hours.”
Returning to reality, Yang Fan took off the helmet, somewhat shocked by his ranking.
Over eight million—was his strength really that weak?
Just how many students were there in this Primordial Academy?
Yang Fan asked in his heart, “Yang Yi, how many students are in Primordial Academy?”

“Reporting to Master, Primordial Academy recruits from the entire Human Race. According to historical data, it recruits fewer than 10 Peerless Prodigies, about 2,000 Human Race Prodigies, 100,000 Grade A Geniuses, 500,000 Grade B Geniuses, and between 2 to 3 million Grade C and Grade D Geniuses each year. The Primordial Battlefield rankings include all students from freshman to senior years, among whom there are over 2 million Demigod existences,” Yang Yi replied.
According to what Yang Yi said, all the students of Primordial Academy added up were at least in the tens of millions.
“As expected of Primordial Academy. No wonder they don’t care if those geniuses are killed by alien gods; in their eyes, geniuses truly are just a number!” Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow hard.
One had to realize that Yang Fan’s Divine Realm currently only had about forty million believers, while the data just now referred to people in the real world.
As expected of one of the highest-specification academies for humanity, it was simply terrifying.
“What are these free course hours?”

“Study time available at the Primordial Academy. The time flow within the Study Hall is the same as in the Divine Realm—one day in the outside world is one year in the Study Hall. However, these thousand years represent the total study duration for a single believer,” Yang Yi explained.
“For a single believer!” Yang Fan’s expression changed drastically.
Currently, the believers in his Divine Realm numbered as many as forty million; if averaged out, each person wouldn’t even get half a day.
“Reporting to Master, the Study Hall is the largest place of consumption in Primordial Academy; one divinity point can only be exchanged for 100 years of course hours.”
“In other words, I only received a reward of ten Divinity Points for participating in the Primordial Battlefield just now?” Yang Fan rolled his eyes, feeling that Primordial Academy was too stingy.

“Primordial Academy’s move is mainly to let students understand the benefits of the Study Hall. As for the real rewards of the Primordial Battlefield, they can only be obtained after entering the top one million.”

“Master, not all believers attend the Study Hall together. Master can choose believers with corresponding talents to enter. For example, believers with cultivation talent can go to learn Cultivation Techniques and Martial Skills, while believers with forging talent can go to learn forging skills. High-level skills cannot be purchased directly from the mall and require believers to figure them out on their own, and the Primordial Academy can significantly shorten this time. The various skills learned are accumulated as knowledge and then passed down from generation to generation within the Divine Realm. This is the correct way to use the Study Hall.”
“So that’s how it is.” Yang Fan showed a look of realization.
Unlike simple skills like gathering and hunting, abilities such as Cultivation Techniques, Blacksmithing, and Alchemists are not easily comprehended.
Currently, none of his believers had even reached Minor Achievement in their comprehension of the B-rank Cultivation Technique, the Everlasting Spring Technique.
If they could comprehend the technique in the Study Hall, their cultivation speed would be significantly accelerated upon returning to the Divine Realm.
“Yang Yi, select one thousand believers with the best talent to enter the Primordial Academy to study the technique. Let’s see the results first,” Yang Fan ordered.
“Yes, Master, I will arrange it immediately. After a search, the Primordial Academy has Foundation Establishment Realm believers specifically for teaching the Everlasting Spring Technique.”
“Report the results to me tomorrow. If the effect is significant, we will purchase course hours in bulk to quickly improve the believers’ strength.”
“Yes.”
Yang Fan was not short on funds now; if the Primordial Academy’s effects were significant, then he wouldn’t mind speeding things up for his believers.
Just as Yang Fan was considering whether to visit the trading area, he suddenly heard a knock on the door.
Knock knock knock.
Yang Fan opened the door and found a man in a business suit standing outside.
“You must be Your Highness Yang Fan?” the visitor asked respectfully.
“And you are?” Yang Fan’s expression tightened.
Sensing the other party’s aura, he was definitely a Low-rank God.

“I am a lawyer from Yuandan Co., Ltd., and I hope to sign an investment contract with Your Highness. These are the contents of the contract. If Your Highness has any interest after reading it, you can contact me at any time.” After handing the contract to Yang Fan, the man bowed and then turned and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Prodigy Classmates
paragraphs: Opening the contract, Yang Fan’s expression suddenly turned to one of pleasant surprise, followed by a tight frown, before he finally threw the contract directly into the trash can.
The investment from the Yuandan Co., Ltd.

was truly not low; once signed, he would first receive a capital subsidy of one hundred thousand Divinity Points, along with ten resource-type buildings valued at no less than three thousand Divinity Points each.
This was only the initial investment; as Yang Fan achieved his Breakthrough to demigod, the rewards would increase significantly.
As expected of a company from Taichu City, they were generous with their offers, but the conditions were equally harsh.
The other party required Yang Fan to sign a thousand-year labor contract with Yuandan Co., Ltd.
after becoming a god, and 20% of all proceeds from the Divine Kingdom Battlefield would have to be handed over to the company for free.
With such draconian terms, no matter how lavish the investment, Yang Fan would never choose to agree.
“As expected, there’s no such thing as a free lunch in this world. It’s a pity no one is recruiting me to be a live-in son-in-law anymore!” Yang Fan laughed self-deprecatingly.
Yang Fan was no longer that poor kid from Mingyue Community; he already had enough capital.
Under his Ten-fold Evolution Talent, the resource output of his Divine Kingdom could now easily cover the expenses of his believers.
Under such circumstances, why would he give up long-term freedom for short-term interests?
“Ding-ling-ling,” the bell rang again.
“Are there really this many investment companies?” Yang Fan sighed and pulled open the door.
“You... you are?” Yang Fan looked at the visitor with some curiosity.
Standing before him was a massive fat man, 1.8 meters tall and weighing over three hundred catties.

The other party was a Divine Being just like Yang Fan, but the clothes he wore displayed runes at every moment, and his divine aura was fully revealed; one could tell at a glance they were no ordinary items.
“Sima Bang, I live next door. Just coming over for a visit,” the other party responded.
Yang Fan glanced at the small attic next door and said politely, “Yang Fan, I just enrolled today.”
“Come on, let’s go eat. There are only four Prodigies in this area, and now that we’re all here, let’s have a small gathering.” Sima Bang pointed behind him, signaling for Yang Fan to follow.
The other party didn’t seem to have considered that Yang Fan might refuse, and immediately led the way, waddling his backside which was three times the size of a normal person’s.
“What did this brother grow up eating? At this rate, surpassing Luo Tietie is just around the corner,” Yang Fan complained inwardly.
Since he had nothing to do anyway, Yang Fan naturally wouldn’t refuse to give the other party Face.
Not far from where they lived, there really was a restaurant.
“Greetings, Your Highness Sima.” The waiter in front of the restaurant was all smiles.
“Bring out a serving of your signature Phoenix Feather Feet; don’t worry about anything else,” Sima Bang said with a wave of his hand.
“Right away, Your Highness, this way please.”
Yang Fan followed him and soon arrived at the most luxurious private room on the third floor.
Pushing open the door, two people were already sitting inside, one man and one woman.
The man had sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, and the aura emanating from him was incredibly powerful, appearing to be just a step away from a Breakthrough to demigod.
The woman had a quiet temperament; sitting there, she was like a pool of seawater, calm and without waves.

“The last brother has arrived, so I called you guys over for a gathering. In the future here in Taichu City, there will be many places where we’ll need to cooperate, so let’s get to know each other and make friends.”
Sima Bang took the seat of honor and gave Yang Fan a look, gesturing for him to sit down and talk.
“Ye Jianfeng, from the direct line of the Beihai Ye Family, S-rank talent Myriad Sword Body, Cultivation path.”
“Wen Yushui, of the Wen Family from Tiannan City, S-rank talent Water Deity, Cultivation path.”
“I’ve already told you my name. I am the 107th son of the head of the Sima Family in Taichu City. My talent is S-rank Devour, Martial Arts path.”
The three of them introduced themselves respectively.
“I am Yang Fan, S-rank talent Tenfold Time Sequence, Cultivation path,” Yang Fan introduced himself as well.
“Surname Yang? From the Lingnan Yang Family?” Sima Bang asked curiously.
“No, I come from Yang County, a remote place. I am not from a Great Family,” Yang Fan replied truthfully.
As soon as he entered the room, Yang Fan could see that these three were all stronger than him, and the temperament they exuded clearly marked them as direct descendants of Great Families.
Unlike Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, the temperament of these three was more noble, as if they had occupied high positions for a long time.
Although their behavior was approachable, the pride in their eyes could not be hidden.
“Yang County?” Wen Yushui frowned slightly, feeling as if she had heard of this place before.
“Since we’ve all introduced ourselves, let’s eat first and chat while we eat.”
Sima Bang snapped his fingers, and a card appeared in his hand.
Then, a large amount of food manifested from the card onto the dining table.
There were only four people in the entire private room, but it was a large table for twenty, and it was now completely piled high with various dishes.
“I’m starving. Sorry, I’m going to start eating first. Because of my Divine Kingdom talent, not only are my believers particularly big eaters, but I am too. Please don’t mind, you three!”
While speaking, Sima Bang first used his chopsticks to put a large piece of meat into Yang Fan’s bowl, and then pulled the remaining two-thirds of the meat in front of himself.
“Don’t be shy, brother. I already know these two. You guys chat, don’t mind me,” Sima Bang said casually.
He seemed truly famished; as he wolfed it down, that large plate of meat was swallowed into his stomach in just two or three bites.
Looking at the unknown precious meat in his bowl, Yang Fan was somewhat shocked.
Although he didn’t know what kind of Yao Beast meat it was, the terrifying life energy it emanated made him feel full just by taking a sniff.
It was hard to imagine that Sima Bang could feast on such high-energy food with such gusto.
“Is it because of the S-rank Devour talent?” Yang Fan wondered to himself.

“Brother Yang, this is Water Flood-Dragon meat from a Foundation Establishment stage Great Yao. I ate a bowl of it the day before yesterday and my stomach still feels uncomfortable. We don’t have Young Master Sima’s good stomach, so take it easy,” Ye Jianfeng reminded him from the side.
“Thank you,” Yang Fan said gratefully after taking a small taste.
With a wave of her right hand, Wen Yushui made a teapot appear on the table.
“This is Mind-Refreshing Tea, a specialty from my Divine Kingdom. Since Young Master Sima is eating such greasy food, why not have some plain tea with it?”
Wen Yushui poured a cup for all three of them.

“This Mind-Refreshing Tea of yours is really not bad; it’s refreshing in the mouth. How much stock do you have? Why not sell it all to me, I’ll let my believers have a taste too,” mumbled Sima Bang while still chewing food.
“There are still two tons in the Divine Kingdom’s stock; I’ll just give it to Young Master Sima,” Wen Yushui said indifferently.
Ye Jianfeng also took out a large plate of golden-yellow fruit from his Divine Kingdom.
“This is Sword Spirit Fruit; it tastes pretty good. Young Master Sima and Brother Yang can both try some.”
Yang Fan could see that the primary focus of Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui was on Sima Bang, and their intention to curry favor was very obvious.
This was likely related to the Sima Family behind him; the background of a Family that could stand tall in a place like Taichu City could well be imagined.
Seeing that all three had taken out specialties from their Divine Kingdoms to entertain, Yang Fan likewise took out the Monkey Wine he had brewed.
Smelling the wine’s fragrance, Sima Bang’s eyes lit up, and he directly snatched the entire wine pot over.
“Monkey Wine! I haven’t drunk this in a long time. I didn’t expect Brother Yang’s Divine Kingdom to produce this too?” Sima Bang said somewhat nostalgically.
The other party drank the entire pot of Monkey Wine in one gulp!
Faced with this unconventional behavior, Yang Fan didn’t mind at all and took out ten full jars from his Divine Kingdom and placed them on the table.
Seeing this scene, the looks in Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui’s eyes as they watched Yang Fan changed slightly.
Although Yang Fan had no background, it now seemed that the foundation of his Divine Kingdom was not bad.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Human Race Faction Divisions
paragraphs: The three of them were not too surprised.
For an ordinary person to be admitted in advance by Primordial Academy, it certainly wouldn’t be as simple as having just an S-rank Talent; having some Opportunity was also normal.
“This Monkey Wine can enhance the Comprehension Ability of believers. I wonder if Brother Yang’s Divine Kingdom can mass-produce it. We can trade privately to avoid taxes,” Ye Jianfeng asked.
Yang Fan nodded.
“I wonder how much Brother Ye wants?”
“Ten thousand pots a month.”
“Very well.” Yang Fan nodded and agreed.
Even descendants of large families like Ye Jianfeng would also consider lawful tax avoidance.
“Brother Yang’s Divine Kingdom has truly profound foundations to be able to produce ten thousand pots of Monkey Wine every month. Impressive!” Wen Yushui said with envy.
Producing ten thousand pots of Monkey Wine every month meant that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had set up at least 100 Monkey Wine Springs.
For a Divine Being to possess this much Divine Kingdom asset was not much worse compared to the Prodigies from their big families.
“This is the main income of my Divine Kingdom, and I am currently relying on these Monkey Wine Springs to support it,” Yang Fan responded with a smile.
Ye Jianfeng glanced at Yang Fan.

“Brother Yang, since you are not from a Family descendant, why not seek the backing of a major faction? If you can get Young Master Sima’s recommendation, the future development of your Divine Kingdom will definitely be smooth sailing.”
“Don’t flatter me. I am just an unfavored one at home, and I don’t have the ability to recommend people.”

“The matters of investing in Geniuses with different surnames in my Sima Family are all managed by my third brother. If Old Yang needs it, I can help mention it, and by then there might be specialized lawyers to coordinate with you.”
Sima Bang was eating while speaking, yet his voice was extremely clear.
As the son of the Sima Family head, recommending a Genius was something he could still manage.
However, right now he and Yang Fan could only be considered ordinary friends who had just met.
The reason they were sitting together for dinner was entirely because they were all rated as Human Race Prodigies, possessing equal value.
Don’t look at Sima Bang as looking like a fat pig; being able to grow up within the Sima Family, he naturally couldn’t be a fool.
The most important word in interpersonal relationships is ‘benefit’.
Right now, the relationship among the four was merely that of ordinary drinking and dining friends; how could Sima Bang easily mobilize his network just because of a first meeting.

“That’s truly a pity. The Sima Family is one of the Five Great Giants after all. If I didn’t already have a Family, I would want to follow Young Master Sima and mix with him,” Ye Jianfeng said with a smile.
“Five Great Giants?” Yang Fan’s expression showed a look of curiosity.
“Brother Yang doesn’t know?”
“I just arrived in Taichu City.”
Looking at the other party’s shocked gaze, Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat awkward.
Having grown up in a remote place like Yang County, he really didn’t know the faction divisions of the Human Federation.
In just over ten minutes, Sima Bang had swept away the food on the table like a storm sweeping away clouds.
He wiped his mouth and said, “The two strongest factions of the entire Human Race are the Federal Government and the Virtual Universe Company.”

“The Federal Government controls the law and the military, and is the nominal supreme ruling body. Meanwhile, the Virtual Universe Company monopolizes the consciousness network, Divine Kingdom transactions, and data Systems, mastering 70% of the information and resource distribution channels.”
“Beneath them are the Five Great Giants families.”
“My Sima Family is an old-established aristocratic Family, controlling multiple core resource planets, leading strategic resource extraction and military supplies.”

“The Lu Corporation is known for its capital, with the broadest layout, deeply participating in the virtual Universe industry and Divine Kingdom transaction System, and is one of the Federation’s largest resource circulation hubs.”
“The Han Family Military Government has garrisoned the border Star Domains year-round, fighting against alien invasions, mastering elite deity legions and large-scale warfare resources.”

“The Gu Family Spirit Domain specializes in cultivation Systems and resource cultivation, controlling a large number of Spirit Plant Stars and Spirit Vein Planets, and is the main supplier of Medicinal Pills and spiritual materials.”

“The Qin Technology Alliance controls high-end weapons, space wormhole navigation, and the research and development of Divine Kingdom auxiliary Systems, and is the core promoter of federal technology.”
Sima Bang did not despise Yang Fan for his lack of experience, but instead patiently explained.

Wen Yushui on the side also added, “The factions of the Five Great Giants are stationed in different Star Domains, fighting against alien races year-round, acquiring resources and expanding their factions through war.”

“At the same time, through methods such as capital injection and holding shares, they deeply penetrate various industries of the Federation. From resource extraction and Divine Kingdom construction to virtual transactions and weapon manufacturing, everything is within their control.”
“Take our Wen Family for example. On the surface, we are the number one Family in Tiannan City, but in reality, 40% of the Family’s shares are controlled under the Lu Corporation.”
Yang Fan also understood.

Although the Five Great Giants were one level lower than the Virtual Universe Company and the Federal Government, in reality, the major factions check and balance each other, mutually infiltrating, forming a network of interests that encompasses the entire Human Race.
No wonder Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui were so polite to Sima Bang; it turned out the other party was a second-generation rich kid from a super aristocratic Family.
“Miss Wen, isn’t your Wen Family’s sphere of influence belonging to Xingqiong Academy? Why did you come here to enroll?” Ye Jianfeng asked curiously.
“Hiding from someone.” Wen Yushui’s gaze turned cold.
Seeing that the other party did not want to answer, Ye Jianfeng politely did not continue to press.

Seeing this, he changed the subject and continued, “Do you know? There is a Genius in our batch who rushed into the top 900,000 the first time he participated in the Primordial Battlefield. Too fierce.”
“Then isn’t he already a demigod powerhouse back in high school!” Wen Yushui’s eyes lit up.
“More than that, being able to enter the top one million in the school, even among demigods, he is an outstanding figure. I really don’t know what kind of Talent he has.”
“SS-rank.” Sima Bang paused in his tone and said.
“Young Master Sima knows?” Wen Yushui asked curiously.
“An outsider Genius of my Sima Family, Ma Huainan. SS-rank Talent Martial God Body, he already had believers of the Martial Disciple Realm in the first semester of his third year of high school.”
Speaking of this, Sima Bang’s expression was somewhat unsightly.
However, the two of Ye Jianfeng did not notice the change in the other’s expression, and at this moment they still had faces full of envy.
Under normal circumstances, students with S-rank Talent like them wanted to break into the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield, which would take at least sophomore or even junior year.
As expected of a Genius with SS-rank Talent, perhaps they wouldn’t even need four years before the other party could Breakthrough to a deity.
Coming to a Holy Land of the Human Race like Primordial Academy, past achievements really didn’t count for much.

“I pulled a small group chat, you guys accept it. Any news can be shared, and if there are strategic-level resource buildings that your own Divine Kingdom doesn’t need, we can also trade privately,” Sima Bang said.
None of the three had any objections to this.
Right now, everyone was still a student, focusing on developing their Divine Kingdoms.
Becoming a deity in the future meant participating in the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Making friends, helping each other, and uniting and cooperating.
This was the consensus among deities.
The three followed Sima Bang downstairs, and his fat body directly crammed the entire staircase.
“Ouch, who is it, you damn fat—”
In the stairwell, a youth was squeezed down and was about to start cursing.
However, the moment he turned his head and saw Sima Bang and his group, his whole face turned pale with fright.
“Y-Your Highness.”
“Don’t block the way, get lost!” Ye Jianfeng’s gaze turned cold, and a trace of inexplicable Sword Intent pierced directly into the other person’s eyes.
“Ah.” The person who had just spoken retreated sharply, sat on the ground, clutching his eyes with a face full of pain.
