“Then isn’t he already a demigod powerhouse back in high school!” Wen Yushui’s eyes lit up.
“More than that, being able to enter the top one million in the school, even among demigods, he is an outstanding figure.
I really don’t know what kind of Talent he has.”
“SS-rank.” Sima Bang paused in his tone and said.
“Young Master Sima knows?” Wen Yushui asked curiously.
“An outsider Genius of my Sima Family, Ma Huainan.
SS-rank Talent Martial God Body, he already had believers of the Martial Disciple Realm in the first semester of his third year of high school.”
Speaking of this, Sima Bang’s expression was somewhat unsightly.
However, the two of Ye Jianfeng did not notice the change in the other’s expression, and at this moment they still had faces full of envy.
Under normal circumstances, students with S-rank Talent like them wanted to break into the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield, which would take at least sophomore or even junior year.
As expected of a Genius with SS-rank Talent, perhaps they wouldn’t even need four years before the other party could Breakthrough to a deity.
Coming to a Holy Land of the Human Race like Primordial Academy, past achievements really didn’t count for much.
“I pulled a small group chat, you guys accept it.
Any news can be shared, and if there are strategic-level resource buildings that your own Divine Kingdom doesn’t need, we can also trade privately,” Sima Bang said.
None of the three had any objections to this.
Right now, everyone was still a student, focusing on developing their Divine Kingdoms.
Becoming a deity in the future meant participating in the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Making friends, helping each other, and uniting and cooperating.
This was the consensus among deities.
The three followed Sima Bang downstairs, and his fat body directly crammed the entire staircase.
“Ouch, who is it, you damn fat—”
In the stairwell, a youth was squeezed down and was about to start cursing.
However, the moment he turned his head and saw Sima Bang and his group, his whole face turned pale with fright.
“Y-Your Highness.”
“Don’t block the way, get lost!” Ye Jianfeng’s gaze turned cold, and a trace of inexplicable Sword Intent pierced directly into the other person’s eyes.
“Ah.” The person who had just spoken retreated sharply, sat on the ground, clutching his eyes with a face full of pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Trading Area
paragraphs: Facing the scene before them, Sima Bang and the others’ expressions did not change much; instead, as if it were only natural, they walked straight out of the restaurant.
Yang Fan was somewhat surprised by this.
Ye Jianfeng, whose attitude at the dining table just now had been approachable, was actually so domineering towards other students.

“Was that Divine Power just now? To think he is a Divine Being just like me, yet he actually possesses such methods. As expected of a Genius from a major Family, truly extraordinary.” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
“Brother Yang, judging by your expression, do you think I went overboard with my action?” Ye Jianfeng turned his head and asked.
Yang Fan shook his head, “I’m just a bit surprised.”

“The Primordial Academy emphasizes potential as supreme, categorized into Prodigy, Prodigy, Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding. In Taichu City, those of lower ranks must salute those of higher ranks. As long as lives are not lost, beating these people up is of no consequence.”
“How do they know our identities?”

“The access keys can sense each other. If you see those Prodigy-level geniuses, it will issue a warning. Conversely, those without a warning prove that the other party’s rank is lower than yours. We are Human Race Prodigys, and the value we contribute at The Frontline in the future will far surpass Grade Jia geniuses. Even a Grade Jia demigod expert can be beaten by you, and the other party will definitely not dare to fight back, though the result might just be that your own hand hurts.” Ye Jianfeng said with a smile.
Hearing these words, Yang Fan gained a new understanding of the rules of Taichu City.
As long as no lives are taken, you can freely insult and beat geniuses of lower ranks than yours.
This educational model is forcing people to grow, indeed.

Wen Yushui stepped forward and joked, “We must all work hard. If we still cannot squeeze into the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield within two years, we will be demoted, and this younger sister certainly doesn’t want to be kicked out of the chat group by then.”
As she spoke, Wen Yushui also stuck out her tongue, acting cute.
“Let’s gather again when we have time. I’ll take you to the restaurant under the Sima Family then; it’s much more delicious than here.” Sima Bang waved his hand and walked toward his own courtyard.
Returning home, Yang Fan let out a soft sigh of relief.
Interacting with these descendants of major families was actually quite simple.
If you have strength and value, they will release goodwill.

If one day Yang Fan’s rating dropped to Grade Jia, I’m afraid the other party would kick him out of the chat group at the first instance, or even give him a harsh warning like that classmate just now.
“Strength!” Yang Fan murmured.
The next day, Yang Fan, who had awakened, entered his Divine Kingdom at the first moment.
“How is the effect of the Primordial Academy?” Yang Fan inquired.

“The effect is remarkable. Two believers have already comprehended the Everlasting Spring Technique to the Minor Achievement Realm, and the remaining believers have also made considerable progress in Cultivation Technique cultivation.” Yang Yi replied.
Yang Fan pinched his chin, “Yang Yi, how do you think the Divine Kingdom should develop next?”

“Reporting to Master, the Divine Kingdom has 10,340 Divinity Points. Given the current population of the Divine Kingdom, the believers worth cultivating are no less than 100,000, and the Primordial Academy still needs more funds invested. Besides this, Master should immediately go to the Taichu City trading area to find buildings similar to the immortal nurturing tower, the more the better. Master should spend all energy during the freshman year on breaking through to demigod.”
Yang Fan nodded and said, “In that case, increase the academy’s daily fund usage to twenty Divinity Points, temporarily using all of it to study the Everlasting Spring Technique.”
20 Divinity Points a day meant 600 a month, which was already a considerable burden for Yang Fan’s current Divine Kingdom resource output.
Although the funds inside Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were currently very abundant, he couldn’t dump all of them into the Primordial Academy.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan opened his wristband and sent a message to Tang Yue.
In less than a quarter of an hour, knocking sounded outside the door.
“Your Highness.” Tang Yue bowed in salute.
“Let’s go, accompany me to the trading area.”

Walking on the road, seeing that they were nearing their destination, Tang Yue slowly said, “Your Highness, the trading area is divided into resource-type buildings, special buildings, combat-power-type buildings, and Wonder-type buildings.”
“There are Wonders too?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.
“Of course, this is Taichu City. Strategic-grade resources can basically be bought here.” At this time, Tang Yue’s face was full of pride.
“Can everything be purchased?”

“With Your Highness’s current authority, you can purchase A-rank and below buildings. If evaluated as a Prodigy, or after breaking through to a God, the authority will be raised again.” Tang Yue explained.
“Take me to take a look first.” Yang Fan said calmly.
For Yang Fan now, B-Rank Buildings were of great help.
S-Rank Buildings were too far away from him, so there was no need to rush.
Arriving at the trading market, Yang Fan felt quite a few divine breaths.
The coercion inadvertently emitted by the other party made it difficult for him to even stand.
Fortunately, Tang Yue followed alongside, and the aura of a Tier 3 God on her body reduced a lot of pressure for him.
Unlike Yang County, there were too many deities in Taichu City; casually throwing a brick from upstairs would probably hit one.
“Fellow Daoist Tang Yue, I haven’t seen you patronize my small shop for a long time. This is...”
“To think it is a Your Highness. You really managed to land a good errand; the Primordial Academy must give plenty of rewards!”
An old man stepped forward to greet them.
“Greetings, Senior.” Yang Fan saluted.
The other party was likewise a Tier 3 God.

“This old man is Yuan Zong. Your Highness need not be overly courteous. The rules of Taichu City are different from the outside world as the cradle of Human Race deities. Here, potential is more important than strength, and your status is higher than mine.” Yuan Zong slowly said.
“Thank you for the guidance.”
“My small shop sells resource-type buildings. I Wonder if Your Highness has a target in mind?”
Yang Fan shook his head.
Coming over today, he mainly wanted to broaden his horizons and truly did not have a specific target.
“This is the product catalog. You can take a look first, and delivery is on the spot.”
Yuan Zong snapped his fingers, and a blue light was projected onto the shop wall.
“Star Core Energy Well (B-Rank) —— 5000 Divinity Points
Spirit Beast Breeding Ground (B-Rank) —— 6000 Divinity Points
Elemental Fusion Pool (B-Rank) —— 3000 Divinity Points
Spiritual Vein (A-Rank) —— 15000 Divinity Points
Spatial Farm (A-Rank) —— 50000 Divinity Points
Spirit Liquid Condensation Pool (A-Rank) —— 60000 Divinity Points
Tiangong Manufacturing Hub (A-Rank) —— 120000 Divinity Points
As expected of strategic-grade resource buildings, Yang Fan had basically never even heard of them.
Looking at the Spiritual Vein’s price reaching as high as 15,000 Divinity Points, a trace of doubt arose in Yang Fan’s heart.
Without Evolution Talent, the Spirit Stone income produced by a Spiritual Vein each month was only 100 Divinity Points, amounting to an annual income of 1,200 Divinity Points.
According to this price, the annualized return rate wasn’t even 10%.
Was this an A-Rank resource building?
B-Rank buildings like Monkey Wine Spring had annualized return rates as high as over 50%.
Yang Fan looked at the product catalog, but in his mind, he raised his question to Yang Yi.

“Master, there are two main reasons. The core function of the Spiritual Vein is to elevate the life level of the entire Divine Kingdom. The Spiritual Qi produced by the Spiritual Vein will slowly change the ecological environment of the Divine Kingdom, making it smoother for believers to Cultivate, while the output of Spirit Stones is secondary. The second reason is that this type of resource is too rare on the market, and the prices are all artificially high.”

“Master is currently just a Divine Being, whether it is the Divine Kingdom’s own environment or the believers’ strength and Realm are too low. It is suggested to focus mainly on purchasing B-Rank buildings.” Yang Yi expressed his understanding.
“Record the catalog, and go back to sort out the detailed information through the Divine Shop.” Yang Fan said.
“Yes, Master.”
Even just a single shop had as many as thousands of building catalogs inside.
To screen out buildings useful to oneself, one naturally had to rely on the powerful computing power of Intelligent Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Wonder Dragon Marsh Water Mansion
paragraphs: Without making a purchase, Yang Fan and Tang Yue headed to the next shop.
Yuan Zong showed no dissatisfaction with this; the buildings sold in Taichu City were extremely valuable, and if placed outside, any single one of them would be a deity’s core building.
The higher the value of an item, the slower its liquidity naturally was.
Moreover, these buildings were currently lying in their respective Divine Realms, steadily generating revenue, so they were not in a rush to trade them.
Just as before, Yang Fan had Yang Yi record the entire product catalog.
This was a shop for special buildings, and Yang Fan actually saw a familiar building.
“Special building, Fountain of Life, priced at 40 Divinity Points.”
Surprisingly, this Fountain of Life was the lowest-priced item, placed right in the front row.
However, Yang Fan was left speechless by this price.
One had to know that the guide price given by the Divine Shop for the Fountain of Life was only 20 Divinity Points, yet the other party had doubled it.
“Is this the premium of a strategic-level building?” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
Next were the building shops related to enhancing the believers’ strength.
“Bloodline Evolution Pool (Grade A) —— 100,000 Divinity Points”
“Gravity Cultivation Ground (Grade B) —— 3,000 Divinity Points”
“immortal nurturing tower (Grade B) —— 1,500 Divinity Points”
“Qi and Blood Melting Furnace (Grade B) —— 3,000 Divinity Points”
“Martial Dao Evolution Platform (Grade B) —— 8,000 Divinity Points”
Seeing that the price of the immortal nurturing tower was as high as 1,500 Divinity Points—a full 600 higher than the Divine Shop’s guide price—Yang Fan felt his heart ache.
“Senior, I would like to purchase the immortal nurturing tower. I Wonder if there is any discount on the price?” Yang Fan probed.
The shopkeeper slowly raised his eyes with a hint of displeasure in them.

However, after sensing Yang Fan’s identity, he could only suppress his dissatisfaction and said, “Your Highness, everything sold in Taichu City consists of strategic-level resources; there is no such thing as bargaining.”
Feeling the dissatisfied gaze, Yang Fan felt quite awkward.
If not for his identity as a Human Race Prodigy, the other party probably would have lashed out directly.
Yang Fan felt a pang of heartache, “In that case, I will purchase three immortal nurturing towers.”
“Your Highness, please have a seat. I will get the goods right away!” The other party hurriedly stood up, fetched a chair, and placed it in front of Yang Fan.
Purchasing three immortal nurturing towers at once meant a transaction amount as high as 4,500 Divinity Points.
This was indeed a huge order.
The shopkeeper moved very quickly, storing the buildings into blank cards in just a few minutes.
“I am Cao Shaoqiu. If Your Highness has any needs in the future, you are always welcome to visit my humble shop.”
Yang Fan nodded.
After transferring the Divinity Points to the other party, he left the place together with Tang Yue.
With this single consumption, half of Yang Fan’s liquid funds were gone.
Only at this moment did Yang Fan realize that in Taichu City, no matter how many Divinity Points one had, it would never be enough.
Take this immortal nurturing tower as an example; if he truly had sufficient funds, even if he purchased 100 of them, the believers in his Divine Realm wouldn’t be enough to use them.

Yang Fan thought to himself, “Primordial Academy costs money, purchasing buildings costs money, and nurturing believers costs money. No matter how much money one earns, it is never enough. My Divine Realm still needs to purchase more resource-type buildings.”
Yang Fan was not worried about how to earn more Divinity Points; with his tenfold Evolution Talent, his yield rate was naturally multiplied by ten.
However, there was no need to purchase buildings for Divine Realm investments in Taichu City; these were all strategic buildings with far too severe price premiums.
If he wanted high-yield buildings, he could completely purchase them in the Divine Shop.
The reason Yang Fan only purchased three immortal nurturing towers was to reserve sufficient funds to continue investing in his Divine Realm.
They arrived at the last shop selling Wonder buildings.
“Wonder: Dragon Marsh Water Mansion —— 200 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Immortal Qi Source —— 10,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain —— 500 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Divine Wood Forest —— 50,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Penglai Island —— 11,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Myriad Spirits Waters —— 200,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Dragon Vein Land —— 1,000,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Flat Peach Garden —— 300,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Crystal Mineral Cave —— 100,000 Divinity Points”
As expected of Taichu City, Yang Fan intentionally searched and found that both Spirit Peach Mountain and Penglai Island, which were Wonder buildings in his own Divine Realm, were sold here.
“Perhaps I can use the remaining funds to purchase Spirit Peach Mountains entirely,” Yang Fan pondered inwardly.
Currently, apart from the Spiritual Vein, the largest source of revenue in his Divine Realm was the Monkey Wine.
Yang Fan felt that he could completely increase his investment and expand his wine industry.
“Master, Spirit Peach Mountain requires Immortal Qi. A single Penglai Island can support at most five Spirit Peach Mountains,” Yang Yi’s reminder echoed in his mind.
Yang Fan glanced at the price of Penglai Island and couldn’t help cursing inwardly that the shopkeeper’s heart was too dark.
According to the Divine Shop’s pricing, the value of Penglai Island was around 5,000 Divinity Points.
Yet here, it had directly more than doubled.
Although things were valued for their rarity and what was sold here was the true market price, Yang Fan still felt his heart ache.
With his current funds, it was simply impossible to purchase Penglai Island, so the plan to brew Monkey Wine on a large scale had to be temporarily shelved.
“Shopkeeper, I want to purchase four Spirit Peach Mountains,” Yang Fan said.
The elderly man who was dozing opened his eyes.
Upon seeing Yang Fan, his expression tightened a bit.
The other party stood up, “So it is Your Highness. This old man is An Hai, greetings.”
The identity of a Human Race Prodigy was truly useful; the owners of these shops were all Tier 3 Gods, yet their attitudes toward Yang Fan were extremely polite.
“Manager An Hai, I Wonder if the stock of Spirit Peach Mountains is sufficient?” Yang Fan pressed on.

“Naturally. Spirit Peach Mountain is not a high-value Wonder building and is often found in the Divine Realms of ape-like Alien Gods. Let alone four, if Your Highness wants four hundred, I can have them transferred from the company for you,” An Hai waved his hand dismissively.
Hearing this, Yang Fan was equally shocked.
He hadn’t expected that a Wonder building he once thought to be of immense value and worried about being snatched away would be so casually handled here in Taichu City.
An Hai said, “May I ask Your Highness’s esteemed surname?”
“Yang Fan.”
“Your Highness Yang Fan, the grade of the spirit fruits grown on this Spirit Peach Mountain is not high. Why are you purchasing four at once?”
“I plan to invest in the Monkey Wine Spring,” Yang Fan did not hide it.
Inside Taichu City, Yang Fan felt that the meager resources in his Divine Realm were simply not worth others coveting, so he could just speak frankly.

“The yield rate of Monkey Wine is indeed not bad, but Spirit Peach Mountain requires Immortal Qi supply. My shop also has Wonder buildings like Immortal Treasure Houses, Penglai Island, and Immortal Lakes. I Wonder if Your Highness needs any? The prices are guaranteed to be fair,” An Hai continued to pitch.
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt a bit awkward.
It wasn’t that he didn’t need them, but that he had no money.
Right at this moment, Tang Yue stepped forward, her tone somewhat displeased, “Manager An, you talk too much.”

“So it is Fellow Daoist Tang Yue. Watching the shop here every day is so boring. Seeing that His Highness Yang Fan has an easygoing temperament, I couldn’t help chatting a bit more. I apologize to Your Highness here,” An Hai hurriedly apologized.
After Yang Fan paid 2,000 Divinity Points, his gaze inevitably fell on the first line of the Wonder building catalog: Dragon Marsh Water Mansion —— 200 Divinity Points.
“Manager An, I Wonder what the effect of this Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is?” Yang Fan couldn’t help asking one more question, mainly because this Wonder was the cheapest one in the shop.

“This Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is produced by the Sea Snake Clan. The Divine Realms of this clan often contain a large number of such Wonder buildings. Apart from improving the aquatic environment, its greatest function is raising Dragon Fish.”
“Dragon Fish contain a massive amount of life essence and are an essential resource for Divine Realms following the Martial Route, with a stable price.”

“The Divine Realm can harvest them once every hundred years, with each yield rate reaching as high as 30%, and an annualized yield rate exceeding 100%. This is much higher than the yield of the Monkey Wine Spring.”
“Your Highness Yang Fan, the inventory of this Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is quite large. If you make a bulk purchase, I can offer you a discount here!” An Hai’s face was plastered with smiles.

If Your Highness has any needs in the future, you are always welcome to visit my humble shop.”
Yang Fan nodded.
After transferring the Divinity Points to the other party, he left the place together with Tang Yue.
With this single consumption, half of Yang Fan’s liquid funds were gone.
Only at this moment did Yang Fan realize that in Taichu City, no matter how many Divinity Points one had, it would never be enough.
Take this immortal nurturing tower as an example; if he truly had sufficient funds, even if he purchased 100 of them, the believers in his Divine Realm wouldn’t be enough to use them.
Yang Fan thought to himself, “Primordial Academy costs money, purchasing buildings costs money, and nurturing believers costs money.
No matter how much money one earns, it is never enough.
My Divine Realm still needs to purchase more resource-type buildings.”
Yang Fan was not worried about how to earn more Divinity Points; with his tenfold Evolution Talent, his yield rate was naturally multiplied by ten.
However, there was no need to purchase buildings for Divine Realm investments in Taichu City; these were all strategic buildings with far too severe price premiums.
If he wanted high-yield buildings, he could completely purchase them in the Divine Shop.
The reason Yang Fan only purchased three immortal nurturing towers was to reserve sufficient funds to continue investing in his Divine Realm.
They arrived at the last shop selling Wonder buildings.
“Wonder: Dragon Marsh Water Mansion —— 200 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Immortal Qi Source —— 10,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain —— 500 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Divine Wood Forest —— 50,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Penglai Island —— 11,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Myriad Spirits Waters —— 200,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Dragon Vein Land —— 1,000,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Flat Peach Garden —— 300,000 Divinity Points”
“Wonder: Crystal Mineral Cave —— 100,000 Divinity Points”
As expected of Taichu City, Yang Fan intentionally searched and found that both Spirit Peach Mountain and Penglai Island, which were Wonder buildings in his own Divine Realm, were sold here.
“Perhaps I can use the remaining funds to purchase Spirit Peach Mountains entirely,” Yang Fan pondered inwardly.
Currently, apart from the Spiritual Vein, the largest source of revenue in his Divine Realm was the Monkey Wine.
Yang Fan felt that he could completely increase his investment and expand his wine industry.
“Master, Spirit Peach Mountain requires Immortal Qi.
A single Penglai Island can support at most five Spirit Peach Mountains,” Yang Yi’s reminder echoed in his mind.
Yang Fan glanced at the price of Penglai Island and couldn’t help cursing inwardly that the shopkeeper’s heart was too dark.
According to the Divine Shop’s pricing, the value of Penglai Island was around 5,000 Divinity Points.
Yet here, it had directly more than doubled.
Although things were valued for their rarity and what was sold here was the true market price, Yang Fan still felt his heart ache.
With his current funds, it was simply impossible to purchase Penglai Island, so the plan to brew Monkey Wine on a large scale had to be temporarily shelved.
“Shopkeeper, I want to purchase four Spirit Peach Mountains,” Yang Fan said.
The elderly man who was dozing opened his eyes.
Upon seeing Yang Fan, his expression tightened a bit.
The other party stood up, “So it is Your Highness.
This old man is An Hai, greetings.”
The identity of a Human Race Prodigy was truly useful; the owners of these shops were all Tier 3 Gods, yet their attitudes toward Yang Fan were extremely polite.
“Manager An Hai, I Wonder if the stock of Spirit Peach Mountains is sufficient?” Yang Fan pressed on.
“Naturally.
Spirit Peach Mountain is not a high-value Wonder building and is often found in the Divine Realms of ape-like Alien Gods.
Let alone four, if Your Highness wants four hundred, I can have them transferred from the company for you,” An Hai waved his hand dismissively.
Hearing this, Yang Fan was equally shocked.
He hadn’t expected that a Wonder building he once thought to be of immense value and worried about being snatched away would be so casually handled here in Taichu City.
An Hai said, “May I ask Your Highness’s esteemed surname?”
“Yang Fan.”
“Your Highness Yang Fan, the grade of the spirit fruits grown on this Spirit Peach Mountain is not high.
Why are you purchasing four at once?”
“I plan to invest in the Monkey Wine Spring,” Yang Fan did not hide it.
Inside Taichu City, Yang Fan felt that the meager resources in his Divine Realm were simply not worth others coveting, so he could just speak frankly.
“The yield rate of Monkey Wine is indeed not bad, but Spirit Peach Mountain requires Immortal Qi supply.
My shop also has Wonder buildings like Immortal Treasure Houses, Penglai Island, and Immortal Lakes.
I Wonder if Your Highness needs any?
The prices are guaranteed to be fair,” An Hai continued to pitch.
Hearing this, Yang Fan felt a bit awkward.
It wasn’t that he didn’t need them, but that he had no money.
Right at this moment, Tang Yue stepped forward, her tone somewhat displeased, “Manager An, you talk too much.”
“So it is Fellow Daoist Tang Yue.
Watching the shop here every day is so boring.
Seeing that His Highness Yang Fan has an easygoing temperament, I couldn’t help chatting a bit more.
I apologize to Your Highness here,” An Hai hurriedly apologized.
After Yang Fan paid 2,000 Divinity Points, his gaze inevitably fell on the first line of the Wonder building catalog: Dragon Marsh Water Mansion —— 200 Divinity Points.
“Manager An, I Wonder what the effect of this Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is?” Yang Fan couldn’t help asking one more question, mainly because this Wonder was the cheapest one in the shop.
“This Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is produced by the Sea Snake Clan.
The Divine Realms of this clan often contain a large number of such Wonder buildings.
Apart from improving the aquatic environment, its greatest function is raising Dragon Fish.”
“Dragon Fish contain a massive amount of life essence and are an essential resource for Divine Realms following the Martial Route, with a stable price.”
“The Divine Realm can harvest them once every hundred years, with each yield rate reaching as high as 30%, and an annualized yield rate exceeding 100%.
This is much higher than the yield of the Monkey Wine Spring.”
“Your Highness Yang Fan, the inventory of this Dragon Marsh Water Mansion is quite large.
If you make a bulk purchase, I can offer you a discount here!” An Hai’s face was plastered with smiles.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Money Disappears So Quickly!
paragraphs: Yang Fan glanced at his Faith Points balance; he couldn’t even afford 20 of them, so he didn’t know if this would count as a bulk purchase.
Yang Fan didn’t rush to answer, instead asking Yang Yi in his mind, “Given the current water surface area of my Divine Kingdom, approximately how many Dragon Marsh Water Mansions can be placed?”
“Reporting to Master, the current water area accounts for 65% of the Divine Kingdom’s total area. A maximum of 1,000 Dragon Marsh Water Mansions can be placed.”
“What is the actual profit of a Dragon Marsh Water Mansion?”

“Searching... The price for ten thousand Dragon Fish fry is 1,500 Divinity Points. Ten thousand adult Dragon Fish sell for 2,000 Divinity Points. Over a hundred years in the Divine Kingdom, each Dragon Marsh Water Mansion can generate an actual profit of about 500 Divinity Points.”
Hearing this data, Yang Fan couldn’t help but be shocked.
“Dragon Fish fry are that expensive?”

“According to the query, Dragon Fish have a low reproduction rate. Only Dragon Fish that have broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage possess large-scale breeding capabilities. These powerful Dragon Fish are currently mostly monopolized by the Gu Family Spirit Domain, hence the high investment cost.”
“Is the selling price of adult Dragon Fish as stable as they say?”
“According to records, there have been no changes for nearly ten thousand years; it is a very mature breeding industry.”
Yang Fan snapped back to reality.
At this moment, he even wanted to return the Spirit Peach Mountain he had just bought; the profit margin of the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion was indeed higher.
“I Wonder how many I need to buy to get a discount?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask.
An Hai slowly extended five fingers.
“Five?” Yang Fan said.

Hearing this, An Hai couldn’t help but stumble, saying speechlessly, “Your Highness must be joking, it’s five hundred. And that’s only because of Your Highness’s status. If other gods were buying, I wouldn’t even give a 5% discount unless they bought 2,000 at once.”
This was Taichu City, after all; the small amount of capital in Yang Fan’s hands wouldn’t even make a splash if thrown in.
“Funds are limited; I only have the ability to buy two for now,” Yang Fan sighed.
The Dragon Marsh Water Mansion Wonder itself wasn’t expensive, but he also had to buy Dragon Fish fry, so he had to keep enough funds.
Yang Fan looked at the Dragon Marsh Water Mansion at the top of the light screen and couldn’t help but swallow his saliva.
Once he had enough funds, this would be his largest investment channel.
Seeing Yang Fan’s expression, An Hai tempted him, “According to the records, Your Highness hasn’t joined a major Family yet. I Wonder if you are willing to accept investment?”
“Sorry, I don’t want to lose my freedom.” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
He had already seen an investment contract; although the other party offered a high enough price, the conditions were equally harsh.
With his Evolution Talent, even if his startup capital was insufficient, he could make up for it with time.
There was no need to lose big for a small gain.

“That’s a pity then. We can add each other as friends. I am a staff member of the Gu Family Spirit Domain. If you want to buy Dragon Marsh Water Mansions in the Late Stage, just send a message, and I’ll arrange for home delivery.”
Yang Fan nodded, transferred another 400 Divinity Points to the other party, and left the shop.

On the way back, Tang Yue couldn’t help but remind him, “Your Highness, your Tenfold Time Sequence talent will drain the Spiritual Qi of the Divine Kingdom. Aside from believers, other creatures might die in large numbers. This kind of investment might not be suitable.”
The Spirit Peach Mountain was one thing; if the Divine Kingdom’s Spiritual Qi dropped, at most the spirit fruits wouldn’t grow.
But Dragon Fish were delicate; once the ecological environment significantly deteriorated, they would definitely die in large numbers.
Tang Yue didn’t understand why Yang Fan, knowing he had the Tenfold Time Sequence talent, would still buy Dragon Marsh Water Mansions as an investment for his Divine Kingdom.
Regarding Tang Yue’s well-intentioned reminder, Yang Fan just nodded faintly and didn’t respond much.
His talent wasn’t Tenfold Time Sequence, but the higher-dimensional Evolution Talent.
Back in his room, Yang Fan immediately loaded the three immortal nurturing towers, four Spirit Peach Mountains, and two Dragon Marsh Water Mansions he had purchased today into his Divine Kingdom.
As the Spirit Peach Mountains and immortal nurturing towers entered the Divine Kingdom, the entire Penglai Island began to look crowded.
The Spirit Peach Mountains occupied a large area and now formed a circle around Penglai Island.
The Immortal Qi produced on the island no longer dissipated and was entirely absorbed by them.
“Yang Yi, purchase twenty thousand Dragon Fish fry and put them into the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions,” Yang Fan ordered.
“Yes.”
The area occupied by the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions wasn’t large, and they didn’t cause much of a stir when they landed in the sea.
Only the originally calm sea water rippled slightly.
The water quality became clearer, and a hint of gentle Spiritual Qi faintly appeared.
Small spirit algae and water grass began to appear among the sand and stones on the seabed, growing slowly but steadily.
The change wasn’t large, but it was quietly altering the aquatic ecosystem.
With the release of twenty thousand Dragon Fish fry, the once quiet waters suddenly gained a bit more vitality.
These fry were only about a foot long, with slender and smooth bodies and pale golden scales.
As they swam in the water, they emitted a soft, faint glow.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, currently hidden.)
Believers: Tier 5 Beings (46), Tier 4 Beings (53,374), Tier 3 Beings (2.35 million), Tier 2 Beings (11.3 million), Tier 1 Beings (23.7 million), Mortals (11.8 million)
Subordinates: little spirits (22,929)

Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Minor Achievement), Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-rank, Major Achievement), Extinguishing God Array (E-rank, Major Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-rank, Entry Level)...
Faith Points: 44 billion (Daily provision of 815.2)

Buildings: Moon Well x20,000, Sun Spring x20,000, A-Grade Building Spiritual Vein x1, B-Grade Building Alchemy Tower x1, B-Grade Building immortal nurturing tower x4, B-Grade Building Monkey Wine Spring x100, B-Grade hundred herb spirit pivot academy, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Thousand-year, currently birthing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone...
Wonders: Penglai Island (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x5 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x2 (Deployed)
Assets: Taisui x610, Dragon Fish fry (x20,000), Small Mineral Vein, Spirit Stones (), various spirit fruits (), various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plants (), B-Grade Weapons (x10,000)...”
Looking at the current detailed information of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan couldn’t help but lament, “Faith Points really don’t last long.”
In just this short while, the ten thousand Divinity Points the Luo Family had invested in him had all been spent.
With four more Spirit Peach Mountains, he also needed to buy four hundred Monkey Wine Springs as supporting industries, which was another 8,000 Divinity Points.
Then there was the investment in the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions and the purchase of Dragon Fish fry.
Furthermore, there were now more directions for investing in believers, such as the fees for the Primordial Academy and investments in buildings like the immortal nurturing tower and Spiritual Veins.
As long as Yang Fan had enough funds, he could accelerate the development of his believers at any time.
But everything required sufficient Divinity Points to support it.
Yang Fan lowered his head in thought, “Besides accepting investments from large companies, what other ways are there to quickly accumulate funds!”
With his Evolution Talent, the more assets there were in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, the greater his profits would be.
If he were still in Yang County, it wouldn’t matter that he didn’t have better channels to invest in his believers.
But in this Taichu City, he had seen too many methods to make believers stronger quickly, as well as those strategic-level buildings; how could he not be tempted?

In a cradle for geniuses like Taichu City, Yang Fan didn’t need to worry about whether he was performing too brilliantly and attracting jealousy; the only thing he needed to do now was to become stronger as quickly as possible.
The stronger the potential he displayed, the more preferential treatment he would receive.
This was the truth Yang Fan had realized after his experiences over the past few days.
He needed more funds to use his Evolution Talent to earn resources and invest in his believers to make them stronger faster, forming a positive cycle.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: The Betting Agreement
paragraphs: Suddenly, Yang Fan seemed to think of something.
“Yang Yi, if I mortgage my Divine Kingdom assets, roughly how much capital can I get right now?” Yang Fan asked suddenly.
“Which assets do you wish to mortgage, Master?” Yang Yi asked in return.
“All of them. It doesn’t matter if the interest is higher; the more capital, the better.” A hint of fanaticism appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.

“A reminder to Master: this operation is extremely dangerous. The larger the loan amount, the more the lending company will raise interest rates to hedge risks. Even if Divine Kingdom investments on the market can cover the interest, there is a significant risk of default. Once a default occurs, the Divine Kingdom assets will be forcibly seized. Under compound interest, you might even end up with high debts that you can’t climb out of for a lifetime,” Yang Yi warned.
Yang Fan gave the order: “Go and inquire for me immediately.”
Under normal circumstances, using investment returns to cover interest is indeed risky.
But what if the investment return is tenfold?
Then it’s not a risk, but free money.
The sooner he obtained capital, the faster Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom would develop.
To others, lending platforms were high-risk capital turnovers; to him, this was his own bank, a financial lever with a one-hundred-percent guaranteed win.
Yang Yi executed the command, sending the requirements to major lending platforms.
At the same time, on a planet billions of light-years away from Taichu City.
This was a planet without any “nature.” Looking as far as the eye could see, the entire land was completely covered in steel.
Beneath the sky, countless electronic machines shuttled between streets and sky-rails, operating with precision and efficiency, with almost no downtime.
There was no noise here, only the continuous sound of mechanical operation.
And at the very center of this world stood a core building ten thousand meters high.
The building was pitch black, with a massive light screen logo floating on it: “Elephant Loan Welcomes You.”
The top floor of the building.

A man dressed in casual clothes sipped red wine, muttering, “Intelligent Six, continue to increase advertising investment. The headline content should be something like ‘Elephant Loan is not interested in money; to serve customers, the base interest rate has been lowered from 30% to 29.9%.'”
Just then, a mechanical voice suddenly sounded in the room: “President Ma, there is a loan that requires your approval.”
“Since when do I need to personally oversee loan business? What’s the amount, and what’s the collateral?”
“The other party is mortgaging all Divine Kingdom assets. According to the data, the approximate capital is thirty thousand Divinity Points,” the Intelligent Life responded.
“Only that much? Is it a Demigod or a Divine Being?”
“A Divine Being.”
“He seems quite wealthy then. Just approve the loan according to the normal process; no need to disturb me!”
“But according to the identity information, the other party is evaluated by the Federation’s Supreme Intelligent Life as a Human Race Prodigy!”
As the Intelligent Life finished speaking, the man spat out all the wine in his mouth.
“Cough, cough, cough! Send me all the information immediately. Also, help me apply for a meeting in the Virtual World.”
“A Human Race Prodigy is looking for my small company to borrow money? What’s going on? Is it possible that I, Ma Yu, am about to hit the jackpot?”
“Mortgaging all assets, there should be twenty or thirty thousand Divinity Points!” Yang Fan thought to himself.
At that moment, Yang Yi’s voice suddenly came to his mind.
“Master, a major shareholder of a lending company has applied for a face-to-face meeting with you.”
“A meeting?” Yang Fan showed a puzzled expression.
Capital lending was essentially a financial game.
In today’s world, one hundred percent of the work was completed by Intelligent Life.
Assessing risks, signing contracts, issuing agreements, and even reclaiming collateral at the Late Stage no longer required a god to appear in person.
Yang Fan didn’t understand why a major shareholder of a lending company would want to see him.
“This is the other party’s specific information.” Yang Yi transmitted the information to Yang Fan.
As he processed the information in his mind, Yang Fan’s expression gradually became strange.

“The actual controller of Elephant Loan—Ma Yu, with the strength of a Rank Five God. Elephant Loan Data: Founded in Year XXX of the Divine Kingdom Era, a Federation listed company with a market value exceeding ten billion Divinity Points. The company’s financial statements are as follows: compound annual growth rate of 42%, ROE...”
This was all public information, which Yang Yi had organized and presented.
Yang Fan became increasingly confused.
“Why would such a big shot want to see me? With the meager assets in my Divine Kingdom, could this even be considered a big business to him?”
Yang Fan didn’t understand.
Ever since coming to Taichu City, he realized that the assets in his Divine Kingdom were nothing at all.
A Rank Five God was the strongest person Yang Fan had ever encountered, so he naturally didn’t dare to be negligent.
Putting on the virtual helmet, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered.
As soon as he entered the Virtual World, a young man with an ordinary, even slightly ugly appearance, came forward to greet him.
“Young friend Yang Fan, it’s a pleasure to meet you. I am Ma Yu, the Chairman of Elephant Loan. It is an honor that you are cooperating with our company again,” Ma Yu said as he stepped forward.
Yang Fan bowed.
“Greetings, President Ma.”

“An honest man doesn’t resort to insincerity. I checked the data before coming; you haven’t signed a contract with any listed company or super family. I see the potential of your Human Race Prodigy status and want to invest in you.”

“I will bear all your education expenses at Primordial Academy and provide you with an additional subsidy of 100,000 Divinity Points every year. As for the condition, you must come to work at Elephant Loan after becoming a god. If you Breakthrough to a Rank Four God, I can even give you a 10% equity reward.”
Ma Yu stated his conditions in simple and clear terms.
Yang Fan realized at this moment that this President Ma wasn’t interested because of the mortgage loan, but because he valued his status as a Human Race Prodigy.
The other party was willing to bear his education expenses at Primordial Academy; based on this point alone, his sincerity was higher than that of Yuandan Co., Ltd.
One must know that the tuition fees at Primordial Academy were a significant expense.
Although Yang Fan was tempted, he still shook his head and refused, “I’m sorry, I don’t plan on joining a company.”
Being rejected by Yang Fan, Ma Yu got a bit anxious.
“Young friend Yang Fan must be very short on capital!”
Yang Fan nodded.
If not for that, he wouldn’t have put up all his assets as collateral.

“As long as you accept our company’s recruitment, the annual subsidy will be increased to 200,000 Divinity Points. Never mind a Divine Being, it would be enough to support the Divine Kingdom consumption of a god,” Ma Yu continued to raise the stakes.
“I’m sorry.” Yang Fan still refused.
Although the other party’s conditions were enticing, Yang Fan was no longer that poor boy who had nothing.
As long as there was enough time, he wouldn’t lack Divinity Points.
After saying this, Yang Fan prepared to leave.
There were many lending companies; with sufficient collateral, Yang Fan could completely obtain capital from other companies.
This was the Virtual World, so he didn’t need to care about the other party’s strength.
Watching Yang Fan turn around, Ma Yu hurriedly said, “We can sign a Betting Agreement.”
“A Betting Agreement?”

“That’s right. I can give you a loan limit of 1,000,000 Divinity Points. In one year, if you can repay me with interest, the agreement will automatically be voided. If you can’t, I won’t ask you to repay this capital, but you must join our company after you graduate in the future.”
Yang Fan immediately became interested upon hearing this.
“May I know the specific contents of the agreement?”
Ma Yu snapped his fingers, and a thick stack of documents appeared in front of Yang Fan.
There was a lot of content in the agreement, so Yang Fan directly let Yang Yi scan and read it.

After a moment, Yang Yi’s voice appeared in his mind: “Master, the interest on these 1,000,000 Divinity Points is as high as 200%. After one year, you must repay a total of 3,000,000 Divinity Points in principal and interest. The interest cost far exceeds the Divine Kingdom investments on the market; the risk is enormous. If Master wants to repay this capital within a year, the only way is to break into the top 1,000,000 of the Primordial Battlefield and obtain the rewards.”
Ma Yu wasn’t in a hurry and said in a calm tone, “Although the contents of the agreement are somewhat harsh, I doubt any other company on the market would give this loan limit.”
“I’ll sign,” Yang Fan said suddenly.

sentences.text: Suddenly, Yang Fan seemed to think of something.
“Yang Yi, if I mortgage my Divine Kingdom assets, roughly how much capital can I get right now?” Yang Fan asked suddenly.
“Which assets do you wish to mortgage, Master?” Yang Yi asked in return.
“All of them.
It doesn’t matter if the interest is higher; the more capital, the better.” A hint of fanaticism appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
“A reminder to Master: this operation is extremely dangerous.
The larger the loan amount, the more the lending company will raise interest rates to hedge risks.
Even if Divine Kingdom investments on the market can cover the interest, there is a significant risk of default.
Once a default occurs, the Divine Kingdom assets will be forcibly seized.
Under compound interest, you might even end up with high debts that you can’t climb out of for a lifetime,” Yang Yi warned.
Yang Fan gave the order: “Go and inquire for me immediately.”
Under normal circumstances, using investment returns to cover interest is indeed risky.
But what if the investment return is tenfold?
Then it’s not a risk, but free money.
The sooner he obtained capital, the faster Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom would develop.
To others, lending platforms were high-risk capital turnovers; to him, this was his own bank, a financial lever with a one-hundred-percent guaranteed win.
Yang Yi executed the command, sending the requirements to major lending platforms.
At the same time, on a planet billions of light-years away from Taichu City.
This was a planet without any “nature.” Looking as far as the eye could see, the entire land was completely covered in steel.
Beneath the sky, countless electronic machines shuttled between streets and sky-rails, operating with precision and efficiency, with almost no downtime.
There was no noise here, only the continuous sound of mechanical operation.
And at the very center of this world stood a core building ten thousand meters high.
The building was pitch black, with a massive light screen logo floating on it: “Elephant Loan Welcomes You.”
The top floor of the building.
A man dressed in casual clothes sipped red wine, muttering, “Intelligent Six, continue to increase advertising investment.
The headline content should be something like ‘Elephant Loan is not interested in money; to serve customers, the base interest rate has been lowered from 30% to 29.9%.'”
Just then, a mechanical voice suddenly sounded in the room: “President Ma, there is a loan that requires your approval.”
“Since when do I need to personally oversee loan business?
What’s the amount, and what’s the collateral?”
“The other party is mortgaging all Divine Kingdom assets.
According to the data, the approximate capital is thirty thousand Divinity Points,” the Intelligent Life responded.
“Only that much?
Is it a Demigod or a Divine Being?”
“A Divine Being.”
“He seems quite wealthy then.
Just approve the loan according to the normal process; no need to disturb me!”
“But according to the identity information, the other party is evaluated by the Federation’s Supreme Intelligent Life as a Human Race Prodigy!”
As the Intelligent Life finished speaking, the man spat out all the wine in his mouth.
“Cough, cough, cough!
Send me all the information immediately.
Also, help me apply for a meeting in the Virtual World.”
“A Human Race Prodigy is looking for my small company to borrow money?
What’s going on?
Is it possible that I, Ma Yu, am about to hit the jackpot?”
“Mortgaging all assets, there should be twenty or thirty thousand Divinity Points!” Yang Fan thought to himself.
At that moment, Yang Yi’s voice suddenly came to his mind.
“Master, a major shareholder of a lending company has applied for a face-to-face meeting with you.”
“A meeting?” Yang Fan showed a puzzled expression.
Capital lending was essentially a financial game.
In today’s world, one hundred percent of the work was completed by Intelligent Life.
Assessing risks, signing contracts, issuing agreements, and even reclaiming collateral at the Late Stage no longer required a god to appear in person.
Yang Fan didn’t understand why a major shareholder of a lending company would want to see him.
“This is the other party’s specific information.” Yang Yi transmitted the information to Yang Fan.
As he processed the information in his mind, Yang Fan’s expression gradually became strange.
“The actual controller of Elephant Loan—Ma Yu, with the strength of a Rank Five God.
Elephant Loan Data: Founded in Year XXX of the Divine Kingdom Era, a Federation listed company with a market value exceeding ten billion Divinity Points.
The company’s financial statements are as follows: compound annual growth rate of 42%, ROE...”
This was all public information, which Yang Yi had organized and presented.
Yang Fan became increasingly confused.
“Why would such a big shot want to see me?
With the meager assets in my Divine Kingdom, could this even be considered a big business to him?”
Yang Fan didn’t understand.
Ever since coming to Taichu City, he realized that the assets in his Divine Kingdom were nothing at all.
A Rank Five God was the strongest person Yang Fan had ever encountered, so he naturally didn’t dare to be negligent.
Putting on the virtual helmet, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered.
As soon as he entered the Virtual World, a young man with an ordinary, even slightly ugly appearance, came forward to greet him.
“Young friend Yang Fan, it’s a pleasure to meet you.
I am Ma Yu, the Chairman of Elephant Loan.
It is an honor that you are cooperating with our company again,” Ma Yu said as he stepped forward.
Yang Fan bowed.
“Greetings, President Ma.”
“An honest man doesn’t resort to insincerity.
I checked the data before coming; you haven’t signed a contract with any listed company or super family.
I see the potential of your Human Race Prodigy status and want to invest in you.”
“I will bear all your education expenses at Primordial Academy and provide you with an additional subsidy of 100,000 Divinity Points every year.
As for the condition, you must come to work at Elephant Loan after becoming a god.
If you Breakthrough to a Rank Four God, I can even give you a 10% equity reward.”
Ma Yu stated his conditions in simple and clear terms.
Yang Fan realized at this moment that this President Ma wasn’t interested because of the mortgage loan, but because he valued his status as a Human Race Prodigy.
The other party was willing to bear his education expenses at Primordial Academy; based on this point alone, his sincerity was higher than that of Yuandan Co., Ltd.
One must know that the tuition fees at Primordial Academy were a significant expense.
Although Yang Fan was tempted, he still shook his head and refused, “I’m sorry, I don’t plan on joining a company.”
Being rejected by Yang Fan, Ma Yu got a bit anxious.
“Young friend Yang Fan must be very short on capital!”
Yang Fan nodded.
If not for that, he wouldn’t have put up all his assets as collateral.
“As long as you accept our company’s recruitment, the annual subsidy will be increased to 200,000 Divinity Points.
Never mind a Divine Being, it would be enough to support the Divine Kingdom consumption of a god,” Ma Yu continued to raise the stakes.
“I’m sorry.” Yang Fan still refused.
Although the other party’s conditions were enticing, Yang Fan was no longer that poor boy who had nothing.
As long as there was enough time, he wouldn’t lack Divinity Points.
After saying this, Yang Fan prepared to leave.
There were many lending companies; with sufficient collateral, Yang Fan could completely obtain capital from other companies.
This was the Virtual World, so he didn’t need to care about the other party’s strength.
Watching Yang Fan turn around, Ma Yu hurriedly said, “We can sign a Betting Agreement.”
“A Betting Agreement?”
“That’s right.
I can give you a loan limit of 1,000,000 Divinity Points.
In one year, if you can repay me with interest, the agreement will automatically be voided.
If you can’t, I won’t ask you to repay this capital, but you must join our company after you graduate in the future.”
Yang Fan immediately became interested upon hearing this.
“May I know the specific contents of the agreement?”
Ma Yu snapped his fingers, and a thick stack of documents appeared in front of Yang Fan.
There was a lot of content in the agreement, so Yang Fan directly let Yang Yi scan and read it.
After a moment, Yang Yi’s voice appeared in his mind: “Master, the interest on these 1,000,000 Divinity Points is as high as 200%.
After one year, you must repay a total of 3,000,000 Divinity Points in principal and interest.
The interest cost far exceeds the Divine Kingdom investments on the market; the risk is enormous.
If Master wants to repay this capital within a year, the only way is to break into the top 1,000,000 of the Primordial Battlefield and obtain the rewards.”
Ma Yu wasn’t in a hurry and said in a calm tone, “Although the contents of the agreement are somewhat harsh, I doubt any other company on the market would give this loan limit.”
“I’ll sign,” Yang Fan said suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: A Bright Future Ahead
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, Ma Yu looked as if he had hit the jackpot, his face flushing with ecstasy.
“Good! This is the latest smart contract. No signature required, just a retinal scan.”

Once the process was complete, Ma Yu spoke with a sincere expression, “Little Yang, don’t worry. Our company’s core business is financial lending. There’s little to do, high bonuses, and no danger. You won’t regret it.”
“Does President Ma not believe I can pay back your three million in a year?”

“Hahaha, young people certainly have ambition. Keep it up. Once you become a formal employee next year, you can come directly to me if you need anything. A Genius with an S-rank talent like you is someone I will definitely cultivate with all my resources.”
Leaving behind those words, Ma Yu departed from the Virtual World.
In reality, Ma Yu was in a good mood as he took off his helmet.
He poured himself a glass of red wine and downed it in one gulp.
“President Ma, the other party’s Divine Kingdom assets are too meager. Is an investment of one million Divinity Points too risky?” The voice of an Intelligent Life echoed from his surroundings.

“What do you know? What is a mere million Divinity Points? He is a Human Race Prodigy. As long as he doesn’t perish, his future achievements will be at least that of a Fourth-Order God. With one more Mid-tier God-level powerhouse, our company’s market share could increase by at least thirty percent.”

“Those assessed as Human Race Prodigies either come from major families or are recruited by those giant corporations the moment their Divine Kingdom awakens. I never expected to run into a ‘wild’ one!”
“Fantastic, I’ve definitely won this bet! Give it a thousand years, and perhaps my Elephant Loan will be able to expand into other Star Domains, hahaha.”
Ma Yu let out a long breath, his face flushed with excitement.
Repeating this luxurious yet dull life of a God every day, it had been many years since he last felt his heart race like this.
“President Ma, is it possible for this person to break into the top one million in the Primordial Battlefield? If he succeeds, this loan...”

“Don’t worry, his talent is Tenfold Time Sequence, which is why he needs a massive amount of resources to accelerate the time flow of his Divine Kingdom. I intentionally raised the loan amount to one million just so he couldn’t refuse. That kid is probably feeling smug right now, thinking that with so much capital and a tenfold development speed, his believers will soon surpass those of other geniuses!”

“This is the Primordial Academy. Any random Demigod who walks out of here is a top-tier existence in the outside world. According to my calculations, even with my support, he might only have a chance by the second half of his sophomore year,” Ma Yu said with full confidence.
“President Ma is wise! You will surely lead Elephant Loan to a new level,” the Intelligent Life flattered him.
“Number Four, you certainly have a way with words! In a moment, I’ll buy you a high-grade Mechanical Heart as a reward.”
“Thank you for your cultivation, President Ma!”
In Taichu City, Yang Fan’s consciousness had re-entered his Divine Kingdom.
“This title of Human Race Prodigy is truly useful. I still underestimated my own weight,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh.
Simply because of an identity, a Fifth-Order God was willing to treat him as an equal, and even handed over a million Divinity Points just like that.
Yang Yi and Yang Er appeared before him simultaneously.
Yang Yi said calmly, “Master, according to the data, Elephant Loan’s size is less than one percent of Yuandan Co., Ltd. Given your current status, there might be better choices.”

Yang Er added, “In the short term, Elephant Loan might be more generous, but for future development, the platform is equally important. An ordinary financial company like Elephant Loan will limit Master’s growth.”
Yang Fan waved his hand, indicating he understood.
Ma Yu hadn’t hidden his thoughts; he believed Yang Fan wouldn’t be able to repay the loan in a year, effectively using a million Divinity Points to buy a future employee with infinite potential.
But Yang Fan felt that he was the one who had definitely won this bet!
What Primordial Battlefield?
Did he need to rely on school rewards to repay the loan?
Non-existent.
Under a tenfold return rate, he could easily afford a mere double interest.
“Earning two million Divinity Points from me in a year... I wonder if President Ma will be laughing or crying then?” A hint of mischief rose in Yang Fan’s heart.
Elephant Loan used smart lending; the moment the process ended, the million Divinity Points had already been deposited into his Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Yi, help me contact An Hai. Purchase the remaining Dragon Marsh Water Mansions. I want the water areas in the Divine Kingdom to be completely filled,” Yang Fan ordered.
This single transaction cost nearly 200,000 Divinity Points.
“Spend another 750,000 Divinity Points to buy five million Dragon Fish fry and release them all into the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions for cultivation.”
In a hundred years of Divine Kingdom time, the Dragon Fish would mature.
For Yang Fan, that was only ten days in the real world.
He could harvest three times a month.
The profit for every ten thousand fish was about 500 Divinity Points.
A single harvest of this batch would yield a net profit of 250,000 Divinity Points; his principal would double in just one month.
Raising Dragon Fish was currently the highest-yielding investment in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, so he naturally had to pour a large amount of capital into it.
Yang Fan continued to arrange, “Continue to spend 8,000 Divinity Points in the mall to buy 400 Monkey Wine Springs.”
“Yes,” Yang Yi nodded.

“After the resources produced by the Divine Kingdom are sold, continue to buy Dragon Fish fry for investment. The primary goal now is to maximize the production of the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions,” Yang Fan continued.
Hearing this, Yang Yi couldn’t help but remind him, “Master, this will take about a year. This capital for the believers...”
“Do as I say.”
These intelligent lives could not perceive the existence of his SSS-rank Talent, so their suggestions were naturally unsatisfactory at times.
Although Yang Yi and Yang Er did not understand his methods, as intelligent lives, they would firmly execute their God’s tasks.
“Faith Points: 7.994 trillion (Daily provision of 815.2 billion).”
He didn’t plan to move the remaining funds for now, keeping them as emergency capital.
Yang Fan added, “In addition, from now on, the daily expenses for the Primordial Academy will be increased to 100 Divinity Points. You two handle the specific course arrangements.”
“As you command, Master.”
Returning to reality, Yang Fan soon heard a knock at the door.
The visitor was a First-Order God wearing a work uniform.

“Your Highness, these are the buildings Senior An Hai asked me to deliver to you. A 5% discount was applied, and the excess funds have been returned to your Divine Kingdom,” the person said respectfully.
“Thank you.” Yang Fan loaded the cards containing the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions into his Divine Kingdom.
As the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions loaded, the entire water region surged with milky-white mist, and the environment of the Divine Kingdom began to become more humid.
The quality of the Divine Kingdom’s environment directly affected the God.
At this moment, Yang Fan also felt a wave of comfort, as if his entire being was soaking in a hot spring.
There was no academic pressure at the Primordial Academy.
Besides checking on the development of his Divine Kingdom every day, Yang Fan would go to the Virtual World to meet his Family.
If he was bored, he would also visit Tianxiang Renjian to see old friends.
Ten days passed like this, bringing the first wave of Dragon Fish harvest.
After deducting costs, the five million Dragon Fish yielded a net profit of exactly 250,000 Divinity Points.
According to his requirements, Yang Yi reinvested the funds into the cultivation of more Dragon Fish.
Within the Divine Kingdom, the number of Dragon Fish had already reached over 7.6 million.
At this rate, it wouldn’t even take a month in the real world to maximize the production of the Dragon Marsh Water Mansions.
“The future is looking bright!” Yang Fan said with full confidence.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Do You
paragraphs: Due to the unique atmosphere of Taichu City, both the resident gods and the newly joined students spent most of their time living in the real world.
Yang Fan also noticed that it had been quite noisy outside lately.
After checking the group chat, he realized that the College Entrance Examination had ended, and many freshmen had arrived in Taichu City.
‘Beep beep beep,’ a notification sounded from his wristwatch.
It was Wen Yushui speaking in the group: “The living environment in Taichu City is just too poor; it’s so noisy outside!”
Ye Jianfeng: “The dormitories for Grade A students are too close to us. I just went over and taught them a lesson; it’s much better now.”
Wen Yushui: “It’s a bit of a hassle.”

Sima Bang: “The population density of Taichu City is about a hundred times that of the outside world, so noise pollution is serious. You can buy Formation Plates for Soundproofing Formations in the mall.”
“You can do that? Thanks, Big Brother Sima, you really are knowledgeable.” Wen Yushui sent the message along with a ‘heart’ emoji.

“I’ve lived here since I was a child, so I naturally have more life experience.” Sima Bang added, “I have slots for a Yellow-Grade Secret Realm. Do you guys want them? Ten thousand Divinity Points per person.”
Ye Jianfeng: “So cheap?”
Sima Bang: “Internal Family price. Participants follow a fixed route for exploration; what you get depends entirely on luck.”

Ye Jianfeng: “I want it. At the very least, I can harvest tens of thousands of Divinity Points. As expected of the Sima Family, one of the five giants—they are truly generous in nurturing the youth. This little brother is impressed!”
Wen Yushui: “I want it too. Long live Big Brother Sima.”
At this moment, Yang Fan was checking some information.
“Secret Realms refer to ownerless Divine Kingdoms that have broken away from a god’s control but still maintain a complete structure.
In essence, a Divine Kingdom is like an independent ‘island’ floating in the Void Realm, maintained by the will of a god.
When a god dies, some Divine Kingdoms do not collapse but stabilize themselves, drifting in the Void Realm to form special accessible spaces—Secret Realms.
The interior of a Secret Realm retains a complete ecosystem and resource cycle.
Its operation is often more active, and the growth rate of resources far exceeds that of the outside world.
Spirit Plants multiply rapidly, and the recovery cycles for minerals and Yao Beasts are extremely short, giving them high development value.
Based on the tier of the original Divine Kingdom, Secret Realms are divided into four grades:
Heaven-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from high-tier gods’ kingdoms, massive in scale with perfect rules and dense resources; extremely dangerous;
Earth-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from mid-tier gods, stable structure, rich in resources, suitable for long-term development; high danger;
Mystic-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from low-tier gods, moderate resources and moderate danger;
Yellow-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from demigod-level kingdoms, smaller in scale, mostly basic resource production areas; low danger.
Due to the immense value of Secret Realms, major powers usually dispatch legions to guard them long-term, establishing strongholds for blockade and continuous development.”
After figuring out what a Secret Realm was, Yang Fan immediately messaged the group: “I want one too, thanks.”
“Just transfer the Divinity Points to my Divine Kingdom, and I’ll send you the entry permits.”
Sima Bang wasn’t worried about Yang Fan and the others defaulting on payment; he sent the entry permits to their inboxes first.
Sima Bang continued messaging: “This Secret Realm is a resource point for my Sima Family. There’s no danger inside; just arrange for Intelligent Life to collect resources.”
“Got it, thanks Big Brother Sima.”
“Got it, let’s get together again sometime.”
Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui expressed their thanks.
A profit of tens of thousands of Divinity Points made even children of great families like them excited.
Perhaps only someone of Sima Bang’s status would use such an opportunity to grant a favor!
“Received.”
After replying, Yang Fan immediately transferred the Divinity Points to the other party and then began studying the entry permit.
“Yellow-Grade Secret Realm Exploration Permit (Coordinates: ) — Sima Family Seal.”
Yang Fan placed the permit into his Divine Kingdom and then tapped the coordinates.
His consciousness was instantly sucked away by a spatial force.
“Please present your permit, sir!”
A person wearing a purple robe, stepping on a Flying Sword, floated in mid-air.
Yang Fan recognized at a glance that the other party was a believer, and at the very least, at the Foundation Establishment Realm.
The aura emanating from him was much stronger than that of the Foundation Establishment Tree Demon King in his own Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan took out the permit.
“One-time permit. Sir, please proceed to Channel 864.”
An irresistible force suddenly descended!
In the next moment, Yang Fan found himself in another world.
The Spiritual Qi here was abundant, and the air carried a distinct vitality.
The terrain was not very undulating, and Spiritual Plants were distributed neatly, showing faint signs of cultivation.
Further away, the aura of Yao Beasts roamed, but it wasn’t chaotic; instead, it followed a certain pattern of “domestication.”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered.
“As expected of a Secret Realm guarded by a major power. It seems they come here periodically to harvest.”
As the thought faded, the space vibrated slightly.
Yang Er’s figure appeared first, followed closely by exactly five million believers, spreading out like a tide and quickly forming an array.
“Collect resources along the channel,” Yang Fan arranged.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Er nodded and then organized the believers to start working.
Clearly, whether it was the Spirit Plants or the Yao Beasts, these were resources previously released and nurtured by the Sima Family.
To Yang Fan, he didn’t care much about this small amount of resource profit; the main reason he agreed was to broaden his horizons.
As expected of the Sima Family, one of the five giants—they truly have many ways to nurture the younger generation.
His consciousness quickly withdrew.
When he opened his eyes again, Yang Fan had returned to reality.
He put on his helmet, and his consciousness entered the Virtual World.
Soon, he received three invitation messages from Luo Bing, Li Shuhao, and Zhang Pang respectively.
Yang Fan first clicked on Luo Bing’s coordinates.
Looking at the location, a flash of disappointment crossed Yang Fan’s mind.
It was actually the Luo Family conference room.
He had originally thought this ice beauty missed him, but now it seemed he was being over-affectionate.
“Bing...” Yang Fan started, unsure of how to address her.
Luo Bing bit her lip slightly.
“Just call me Luo Bing. How is Primordial Academy?”
“It’s alright, quite free.”
“The College Entrance Examination is over, and my results are out. I’m going to Tianshui University in the Luotian Star Domain.” Luo Bing seemed to be reporting for work.
Yang Fan nodded to show he understood.
In this era, one didn’t need to apply for university themselves.
Instead, the moment the exam results came out, an Intelligent Life would automatically assign them.
Luo Bing suddenly stared into Yang Fan’s eyes.
“Do you... want it?”
“Cough, cough, cough, why would you say that?” Yang Fan’s old face turned red.
“Then why have you been staring at my chest?”
“Sorry, force of habit!”
“Pervert!”
Before Yang Fan could answer, Luo Bing had already left the Virtual World.
Seeing this, Yang Fan was completely stunned.
“Damn, I do want it! The conference room is fine too! Why run so fast?” Yang Fan complained.
He shook his head with a bitter smile and then clicked on Zhang Pang’s coordinates.
“Godfather, your son missed you to death!”

sentences.text: Due to the unique atmosphere of Taichu City, both the resident gods and the newly joined students spent most of their time living in the real world.
Yang Fan also noticed that it had been quite noisy outside lately.
After checking the group chat, he realized that the College Entrance Examination had ended, and many freshmen had arrived in Taichu City.
‘Beep beep beep,’ a notification sounded from his wristwatch.
It was Wen Yushui speaking in the group: “The living environment in Taichu City is just too poor; it’s so noisy outside!”
Ye Jianfeng: “The dormitories for Grade A students are too close to us.
I just went over and taught them a lesson; it’s much better now.”
Wen Yushui: “It’s a bit of a hassle.”
Sima Bang: “The population density of Taichu City is about a hundred times that of the outside world, so noise pollution is serious.
You can buy Formation Plates for Soundproofing Formations in the mall.”
“You can do that?
Thanks, Big Brother Sima, you really are knowledgeable.” Wen Yushui sent the message along with a ‘heart’ emoji.
“I’ve lived here since I was a child, so I naturally have more life experience.” Sima Bang added, “I have slots for a Yellow-Grade Secret Realm.
Do you guys want them?
Ten thousand Divinity Points per person.”
Ye Jianfeng: “So cheap?”
Sima Bang: “Internal Family price.
Participants follow a fixed route for exploration; what you get depends entirely on luck.”
Ye Jianfeng: “I want it.
At the very least, I can harvest tens of thousands of Divinity Points.
As expected of the Sima Family, one of the five giants—they are truly generous in nurturing the youth.
This little brother is impressed!”
Wen Yushui: “I want it too.
Long live Big Brother Sima.”
At this moment, Yang Fan was checking some information.
“Secret Realms refer to ownerless Divine Kingdoms that have broken away from a god’s control but still maintain a complete structure.
In essence, a Divine Kingdom is like an independent ‘island’ floating in the Void Realm, maintained by the will of a god.
When a god dies, some Divine Kingdoms do not collapse but stabilize themselves, drifting in the Void Realm to form special accessible spaces—Secret Realms.
The interior of a Secret Realm retains a complete ecosystem and resource cycle.
Its operation is often more active, and the growth rate of resources far exceeds that of the outside world.
Spirit Plants multiply rapidly, and the recovery cycles for minerals and Yao Beasts are extremely short, giving them high development value.
Based on the tier of the original Divine Kingdom, Secret Realms are divided into four grades:
Heaven-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from high-tier gods’ kingdoms, massive in scale with perfect rules and dense resources; extremely dangerous;
Earth-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from mid-tier gods, stable structure, rich in resources, suitable for long-term development; high danger;
Mystic-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from low-tier gods, moderate resources and moderate danger;
Yellow-Grade Secret Realm—Originating from demigod-level kingdoms, smaller in scale, mostly basic resource production areas; low danger.
Due to the immense value of Secret Realms, major powers usually dispatch legions to guard them long-term, establishing strongholds for blockade and continuous development.”
After figuring out what a Secret Realm was, Yang Fan immediately messaged the group: “I want one too, thanks.”
“Just transfer the Divinity Points to my Divine Kingdom, and I’ll send you the entry permits.”
Sima Bang wasn’t worried about Yang Fan and the others defaulting on payment; he sent the entry permits to their inboxes first.
Sima Bang continued messaging: “This Secret Realm is a resource point for my Sima Family.
There’s no danger inside; just arrange for Intelligent Life to collect resources.”
“Got it, thanks Big Brother Sima.”
“Got it, let’s get together again sometime.”
Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui expressed their thanks.
A profit of tens of thousands of Divinity Points made even children of great families like them excited.
Perhaps only someone of Sima Bang’s status would use such an opportunity to grant a favor!
“Received.”
After replying, Yang Fan immediately transferred the Divinity Points to the other party and then began studying the entry permit.
“Yellow-Grade Secret Realm Exploration Permit (Coordinates: ) — Sima Family Seal.”
Yang Fan placed the permit into his Divine Kingdom and then tapped the coordinates.
His consciousness was instantly sucked away by a spatial force.
“Please present your permit, sir!”
A person wearing a purple robe, stepping on a Flying Sword, floated in mid-air.
Yang Fan recognized at a glance that the other party was a believer, and at the very least, at the Foundation Establishment Realm.
The aura emanating from him was much stronger than that of the Foundation Establishment Tree Demon King in his own Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan took out the permit.
“One-time permit.
Sir, please proceed to Channel 864.”
An irresistible force suddenly descended!
In the next moment, Yang Fan found himself in another world.
The Spiritual Qi here was abundant, and the air carried a distinct vitality.
The terrain was not very undulating, and Spiritual Plants were distributed neatly, showing faint signs of cultivation.
Further away, the aura of Yao Beasts roamed, but it wasn’t chaotic; instead, it followed a certain pattern of “domestication.”
Yang Fan’s eyes flickered.
“As expected of a Secret Realm guarded by a major power.
It seems they come here periodically to harvest.”
As the thought faded, the space vibrated slightly.
Yang Er’s figure appeared first, followed closely by exactly five million believers, spreading out like a tide and quickly forming an array.
“Collect resources along the channel,” Yang Fan arranged.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Er nodded and then organized the believers to start working.
Clearly, whether it was the Spirit Plants or the Yao Beasts, these were resources previously released and nurtured by the Sima Family.
To Yang Fan, he didn’t care much about this small amount of resource profit; the main reason he agreed was to broaden his horizons.
As expected of the Sima Family, one of the five giants—they truly have many ways to nurture the younger generation.
His consciousness quickly withdrew.
When he opened his eyes again, Yang Fan had returned to reality.
He put on his helmet, and his consciousness entered the Virtual World.
