chapters.title: Chapter 115: Major Upgrade of the Divine Kingdom — — Sky City
paragraphs: As soon as Yang Fan appeared, Zhang Pang pounced over.
“Stop, get away from me, I am straight.” Yang Fan raised his foot and kicked the other person away.
Although everyone was just a consciousness body, the sensation was very real, and Zhang Pang, who had fallen to the ground, got up and rubbed his own buttocks.
“I am straight too, just expressing my longing.” Zhang Pang said aggrievedly.
Yang Fan rolled his eyes, “You brat, act normally for me. Tell me, what do you want with me?”

“Didn’t you tell me to invest in Blood Clotting Flower at the beginning of the year? Under the blessing of the Planting Talent, my father and I harvested two waves in total, earning 80 million Faith Points.” Zhang Pang said.
“So much!” Yang Fan said in surprise.
Zhang Wanshan was doing pretty well in Mingyue Community, but that could only be considered the king of the slum area.
Just how much did they invest!
Zhang Pang explained, “My dad mortgaged our property and shops, and also mortgaged the buildings inside his divine kingdom to a financial company. The investment was a bit large.”
Speaking of this, Zhang Pang’s tone even carried a hint of relief.
Fortunately, the acquisition price of Blood Clotting Flower didn’t drop; otherwise, that high interest could have crushed his family.
“Uncle Zhang is fierce enough!” Yang Fan gave a thumbs up.
Because of a single word from him, the other party actually gambled away their entire family fortune.
As expected, ginger is still spicier when old!
Back then, if he didn’t have the Evolution Talent to harvest once every twenty days, he would never have dared to make a heavy investment.
“My dad said since it was the information you provided, he wants to split 50 million out of this 80 million profit with you.” Zhang Pang continued.
“Uncle Zhang is so generous.”
Yang Fan was a bit surprised.
These tens of millions of Faith Points were completely unimportant to him right now, but they were definitely not for Zhang Pang’s family.

“I also think my dad is too generous!” Zhang Pang smiled sheepishly, “However, he said the most valuable thing is the information itself. If it were information provided by his Main God classmate, our family would be lucky to get twenty percent.”

“He also told me to follow you closely. Anyway, the general idea is that in the future, even if I borrow your name, I might even be able to open a big company. He also said you are now favored by a big figure, telling me to be careful when I speak and not be too rash. Anyway, he gave me a lot of instructions, and I didn’t remember them all.” Zhang Pang touched his head while dumping everything his father told him all at once.
Yang Fan rolled his eyes, “Alright, stop acting for me. Playing dumb has gone too far. Keep this little money for yourself, I don’t want it.”

“Adoptive father is so good to me, I’ve heard about it. You earned over 80 billion from the Class 1 divine kingdom resource collection, how could you possibly look down on this little pocket change in my hands.”
“Then why did you still bring it up?”
“Whether you look down on it is one thing, but whether to give it or not is my attitude. Since we are hugging thighs, we still need to have some emotional intelligence.” Zhang Pang said proudly.
“Develop your own divine kingdom well, and you’d better Breakthrough to a demigod. I don’t want to attend your funeral too early.”
“Brother Yang, we don’t say such unlucky things. I still want to live a few more years!” Zhang Pang made a frightened look.
“Today I will let you continue hugging thighs and accompany me to see someone.”
“Who?”
“Classmate, Li Shuhao.”
Yang Fan smiled, and then forwarded the coordinates to Zhang Pang.
“The location of Tianxiang Renjian, I can freeload for another night, thank you adoptive father.” Zhang Pang smiled evilly.
Arriving at Tianxiang Renjian, the place where the two appeared this time was not the ordinary private room outside, but a presidential suite.
Yang Fan was already familiar with this place, but Zhang Pang looked around like Granny Liu entering the Grand View Garden, his head spinning non-stop.
“Genius Yang Da, and Zhang... Brother Zhang, welcome you.” Li Shuhao stood up and said.
“You went to great expense.” Yang Fan said politely.

“Your coming means you treat me as a brother, how can there be any talk of great expense. Today I’ll treat, the three of us will enjoy ourselves well. Come, let’s drink.” Li Shuhao raised his glass and said.
Towards Li Shuhao, Yang Fan had no aversion.
Back then, helping others inquire about his news was also reasonable.
However, speaking the two words ‘brother’ was just polite convention; at most, both parties were just acquaintances.
As for the cost of the presidential suite in Tianxiang Renjian, it was nothing at all to the current Yang Fan.
The reason he chose to accept the invitation and even bring Zhang Pang along naturally had other reasons.
Coming alone every time was naturally a bit boring.
Sometimes playing together with everyone was also experiencing a new fun.
Sharing joy with others is better than enjoying it alone!
Time flew by.
With consciousness traveling back and forth between Tianxiang Renjian and reality, a month quickly passed.
“Believers: Tier 5 Beings (446), Tier 4 Beings (160,000), Tier 3 Beings (4.35 million), Tier 2 Beings (13.31 million), Tier 1 Beings (13.2 million), Mortals (14.8 million),
Vassals: little spirits (32,828),
Faith Points: 12,883 billion (providing 915.2 Faith Points daily).”
The number of Dragon Fish in his divine kingdom had reached ten million, completing the first goal of divine kingdom investment.

Today, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom relied on Dragon Marsh Water Mansion for a monthly net profit of 1.5 million Divinity Points; Monkey Wine Spring had a net profit of 5,000 Divinity Points; Spiritual Vein net profit of 1,000 Divinity Points; hundred herb spirit pivot academy 100 Divinity Points; Moon Well and other miscellaneous earnings were about 20 Divinity Points.

Aside from the explosive growth in divine kingdom investment returns, due to the massive improvement in the divine kingdom’s environment, the overall strength of the believers had multiplied several times over these short 300 years.
Yang Fan could feel that the growth of the believers’ strength was still in a rapid upward period.
In another few hundred years, the Tier 5 Beings could break through a thousand.
Entering the divine kingdom with his consciousness, Yang Fan immediately ordered: “Yang Yi, continue to purchase Penglai Island, Spirit Peach Mountain, Monkey Wine Spring, and Spiritual Vein.”
What Yang Fan lacked the least right now was Divinity Points.
Give himself another month, and his Divinity Points could easily surpass one million.
As long as he continued to stack buildings, the production capacity of the divine kingdom could be raised even higher.
Moreover, Penglai Island and Spiritual Vein were also of great use in improving the Spiritual Qi environment.
Yang Yi spoke up to remind him: “According to the master’s thoughts, the current divine kingdom development path is resource stacking, and the planning is erroneous.”
Yang Fan paused slightly, “Go on.”
“If we only increase the quantity of a single resource node, the returns will grow linearly. It is recommended to adjust it to — — combined ecological composition.”
A light screen unfolded above Yang Yi.
A complete set of deduction models emerged.

“Taking the existing system as the core: Spiritual Vein improves the overall environment, Penglai Island provides an Immortal Qi environment, Spirit Peach Mountain produces basic resources, and Monkey Wine Spring converts basic resources into commodities.”
“The missing parts are: environmental transformation, circular enhancement, and life level transition.”
“It is recommended to add the following buildings:

Solar Core (Grade B): Produced from Mechanical Divine Kingdom, it can simulate a constant light source, form a day-night alternation cycle, absorb and dispatch the divine kingdom’s Spiritual Qi for illumination, and greatly improve the growth efficiency and stability of Spirit Plants.
Price: 10 Divinity Points

Spirit Rain Transformation Platform (Grade B): Using Spiritual Qi as the source, it periodically condenses spirit clouds to drop spirit rain, nourishing Spirit Plants and beings, which can increase growth speed and resource production efficiency.
Price: 80 Divinity Points

Cloud Step Heavenly Path (Grade B): A transportation road constructed in the air connecting various aerial islands, facilitating rapid travel for believers and resource transportation while optimizing the internal operational efficiency of the divine kingdom.
Price: 5 Divinity Points

Four Images Rotation Domain (Grade A): Simulates the changes of the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn, and winter, evolving a natural cycle, enhancing believers’ comprehension of Heaven and Earth’s laws, and promoting cultivation and stable environmental development.
Price: 10,000 Divinity Points

Psionic Dispatch Center (Grade A): A divine kingdom energy core regulation device that can uniformly distribute the flow of Spiritual Qi, optimize resource utilization efficiency, and make various buildings operate synergistically to form an efficient ecological system.
Price: 55,000 Divinity Points.”
Yang Yi was very considerate, even presenting the scene after the construction was completed on the light screen.
The divine kingdom in the light screen began to change.
“Above the firmament, the Solar Core slowly operated.
Light spilled from high above, gentle and stable, just like a real sun revolving in the sky.
Beneath the light, clouds quietly gathered.
The Spirit Rain Transformation Platform induced Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, turning it into fine raindrops falling from high above.
The rain was not hurried, but continuous, falling on Penglai Island, amidst Spirit Peach Mountain, and on every inch of land.
Clouds and mist, light and rainwater intertwined together, resembling a fairyland on earth.
One Cloud Step Heavenly Path after another extended, suspended in the air, connecting with each other, stringing Penglai Island after Penglai Island into a network.
Believers walked upon it, as if shuttling through a sea of clouds.
Looking down from above, islands floated in the air, clouds and rain intertwined, and roads crisscrossed.
This was no longer a lonely night sky, but a’Sky City’ truly suspended above the firmament.”
Yang Fan even felt that his divine kingdom had “come alive”.
“Go with this.” Yang Fan said decisively.
What is called professional!
This is called being professional!

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Faith Points 99999
paragraphs: As expected of a high-level Intelligent Life, just by simply configuring some other buildings like this, he directly constructed a brand-new world in the sky of his own Divine Kingdom.
Moreover, these buildings only needed to be purchased once to cover the entire Divine Kingdom.
For Yang Fan now, they were not expensive at all.

“Master, given the current area of the Divine Kingdom, a total of 100 Penglai Islands can be arranged. By then, the survival area for believers will greatly increase, and the total population cap will increase to 300 million. We can purchase a Breeding Card.”
Yang Yi continued, “With the Psionic Dispatch Center, we can place Spiritual Veins on the ground.”
Yang Fan waved his hand indifferently.
“You can arrange these trivial matters yourself; you don’t need to report everything to me. Also, from now on, the daily fee for the Primordial Academy will be increased to 1,000 Divinity Points.”
With sufficient funds, naturally, doing things was willful.
Purchasing class time with 1,000 Divinity Points meant 100,000 years of study time every day.
Yang Fan was also unsure whether a super second-generation heir like Sima Bang could be as domineering as himself.
The development of the Divine Kingdom required time.
Even with his Evolution Talent, Yang Fan still needed to wait patiently.
One month passed, then two months passed.
During this period, Yang Yi submitted several applications.
“The number of Tier 5 Beings taking the Martial Route has exceeded 100. Requesting to purchase the B-rank Cultivation Technique, Indestructible Golden Body Technique, priced at 5 Divinity Points.”
“Approved.”

“Current Divinity Points are sufficient. Requesting to purchase the Wonder: Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena. Believers’ Body Refining progress will increase by 50%, and Martial Skill comprehension will increase by 30%. Priced at 2,000 Divinity Points.”
“Approved.”
“Requesting to purchase 20 immortal nurturing towers.”
“Approved.”
“Requesting to purchase Spiritual Veins to improve the Divine Kingdom...”
“Approved.”
“Requesting to purchase Spiritual Veins...”
“Approved.”
In these two months, Yang Fan himself almost forgot how many applications he had approved.
Now, Yang Fan was increasingly glad that he had purchased a high-level Intelligent Life like Yang Yi.
Otherwise, with his own brain working twenty-four hours without stopping, it would be impossible to complete so much work.
He hadn’t stepped outside for more than two months.
The buildings he needed were either purchased in the mall or delivered by An Hai.
At this moment, Yang Fan came over to the chair and carefully sat down.
With a bang, the chair forged from refined iron instantly shattered into pieces.
“Yang Yi, buy me a sturdier alloy chair and materialize it into reality immediately. Which broken one is this already?” Yang Fan’s tone was somewhat helpless, yet somewhat blissful.
In two months, which was over 600 years in the Divine Kingdom, as the believers rapidly grew stronger, Yang Fan’s Physical Body had grown dozens of times stronger.
During this period, it wasn’t just the chairs; Yang Fan had replaced all his furniture with ones forged from refined iron.
There was no help for it; his own strength had surged too fast, and he was somewhat unable to control it.
After materializing the alloy chair into reality through a card, Yang Fan immediately sat down, his consciousness entering the Divine Kingdom.

Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (all resources in the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.)
Believers: Tier 5 Beings (4,422), Tier 4 Beings (600,000), Tier 3 Beings (14.22 million), Tier 2 Beings (43.31 million), Tier 1 Beings (83.2 million), Mortals (64.8 million)
Dependent: little spirits (42,222)
Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Indestructible Golden Body Technique (Entry), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-rank, Minor Achievement)...
Faith Points: 22,883 billion (daily supply of 999.9 Faith Points)

Buildings: Moon Well x20,000, Sun Spring x20,000, A-rank Building Psionic Dispatch Center, A-rank Building Spiritual Vein x20, A-rank Building Four Symbols Rotation Domain, B-rank Building immortal nurturing tower x50, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring x50,000, B-rank hundred herb spirit pivot academy, B-rank Building Solar Core, B-rank Building Spirit Rain Transformation Platform, B-rank Building Cloud Step Heavenly Path...
Wonders: Penglai Island x100 (arranged), Spirit Peach Mountain x500 (arranged), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x1,000 (arranged), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena (arranged)
Assets: Dragon Fish fry (x10 million), Spirit Stone (**), various spiritual fruits (**)...”

In these two months, the total revenue of the Divine Kingdom exceeded 3 million Divinity Points, among which over 2 million were used to purchase Penglai Island, Spirit Peach Mountain, and Monkey Wine Spring.
Most of the remaining funds were used by Yang Yi to purchase Spiritual Veins.
Now, the Spiritual Qi in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had reached a state close to liquefaction, and every rainfall from the Spirit Rain Transformation Platform was like raining spiritual liquid.
Under such an environment, the believers in the Divine Kingdom were slowly growing stronger even just by breathing, and their Aptitude was continuously improving.
Coupled with the massive purchase of Penglai Island, the living space for believers had increased, causing the population to surge significantly.
Adding all these reasons together, the number of Tier 5 Beings could soar to 4,422 within 600 years.
It was just a pity that the Faith Points that believers could provide daily were still stuck at 999.99.
Yang Fan understood that this was because no believers in the Qi Refining Realm had yet been born within his Divine Kingdom.
This was a hurdle for breaking through to a demigod.

Once a believer in the Qi Refining Realm appeared, the total area of his Divine Kingdom would break through the limit of one million square kilometers, and his life level would undergo a qualitative leap.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this.
To be precise, he felt that he was not far from this step.
If it were two months ago, Yang Fan still had no direction at all regarding breaking through to a demigod, but now he seemed to have touched that barrier.
An opportunity, a bit of luck, or even lying in bed sleeping, he could become a demigod powerhouse at any time.
Watching his Divine Kingdom change with each passing day, Yang Fan couldn’t help but open his arms and sigh, “It’s really great to be admitted to the Primordial Academy.”
Yang Fan was clear that if he hadn’t been rated as a Human Race Prodigy and come to Taichu City, he would never have achieved his current accomplishments.
Yang Fan now was like standing on the shoulders of giants, leaping forward a huge step.
Yang Er had also returned to the Divine Kingdom a few days ago.
Secret Realms controlled by major families like this were extremely safe.
This exploration basically resulted in no loss of believers.
However, what Yang Er brought back were all basic resources.
After selling them, they amounted to about 40,000 Divinity Points.
Yang Fan naturally looked down on this bit of revenue, but it was better than nothing.
Moreover, this experience also let him know that besides Alien Divine Kingdoms, there were countless Secret Realms in this world.
In the future, after Yang Fan’s believers broke through the Qi Refining Realm, they might as well go out to explore.
At this moment, Yang Fan was admiring the beautiful scenery of Penglai Islands crisscrossing and connecting in the sky of the Divine Kingdom.
Suddenly, Yang Yi reminded, “Master, there is a message notification in the important group chat.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to the Real World.
Ye Jianfeng: “I have broken through to a demigod and want to treat everyone to dinner. Do the three of you have time? @All”
Sima Bang: “Come to the Sima Family’s restaurant for dinner, all expenses covered. Congratulations to Brother Ye first.”
Wen Yushui: “Big Brother Ye is amazing, breaking through to a demigod so quickly. I definitely have time.”
Yang Fan: “Congratulations, I have time too.”
After everyone confirmed, Sima Bang sent an address in the group chat.
Changing his clothes and pushing open the door, this was the first time Yang Fan had left his room in two months.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Qi Refining Realm Believers
paragraphs: The Sima Family’s restaurant in Taichu City was named ‘Yuexiang Pavilion’.
‘Yuexiang Pavilion’ covered an area of a full thousand square meters.
It unfolded in an overall circular shape, with the building layers stacked up and stretching out continuously.
Standing outside, Yang Fan could even sense the fluctuations of the Formation.
“As expected of the Sima Family, one of the Five Great Giants, they are truly overbearing,” Yang Fan sighed with emotion.
In Taichu City, where every inch of land was extremely precious, they had actually opened such a massive restaurant, which was enough to demonstrate the strength of the Sima Family.
“Your Highness, do you happen to have a reservation?” A low-tier god stepped forward to ask.
“Earth-grade Room Number 5,” Yang Fan said.
“So you are Young Master’s friend, please follow me.” The other party stepped forward to lead the way.
Arriving at the room, Yang Fan found that the other three had already arrived.
“Apologies, I am late.”
Ye Jianfeng waved and said, “It’s fine, hurry up and sit down to eat. Young Master Sima was so hungry he could barely wait for you!”
Over these past two months, although Yang Fan had not left his room, he frequently spoke in the chat group.
Sometimes the four of them would also gather in the Virtual World, and their relationship had grown quite a bit closer.
“Brother Ye, after breaking through to demigod, how has your strength changed?” Sima Bang asked while eating.
Wen Yushui and Yang Fan similarly revealed curious expressions.

“The changes are huge. The area of my Divine Kingdom has grown to nine million square kilometers, and the rules within the Divine Kingdom tend to be complete. From then on, it is even easier for believers to break through the Qi Refining Realm.”
“Aside from that, my connection with the Divine Kingdom is even closer, and my self in the Real World is already able to use the believers’ methods of defending against enemies.”
Speaking of this, Ye Jianfeng lightly raised his right hand, and a sword light gathered from Spiritual Qi surfaced at his fingertips.
With a gentle flick from him, the wine glass in front of him was blasted into fine powder, yet the wine inside was wrapped in a gentle power and did not spill all over the ground.
“Is this Divine Power?” Yang Fan sighed with emotion.

“So-called Divine Power is nothing more than inheriting a portion of the believers’ special abilities. My talent is the Myriad Sword Physique, and most believers have the Aptitude to Cultivate the Dao of the Sword, thus I can swing out Sword Qi. Some people’s believers specialize in the fire attribute, so they can wield flames. Like Sister Wen’s Water God Talent, after reaching demigod, she can control water. These are all changes after gods walking the Cultivation Route break through. The Martial Route is mostly related to the Physical Body itself. Those high-tier martial gods blowing up a planet with a single punch is completely possible. As for gods on the Mechanical Path, they are mostly related to computing power and creation.”
“Simply put, Divine Power is the materialization of believers’ abilities. Whatever the believers are good at, you will possess that kind of power,” Ye Jianfeng explained.
Yang Fan looked at the other party curiously, “Then what if one walks the Fusion route of Cultivation and Martial Arts?”
“That would naturally mean having a powerful Physical Body while also being able to cast spells.”

Ye Jianfeng looked at Yang Fan with some envy, “Brother Yang possesses the talent of the Tenfold Time Sequence. If resources are sufficient, perhaps he really can try walking the path of Dual Cultivation.”
“An S-rank Talent related to the Law of time like the Tenfold Time Sequence is an outstanding existence even among S-rank Talents.”

“With the Tenfold Time Sequence talent, although the believers themselves develop quickly, the burden on the Divine Kingdom is also very heavy. Choosing to run Cultivation and Martial Arts in parallel consumes quite a few resources,” Sima Bang couldn’t help reminding him.

Wen Yushui took a sip of the mind-refreshing tea, “My Wen Family also has elders who walked the Fusion route. They are indeed strong in the same Realm, but they are still stuck at a Tier 3 God to this day.”
“Many thanks to the two of you for the guidance, I know what I’m doing.”
The two people’s reminder came out of good intentions, which Yang Fan naturally understood.
At this moment, Ye Jianfeng’s gaze was fixed intently on Yang Fan, “Brother Yang’s strength has changed so much, it feels like he is about to break through to demigod.”
Ye Jianfeng, who was already a demigod powerhouse, had a perception much sharper than Sima Bang and the other.
Unlike the last gathering, the aura of Yang Fan’s Physical Body was not even weaker than Sima Bang, who walked the Martial Route.
The change could not be described as small.
Although Ye Jianfeng was the first among the four to break through to demigod, that was because he had already touched the threshold when he came to study at the Primordial Academy.
Solely speaking of the speed of progress, Ye Jianfeng felt that Yang Fan was the fastest person among the four of them.
Hearing these words, the gazes of Sima Bang and Wen Yushui were somewhat shocked.

Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand and said low-profilely, “I am still far from breaking through to demigod. The believers’ strength has indeed changed quite a bit, but I still have to thank the educational resources of the Primordial Academy.”
Hearing this, the three of them subconsciously nodded.
Not to mention those strategic-level buildings that were hard to see in the outside world, the Primordial Academy already allowed everyone’s believers to reap massive gains.
For a Prodigy with an ordinary background like Yang Fan, their progress in the freshman semester would indeed be even greater.
“Let’s all work hard, wishing all three of us to completely break through to demigod in the freshman semester.” Wen Yushui used tea as a substitute for wine.
“Alright, Brother Ye took a step ahead. We will catch up as soon as possible,” Sima Bang likewise echoed.
Although he came from the Sima Family, Ye Jianfeng being able to break through to demigod so quickly was enough to show his potential.
At today’s dinner party, Sima Bang’s overall attitude was a bit more humble.
This was reality.
Even if no one explicitly stated it, the attitudes and identities of the four were undergoing subtle changes.
Yang Fan was somewhat curious, “Brother Ye, what is your ranking on the Primordial Battlefield?”
Ye Jianfeng shook his head, “Not great, over 2.4 millionth place. Having just broken through not long ago, I should be a bottom-tier demigod powerhouse in the Primordial Academy right now.”

Relying on his S-rank Talent Myriad Sword Physique, Ye Jianfeng had originally thought his combat strength was matchless and went to challenge the Primordial Battlefield at the very first opportunity.
But the result left something to be desired.
The Primordial Academy truly lived up to its name as a cradle of Geniuses; casually pulling out any demigod powerhouse would mean someone at the top tier if placed in the outside world.

“Brother Ye went to challenge the Primordial Battlefield just after breaking through; this result is already quite good. With your talent, perhaps you might even become a true god during university,” Sima Bang said.
“Brother Sima, stop buttering me up. Just thinking about such a thing in a dream is enough,” Ye Jianfeng smiled bitterly and said.
Only by truly breaking through to a demigod does one become even clearer about just how far the distance between a demigod and a god actually is.
If going from a Divine Being to a demigod was a 100-meter sprint, then breaking through from a demigod to a god was a marathon.
Even placed in a gathering place of Prodigies like the Primordial Academy, monsters capable of becoming god-level powerhouses during university were still few and far between.
“Come, drink. I feel that the Monkey Wine brewed by Brother Yang tastes even better than last time.”
“Then Brother Sima, drink more. There’s plenty of Monkey Wine to go around!”
“Refreshing.”
This meal was eaten very comfortably.
From Divine Kingdom investments to believer developments, they finally chatted about following elders to truly experience the world at the Divine Kingdom Battlefield when they were young.
After a dinner party, Yang Fan gained an even deeper understanding of these great Family disciples.
Powerful gods possessed good genes, and the probability of their descendants possessing powerful talents was even higher.
The more powerful the elders were, the more right to speak they possessed within the Human Federation, thereby seizing massive amounts of resources.
The Cultivation methods for descendants were also different from remote places like Yang County.
Once a Divine Kingdom was awakened, the Family would fund the purchase of Intelligent Life and hire an Actuary to arrange the development of the Divine Kingdom.
Even the Divine Kingdom during the Barbarians era had already placed S-Rank Buildings.
The might of talents, a systematically complete educational method, and resources given upon request.
No wonder more than eighty percent of powerhouses in the entire Human Federation nowadays came from the Five Great Giants.
Phoenixes flying out of a chicken coop like Yang Fan would also many times choose to sell their freedom to large Families in exchange for resources to invest in their Divine Kingdom.
The development of a Divine Kingdom: slow by one step, slow by every step.
Everyone exerted all their strength to snatch quotas, fight for resources, and pull in investments.
At this moment, Yang Fan had already returned home, lying on the bed and preparing to fall asleep.
Suddenly, it was as if some boundary within his own body had been broken through.
Boom!
An invisible power descended from the Void Realm, instantly piercing through his body.
“Believers of the Qi Refining Realm have appeared!” Yang Fan abruptly opened his eyes.

Phoenixes flying out of a chicken coop like Yang Fan would also many times choose to sell their freedom to large Families in exchange for resources to invest in their Divine Kingdom.
The development of a Divine Kingdom: slow by one step, slow by every step.
Everyone exerted all their strength to snatch quotas, fight for resources, and pull in investments.
At this moment, Yang Fan had already returned home, lying on the bed and preparing to fall asleep.
Suddenly, it was as if some boundary within his own body had been broken through.
Boom!
An invisible power descended from the Void Realm, instantly piercing through his body.
“Believers of the Qi Refining Realm have appeared!” Yang Fan abruptly opened his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Talent Upgrade Hundredfold Acceleration
paragraphs: Blood surged like a torrent within his body, his bones emitted a low roar, and his muscles, Meridians, and even every single cell were undergoing a frantic transformation.
His strength began to skyrocket at a speed that was nearing out of control.
Between breaths, the air was compressed; the sound of his heartbeat thundered like battle drums.
Yang Fan could feel that this enhancement was different from previous ones; his genes seemed to be undergoing a ‘leap’.
His entire Physical Body seemed to step directly from the mortal realm into another level of life.
At this moment, Yang Fan even felt that he could not bear the pain, and his consciousness began to be forcibly pulled away.
Opening his eyes again, Yang Fan’s consciousness was already within the Divine Kingdom.
The earth was expanding.
Wherever his vision reached, the territory extended frantically, mountains rose abruptly from the ground, and rivers rushed out from the Void Realm.
The area surged straight to ten million square kilometers!
Between heaven and earth, the rules began to improve.
The Spiritual Qi, which was originally so dense that it was nearly liquefied, now began to become thin, diluted by the massively increased space of the Divine Kingdom.
In the distance, a great river traversed heaven and earth with a mighty current; mountain ranges undulated continuously straight into the clouds; lakes were like mirrors, reflecting the firmament;
The wind flowed, the clouds changed, and the light of the Solar Core radiated across the entire heaven and earth.
Yang Fan’s consciousness stood high above in the sky.
At this moment, he clearly felt that his Divine Kingdom had completed an essential leap.
A demigod is finally achieved!
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 10 million square kilometers
Talent: SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, accelerates Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden) (Upgraded, currently 100-fold acceleration)
Believers: Qi Refining Realm (1) Tier 5 Being (4622)...
Divinity Points: 230,000 (provides 0.00001 Divinity Points daily)”
Feeling the changes inside the Divine Kingdom.
The increase in area and the improvement of rules were secondary.
What surprised Yang Fan the most was that his SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution had finally changed.
The 100-fold time acceleration was ten times higher than before, and as for the consumption, it only required 1 Divinity Point per day.
Being conscious within the Divine Kingdom, he laughed out loud directly, “Good, good, good, my Dao is promising!”
What does breaking through to a demigod even count for?
How can it compare to the sweetness of an Evolution Talent upgrade!
Previously, when others developed their Divine Kingdom for one year, his Divine Kingdom developed for ten years.
But now it had become one year for others and a hundred years for him.
“Congratulations, Master, on breaking through to a demigod.” Yang Yi and Yang Er said in unison.
Yang Fan nodded, “Now that the Divine Kingdom area has expanded, continue to purchase Dragon Marsh Water Mansion to increase revenue.”

“Master, investment in the Divine Kingdom needs to be step by step. Currently, the Divine Kingdom area is vast, and the believer population is severely lacking. I apply to purchase the A-Rank Breeding Card first.” Yang Yi said.
“No problem.” Yang Fan waved his hand indifferently.
With Yang Fan’s current ability to earn Divinity Points, he no longer needed to care about the price of one-time consumables like the Breeding Card.

“Master, as the rules of the Divine Kingdom improve, believers will find it easier to break through the Qi Refining Realm. According to big data projections, the strength of believers will show explosive growth within a thousand years in the Divine Kingdom.”

“The B-Rank Cultivation Technique Everlasting Spring Technique belongs to the wood attribute Cultivation Technique. I apply to purchase one set each of the metal, water, fire, and earth attribute Cultivation Techniques.”
“Agreed.”

“The current Divine Kingdom possesses the building Alchemy Tower, and has the matching hundred herb spirit pivot academy. I apply to expand the Primordial Academy curriculum so that believers can learn the secondary profession ‘Alchemist’.”
“Agreed.”
“It is recommended to purchase the C-rank Array...”
“Agreed, agreed, agreed! All agreed!” Yang Fan interrupted.
With the Breakthrough to demigod, the work inside the Divine Kingdom was increasing more and more.
Now Yang Fan was like a chairman, while Yang Yi and Yang Er were his secretaries.
Now, even just nodding in agreement, Yang Fan was starting to find it troublesome.
Yang Fan asked, “To break through and become a true god, to what extent specifically does the Divine Kingdom need to develop?”
Having clearly just broken through to a demigod, stimulated by the 100-fold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan had already developed the wild ambition to become a god.

“There are two major conditions to becoming a god: First, relying solely on believers, reality provides 1 Divinity Point daily. Second, the total area of the Divine Kingdom breaks through one hundred million square kilometers.” Yang Yi answered based on the data.
“One hundred million square kilometers? It is so simple, one only needs to purchase a Divine Kingdom expansion card.” A trace of ease appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
Although the Divine Kingdom expansion card was not cheap, the thing he worried about least right now was the problem of money.
Under a hundredfold return, how could he lack ordinary resources in the future?
“Master has misunderstood. Unlike Divine Beings, if a demigod wants to increase the area of the Divine Kingdom, it cannot be done through a Divine Kingdom expansion card.”
“Then what should be done?”
“Absorb the Divine Kingdom Core!”
“Divine Kingdom Core?” Yang Fan frowned.
He naturally knew what the Divine Kingdom Core was.
As long as they were gods, they all had their own Divine Kingdom Core.
Once the Divine Kingdom Core was destroyed, the god and all the believers within the Divine Kingdom would perish at the same time.

Yang Yi continued to explain, “The Divine Kingdom Battlefield possesses special rules. Once the Divine Kingdom Core is seized, all living beings, buildings, and even plants within the Divine Kingdom will collapse.”

“As for the land of the Divine Kingdom itself, a part of it transforms into spoils of war, crossing space to appear in the victor’s Divine Kingdom, while another part drifts in the Void Realm, colliding with other Void Realm remnants, and after countless times, forms various Secret Realms.”
Hearing this, a trace of sudden realization appeared on Yang Fan’s face.
No wonder there was the saying of ‘pioneering reclamation’.
After those Alien Gods were defeated, the victor would send believers to clean out all the assets in the Divine Kingdom, and only then choose to collect the Alien God’s Divine Kingdom Core.
After all, wasting resources is shameful.
Yang Fan continued, “Can the Divine Kingdom Core be purchased?”

“It cannot be purchased. The Divine Kingdom Core has a huge effect on both demigods and gods. After resource collection is completed, gods will always choose to absorb it on the spot, and it is impossible to place it in the mall for sale.”
“It seems that in the future, I will still have to go take a look at the school’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone.” Yang Fan muttered.
If the world Yang Fan lived in was named ‘Dimension One’, then the Divine Kingdom they controlled was in ‘Dimension Two’.
The area of Dimension Two was countless times that of Dimension One.
And these so-called gods of theirs were more like gaming youths sitting in front of computers, and these successive Divine Kingdom Wars were just like life-and-death games.
Winning allowed one to obtain the opponent’s resources and territory, while losing meant that one’s self in reality would also die.
The rules were simple yet cruel, but Yang Fan was excited and full of drive.
A simple truth: what kind of gamer is the strongest?
It’s not the one with the best operations, nor the one who spends money to pay-to-win, but the cheater.
If not for the cheat that was the SSS-rank Talent, Yang Fan might still be working hard to make a living with his parents in Mingyue Community right now.
Consciousness returned to reality, and Yang Fan could feel that the modification of his body had been completed.

Unlike the Divine Being period when his strength skyrocketed to the point of being uncontrollable, along with breaking through to a demigod, Yang Fan felt that his Mental Energy had become thousands of times stronger.
Not only could he easily control this powerful Physical Body, but even his connection with his Divine Kingdom had become closer.
Even while staying in reality, he could feel everything happening within the Divine Kingdom in real-time.
Feeling the Divine Kingdom changing every single second, Yang Fan couldn’t help whispering, “Is this the hundredfold time flow rate? It really is fascinating.”

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Massive Update of Divine Kingdom Buildings
paragraphs: After breaking through to Demigod, for every month in the Real World, three thousand years passed in the Divine Kingdom.

With his current Divine Kingdom assets, one thousand Dragon Marsh Water Mansions yielded 15 million Divinity Points per month, the Monkey Wine Spring yielded 5 million Divinity Points, the Spiritual Vein yielded 200,000 Divinity Points, plus various miscellaneous gains, reaching up to 22 million Divinity Points per month.
Breaking through to Demigod, Yang Fan did not make a fuss and continued to live an ordinary life just like usual.
The only difference perhaps was that he could go to the second floor of Tianxiang Renjian, where there were Demigod service personnel.
Their price was much more expensive, requiring 2 million Faith Points for a single night, but for Yang Fan, calling 10 of them was not a problem at all.
In the blink of an eye, a month passed.
At this moment, Yang Fan was sitting cross-legged in the small courtyard.
With a thought, the skin on his body began to turn golden.
Yang Fan opened his right hand, and flames of different colors emerged from his five fingers respectively.
Golden, green, blue, red, yellow.
These colors represented the five Spiritual Qis of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth respectively.
With three thousand years of development in the Divine Kingdom, believers in the Qi Refining Realm alone reached over ten thousand people, among whom were all kinds of Spiritual Root Aptitudes.
Correspondingly, Yang Fan could likewise borrow their power.
This power was not the complete strength of the believers, but rather weakened by a thousandfold or ten thousandfold.
However, how vast was the believer population of the Divine Kingdom?
Over ten thousand Cultivators in the Qi Refining Realm added together also allowed Yang Fan’s strength in reality to surpass ordinary Qi Refining Realm levels.
There were also several thousand believers on the Martial Route who had reached the Martial Disciple Realm.
At this moment, the hint of gold on Yang Fan’s skin was the manifestation of the Indestructible Golden Body Technique reaching Major Achievement.
Yang Fan had specifically tried it out; with his current Physical Body, he could easily crush D-grade weapons.
Consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: Ten million square kilometers
Talent: SSS-rank Talent Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.) (Upgraded, currently 100x acceleration)
Believers: Qi Refining Realm (12,736), Martial Disciple Realm (4,323), Tier 5 Beings (36 million)...
Tier 1 Beings (800 million), Mortal (1.2 billion)
Profession: Alchemist (1,000)
Dependents: Adult Elf (200,000)

Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Gengjin Rift-Blade Art (Minor Achievement), Profound Water Origin-Returning Art (Minor Achievement), Crimson Flame Burning Heaven Record (Minor Achievement), Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture (Minor Achievement), Indestructible Golden Body Technique (Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Initiation), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 1.1 million (Providing 0.067 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well x100,000, Sun Spring x100,000, A-grade Building Spiritual Vein x100, B-grade Building Alchemy Tower x10, B-grade Building immortal nurturing tower x200, B-grade Building Monkey Wine Spring x250,000, B-grade hundred herb spirit pivot academy x5, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (100,000 years, nurturing Adult Elves)...
Wonders: Penglai Island x500 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x2,500 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x5,000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena (Deployed)
Assets: Dragon Fish seedlings (x50 million)...”
Under the blessing of the A-grade Breeding Card, the total population of the Divine Kingdom was close to 3 billion.

Besides this, due to purchasing a large number of resource buildings that changed the Divine Kingdom’s environment like Moon Wells and Spiritual Veins, the growth time of the Ancient Spirit Tree was greatly shortened, entering maturity together with the little spirits.
The strength of the Adult Elf was between Tier 5 Beings and the Qi Refinement Stage.
If utilizing the geographical environment, groups of 10 could even threaten believers in the Qi Refining Realm.
With the current strength of the Divine Kingdom’s believers, the Elf Race was not considered weak.

Penglai Island and Dragon Marsh Water Mansions were also being deployed intensively; even though the Divine Kingdom had developed for over 3,000 years, these resource-type buildings still had not reached their limits.
The main reason was that a large number of believers broke through to the Qi Refining Stage one after another, causing the population to surge explosively.
Resource investment naturally began to grow exponentially.
Food consumption skyrocketed, and the Spirit Stones, Medicinal Pills, and cultivation grounds required for Cultivation also expanded comprehensively.
In a short period of time, a large amount of resources were continuously invested into “maintenance and enhancement”.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this; his speed in earning Faith Points would only get faster and faster, so he naturally would not be stingy with investments in believers.
According to his estimate, it wouldn’t take two months for the output of resource-type buildings to be maxed out.
By that time, the monthly Divinity Points yield would reach hundreds of millions.
High above the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan was overlooking the changes of the entire world.

Yang Yi’s figure condensed, and he bowed saying, “Master, it is detected that the overall tier of the Divine Kingdom has greatly increased, and some buildings are no longer suited for the current stage of development.”
Yang Fan’s gaze shifted, “Speak.”

“B-grade building —— one Flesh Sea Blood Pool and one Hundred Spirits Blood Pool each. The current believers’ Aptitude and Cultivation environment have significantly improved. For such basic Bloodline enhancement facilities, the marginal returns approach zero.”
“Suggestion: Sell all of them and recycle the resources.”
Yang Fan did not hesitate, “Agreed.”
Just as Yang Yi said, these two buildings really didn’t have much help for the current Divine Kingdom, and were even a waste of space.

Yang Yi nodded and continued to report: “Special building —— Fully Automatic Concentrator x6, currently only supports low-grade food compression, which does not match the energy demand at the current stage.”
“Tai sui x610, the grade is relatively low and can no longer meet the growth of high-grade believers.”
“Suggestion: Sell them uniformly and replace them with a high-grade food System.”
As he spoke, a sky light screen unfolded.
“Recommended procurement is as follows:

Tianyuan spiritual grain Granary (B-grade): Used for long-term storage of various spiritual grain resources, internally building a stable spiritual aura sealing environment, which can effectively lock in the energy and activity within the spiritual grains, preventing loss and corruption.
Price: 5 Divinity Points.
Long-term procurement of grains such as Nine-Turn Spiritual Corn, Tianyuan Golden Marrow Rice, Xuanjing Soul-Nourishing Rice, Taiqing Condensed Flower Rice, and Zixiao Origin-Nourishing Rice.
Based on the current strength and quantity of Divine Kingdom believers, the Divine Kingdom needs to consume 5,000 Divinity Points every hundred years.

Dragon Meat Cold Storage (B-grade): A functional building dedicated to storing high-grade Dragon flesh and blood, internally building a dual System of low temperature and spiritual aura sealing, which can maximize the locking in of energy and activity in the meat quality.
Price: 20 Divinity Points.
Long-term procurement of Dragon corpses such as Taixu Dragon, Xuanming Dragon, Flame Dragon, Thunder Dragon, and Earth Dragon.
Based on the current strength and quantity of Divine Kingdom believers, the Divine Kingdom needs to consume 10,000 Divinity Points every hundred years.

Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub (A-grade): An automated spiritual food processing building that can make optimal combinations of various high-grade meats, spiritual rice, and spiritual materials, batch-generating high-quality spiritual meals.

With a built-in energy ratio and cooking System, it can automatically adjust the nutritional structure according to believers’ needs, greatly improving absorption efficiency and Cultivation effects, realizing the efficient transformation of “resources → combat power”.
Price: 20,000 Divinity Points.”
Looking at the contents of the light screen, Yang Fan couldn’t help smacking his lips.
It truly was a massive upgrade; with this whole set, the believers in his Divine Kingdom probably ate better than most gods in the Real World.
If it were anyone else, it would be utterly impossible to invest so many resources into food, but who told Yang Fan to earn so much!
Given the current number of resource-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom, even without the Evolution Talent, its yields could easily cover expenses.
Precisely because he considered the Divine Kingdom’s resource output, Yang Yi proposed such a luxurious suggestion.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this; his speed in earning Faith Points would only get faster and faster, so his investment in believers would naturally not be stingy.
“C-grade building —— transmission tower x5, limited coverage, low Legacy efficiency, recommended to upgrade to ——”
The light screen flickered slightly.

“Myriad Laws Heaven-Derived God Tower (A-grade): This building can cover an area of up to 100 million square kilometers, supporting large-scale Cultivation Technique Legacy and synchronized Evolution. It has data collection and feedback capabilities, capable of real-time collection of believer Cultivation data, achieving overall Cultivation efficiency improvement. Price: 100,000 Divinity Points.”
“Replace.”

The current believers’ Aptitude and Cultivation environment have significantly improved.
For such basic Bloodline enhancement facilities, the marginal returns approach zero.”
“Suggestion: Sell all of them and recycle the resources.”
Yang Fan did not hesitate, “Agreed.”
Just as Yang Yi said, these two buildings really didn’t have much help for the current Divine Kingdom, and were even a waste of space.

Yang Yi nodded and continued to report: “Special building —— Fully Automatic Concentrator x6, currently only supports low-grade food compression, which does not match the energy demand at the current stage.”
“Tai sui x610, the grade is relatively low and can no longer meet the growth of high-grade believers.”
“Suggestion: Sell them uniformly and replace them with a high-grade food System.”
As he spoke, a sky light screen unfolded.
“Recommended procurement is as follows:

Tianyuan spiritual grain Granary (B-grade): Used for long-term storage of various spiritual grain resources, internally building a stable spiritual aura sealing environment, which can effectively lock in the energy and activity within the spiritual grains, preventing loss and corruption.
Price: 5 Divinity Points.
Long-term procurement of grains such as Nine-Turn Spiritual Corn, Tianyuan Golden Marrow Rice, Xuanjing Soul-Nourishing Rice, Taiqing Condensed Flower Rice, and Zixiao Origin-Nourishing Rice.
Based on the current strength and quantity of Divine Kingdom believers, the Divine Kingdom needs to consume 5,000 Divinity Points every hundred years.

Dragon Meat Cold Storage (B-grade): A functional building dedicated to storing high-grade Dragon flesh and blood, internally building a dual System of low temperature and spiritual aura sealing, which can maximize the locking in of energy and activity in the meat quality.
Price: 20 Divinity Points.
Long-term procurement of Dragon corpses such as Taixu Dragon, Xuanming Dragon, Flame Dragon, Thunder Dragon, and Earth Dragon.
Based on the current strength and quantity of Divine Kingdom believers, the Divine Kingdom needs to consume 10,000 Divinity Points every hundred years.

Myriad Spirits Dietary Hub (A-grade): An automated spiritual food processing building that can make optimal combinations of various high-grade meats, spiritual rice, and spiritual materials, batch-generating high-quality spiritual meals.

With a built-in energy ratio and cooking System, it can automatically adjust the nutritional structure according to believers’ needs, greatly improving absorption efficiency and Cultivation effects, realizing the efficient transformation of “resources → combat power”.
Price: 20,000 Divinity Points.”
Looking at the contents of the light screen, Yang Fan couldn’t help smacking his lips.
It truly was a massive upgrade; with this whole set, the believers in his Divine Kingdom probably ate better than most gods in the Real World.
If it were anyone else, it would be utterly impossible to invest so many resources into food, but who told Yang Fan to earn so much!
Given the current number of resource-type buildings in the Divine Kingdom, even without the Evolution Talent, its yields could easily cover expenses.
Precisely because he considered the Divine Kingdom’s resource output, Yang Yi proposed such a luxurious suggestion.
Yang Fan was not anxious about this; his speed in earning Faith Points would only get faster and faster, so his investment in believers would naturally not be stingy.
“C-grade building —— transmission tower x5, limited coverage, low Legacy efficiency, recommended to upgrade to ——”
The light screen flickered slightly.

“Myriad Laws Heaven-Derived God Tower (A-grade): This building can cover an area of up to 100 million square kilometers, supporting large-scale Cultivation Technique Legacy and synchronized Evolution.
It has data collection and feedback capabilities, capable of real-time collection of believer Cultivation data, achieving overall Cultivation efficiency improvement.
Price: 100,000 Divinity Points.”
“Replace.”

chapters.title: Chapter 120: The Divine Kingdom is Invaded!!!
paragraphs: Another half-month passed.
Yang Fan’s life gradually returned to a nearly luxurious peace.
Everything he ate daily came from the Divine Kingdom.
The spiritual rice was crystal-clear and melted in the mouth; the spiritual fruits were sweet and carried faint spiritual charm; even the meat was from a Dragon, containing abundant energy.
Compared to this, even the so-called delicacies of Yuexiang Pavilion fell short.
He occasionally closed his eyes to sense the Divine Kingdom, watching the steady increase in the quantity and quality of believers.
Everything was developing in the ideal direction.
The future seemed clearly visible.
“After some more time, I should also go explore the Primordial Battlefield!” Yang Fan said while dozing, feeling completely relaxed.
At that very moment, violent fluctuations suddenly came from deep within the Divine Kingdom!
“Warning! Warning!”
The voices of Yang Yi and Yang Er rang out almost simultaneously, carrying unprecedented urgency.
“Abnormal spatial tearing detected!”
“High-intensity invasion response—Divine Kingdom coordinates exposed, alien believers are attacking!”
Yang Fan’s mind shook, and he abruptly sat up.
Without needing a reminder, as a deity, he had already perceived the changes in the Divine Kingdom space.
Something was forcibly breaking into his Divine Kingdom!
His consciousness instantly withdrew from reality.
Opening his eyes again, Yang Fan had already appeared at the center of the Divine Kingdom.
At the edge of the Divine Kingdom, spatial rifts were forcefully torn open.
The rifts hung in the air like wounds, their edges twisted and vibrating, with figures continuously pouring out from the darkness.
The first to step out were a batch of tall demon monkeys, numbering as many as hundreds of millions of beings.
Their fur was thick and black, their muscles knotted, their eyes flashed with crimson light, and their aura was violent and fierce.
What was even more terrifying was that the aura of dozens of them had already stepped into the Qi Refining Stage!
The moment they landed, the earth trembled slightly.
Immediately after, more alien armies poured out from the rifts, densely packed and spreading out like a tidal wave.
Roars rose and fell, carrying a primitive and violent aura, rapidly spreading toward the Divine Kingdom.
The war had arrived completely without warning.
“Damn it—what is this situation?!” Yang Fan cursed outright.
He was still completely dazed.

The moment before, he was leisurely eating spiritual meals at home, living a nearly “lying flat” farming life—the Divine Kingdom’s resources were self-sufficient, the environment was superior, and development was stable.
Yet the next second—the Divine Kingdom was invaded?!
The transition came too suddenly; at this moment, Yang Fan’s heart was almost in his throat.
This was the first true sense of—the Divine Kingdom suffering an invasion.
Yang Fan had just experienced a Breakthrough to demigod not long ago, his SSS-rank Talent had completed its evolution, everything was developing at high speed, and the future was bright.
He certainly didn’t want to meet an untimely demise just as he was getting started!
“Yang Yi, what on earth is going on!” Yang Fan’s voice was somewhat anxious.
Yang Yi’s figure quickly condensed, and his tone remained calm, “The current situation falls within the category of normal risks.”
“With the Breakthrough to the demigod tier, the external ‘accessibility’ of the Divine Kingdom has greatly increased.”

“If a Divine Being does not possess believers of the Qi Refining Stage or above, it is basically unable to leave the Divine Kingdom for external exploration. Unless actively locked onto by a high-tier existence and having its coordinates deduced, the Divine Kingdom remains in a relatively closed state.”
“Its probability of invasion is extremely low.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly.

Yang Yi’s tone had no fluctuations, “After the birth of believers in the Qi Refining Realm, the ‘degree of connection’ with the outside world increases, making it possible to be explored by other deities’ believers, thereby triggering an invasion event.”
“The current situation may belong to a random contact-type invasion.”
After listening, Yang Fan’s expression became a bit uglier, “In other words, there will be more in the future?”
“The probability exists.”
After a brief pause, Yang Yi added, “But please rest assured, scanning of the invading units has been completed.”
A light screen appeared in front of Yang Fan, and the invading demon monkey groups, quantities, and energy fluctuations were all marked.
“The overall strength of the current invaders—is far below the current defense and combat power threshold of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Evaluation result: Threat Rank—Extremely low.”
Yang Er’s voice also added, “It is recommended to immediately organize a suppression campaign, which can serve as practical combat training.”
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, looking at the Demon Monkey Army still continuously pouring out from the light screen, a trace of familiarity actually appearing in his heart.
“Execute suppression.” Yang Fan hesitated no longer.
Yang Er immediately responded, “Order received, beginning troop deployment.”
The next moment, various places in the Divine Kingdom suddenly stirred.
Across the earth, countless believers gathered like a tide.
Yang Fan stood high in the air, overlooking the overall situation.
Believers in the Qi Refining Stage reached as many as a thousand, and believers in the Martial Apprentice Realm also broke a thousand.
These high-tier believers stepped into the void and stood, floating above the army like sharp blades pressing forward to steady the formation.
As for the ranked beings below, the total number reached as high as four hundred million!
Densely packed like a black torrent, neatly arrayed, they advanced toward the border of the Divine Kingdom with uniform paces.
This was the first time Yang Fan had seen mobilization on this scale; it didn’t look like an “army” at all, but rather a disaster tide.
“Is this a Divine Kingdom War at the demigod level? Mobilizing hundreds of millions of believers at every turn.” Yang Fan muttered.
At the same time, the army’s logistics system was activated simultaneously.
With a thought from Yang Fan, he already perceived countless storage equipment being distributed to logistics units.
spiritual grain, Medicinal Pills, backup weapons...
were all compressed and stored.
Without the need for heavy baggage trains to drag behind, the army marched light while being able to deploy full supplies at any time.
At this moment, the Divine Kingdom’s war machine operated completely under Yang Er’s mobilization.
Yang Fan looked at the distant Demon Monkey Army, then turned his gaze to his own army of believers, arriving at an evaluation: “Using cannons to shoot mosquitoes.”
If he were still a Divine Being, these invading aliens would be enough to bring a devastating disaster to the Divine Kingdom, but now, there was completely no need to worry.
Yang Fan relaxed his mind and began to watch this “performance” from a God’s perspective.
At the edge of the Divine Kingdom, the Demon Monkey Army had already begun to penetrate deeper.
They roared as they advanced, but quickly encountered their first wave of obstruction.
The terrain ahead suddenly changed, and a large area of swamp silently spread—Class C Thousand Poison Swamp.
The demon monkeys that stepped into it sank instantly.
Poisonous Qi surged, corroding flesh and blood, and screams rose and fell one after another.
However, just as a Qi Refining Stage demon monkey made a move, under the outbreak of violent spiritual power, it forcefully tore open the swamp area.
Immediately following, footsteps came from the forest.
Patrol Robots descended, their gun barrels unfolding—
“Da da da—!” Bullets poured down like rain.
Large numbers of demon monkeys were directly pierced through, flesh and blood flying everywhere.
But soon another Qi Refining Stage demon monkey struck, and thousands of Patrol Robots were instantly destroyed.
Yang Fan didn’t care about this at all; if these Patrol Robots were destroyed, so be it.
With the current development of his Divine Kingdom, these robots were even somewhat outdated.
The demon monkeys’ battle line continued to push forward.
Only a day had passed in the outside world, and the Demon Monkey Army had already arrived at the next defense line.
A field of bizarre flowers, and right in the center was the Class B defense building Poison Bee Queen.
The next instant, the sky darkened, and countless bee soldiers soared into the air, blocking out the sun!
Like dark clouds pressing down on the city, the swarm pounced down.
Whomever they touched—whether ordinary demon monkeys or ranked demon monkeys—their bodies dissolved instantly!
Flesh and blood turned to water, and not even bones were left behind.
The scene was terrifying to the extreme.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Follow the coordinates and attack!
paragraphs: “The whole army, advance at full speed and stay away from this place!” shouted the Qi Refining Realm powerhouse among the demon monkeys.
There were too many poison bees; even the Qi Refining Realm felt it was troublesome, and they simply couldn’t be killed off.
The longer they stayed here, the greater the losses would be.
Watching the losses of its subordinate demon soldiers reach thirty percent, the Qi Refining Realm demon monkey marshal showed a hesitant look in its eyes.
According to the deity’s instructions, what they were attacking was clearly a Divine Being’s divine kingdom.
Why were there so many defensive structures, and why was the Spiritual Qi here so unimaginably dense?
Was this really just a Divine Being’s divine kingdom???
Thinking of its deity’s command, it could only bite the bullet and continue deeper.

Yang Yi’s voice rang out at the right moment: “The environment reconstruction of the Poison Bee Queen cultivation area has been completed, the original Corpse Flower has been removed, and it has been replaced with a highly toxic ecosystem.”
The light curtain image switched.
That area was covered with eerie Spirit Plants, such as Soul-Corroding Blood Vines, Bone-Devouring Nether Orchids, and Soul-Breaking Black Stamens...
A heavily toxic aura permeated the air.
“Current toxicity intensity — Tier 5 Beings will die upon contact.”
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly.
Looking again at the battlefield swallowed by the swarm of bees, and the army of believers about to reach the outer area.
At this moment, he only had one feeling — these invaders weren’t here to invade at all; they were here to throw away their lives.
In just a few days, within Yang Fan’s perception, the marching route of the Demon Monkey Army gradually shifted toward a towering dense forest.
Ancient trees towered into the clouds, their branches and leaves intertwined, almost blocking out the firmament.
This was the territory of the Elf Race.
Apes were naturally born among the mountains and forests, and instinctively felt close to this environment, so the marching route they chose was also predominantly dense forests.
However, the moment they stepped into this forest...
The air changed.
Figures slowly walked out from among the tree shadows; they were Adult Elves.

Unlike little spirits, their figures were slender and upright, generally close to two meters tall, their skin emitted a faint natural luster, and their hair was mostly light gold or silver-white, gently swaying in the wind.
The most eye-catching thing was the bow in their hands.
The bow body was like a living creature, with patterns flowing across it, exuding a rich and pure breath of life.
At this moment, the breath of the Adult Elves was not gentle at all; instead, it carried an extreme, sharp vitality.
The arrow had not been fired, but the murderous intent was already present.
The leading elf slowly spoke, his voice calm yet unquestionable: “This place is the Domain of our race.”
“Foreign race — retreat.”
Three simple words made the entire forest fall silent.
The Demon Monkey Army instinctively stirred.
But the next moment, dozens of Qi Refining Stage auras suppressed downward simultaneously.
The powerhouses among the demon monkeys made a move to stabilize the military formation.
They didn’t move, but they were observing.
The expressions of those Qi Refining Stage demon monkeys showed obvious changes.
Shock, vigilance, and even dread.
The number of Adult Elves was not large, but the other party were all powerhouses.
Their auras faintly made even the Qi Refining Realm demon monkeys feel a fatal threat.
The scarlet in the leading demon monkey’s eyes slightly receded, its thoughts spinning rapidly.

“What kind of divine kingdom is this? Shouldn’t a Divine Being’s divine kingdom be completely controlled? How could such an independent consciousness, and even a threatening race, appear? Is this Human Race deity not afraid of a backlash?”
A trace of unease surfaced in its heart.
Just as it hesitated, a heavy vibration suddenly came from deep within the forest.
“Boom... Boom...”
It was as if some behemoth was moving.
The next moment, a giant shadow walked out from the forest.
That was a “tree”, with countless vines hanging down like tentacles, and its aura was extremely oppressive.
“Foundation Establishment!” the demon monkey leader suddenly roared out.
There was obvious terror in its voice.
It almost instinctively made a judgment — they absolutely could not fight; they had to go around.
However, just as it was about to order a retreat, a black tide surged on the distant horizon, and the earth shook.
Above the sky, figures stepped through the air and came.
Yang Fan’s army of believers had arrived.
Looking at the thousands of figures standing in the air above the firmament, the demon monkey leader was completely dumbfounded.
Its pupils shrank slightly, and its breathing became sluggish.
“Is this... a Divine Being’s divine kingdom?” Only one thought remained in its mind, “My deity... where on earth did you get this intelligence?”
At this moment, it even doubted whether it had broken into some other deity’s divine kingdom.
Just then, a Divine Decree slowly rang out above the firmament.
Not Yang Fan, but transmitted by Yang Er.
The voice was ruthless, cold, and carried an absolute sense of control, echoing across the entire heaven and earth.
“Those who trespass into the divine kingdom — are all enemies. Elf Race — obey the command.”
The voice paused for a moment, as if heaven and earth were waiting.
“Fight in coordination, annihilate them completely.”
Yang Er’s words were brief yet unquestionable.
The leading Adult Elf in the forest didn’t hesitate at all, lowering its head and kneeling on one knee.
The voice was calm and devout: “Accepting the Divine Decree.”
“Thank you for bestowing such fertile land upon our race.”
“This battle — our race shall do its utmost.”
As the voice fell, it slowly stood up and drew its bow, the string like a full moon.
An arrow condensed with a rich force of life.
“Hum —!” The arrow shot out.
The battle broke out instantly!
Above the sky, thousands of Qi Refining and Martial Apprentice Realm believers made a move at the same time.
Like falling meteors, they crashed heavily into the Demon Monkey Army.
There was no resistance; the battle was a complete crushing defeat.
Under the bursting spiritual power of a casual strike, large swathes of demon monkeys exploded on the spot, flesh and blood flying everywhere.
With a punch from a Martial Disciple Realm powerhouse, the earth collapsed, and thousands of demon monkeys were directly shaken into blood mists.
Sword lights swept past, harvesting lives in patches.
That wasn’t a battle, but — a massacre.
The ground was quickly soaked in blood, and corpses piled up.
Roars, screams, collapses...
intertwined together.
The Demon Monkey Army began to rout, but there was nowhere to escape.
Space was sealed, and they simply couldn’t retreat back to their own divine kingdom.
Elven arrows accurately picked off targets, and the Tree Demon King swept forward and advanced.
The entire battlefield rapidly turned into a bloody Hell.
In less than a day of divine kingdom time, the battle was already over.
There were no captives, no survivors, and all the invading demon monkeys were completely wiped out.
After the battle, logistics believers quickly took over.
Corpse recycling, resource decomposition, battlefield cleanup...
everything was methodical.
Meanwhile.
Yang Er’s voice rang out once more.
“Application for reward scheme — submitted.”
“Approved for execution.”
The next moment, one hundred thousand Moon Wells and one hundred thousand Sun Springs descended simultaneously upon the territory of the Elf Race.
Vassal races were different from ordinary believers; if they were blindly squeezed, it would only weaken their potential and even invite a backlash.
Moderate investment and feedback could instead stimulate stronger growth and loyalty.
Furthermore, the Elf Race was naturally gentle; as long as the forest was not destroyed, they rarely actively posed a threat.
They belonged to an extremely stable defensive type of vassal race.
And Yang Fan obviously had deeper plans; this forest could completely be forged into a natural defense line for the divine kingdom.
Moon Wells and Sun Springs could accelerate the growth of the Ancient Spirit Tree.
As time passed, this place would no longer be just a forest, but an Elf Kingdom, and an even stronger barrier for the divine kingdom.
The battlefield cleanup had not yet ended when Yang Er’s voice already sounded.
“All invading alien believers have been completely annihilated.”
“Through spatial residue analysis, the coordinates of the opponent’s divine kingdom have been successfully captured.”
The light curtain unfolded, and a string of stable spatial coordinates slowly emerged.
“According to Divine Kingdom War big data, the military forces invested in an invasion account for an average of 30% of the total combat power, suggesting...”
“No suggestions needed.”
Yang Fan spoke directly, carrying an unquestionable decisiveness: “Follow the coordinates and attack.”
