The next moment, a giant shadow walked out from the forest.
That was a “tree”, with countless vines hanging down like tentacles, and its aura was extremely oppressive.
“Foundation Establishment!” the demon monkey leader suddenly roared out.
There was obvious terror in its voice.
It almost instinctively made a judgment — they absolutely could not fight; they had to go around.
However, just as it was about to order a retreat, a black tide surged on the distant horizon, and the earth shook.
Above the sky, figures stepped through the air and came.
Yang Fan’s army of believers had arrived.
Looking at the thousands of figures standing in the air above the firmament, the demon monkey leader was completely dumbfounded.
Its pupils shrank slightly, and its breathing became sluggish.
“Is this... a Divine Being’s divine kingdom?” Only one thought remained in its mind, “My deity... where on earth did you get this intelligence?”
At this moment, it even doubted whether it had broken into some other deity’s divine kingdom.
Just then, a Divine Decree slowly rang out above the firmament.
Not Yang Fan, but transmitted by Yang Er.
The voice was ruthless, cold, and carried an absolute sense of control, echoing across the entire heaven and earth.
“Those who trespass into the divine kingdom — are all enemies.
Elf Race — obey the command.”
The voice paused for a moment, as if heaven and earth were waiting.
“Fight in coordination, annihilate them completely.”
Yang Er’s words were brief yet unquestionable.
The leading Adult Elf in the forest didn’t hesitate at all, lowering its head and kneeling on one knee.
The voice was calm and devout: “Accepting the Divine Decree.”
“Thank you for bestowing such fertile land upon our race.”
“This battle — our race shall do its utmost.”
As the voice fell, it slowly stood up and drew its bow, the string like a full moon.
An arrow condensed with a rich force of life.
“Hum —!” The arrow shot out.
The battle broke out instantly!
Above the sky, thousands of Qi Refining and Martial Apprentice Realm believers made a move at the same time.
Like falling meteors, they crashed heavily into the Demon Monkey Army.
There was no resistance; the battle was a complete crushing defeat.
Under the bursting spiritual power of a casual strike, large swathes of demon monkeys exploded on the spot, flesh and blood flying everywhere.
With a punch from a Martial Disciple Realm powerhouse, the earth collapsed, and thousands of demon monkeys were directly shaken into blood mists.
Sword lights swept past, harvesting lives in patches.
That wasn’t a battle, but — a massacre.
The ground was quickly soaked in blood, and corpses piled up.
Roars, screams, collapses...
intertwined together.
The Demon Monkey Army began to rout, but there was nowhere to escape.
Space was sealed, and they simply couldn’t retreat back to their own divine kingdom.
Elven arrows accurately picked off targets, and the Tree Demon King swept forward and advanced.
The entire battlefield rapidly turned into a bloody Hell.
In less than a day of divine kingdom time, the battle was already over.
There were no captives, no survivors, and all the invading demon monkeys were completely wiped out.
After the battle, logistics believers quickly took over.
Corpse recycling, resource decomposition, battlefield cleanup...
everything was methodical.
Meanwhile.
Yang Er’s voice rang out once more.
“Application for reward scheme — submitted.”
“Approved for execution.”
The next moment, one hundred thousand Moon Wells and one hundred thousand Sun Springs descended simultaneously upon the territory of the Elf Race.
Vassal races were different from ordinary believers; if they were blindly squeezed, it would only weaken their potential and even invite a backlash.
Moderate investment and feedback could instead stimulate stronger growth and loyalty.
Furthermore, the Elf Race was naturally gentle; as long as the forest was not destroyed, they rarely actively posed a threat.
They belonged to an extremely stable defensive type of vassal race.
And Yang Fan obviously had deeper plans; this forest could completely be forged into a natural defense line for the divine kingdom.
Moon Wells and Sun Springs could accelerate the growth of the Ancient Spirit Tree.
As time passed, this place would no longer be just a forest, but an Elf Kingdom, and an even stronger barrier for the divine kingdom.
The battlefield cleanup had not yet ended when Yang Er’s voice already sounded.
“All invading alien believers have been completely annihilated.”
“Through spatial residue analysis, the coordinates of the opponent’s divine kingdom have been successfully captured.”
The light curtain unfolded, and a string of stable spatial coordinates slowly emerged.
“According to Divine Kingdom War big data, the military forces invested in an invasion account for an average of 30% of the total combat power, suggesting...”
“No suggestions needed.”
Yang Fan spoke directly, carrying an unquestionable decisiveness: “Follow the coordinates and attack.”

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Divine Kingdom Coordinate Deduction Card He Was Targeted!
paragraphs: Yang Er paused slightly, “Order confirmed.”
Since the other party already knew his Divine Kingdom coordinates, regardless of whether this invasion was a random contact, it already constituted a threat to him.
And threats must be eliminated.
Yang Fan did not hesitate at all in his heart.
Defense has never been the optimal solution.
There is the principle of slaying the enemy a thousand miles away, not guarding against them for a thousand days.
Since the other party had already reached out, then he would chop off that hand.
“The entire army is fully prepared.” Yang Er’s voice sounded once again, “Begin coordinate locking.”
The next moment, space oscillated, and the region where the army was located was pulled as a whole.
It directly teleported using the coordinate channel.
The other Divine Kingdom.
The heavens and earth were dim, and the air was filled with a primitive and violent aura.
The mountain forests were rugged, and the vegetation was messy; although Spiritual Qi existed, it appeared disordered and wild.
In the distance, patches of ape groups could be vaguely seen moving around.
Yang Fan, inside his own Divine Kingdom, borrowed Yang Er’s perspective and saw everything at the first instance.
With just a single glance, his entire body abruptly stood up.
Yang Fan’s pupils shrank slightly, and his judgment regarding “random invasion” in his heart instantly shattered.
He recognized it; this Divine Kingdom was right at the examination venue of the mid-term examination of Yang County No.
1 Middle School.
It was the Divine Kingdom of the Demi-god Demon Monkey that had ‘gifted’ him Spirit Peach Mountain as startup capital.
At this moment, all clues instantly strung together.
This was not any coincidence at all.
Rather, he had been targeted.

Yang Fan’s gaze sank, and his voice became unprecedentedly serious: “Yang Yi, aside from the possibility of random contact, if it is artificial, how do deities in reality locate other people’s Divine Kingdom coordinates?”
Yang Yi did not hesitate and directly gave the answer: “It can be done through a special item — the Divine Kingdom Coordinate Deduction Card.”
Yang Fan frowned slightly: “Speak specifically.”

“There are strict restrictions on such items.” Yang Yi’s tone remained calm, “The success rate of the deduction depends on the amount of information already mastered, including but not limited to: the identity information of the target deity, past contact records, and whether you have entered the other party’s Divine Kingdom, or the other party has entered your Divine Kingdom.”

“The more complete the information, the higher the deduction success rate; if key contacts are lacking and deductions are made based solely on vague features, the success rate will drop significantly, even approaching zero.”
Yang Fan’s gaze flickered slightly.

Yang Yi continued to add: “In addition, Penglai Island has currently been deployed inside the Divine Kingdom, which possesses a certain degree of coordinate shielding capability, significantly increasing the difficulty of external deduction.”
“In other words.” Yang Fan slowly spoke, “Under normal circumstances, it is very difficult for me to be locked onto.”
“Yes.” Yang Yi nodded, “Unless there is a clear association.”

After a brief pause, it spoke again: “Additionally, according to the rules of the Divine Kingdom War, High-tier Gods usually cannot directly invade the Divine Kingdom of lower-tier gods. Forcing entry requires paying an extremely high price. The greater the tier gap, the higher the invasion cost, to the point of even lacking feasibility.”
Yang Fan did not speak; he looked at that string of coordinates before him, but his thoughts were rapidly extending.
This entire set of rules looked very much like a carefully designed screening mechanism.
At the lower-tier stage, they slaughter each other; the winners are promoted; after entering higher tiers, they continue to slaughter each other.
Screened down layer by layer.
Those who survive have the qualifications to continue walking upwards.
“Raising Gu!” This word flashed through Yang Fan’s heart.
This world, from the very beginning, did not exist for “peaceful development”.
Rather, it was to screen for the strong.
Yang Fan gently shook his head, suppressing the thought.
Thinking too much had no meaning; the most important thing was the matter right in front of him.
Yang Fan once again cast his gaze toward that piece of Alien Divine Kingdom.
Continuing to analyze how the Demi-god Demon Monkey managed to locate his Divine Kingdom coordinates did not hold much meaning; the answer was right inside the other party’s Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s eyes gradually turned cold, “Let’s talk after taking it down.”
At this moment, he also came to a realization; no wonder the alien believers were so weak.
For the sake of the exam, the school leaders of Yang County No.
1 Middle School had long since beaten this Demi-god Demon Monkey into heavy injuries, leaving its Divine Kingdom on the verge of collapse.
How much time had passed now?
Being able to barely scrape together a dozen or so Qi Refining Stage believers could already be considered exhausting its foundations.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, but then felt a trace of chill.
If not for the fact that he possessed an SSS-rank Talent and his Divine Kingdom’s development far exceeded the norm, this sudden invasion probably wouldn’t have left any room for a comeback at all.
Although the other party was weak, it was only relative to a demigod; if it were replaced by a Divine Being, it probably would have long been trampled flat by this wave of the Demon Monkey Army.
Meanwhile, deep within the Alien Divine Kingdom, the ape deity was curled up in the core region, its aura disordered, and its Divine Thought fluctuations resembling a candle flickering in the wind.
His eyes were bloodshot, and his lips trembled incessantly, whispering like someone grasping at the last shred of rationality.
“No wonder... No wonder the deduction succeeded... He is already a demigod... Naturally, the difficulty of deducing the coordinates was small.”
“How is it possible... How could it be so fast... Clearly, before, he was just a Divine Being...”
“What should I do? The Origin Qi of the Divine Kingdom hasn’t even recovered by ten percent, I can’t stop it... I can’t stop it.”
He suddenly raised his head, a light interwoven with resentment and fear flashing through his eyes.
“Damnable Human Race... Tricking me... All of you are tricking me...”
The voice became increasingly urgent, almost carrying a breakdown-induced shrillness, “I cannot die, I cannot die, there must still be a way... There must still be...”
His voice gradually lowered, yet it appeared increasingly hollow and despairing.
On the other end, Yang Fan’s army had already penetrated deep inside.

Today’s believers marched at a speed more than ten times faster than during the mid-term exam; the outer defenses that originally required step-by-step advancement were practically nominal in front of them.
Those defense buildings that had not yet been fully repaired were crushed and cleared all the way, not even possessing the qualification to cause any delay.
Unlike wasteland reclamation, this time Yang Er did not spare any energy to collect resources along the way; all orders had only one target, pointing straight at the Divine Kingdom Core.
In a Divine Kingdom War, the primary objective is to slay the opposing deity, and wasteland reclamation comes afterward.
Yang Fan watched the scattered and barely organized resistance of the demon monkeys in the light screen, and the tension on his face finally eased.
The situation was even more relaxed than he had anticipated; those hastily assembled troops were completely unable to form an effective defense line.

“It seems that the batch that just invaded my Divine Kingdom is already all your trump cards.” He muttered to himself, with a hint of coldness in his tone, “Treating me as a Divine Being, wanting to seize the opportunity to snatch back Spirit Peach Mountain?”
He chuckled softly, but his gaze was as cold as frost, “Then you probably don’t know that this single move will cost you your life.”
“You will become the first Alien Demigod to die in my hands.”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan’s consciousness slowly withdrew from the Divine Kingdom and returned to reality.
He knew very well that with the current marching speed of the believers, it would still take time to truly reach the opposing Divine Kingdom Core region.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, it would take at least a dozen more years of advancement, which meant a dozen or so days in real time.
Since victory or defeat was already decided, he was no longer in a rush.
Compared to personally monitoring every step of advancement, Yang Fan trusted Yang Er’s judgment and dispatching even more.
For the time ahead, he only needed to occasionally pay attention to the battle situation and prevent accidents from happening.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: The Cruelty of Divine Kingdom War
paragraphs: Time passed quietly.
On this day, Yang Fan was resting his eyes and meditating when Yang Er’s voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
“Master, we have arrived at the enemy’s Divine Kingdom Core area.”
The moment the voice fell, Yang Fan abruptly opened his eyes.
Without a trace of hesitation, his mind sank, and his consciousness instantly crossed over along the coordinates.
The next moment, his field of vision suddenly expanded, and he was already standing above that Alien Divine Kingdom.
What met his eyes was a Demon Monkey Army that had been forcibly gathered.
Six Qi Refining Stage demon monkeys stood at the very front.
Although their Aura was strong, it faintly exuded hollowness and instability, clearly being a force cultivated in haste.
Behind them were dense, graded demon monkeys, but their total number was already less than 100 million, their formation was scattered, and their Aura was far inferior to before.
Further back was a scene bordering on chaos.
Four to five hundred million ordinary demon monkeys were forcibly driven to one side of the mountain range, crowding together into a pitch-black tide of monkeys.
Even juvenile demon monkeys that had yet to grow up were crammed into the ranks, holding crude wooden sticks in their hands and emitting disorderly chirping sounds.
That could no longer be considered an army; it looked more like an ethnic group driven to a desperate end.
Yang Fan only took one look before completely understanding — the opponent had no way out left.
This was staking all usable forces for a final desperate struggle.
Yang Fan was silent for a moment, his gaze slowly sweeping across this familiar yet unfamiliar battlefield, a trace of indescribable emotion suddenly rising in his heart.
During the midterm exam back then, he was the one being hunted down.
Millions of the Demon Monkey Army swept across, forcing him to flee all the way without daring to stop for millions of kilometers.
That sense of powerlessness and oppression remained vividly clear to this day.
And now, the same race, the same scene, but their positions had been completely reversed.
Yang Fan softly exhaled a breath, “The momentum of offense and defense has reversed.”
“Is this the Divine Kingdom War?”
Yang Fan stood high in the sky, his gaze overlooking below.
In the eyes of those alien believers, fear and madness intertwined; some roared, some trembled, and some even knelt on the ground, as if praying for a lifeline that did not exist at all.
He suddenly realized one thing: once the Divine Kingdom Core was seized, all life here would return to nothingness.
There were no prisoners, no way out, only a final struggle between life and death.
An Aura suppressed to the extreme permeated the air.
Just at this moment, a familiar Aura slowly condensed above the firmament.
The figure of that Demi-god Demon Monkey appeared once more.
Only, at this moment, it no longer possessed its initial arrogance; its Aura was weak, and its expression even carried a trace of unmasked panic.
“Human Demigod...” Its voice was hoarse, “Spare me once, and I’ll tell you a secret.”
Yang Fan did not respond.
He simply took a step forward, and his conscious Incarnation rapidly expanded, his figure shooting up step by step, instantly becoming level with the opponent.
Yang Fan’s gaze was calm, “What secret?”
The demon monkey gritted its teeth and said, “Withdraw your troops first.”
Yang Fan glanced at it, only to see him casually wave his hand, “Let’s finish fighting first and talk later.”
The tone was understatement itself, as if what he was deciding was merely an insignificant trivial matter.
The order was given, and Yang Er executed it instantly.
The great battle began.
This war had almost no suspense; the gap in troop strength was too huge, and the gap in power was even greater.
Qi Refining Stage and Martial Apprentice Realm believers were like sharp blades, directly tearing open the final defense line.
The demon monkeys’ resistance began to collapse the instant they made contact.
Amidst the roar of spiritual power, patches of life were wiped out.
Whether it was adult demon monkeys or undeveloped baby monkeys.
Whether they roared in resistance or fled in panic.
There was no difference.
Under a single blow, flesh and blood flew everywhere, corpses fell in rows, the mountain range was dyed dark red, and a pungent stench of blood permeated the air.
There were mother monkeys shielding their cubs in their arms, only to be blasted into blood mist along with their cubs the next instant.
There were demon monkeys kneeling to beg for survival, but before the words could leave their mouths, their heads and bodies were already separated.
The entire Divine Kingdom Core area was like a purgatory.
Yet all of this was seen by Yang Fan, but his expression remained consistently calm.
It was not that he felt nothing, but rather that he had long understood that this was the rule of this world.
Alien races eat humans, gods eat humans, and humans...
likewise eat humans.
This was a world that ate people.
Yang Fan would feel it was cruel, but he wouldn’t show pity, let alone go soft on them.
Because he knew very well that if he didn’t eat people, the one who would be eaten would be himself.
Yang Fan slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, there were no longer any ripples in his eyes.
“All living beings sink, all in the bitter sea; you and I are both blade-wielders, merely crossing our respective tribulations.”
Feeling the large-scale dissipation of its believers’ Aura, that Alien Demigod finally completely lost its composure.
Seeing the opponent suddenly roar up to the sky, the Spiritual Qi between heaven and earth frantically converged.
The originally chaotic airflow was forcibly pulled, condensing into a silver iron rod hundreds of zhang long that traversed the firmament.
Carrying a shrill whistle that tore through the air, it smashed fiercely toward Yang Fan’s believer army below.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan likewise moved.
A god’s power inherently originated from believers; at this moment, the opponent’s believers had already been slaughtered to the last.
This strike looked impressive in momentum, but in Yang Fan’s eyes, it was like paper.
Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly shot up, transforming into a golden giant standing between heaven and earth.

He raised his hand and grabbed gently, and that silver iron rod pressing down horizontally unexpectedly shattered inch by inch in his palm like a fragile piece of paper, turning into countless specks of spiritual light powder that dissipated with the wind.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s figure flashed, and he had already appeared before that Alien Demigod.
Extending his five fingers, he directly grabbed the opponent’s neck.
At the same time, a Qi Refining Stage believer galloped up from below, respectfully holding a purple crystal aloft with both hands.
“My God, the Divine Kingdom Core is here!”
Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon that crystal.
That was a crystal about the size of a human head, its entire body shimmering with purple intent, as if countless tiny points of light were slowly rotating inside, resembling a miniature world.
Complex patterns vaguely surfaced on its surface, and every single pattern was connected to the rules of the divine kingdom, emitting a stable and profound Aura.
This was the foundation of a Divine Kingdom.
Once shattered, all things return to zero.
“Spare me... I don’t want to die...”
The choked Alien Demigod’s voice was intermittent, its eyes filled with terror.
Yang Fan’s expression was cold: “Speak, what secret?”
The opponent spoke with difficulty: “Can you... swear... to let go...”
“You have no room for bargaining,” Yang Fan said indifferently, while shifting his gaze.
That believer instantly understood, exerting sudden force with both hands.
The purple crystal began to slowly contract in his palm, cracks faintly appearing on its surface.
In an instant, that Alien Demigod let out a shrill scream, its consciousness violently vibrating, nearly collapsing on the spot.
“I’ll talk! I’ll talk!”
Its voice was sharp and flustered, “I originally couldn’t deduce your Divine Kingdom coordinates... It was the Human Race... Someone contacted me and gave me your information!”
Yang Fan’s gaze turned cold: “What information?”
“He had been to your Divine Kingdom... and during the exam, you also entered my Divine Kingdom... Coupled with some basic data... He also gave me a Divine Kingdom coordinate deduction card...”
“Who is it?”
“I... I can’t remember for a moment...”
Yang Fan’s expression did not change, but his voice turned completely cold.
“Then you have no need to stay alive.”
The believer increased the power in his hands once more, and the purple crystal began to vibrate violently.
That Alien Demigod’s roar almost tore the firmament apart.
“I remember! I remember!”

It shouted abruptly, its voice carrying despair, “His surname is Luo! His name is Luo Mingxuan! Right, it’s him! It was this bastard who harmed me! I had already been willing to admit defeat, it was him!”

Only, at this moment, it no longer possessed its initial arrogance; its Aura was weak, and its expression even carried a trace of unmasked panic.
“Human Demigod...” Its voice was hoarse, “Spare me once, and I’ll tell you a secret.”
Yang Fan did not respond.
He simply took a step forward, and his conscious Incarnation rapidly expanded, his figure shooting up step by step, instantly becoming level with the opponent.
Yang Fan’s gaze was calm, “What secret?”
The demon monkey gritted its teeth and said, “Withdraw your troops first.”
Yang Fan glanced at it, only to see him casually wave his hand, “Let’s finish fighting first and talk later.”
The tone was understatement itself, as if what he was deciding was merely an insignificant trivial matter.
The order was given, and Yang Er executed it instantly.
The great battle began.
This war had almost no suspense; the gap in troop strength was too huge, and the gap in power was even greater.
Qi Refining Stage and Martial Apprentice Realm believers were like sharp blades, directly tearing open the final defense line.
The demon monkeys’ resistance began to collapse the instant they made contact.
Amidst the roar of spiritual power, patches of life were wiped out.
Whether it was adult demon monkeys or undeveloped baby monkeys.
Whether they roared in resistance or fled in panic.
There was no difference.
Under a single blow, flesh and blood flew everywhere, corpses fell in rows, the mountain range was dyed dark red, and a pungent stench of blood permeated the air.
There were mother monkeys shielding their cubs in their arms, only to be blasted into blood mist along with their cubs the next instant.
There were demon monkeys kneeling to beg for survival, but before the words could leave their mouths, their heads and bodies were already separated.
The entire Divine Kingdom Core area was like a purgatory.
Yet all of this was seen by Yang Fan, but his expression remained consistently calm.
It was not that he felt nothing, but rather that he had long understood that this was the rule of this world.
Alien races eat humans, gods eat humans, and humans...
likewise eat humans.
This was a world that ate people.
Yang Fan would feel it was cruel, but he wouldn’t show pity, let alone go soft on them.
Because he knew very well that if he didn’t eat people, the one who would be eaten would be himself.
Yang Fan slowly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, there were no longer any ripples in his eyes.
“All living beings sink, all in the bitter sea; you and I are both blade-wielders, merely crossing our respective tribulations.”
Feeling the large-scale dissipation of its believers’ Aura, that Alien Demigod finally completely lost its composure.
Seeing the opponent suddenly roar up to the sky, the Spiritual Qi between heaven and earth frantically converged.
The originally chaotic airflow was forcibly pulled, condensing into a silver iron rod hundreds of zhang long that traversed the firmament.
Carrying a shrill whistle that tore through the air, it smashed fiercely toward Yang Fan’s believer army below.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan likewise moved.
A god’s power inherently originated from believers; at this moment, the opponent’s believers had already been slaughtered to the last.
This strike looked impressive in momentum, but in Yang Fan’s eyes, it was like paper.
Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly shot up, transforming into a golden giant standing between heaven and earth.

He raised his hand and grabbed gently, and that silver iron rod pressing down horizontally unexpectedly shattered inch by inch in his palm like a fragile piece of paper, turning into countless specks of spiritual light powder that dissipated with the wind.
The next moment, Yang Fan’s figure flashed, and he had already appeared before that Alien Demigod.
Extending his five fingers, he directly grabbed the opponent’s neck.
At the same time, a Qi Refining Stage believer galloped up from below, respectfully holding a purple crystal aloft with both hands.
“My God, the Divine Kingdom Core is here!”
Yang Fan’s gaze fell upon that crystal.
That was a crystal about the size of a human head, its entire body shimmering with purple intent, as if countless tiny points of light were slowly rotating inside, resembling a miniature world.
Complex patterns vaguely surfaced on its surface, and every single pattern was connected to the rules of the divine kingdom, emitting a stable and profound Aura.
This was the foundation of a Divine Kingdom.
Once shattered, all things return to zero.
“Spare me...
I don’t want to die...”
The choked Alien Demigod’s voice was intermittent, its eyes filled with terror.
Yang Fan’s expression was cold: “Speak, what secret?”
The opponent spoke with difficulty: “Can you... swear... to let go...”
“You have no room for bargaining,” Yang Fan said indifferently, while shifting his gaze.
That believer instantly understood, exerting sudden force with both hands.
The purple crystal began to slowly contract in his palm, cracks faintly appearing on its surface.
In an instant, that Alien Demigod let out a shrill scream, its consciousness violently vibrating, nearly collapsing on the spot.
“I’ll talk!
I’ll talk!”
Its voice was sharp and flustered, “I originally couldn’t deduce your Divine Kingdom coordinates...
It was the Human Race...
Someone contacted me and gave me your information!”
Yang Fan’s gaze turned cold: “What information?”
“He had been to your Divine Kingdom... and during the exam, you also entered my Divine Kingdom...
Coupled with some basic data...
He also gave me a Divine Kingdom coordinate deduction card...”
“Who is it?”
I can’t remember for a moment...”
Yang Fan’s expression did not change, but his voice turned completely cold.
“Then you have no need to stay alive.”
The believer increased the power in his hands once more, and the purple crystal began to vibrate violently.
That Alien Demigod’s roar almost tore the firmament apart.
“I remember!
I remember!”
It shouted abruptly, its voice carrying despair, “His surname is Luo!
His name is Luo Mingxuan!
Right, it’s him!
It was this bastard who harmed me!
I had already been willing to admit defeat, it was him!”

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Absorbing the Divine Kingdom Core Killing with a Borrowed Knife
paragraphs: As soon as the words fell, Yang Fan had already raised his hand.
A single palm strike landed right on the opponent’s crown.
“Snap—”
With a soft sound, the Alien Demigod’s consciousness instantly shattered and was completely obliterated.

After a brief silence, Yang Er’s voice sounded, “Master, the Alien God has been confirmed dead. It is recommended to immediately initiate the pioneering process, and then absorb the Divine Kingdom Core afterwards.”
Yang Fan glanced at the purple crystal and shook his head slightly.
“No need. We will absorb the Divine Kingdom Core directly after going back.”
This Divine Kingdom had already been ransacked once during the mid-term exam.
The most valuable buildings had long since fallen into his own Divine Kingdom.
Some B-rank and C-rank buildings remaining in the core area had also been conveniently collected; as for the scattered resources on the outer periphery, their value was too low.
To the current Yang Fan, they were meaningless.
Rather than letting believers waste time collecting them here, it was better to return to the Divine Kingdom and use the SSS-rank Talent to properly Cultivate and enhance strength.
Afterwards, space rippled once more.
Yang Fan’s consciousness brought all believers back to his own Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, the center of Yang Fan’s palm was holding that purple crystal.
Having understood the steps to absorb the Divine Kingdom Core from Yang Yi, he hesitated no longer.
With a single thought, his Divine Thought surged out like a tide, directly wrapping around the Divine Kingdom Core.
In an instant, Yang Fan only felt as if his consciousness had touched the “root” of another world.
Countless rule veins unfolded before his eyes, like intersecting beams of light, briefly connecting the two Divine Kingdoms together.
Following closely, the power of rules descended.
There was no roar.
There was no omen.
That Alien Divine Kingdom began to collapse.
The earth split open first, the mountain ranges collapsed, and the forests overturned.
Under the suppression of these rules, the ordinary living beings that originally survived didn’t even have the qualification to struggle, and their auras dissipated instantly.
The trees withered, the Spirit Plants disintegrated, the rivers dried up, and the sky turned gloomy.
The next moment, space trembled.
At the edge of Yang Fan’s own Divine Kingdom, a completely new piece of land materialized without warning.
Mountains, landscapes, rivers...
were as if cut as a whole and forcibly embedded in.
The two different rules collided briefly and then rapidly underwent Fusion, and everything returned to stability.
Yang Fan’s mind shook; he clearly felt that his Divine Kingdom had completed a substantive expansion at this moment, with its range directly increasing by one-tenth.
“Divine Kingdom Area: Eleven million square kilometers”
Yang Fan slowly exhaled a breath, his gaze sweeping across this newly born territory.
The moment the boundaries of the Divine Kingdom extended outward, his entire person seemed to have sublimated.
That was not a simple “becoming larger”.
Rather, it was an enhancement from a fundamental level.
His consciousness was connected with the Divine Kingdom Origin, and at this moment he could clearly perceive that the inch-by-inch expanding territory seemed to elevate his “height” at the same time.
His Soul became more solid, his perception became sharper, and even his thinking became increasingly clear.
It was as if his entire person had been quietly lifted up by a layer.
That feeling was extremely subtle, yet extremely real.
Yang Fan could even vaguely perceive that his life level was approaching a higher dimension bit by bit along with the expansion of the Divine Kingdom.
What was even harder to ignore was the accompanying...
desire.
The moment the first Divine Kingdom Core was absorbed, deep in Yang Fan’s heart, something seemed to be ignited.
That was an unspeakable pleasure, not a mere increase in power.
Instead, it was the sense of satisfaction fed back at the rule level after “plundering”, “annexing”, and “occupying”.
It was like tasting some forbidden thing; once touched, it was hard to forget again, and one would even instinctively want more.
The expansion of the Divine Kingdom area meant that believers had more living space and could continue to reproduce, expand, and screen.
It meant more resources could be developed, more buildings could be deployed, and the entire system could be further upgraded.
And all these would ultimately feed back to him, the “God” himself.
The stronger the believers, the more flourishing the Divine Kingdom.
The more flourishing the Divine Kingdom, the stronger he would be.
Yang Fan’s gaze sank slightly, forcibly suppressing the vaguely spreading desire in his heart.
Yang Fan’s gaze still carried a bit of coldness at the moment.
After a moment of silence, he asked: “Yang Yi, has the full picture of this war been recorded?”
“The entire process has been recorded.”
Yang Fan nodded.
“Send the complete video to the Luo Family head—Luo Hai. By the way, ask them how they plan to explain this matter.”
“Yes, it has been executed.”
Simultaneously as the order was given, the information had been packaged and sent out via federal communication channels.
Yang Fan leaned against the back of the chair, his gaze narrowing slightly.
Of course he didn’t think this matter had anything to do with the entire Luo Family.
On the contrary, the Luo Family’s investment in him was extremely huge, and the other party obviously regarded him as a key Cultivation target.
It was contradictory, and there was simply no motive.
The real problem could only lie with an individual.
“Luo Mingxuan.”
This name flashed through his mind, and Yang Fan’s eyes grew a bit colder.
The grudge between the two wasn’t that big to begin with; at most, it was just a verbal dispute.
But the other party actually played dirty in this way, which greatly exceeded his expectations.

“If not for the fact that my own Divine Kingdom’s development far exceeded ordinary people, I would definitely have died in this calamity. I thought he was a stupid second-generation ancestor, but I really underestimated the people of the world.”
Yang Fan said with lingering fear.
Yang Fan was currently cultivating in Taichu City and was not suited to return personally to deal with these trivial matters.
Since that was the case, it was better to kill with a borrowed knife.
The corners of Yang Fan’s mouth slightly curled into an extremely faint arc.
He believed Luo Hai was not a fool.
Someone who could take charge of the entire Family knew trade-offs better than anyone else.
Yang Fan believed that the other party only needed to take a glance at the video to arrange everything properly.
Some things didn’t require him to say too much.
He just needed to display his value, and naturally someone else would do the rest for him.
With his thoughts settled, Yang Fan couldn’t be bothered to think more about it.
He stretched lazily, his entire state relaxing again, and before long, he fell fast asleep.
However, back in Yang County, the Luo Family was already in an uproar.
Luo Hai ordered a Family meeting to be held overnight, and specially emphasized that it must be conducted in reality.
The Luo Family’s stronghold was brightly lit, and the atmosphere in the hall was oppressive and solemn.
A crowd of Elders and high-ranking officials gathered together, and no one dared to make a sound.
Everyone’s gaze was fixed dead on the projected image on the wall.
That was precisely the complete video sent by Yang Fan.
From the Divine Kingdom invasion, to the counterattack, and finally to the complete process of slaying the Alien Demigod, it was displayed without reservation before everyone’s eyes.

In the image, the scene of the golden giant crushing a hundred-zhang silver iron rod with a single palm and choking the Demi-god Demon Monkey’s throat with one hand was exceptionally shocking even for the Gods present to watch.
Inside the hall, you could hear a pin drop.
Until the video ended, the air seemed to flow again.
The next moment, the long-suppressed emotions erupted instantly.
“How long has it been... Yang Fan, has he actually achieved a Breakthrough to Demigod?”
An Elder stood up abruptly, his voice somewhat trembling.
“From the Divine Kingdom Awakening until now, it hasn’t even been two years, right? This speed... this speed is simply too exaggerated!”
“Are these the resources of the Primordial Academy? No... no, this is no longer a matter of resources; this is Talent!”
“Look at the scale of his believers!”

Someone pointed at the overwhelming army in the image, their voice becoming hurried, “Thousands of Qi Refining Stage believers, plus the Martial Apprentice Realm... This is preparing to practice Cultivation and Martial Arts concurrently!”
“This can no longer be considered an ordinary Demigod!”
“A Prodigy, a true Prodigy.”
“My Luo Family has picked up a treasure.”
“More than just a treasure, this is an Opportunity!”
“As long as he doesn’t fall, in the future...”
Halfway through his words, no one dared to continue speaking.
But everyone understood the unexpressed meaning.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Luo Family Resolution
paragraphs: Inside the hall, breathing became heavy.
Excitement, shock, disbelief...
various emotions intertwined, causing the usually steady Family Elders to flush red.
Stationed in a remote place like Yang County, their resources and horizons were limited.
Someone like Luo Bing, possessing a Grade B Ice Spirit Root talent, was enough for the entire Luo Family to exhaust its resources to nurture.
And now, what lay before them was an existence that had gone from Awakening a Divine Kingdom to Breakthrough to a demigod in less than two years.
This level of talent and growth rate had long surpassed the scope of their cognition.
The potential Yang Fan displayed was no longer “excellent”, but terrifying.
As everyone was immersed in the joy of Yang Fan killing an Alien Demigod, Luo Hai lowered his voice and said, “Did you all get the focus wrong?”
Hearing this, everyone froze, then reacted instantly, casting their gazes at the couple Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming at the same time.
In an instant, terrifying pressure appeared in the parliament hall of the Luo Family.
Even though the two were gods, at this moment they felt the danger of death.
“You really gave birth to a good son.” Luo Chengfeng’s voice suddenly sounded.
The next instant, his figure vanished like a ghost, suddenly appearing in front of the two.
“Colluding with aliens and making a move against your own people, do you want to die?”
Bang!
Bang!
Two crisp yet heavy slapping sounds exploded almost simultaneously.
Space trembled slightly.
Being a First-Order God alike, Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming were not unable to resist, but rather dared not.

Luo Xuan forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart, his voice becoming more urgent: “Our couple is absolutely unaware of this matter! If there is half a sentence of falsehood, I am willing to swear by my Divine Kingdom, let my divine spark shatter and fall into nothingness forever!”
Swearing by the Divine Kingdom was the heaviest oath among gods, but Luo Xuan did not hesitate at all at this moment.
Because he knew better than anyone that now was not the time to reason, but rather a juncture for “self-verification”.
Rao Mingming turned pale, her lips trembled slightly, and finally she softly added: “I swear the same.”
But even so, the atmosphere inside the parliament hall did not ease in the slightest.
It was even colder.
Luo Hai slowly spoke at this moment: “Did you two get the focus wrong again?”
“Do you think whether you knew about it matters anymore?”
A single sentence directly crushed the last bit of hope of Luo Xuan and his wife.
Luo Xuan’s figure swayed imperceptibly.
He finally realized that the core of the problem had completely changed.
It was not the truth itself.
But how to “make Yang Fan not pursue this matter”.
Luo Xuan had lived for endless years; he knew the unwritten rules of large families better than anyone.
There were feelings and friendships.
But in the face of absolute interests, these things always had to take a back seat.
If this matter was not handled well, the two of them would really die.
“Elder Luo Xuan, Elder Rao.”
Luo Hai’s voice remained steady, yet carried unquestionable power, “This matter is of great importance. If the Federal Law Enforcement Team finds out, the entire Family will be implicated.”
“From now on, the two of you will hand over all communication devices, your Divine Kingdom spaces will be sealed, and you will temporarily stay within the Family.”
“Rest assured, as long as it is confirmed to have nothing to do with you, the Luo Family will not implicate anyone.”
“After all, everyone has witnessed your contributions to the Family.”
After these words were spoken, the hall fell into silence.
The more “decent” the rhetoric, the clearer it made people about the irreversibility behind it.
A trace of bitterness welled up in Luo Xuan’s heart.
What of gods?
In front of true interest alignment, the so-called “same clan” was nothing more than an object that could be re-priced at any time.
He slowly exhaled a breath, his voice hoarse: “I understand.”
Luo Hai nodded slightly, saying no more, just raising a hand and waving, “Take them away.”
After they left, Luo Hai swept his gaze across everyone present and said, “I have already sent the Family Law Enforcement Team to the neighboring county to bring back Luo Mingxuan.”
“Besides that, what do you all think we should use to compensate Yang Fan?”
The parliament hall fell briefly silent, and then the atmosphere livened up again.

An Elder spoke up first: “Currently, the Family still has 100,000 Divinity Points in circulating funds. I suggest investing directly in him. In Taichu City, it is said that money is burned everywhere.”
As soon as the voice fell, another Elder immediately chimed in: “There are still quite a few Grade B building resources in the warehouse.”
“I remember there is also a Grade A resource building, ‘Spiritual Vein’, which is of extreme help to the growth of a Divine Kingdom.”

“I had people investigate this youth Yang Fan; he never bullied others at school. He used to have a close friend, Zhang Pang, and they still maintain contact in the Virtual World, which shows he values loyalty. Such a person is not the type to turn hostile once he gains power. Since that is the case, our Luo Family can fully increase investment, trading resources for the future.”
As the voice fell, someone immediately agreed: “That’s right, I agree too.”
“Such an opportunity has fallen upon our Luo Family. If we don’t seize it, it would truly be unforgivable by heaven.”
For a time, opinions inside the parliament hall were surprisingly consistent.
The ways of the world have always been like this.

If a wall is about to collapse, everyone fears avoiding it too late, terrified of a trace of implication; but once momentum rises like a dragon, even if it is just a hint of wind, people will rush to support it.
Human hearts are not fickle; they merely always tend towards higher values and steadier directions.
The so-called cold and warmth are merely due to different positions; the so-called good and evil are sometimes just the weight of bargaining chips.
With the potential Yang Fan has displayed now, it is no longer just “worth nurturing”, but an existence sufficient to tilt the overall strategy of the Luo Family.
Luo Hai finally made the decision, “Give him the Spiritual Vein, and send the 100,000 Divinity Points along with it.”
As the voice fell, there was no dissent in the parliament hall; instead, it felt like a matter of course.
Immediately, an Elder couldn’t help but speak: “Clan Chief, such a large sum of resources, who is suitable to send them?”
As this sentence fell, the atmosphere suddenly became subtle.
Everyone looked at each other, and the originally serious discussion instantly gained a bit of secret competition.
“How about I go?” An Elder spoke up first, his tone carrying undisguised eagerness, “This old man has never been to Taichu City, and happens to want to meet this peerless Genius.”
“Third brother, don’t join in this excitement, making it sound like anyone has been to Taichu City.”
“I’ll go.”
“I am more suitable.”
Luo Chengfeng swept his gaze across everyone and said calmly, “After all, I am Yang Fan’s grandfather, so it is more appropriate for me to step forward in this matter.”
As the sentence fell, the argument instantly stagnated.
Quite a few Elders’ eyes flickered, but it was not good for them to say much more.
Right at this moment, Luo Hai slowly raised his hand, interrupting everyone’s discussion.
“For this matter, I already have arrangements.” His tone was calm, “None of you need to go.”
Everyone was stunned, but Luo Hai didn’t explain too much, merely calmly adding: “The resources will be delivered on time, and the meeting is adjourned.”
After the Elders left, Luo Hai immediately sent a message to Luo Bing.

The next instant, his figure vanished like a ghost, suddenly appearing in front of the two.
“Colluding with aliens and making a move against your own people, do you want to die?”
Bang!
Bang!
Two crisp yet heavy slapping sounds exploded almost simultaneously.
Space trembled slightly.
Being a First-Order God alike, Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming were not unable to resist, but rather dared not.
Luo Xuan forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart, his voice becoming more urgent: “Our couple is absolutely unaware of this matter!
If there is half a sentence of falsehood, I am willing to swear by my Divine Kingdom, let my divine spark shatter and fall into nothingness forever!”
Swearing by the Divine Kingdom was the heaviest oath among gods, but Luo Xuan did not hesitate at all at this moment.
Because he knew better than anyone that now was not the time to reason, but rather a juncture for “self-verification”.
Rao Mingming turned pale, her lips trembled slightly, and finally she softly added: “I swear the same.”
But even so, the atmosphere inside the parliament hall did not ease in the slightest.
It was even colder.
Luo Hai slowly spoke at this moment: “Did you two get the focus wrong again?”
“Do you think whether you knew about it matters anymore?”
A single sentence directly crushed the last bit of hope of Luo Xuan and his wife.
Luo Xuan’s figure swayed imperceptibly.
He finally realized that the core of the problem had completely changed.
It was not the truth itself.
But how to “make Yang Fan not pursue this matter”.
Luo Xuan had lived for endless years; he knew the unwritten rules of large families better than anyone.
There were feelings and friendships.
But in the face of absolute interests, these things always had to take a back seat.
If this matter was not handled well, the two of them would really die.
“Elder Luo Xuan, Elder Rao.”
Luo Hai’s voice remained steady, yet carried unquestionable power, “This matter is of great importance.
If the Federal Law Enforcement Team finds out, the entire Family will be implicated.”
“From now on, the two of you will hand over all communication devices, your Divine Kingdom spaces will be sealed, and you will temporarily stay within the Family.”
“Rest assured, as long as it is confirmed to have nothing to do with you, the Luo Family will not implicate anyone.”
“After all, everyone has witnessed your contributions to the Family.”
After these words were spoken, the hall fell into silence.
The more “decent” the rhetoric, the clearer it made people about the irreversibility behind it.
A trace of bitterness welled up in Luo Xuan’s heart.
What of gods?
In front of true interest alignment, the so-called “same clan” was nothing more than an object that could be re-priced at any time.
He slowly exhaled a breath, his voice hoarse: “I understand.”
Luo Hai nodded slightly, saying no more, just raising a hand and waving, “Take them away.”
After they left, Luo Hai swept his gaze across everyone present and said, “I have already sent the Family Law Enforcement Team to the neighboring county to bring back Luo Mingxuan.”
“Besides that, what do you all think we should use to compensate Yang Fan?”
The parliament hall fell briefly silent, and then the atmosphere livened up again.
An Elder spoke up first: “Currently, the Family still has 100,000 Divinity Points in circulating funds.
I suggest investing directly in him.
In Taichu City, it is said that money is burned everywhere.”
As soon as the voice fell, another Elder immediately chimed in: “There are still quite a few Grade B building resources in the warehouse.”
“I remember there is also a Grade A resource building, ‘Spiritual Vein’, which is of extreme help to the growth of a Divine Kingdom.”
“I had people investigate this youth Yang Fan; he never bullied others at school.
He used to have a close friend, Zhang Pang, and they still maintain contact in the Virtual World, which shows he values loyalty.
Such a person is not the type to turn hostile once he gains power.
Since that is the case, our Luo Family can fully increase investment, trading resources for the future.”
As the voice fell, someone immediately agreed: “That’s right, I agree too.”
“Such an opportunity has fallen upon our Luo Family.
If we don’t seize it, it would truly be unforgivable by heaven.”
For a time, opinions inside the parliament hall were surprisingly consistent.
The ways of the world have always been like this.

If a wall is about to collapse, everyone fears avoiding it too late, terrified of a trace of implication; but once momentum rises like a dragon, even if it is just a hint of wind, people will rush to support it.
Human hearts are not fickle; they merely always tend towards higher values and steadier directions.
The so-called cold and warmth are merely due to different positions; the so-called good and evil are sometimes just the weight of bargaining chips.
With the potential Yang Fan has displayed now, it is no longer just “worth nurturing”, but an existence sufficient to tilt the overall strategy of the Luo Family.
Luo Hai finally made the decision, “Give him the Spiritual Vein, and send the 100,000 Divinity Points along with it.”
As the voice fell, there was no dissent in the parliament hall; instead, it felt like a matter of course.
Immediately, an Elder couldn’t help but speak: “Clan Chief, such a large sum of resources, who is suitable to send them?”
As this sentence fell, the atmosphere suddenly became subtle.
Everyone looked at each other, and the originally serious discussion instantly gained a bit of secret competition.
“How about I go?” An Elder spoke up first, his tone carrying undisguised eagerness, “This old man has never been to Taichu City, and happens to want to meet this peerless Genius.”
“Third brother, don’t join in this excitement, making it sound like anyone has been to Taichu City.”
“I’ll go.”
“I am more suitable.”
Luo Chengfeng swept his gaze across everyone and said calmly, “After all, I am Yang Fan’s grandfather, so it is more appropriate for me to step forward in this matter.”
As the sentence fell, the argument instantly stagnated.
Quite a few Elders’ eyes flickered, but it was not good for them to say much more.
Right at this moment, Luo Hai slowly raised his hand, interrupting everyone’s discussion.
“For this matter, I already have arrangements.” His tone was calm, “None of you need to go.”
Everyone was stunned, but Luo Hai didn’t explain too much, merely calmly adding: “The resources will be delivered on time, and the meeting is adjourned.”
After the Elders left, Luo Hai immediately sent a message to Luo Bing.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Strengthening the Divine Kingdom's Defense System
paragraphs: Time flew by, and another month passed.
Yang Fan’s life remained peaceful; he did not participate in the Primordial Battlefield and rarely went out.
What he did most this past month was frantically strengthen his Divine Kingdom’s defenses.
Now, the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom had completely changed in appearance.
The Thousand Poison Swamp, which was originally only distributed in localized areas, had been directly spread across the entire outer ring, forming a continuous zone of death.
Poisonous gas filled the air; even organized groups of ranked beings who stepped into it would find it difficult to walk out in one piece.
The breeding scale of the Poison Bee Queen was expanded even further.
On the original basis, Yang Fan directly opened up twenty exclusive flower beds for Planting various highly toxic Spirit Plants to provide for the continuous Evolution of the poison bee swarm.
That area was long no longer a mere “defense point,” but a restricted zone in the true sense of the word.
And these were merely reinforcements on the original foundation.
Under Yang Yi’s suggestion, Yang Fan added yet another crucial link—the high-tier monitoring and mobile strike System.

[Eye of God (A-rank): A domain-wide monitoring functional building capable of real-time scanning and early warning of all abnormal fluctuations within the range of the Divine Kingdom, including spatial rifts, energy disturbances, life fluctuations, etc.
It possesses high-precision locking capabilities, providing target guidance for all defense Systems.
Price: 20,000 Divinity Points]
[f3500 fighter jet (B-rank): Equipped with a small nuclear energy core, possessing near-infinite energy supply.
Equipped with high-frequency laser weapons and laser missile Systems, supporting dual anti-air and anti-ground strikes.
Extremely mobile, capable of rapid interception and firepower coverage, posing a significant threat to beings in the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Unit price: 200 Divinity Points]
This Mechanical System was loaded into the Divine Kingdom, integrating monitoring, locking, and striking into one.
Supported by massive Divinity Points, Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had gradually transformed from an original “resource-type powerhouse” into a true war fortress.

Yang Fan was confident that ordinary demigod powerhouses who rashly attacked without preparation wouldn’t even be able to touch his core area before their believers were completely exhausted by the defense buildings.
Yang Fan did not hesitate at all regarding these expenses; in his view, the development of a Divine Kingdom was never a sprint, but a long-distance run without an end.
Running fast was certainly important, but living long enough gave one the qualification to keep running.
Furthermore, he possessed the SSS-rank Talent; as long as time was long enough, development was only a matter of time.
The thing that truly could not go wrong was safety itself.
Although this Divine Kingdom invasion was a false alarm, it made him clearly realize the issue of safety.
In this world, the stronger your strength, the more likely the coordinates of your Divine Kingdom would be discovered by others.
Only powerful defensive strength could put an end to the covetous desires of others!
If other demigods knew of Yang Fan’s methods, they would probably be so angry that they would vomit blood on the spot.
With his current defensive configuration, even some veteran demigod Divine Kingdoms might not be willing to invest to such an extent.
For most gods, the resource priority was always the believers themselves.
Nurturing believers, enhancing combat power, and plundering resources through war—this was the mainstream path.
As for defense buildings, most were merely symbolically deployed to buy time or conduct harassment.
After all, the essence of a Divine Kingdom War was ultimately the slaughter between believers.
Yet someone like Yang Fan, who directly smashed massive resources to arm his entire Divine Kingdom to the teeth, was definitely rare.
However, regarding this, Yang Fan’s thoughts were very simple—earning money was too easy, so naturally, spending it didn’t hurt much.
Entering his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan checked the specific information:
Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11 million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (all resources within the Divine Kingdom accelerated growth by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique Talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.) (Upgraded, currently 100-fold acceleration)

Believers: Qi Refining Realm (23,264), Martial Disciple Realm (11,121), Tier 5 Being (86.44 million), Tier 4 beings (150 million), Tier 3 beings (310 million), Tier 2 beings (400 million), Tier 1 beings (900 million), Mortal (1.3 billion)
Profession: Alchemist (5,000) (already able to refine Qi Gathering Pill, Blood Essence Pill, Bone-Strengthening Pill...)
Dependent: Adult Elf (250,000)

Methods: Everlasting Spring Technique (Major Achievement), Gengjin Rift-Blade Art (Major Achievement), Profound Water Origin-Returning Art (Major Achievement), Crimson Flame Burning Heaven Record (Major Achievement), Thick Earth Mountain-Suppressing Scripture (Major Achievement), Indestructible Golden Body Technique (Major Achievement), Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-rank, Minor Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-rank, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 5.12 million (Daily provided Divinity Points 0.11)

Buildings: Moon Well x200,000, Sun Spring x200,000, Eye of God (A-rank), Spiritual Vein x200 (A-rank), Alchemy Tower x20 (B-rank), hundred herb spirit pivot academy x10 (B-rank), immortal nurturing tower x300 (B-rank), Monkey Wine Spring x500,000 (B-rank), Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (100,000 years, nurturing Adult Elfs), f3500 fighter jet x1,000 (B-rank defense building), Thousand Poison Swamp x500,000 (C-rank)...
Wonders: Penglai Island x1,000 (deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x5,000 (deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x10,000 (deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x5 (deployed)

Assets: Dragon Fish fry (x100 million), small mineral vein, Spirit Stone (), Dragon meat (), spiritual grain (), various Medicinal Pills (), various spirit fruits (), various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plants (), various weapons()

Now, under the effect of the Hundred-fold Evolution Talent, the Divine Kingdom’s largest source of income was fisheries, with net profits in reality reaching as high as 150 million Divinity Points each month.
The second source of income was the wine industry, with a net profit of 50 million Divinity Points.
The Spirit Stones produced by the Spiritual Veins were all distributed to the believers for use.
Given the output of the current 200 Spiritual Veins, even if the number of believers in the Qi Refining Realm increased by severalfold, it would still be difficult to consume them all.
As for Moon Dew and Sun Essence, the Elf Race was allowed to take and use them freely.

Under conditions of extreme resource abundance, Yang Fan did not choose to sell basic resources externally; instead, he invested all of them into the interior of the Divine Kingdom to cultivate believers and dependents.
Yang Fan stood high in the sky of the Divine Kingdom, quietly overlooking this realm.
Today, the Spiritual Qi flowing through the Divine Kingdom was becoming increasingly rich and powerful, the rules were growing increasingly stable, and tyrannical auras were surging everywhere.
He could even clearly perceive that some believers had touched the limit of the Qi Refining Stage and were attempting to break through the threshold of Foundation Establishment.
Feeling this, Yang Fan could not help feeling a bit restless in his heart.
“How about going to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone to give it a try?”
Yang Fan recalled the last time he annexed the Divine Kingdom Core.
That exhilarating feeling of enhanced power and elevated life levels remained vivid to this day, attracting him like a drug.
“Go to the Alien Divine Kingdom Zone and swallow another Divine Kingdom Core.”
As soon as the thought arose, it rapidly spread in his heart.
But soon, Yang Fan took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed that palpitation.
“Steady!” He muttered to himself, “Divine Kingdom War is a life-or-death gamble; one cannot easily take risks.”
Yang Fan was clear that his advantage was never a transient burst, but time.
With the SSS-rank Talent present, as long as he maintained his rhythm, he would become a powerhouse sooner or later.
On the contrary, blind expansion was the greatest risk.
“Taking too big a step can easily tear your balls,” Yang Fan shook his head gently, “At least wait until believers in the Foundation Establishment Realm are born within the Divine Kingdom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Leaving the City to See Luo Bing
paragraphs: Thinking of this, his gaze once again became steady.
Reviewing materials during this period gave him a clearer understanding of demigods.
Among demigods, only a Divine Kingdom with Foundation Establishment Realm believers could truly have a foothold.

Relying on a large number of Qi Refining Realm believers and Formation blessings, risking one’s life to reach the Foundation Establishment Realm could naturally be done, but that was too rash, and Yang Fan certainly didn’t like it.
What he wanted had always been safety and crushing superiority.
Furthermore, once a Foundation Establishment Realm believer was born, the power of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation he mastered would also undergo a qualitative change.
As for the higher-level Core Formation Realm, Yang Fan was very clear that at the demigod stage, it was almost impossible to appear.

The rules of the Divine Kingdom itself had limitations; unless one possessed a special cultivation-type Divine Kingdom talent, the probability of a demigod having Core Formation believers was far too low.
Right at this moment, a communication alert suddenly rang out.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, and tapped open the light screen.
It was a message from Luo Bing.
“I am inside a sightseeing ship outside Taichu City. Are you free right now?”
Her tone remained cold and aloof, but compared to the past, there was a bit more cautious sense of propriety.
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow, “Why did you run over here?”
“Father asked me to come over.”
Seeing this sentence, Yang Fan already had a general judgment in his heart.
He did not continue to press, but instead contacted Tang Yue, “Can Family members enter Taichu City?”
“No. Taichu City has strict access permission restrictions; only those holding an access key can enter,” Tang Yue replied.
“If Your Highness has relatives or friends visiting, I can accompany you outside.”
“Alright.”
Outside Primordial Star, circles upon circles of huge sightseeing ship orbits surrounded it.
As one of the two most prosperous core planets of the Human Race Federation, the halo of Primordial Star had long ceased to be just an “academy,” but rather a symbol.
Even if they could not truly enter Taichu City, merely gazing at it from afar outside the star orbits still attracted countless people to cross the Star Domain to come here.
Some people spent years of savings just to stand in front of the porthole of a sightseeing ship and take a glance at that legendary city.
Some rushed from several light-years away just to check-in and take photos, proving that they had once “approached” it.
Everyone knew that the number of people who could truly enter Taichu City was very few.
Out of hundreds of millions of people, perhaps only one could.
Yet precisely because of this, it appeared all the more sacred. The more out of reach it was, the more people flocked to it.
And precisely under this halo, the tourism industry around Primordial Star flourished to the extreme.
Inside the sightseeing ship, the crowd was bustling.
Geniuses, students, and practitioners from all over shuttled back and forth between the corridors and observation decks, either chatting excitedly or pausing to take pictures.
And in a relatively quiet corner by the porthole, Luo Bing stood quietly.
Her arms were crossed over her chest, her back leaning against the transparent energy glass, and her gaze cast into the distance.
Luo Bing’s eyes at this moment were very complicated, containing yearning, confusion, and a trace of undisguised unwillingness and frustration.
It was like a person standing outside the door, looking at that door that had never opened to her.
“I... really differ this much from him?” Luo Bing asked in a voice only she could hear.
Luo Hai had already sent her that video, and that night she had barely slept all night.
That boy who promoted from Class 7, Grade 12 to Class 1.
That person who, in her memory, still stayed at the position of “working hard to catch up with her.”
I don’t know since when, he had already stood at a height she could not reach.
The demigod Realm—in Tianshui University where she currently studied, even among senior students graduating in their fourth year, not many people could step into it.
Yet Yang Fan had only entered the Primordial Academy for a short time, and had already crossed that threshold.
This was no longer a “gap,” but a “fault-line” lead.
The gap between people was never pulled apart step by step.
Sometimes, it was just a door. Some people stood outside the door desperately looking up, while others had already walked inside.
And the moment the door closed—you couldn’t even see the direction to chase anymore.
At this moment, a young man dressed in luxurious attire walked over with a confident smile and a calm pace, “Beauty, this one is from the Mo City Nan Family...”
“No time, don’t bother me.” Luo Bing didn’t even turn her head slightly, her tone cold, crisp, and neat.
The man’s smile stiffened.

Luo Bing was inherently of peerless beauty, with a cold and untrammeled temperament. Along the way, she had attracted countless gazes and also attracted quite a few Young Masters to take the initiative to chat her up.
But without exception, all of them were shut out by her.

The youth surnamed Nan looked slightly unpleasant, but under the gaze of everyone, it was not good for him to flare up. He could only reluctantly squeeze out a trace of a smile: “In that case, farewell.”
After saying that, he turned around and left.
The love of beauty was universal to everyone.
Encountering a beauty during a journey and wanting to step forward to get acquainted was originally the most normal thing in the world.
Although being rejected was a bit awkward, it wouldn’t cause any ugly scenes.
He had not walked more than a few steps before he was surrounded by several companions.
“Brother Nan, your campaign has failed before it even started. Didn’t you just say that with your face, you could win her over casually?”
“Exactly, you stated your Family background right as you came up, that counts as cheating. We were talking about relying on looks.” Another person patted his own face, smiling with ill intent.
The youth surnamed Nan was not angry, shaking his head and smiling: “She’s an ice beauty, not easy to handle. A forced melon is not sweet.”
Pausing for a moment, he lowered his voice and said: “However, this temper is indeed not very good, I don’t know which Family she came from, she has zero manners.”
“Probably from some small place.” Someone chimed in, “Otherwise how could she speak with such a sharp edge, leaving no room at all.”
The few walked and laughed, their tone carrying a bit of teasing and disdain.
In their cognition, the better the Family background, the more emphasis they placed on propriety and etiquette.
Even if they were arrogant inside, on the surface they would maintain basic decency.
True children of noble families rarely stated rejections so bluntly. They were better at using gentle methods to make the other party retreat in the face of difficulties.
And an attitude like Luo Bing’s, crisp, neat, and merciless, appeared to them instead as “lacking upbringing.”
At the same time.
Inside Taichu City.
Tang Yue had already arrived at the entrance of Yang Fan’s courtyard.
As the courtyard door slowly opened.
The moment her gaze fell upon Yang Fan, she froze completely.
That aura, she was too familiar with it.
The aura of Perfection, faintly harmonizing with heaven and earth.
This was—a Demigod!
“Your... Your Highness, have you made a Breakthrough to a demigod?” Tang Yue said excitedly.
You must know that Tang Yue was a Tier 3 God, and her knowledge was far beyond what ordinary people could compare to.
Yet even so, at the moment of seeing Yang Fan break through to a demigod, she still found it difficult to maintain composure.
Even less than half a year had passed since the start of the freshman year, yet he had stepped from a Divine Being into the demigod Realm.
This growth speed had already exceeded the vast majority of students with S-rank Talent.
With Yang Fan’s performance, during his university period it was even possible to challenge the evaluation of a “Peerless Prodigy”.
After a brief shock, Tang Yue quickly reined in her mind, and her demeanor became even more respectful.
The stronger Yang Fan’s potential was, the higher his future achievements would be. As his protector, the resource rewards she could obtain would also rise accordingly.
“A lucky Breakthrough.”
Yang Fan’s tone was casual, as if he were speaking of a most ordinary matter.
Hearing this, the corners of Tang Yue’s mouth twitched slightly, but she didn’t say much.
She quickly recovered her wits and said solemnly: “Where is Your Highness heading on this trip? Who are you meeting?”
“The sightseeing ship outside the city, my wife.”
Tang Yue was slightly startled, then immediately nodded: “Understood.”
She did not ask any more questions, but quickly mobilized her permissions.
The next moment, an exclusive spatial spaceship was directly summoned.

The spaceship’s appearance was streamlined and stern, overall dark silver, with its surface covered in complex energy lines. Multiple sets of weapon modules were hidden on both sides of the hull, and faintly visible muzzle guns and rails emitted a dangerous aura.
“Your Highness, this is a short-range commuting spaceship equipped by Taichu City for the Human Race Prodigy.” Tang Yue explained while guiding Yang Fan to board the ship.
The spaceship quickly started up, and space trembled slightly.
The next moment, the spaceship directly appeared in the sightseeing area outside Taichu City.
