Reviewing materials during this period gave him a clearer understanding of demigods.
Among demigods, only a Divine Kingdom with Foundation Establishment Realm believers could truly have a foothold.

Relying on a large number of Qi Refining Realm believers and Formation blessings, risking one’s life to reach the Foundation Establishment Realm could naturally be done, but that was too rash, and Yang Fan certainly didn’t like it.
What he wanted had always been safety and crushing superiority.
Furthermore, once a Foundation Establishment Realm believer was born, the power of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation he mastered would also undergo a qualitative change.
As for the higher-level Core Formation Realm, Yang Fan was very clear that at the demigod stage, it was almost impossible to appear.

The rules of the Divine Kingdom itself had limitations; unless one possessed a special cultivation-type Divine Kingdom talent, the probability of a demigod having Core Formation believers was far too low.
Right at this moment, a communication alert suddenly rang out.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, and tapped open the light screen.
It was a message from Luo Bing.
“I am inside a sightseeing ship outside Taichu City.
Are you free right now?”
Her tone remained cold and aloof, but compared to the past, there was a bit more cautious sense of propriety.
Yang Fan raised an eyebrow, “Why did you run over here?”
“Father asked me to come over.”
Seeing this sentence, Yang Fan already had a general judgment in his heart.
He did not continue to press, but instead contacted Tang Yue, “Can Family members enter Taichu City?”
“No.
Taichu City has strict access permission restrictions; only those holding an access key can enter,” Tang Yue replied.
“If Your Highness has relatives or friends visiting, I can accompany you outside.”
“Alright.”
Outside Primordial Star, circles upon circles of huge sightseeing ship orbits surrounded it.
As one of the two most prosperous core planets of the Human Race Federation, the halo of Primordial Star had long ceased to be just an “academy,” but rather a symbol.
Even if they could not truly enter Taichu City, merely gazing at it from afar outside the star orbits still attracted countless people to cross the Star Domain to come here.
Some people spent years of savings just to stand in front of the porthole of a sightseeing ship and take a glance at that legendary city.
Some rushed from several light-years away just to check-in and take photos, proving that they had once “approached” it.
Everyone knew that the number of people who could truly enter Taichu City was very few.
Out of hundreds of millions of people, perhaps only one could.
Yet precisely because of this, it appeared all the more sacred.
The more out of reach it was, the more people flocked to it.
And precisely under this halo, the tourism industry around Primordial Star flourished to the extreme.
Inside the sightseeing ship, the crowd was bustling.
Geniuses, students, and practitioners from all over shuttled back and forth between the corridors and observation decks, either chatting excitedly or pausing to take pictures.
And in a relatively quiet corner by the porthole, Luo Bing stood quietly.
Her arms were crossed over her chest, her back leaning against the transparent energy glass, and her gaze cast into the distance.
Luo Bing’s eyes at this moment were very complicated, containing yearning, confusion, and a trace of undisguised unwillingness and frustration.
It was like a person standing outside the door, looking at that door that had never opened to her.
“I... really differ this much from him?” Luo Bing asked in a voice only she could hear.
Luo Hai had already sent her that video, and that night she had barely slept all night.
That boy who promoted from Class 7, Grade 12 to Class 1.
That person who, in her memory, still stayed at the position of “working hard to catch up with her.”
I don’t know since when, he had already stood at a height she could not reach.
The demigod Realm—in Tianshui University where she currently studied, even among senior students graduating in their fourth year, not many people could step into it.
Yet Yang Fan had only entered the Primordial Academy for a short time, and had already crossed that threshold.
This was no longer a “gap,” but a “fault-line” lead.
The gap between people was never pulled apart step by step.
Sometimes, it was just a door.
Some people stood outside the door desperately looking up, while others had already walked inside.
And the moment the door closed—you couldn’t even see the direction to chase anymore.
At this moment, a young man dressed in luxurious attire walked over with a confident smile and a calm pace, “Beauty, this one is from the Mo City Nan Family...”
“No time, don’t bother me.” Luo Bing didn’t even turn her head slightly, her tone cold, crisp, and neat.
The man’s smile stiffened.
Luo Bing was inherently of peerless beauty, with a cold and untrammeled temperament.
Along the way, she had attracted countless gazes and also attracted quite a few Young Masters to take the initiative to chat her up.
But without exception, all of them were shut out by her.
The youth surnamed Nan looked slightly unpleasant, but under the gaze of everyone, it was not good for him to flare up.
He could only reluctantly squeeze out a trace of a smile: “In that case, farewell.”
After saying that, he turned around and left.
The love of beauty was universal to everyone.
Encountering a beauty during a journey and wanting to step forward to get acquainted was originally the most normal thing in the world.
Although being rejected was a bit awkward, it wouldn’t cause any ugly scenes.
He had not walked more than a few steps before he was surrounded by several companions.
“Brother Nan, your campaign has failed before it even started.
Didn’t you just say that with your face, you could win her over casually?”
“Exactly, you stated your Family background right as you came up, that counts as cheating.
We were talking about relying on looks.” Another person patted his own face, smiling with ill intent.
The youth surnamed Nan was not angry, shaking his head and smiling: “She’s an ice beauty, not easy to handle.
A forced melon is not sweet.”
Pausing for a moment, he lowered his voice and said: “However, this temper is indeed not very good, I don’t know which Family she came from, she has zero manners.”
“Probably from some small place.” Someone chimed in, “Otherwise how could she speak with such a sharp edge, leaving no room at all.”
The few walked and laughed, their tone carrying a bit of teasing and disdain.
In their cognition, the better the Family background, the more emphasis they placed on propriety and etiquette.
Even if they were arrogant inside, on the surface they would maintain basic decency.
True children of noble families rarely stated rejections so bluntly.
They were better at using gentle methods to make the other party retreat in the face of difficulties.
And an attitude like Luo Bing’s, crisp, neat, and merciless, appeared to them instead as “lacking upbringing.”
At the same time.
Inside Taichu City.
Tang Yue had already arrived at the entrance of Yang Fan’s courtyard.
As the courtyard door slowly opened.
The moment her gaze fell upon Yang Fan, she froze completely.
That aura, she was too familiar with it.
The aura of Perfection, faintly harmonizing with heaven and earth.
This was—a Demigod!
“Your...
Your Highness, have you made a Breakthrough to a demigod?” Tang Yue said excitedly.
You must know that Tang Yue was a Tier 3 God, and her knowledge was far beyond what ordinary people could compare to.
Yet even so, at the moment of seeing Yang Fan break through to a demigod, she still found it difficult to maintain composure.
Even less than half a year had passed since the start of the freshman year, yet he had stepped from a Divine Being into the demigod Realm.
This growth speed had already exceeded the vast majority of students with S-rank Talent.
With Yang Fan’s performance, during his university period it was even possible to challenge the evaluation of a “Peerless Prodigy”.
After a brief shock, Tang Yue quickly reined in her mind, and her demeanor became even more respectful.
The stronger Yang Fan’s potential was, the higher his future achievements would be.
As his protector, the resource rewards she could obtain would also rise accordingly.
“A lucky Breakthrough.”
Yang Fan’s tone was casual, as if he were speaking of a most ordinary matter.
Hearing this, the corners of Tang Yue’s mouth twitched slightly, but she didn’t say much.
She quickly recovered her wits and said solemnly: “Where is Your Highness heading on this trip?
Who are you meeting?”
“The sightseeing ship outside the city, my wife.”
Tang Yue was slightly startled, then immediately nodded: “Understood.”
She did not ask any more questions, but quickly mobilized her permissions.
The next moment, an exclusive spatial spaceship was directly summoned.
The spaceship’s appearance was streamlined and stern, overall dark silver, with its surface covered in complex energy lines.
Multiple sets of weapon modules were hidden on both sides of the hull, and faintly visible muzzle guns and rails emitted a dangerous aura.
“Your Highness, this is a short-range commuting spaceship equipped by Taichu City for the Human Race Prodigy.” Tang Yue explained while guiding Yang Fan to board the ship.
The spaceship quickly started up, and space trembled slightly.
The next moment, the spaceship directly appeared in the sightseeing area outside Taichu City.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Kill Him!
paragraphs: Inside the sightseeing ship.
The crowd, who were previously chatting and viewing the scenery, suddenly felt a slight distortion in space.
Shortly after, a behemoth appeared not far away without any warning.
That was a spaceship far exceeding the size of the sightseeing ship, being four to five times larger.
The hull was cold, the lines sharp, and the armed modules faintly visible. Merely hovering there, it brought a sense of oppression.
For a moment, the entire sightseeing ship instantly fell silent.
” Th... What level of spaceship is this? “
” Direct spatial jump in? Without even an early warning? “
” Which big figure has come... “
Low discussions rose and fell one after another.
The originally noisy atmosphere was instantly suppressed.
In the air, there was a faint hint of tension and awe.
” Brother Nan, you are knowledgeable and experienced. Wh... Which big figure is this? “
The youth surnamed Nan stared at the huge spaceship in the distance, his expression turning rare and solemn as he lowered his voice to say, ” This is a dedicated spaceship for a Human Race Prodigy. “
” I have seen it once before. “
” Spaceships of this level can only be mobilized by the prodigies heavily cultivated by Taichu City. “
He paused, his tone clearly becoming serious: ” In a word — — don’t provoke them. “
The complexions of the few people around changed slightly.
” So exaggerated? “
The youth surnamed Nan sneered: ” Exaggerated? Back then, my brother was a Class B Genius. When he was cultivating in Taichu City, he accidentally offended a Prodigy. “
” And the result? “
” He was beaten so badly that he couldn’t get out of bed for a month. “
As the voice fell, the people around drew a cold breath.
” That is a Class B Genius... “
For a moment, the gazes of the few people looking at that spaceship gained a few more parts of awe.
” What are such a level of Prodigy characters suddenly stopping in front of the sightseeing ship for? “
No one answered, because the spaceship hatch was slowly opening.
Tang Yue’s figure walked out first.
With a single step, the aura of a Tier 3 God instantly spread out, enveloping the entire sightseeing ship area like an invisible coercion.
The air seemed to freeze for a moment.
The Demigod staff inside the sightseeing ship changed color abruptly, hurriedly stepping forward to bow respectfully: ” Lord God, I wonder what your instructions are? “

Tang Yue didn’t even look at him, merely scanning the surroundings simply. After confirming there was no threat, she turned around and bowed, saying respectfully: ” Your Highness, there is no danger. “
The next moment, Yang Fan’s figure walked out from the spaceship.
His gaze swept across and quickly locked onto Luo Bing in the corner.
Now Yang Fan was already a Demigod. Seeing him stamp his foot, his entire person directly rose into the air, flying into the interior of the sightseeing ship and landing in front of Luo Bing.
” Luo... Bing’er, the procedures for leaving the city were delayed for a bit, making you wait for a long time. “
The entire sightseeing ship seemed to have been pressed with a pause button.
The crowd that was still discussing earlier completely froze at this moment.
Such a level of existence appeared on the sightseeing ship, actually for a woman?
Shock, bewilderment, incredulity.
Various emotions alternately appeared on everyone’s faces.
Some people had complicated gazes, looking at Luo Bing even with a faint hint of jealousy, wishing they could replace her.
Luo Bing gently curved the corners of her mouth. That trace of a smile was very faint, yet it truly existed.
The heart of vanity exists in everyone. Even though she was always cold and aloof, she could not avoid it either.
Yang Fan reached out to embrace her waist.
Luo Bing paused slightly, yet did not resist.
The two of them just like that, amidst countless complex gazes, turned around and left.
The hatch closed, and space shook once again.
That behemoth vanished instantly, as if it had never appeared.
Inside the sightseeing ship.
The silence lasted for several breaths.
Then a voice sounded, ” Brother Nan... You were quite brave just now, I take back my words mocking you. “
” Fortunately you didn’t succeed. If you really succeeded, I’m afraid you wouldn’t need to return to the Nan Family. “
Cold sweat had already broken out on the forehead of the youth surnamed Nan, ” Stop talking... “
At that instant just now, he even had a feeling of his back turning cold.
Fortunately he didn’t offend the other party. If a Human Race Prodigy really came to find trouble with him,
I’m afraid without the other party needing to make a move, his Family would push him out at the very first moment.
Inside the spaceship.
Tang Yue stood to one side with a respectful demeanor: ” Your Highness, personnel coming from outside Taichu City cannot enter, but there are quite a few high-specification tourism planets nearby. “
” I have already arranged accommodation for you and Madame — — Xinghan Resort Planet, and the presidential suite is ready. “
Yang Fan nodded: ” Alright. “
The spaceship started up once more, space distorted, and it crossed over in the blink of an eye.
Xinghan Resort Planet.
The instant the spaceship shuttled out, the scenery before their eyes suddenly changed.
If Taichu City was the ultimate in simplicity and order, then this place was another extreme.

The entire planet was brightly lit, various neon colors intertwined into a sea, and countless light rails and advertising projections floated in the sky, with an architectural style that was flamboyant and magnificent.
Bright lights and green wine, paper gold and drunken dreams. It seemed even the air was permeated with a decadent aura.
Yang Fan and Luo Bing were both stunned for a moment; this visual impact was too strong.
Yang Fan couldn’t help muttering in his heart: ” The living environment in this place is much more comfortable. Anyone who didn’t know would think this is Taichu City. “
Tang Yue’s expression was as usual, obviously long accustomed to this, leading the two of them all the way into the top-tier hotel of Xinghan Resort Planet — —
Astral Court Hotel.
Straight to the top-floor presidential suite all the way.
The room door opened.
A pale red soft light slowly lit up.
A faint floral fragrance permeated the air, the floor was covered with a soft carpet, in the center was a wide bed, and delicate crystal wine glasses and red wine were placed beside the bed.
Tang Yue bowed slightly: ” Your Highness, everything has been properly arranged for you.
Yang Fan silently gave a like in his heart; his Guardian’s arrangement was indeed thorough.
After Tang Yue retreated, only the two of them were left in the room.
Yang Fan looked at Luo Bing. Ever since she was drugged that day, although the two had contact, they had always maintained a certain restrained distance.
But at this moment, such a distance seemed no longer necessary.
He stepped forward and pulled her into his embrace.
Luo Bing’s body stiffened slightly, ” I still have matters... “
” Let’s talk about it tomorrow. ” Yang Fan’s tone was casual, not giving her a chance to refuse.
Luo Bing fell silent for an instant, and this time she did not push him away again.
The night grew deep.
The light in the room was soft, and the atmosphere gradually became ambiguous.
Low breathing and slight sounds were infinitely magnified in the silence.
It started as panting, and later turned into sounds of begging for mercy.
The next day.
Luo Bing slowly opened her eyes, and the obvious soreness coming from her body made her frown slightly.
She turned her head sideways to look at Yang Fan beside her, her eyes carrying a hint of resentment.
Yang Fan, however, was refreshed and spirited, stretching lazily as he couldn’t help sighing in his heart: ” The body of a Demigod powerhouse is truly terrifying. “
Luo Bing finished dressing, her tone returning to her usual calmness: ” The matter regarding Luo Mingxuan has been investigated clearly. “
” His fund flow and chat records have both been locked down. “
” It is confirmed that he proactively contacted an Alien Demigod, providing information and partial funds to deduce the coordinates of your Divine Kingdom. “
” How should we deal with him? ” Yang Fan said.

” Everything will be as you wish. The person has already been controlled, but Yang County and Taichu City are too far apart to bring this person over. We can enter the Virtual World to deal with him face to face. “
Soon, the two put on the virtual helmets prepared by the hotel, and their consciousnesses connected.
Virtual World.
According to the coordinates provided by Luo Bing, the screen shifted, and the two had already arrived at the Luo Family dungeon.
Real-time image transmission was adopted here, and Yang Fan’s decision could be directly executed by the people in reality.
In the cell, Luo Mingxuan was locked in the center.
His condition at this moment was extremely poor, his body covered with scars, his aura weak, and his eyes hollow—at a glance, he had obviously undergone severe torture.
Where did he still have the look of a young master from back then? He looked more like a dead dog waiting to be disposed of.
Yang Fan looked at the other party. There was no anger in his eyes, nor the pleasure of revenge, only a faint contempt.
Today’s Luo Mingxuan couldn’t even be considered an ” enemy “; he was just a minor hidden hazard that needed to be cleared.
Yang Fan suddenly recalled back then in the Genius Exchange Group, the other party’s taunts carried with a sense of superiority.
Looking back now, he only felt it was somewhat laughable.
After a moment of silence, Yang Fan said in a cold voice: ” Kill him! “
The verbal dispute back then wasn’t a big deal, yet it almost evolved into a life-and-death crisis for himself.
If not for his Breakthrough to a Demigod, the ending might very well have been completely reversed.

The reason strong people can live long is not because they have no enemies. Rather, it is because they do not underestimate any enemy. No matter how minuscule a chess piece is, it can overturn the entire chessboard at a critical moment.
A person can be strong, but cannot be arrogant. They can be ruthless, but must be steady.

chapters.title: Chapter 129: What is mere vengeance for a killed son?
paragraphs: Facing death, Luo Mingxuan slowly raised his head.
His gaze fell on Yang Fan, lacking hysteria and instead carrying an inexplicable calmness.
Offending Yang Fan meant being abandoned by the Family, completely cutting off his path to the Divine Kingdom.
He had no way out, and this vicious scheme was a step Luo Mingxuan took after plotting for a long time.
As long as Yang Fan died, no one would trace it back to him.
There was even a chance he could be welcomed back into the Luo Family.
It was just that heaven does not always grant what people desire!
The moment he heard that Yang Fan had broken through to Demigod and even counter-killed an Alien God, all his hope instantly collapsed.
Yang Fan would not let him go, and struggling any more now would only be a laughingstock, so it was better to die with dignity.
Following Yang Fan’s order, a hair-thin high-energy beam descended from the top of the cell in reality.
There was no sound, no struggle.
The instant the beam swept past, Luo Mingxuan’s Physical Body rapidly decomposed and dissipated from top to bottom, as if being erased.
To deal with a Divine Being, there was no need to invade the Divine Kingdom at all; destroying the other party’s Physical Body in reality was enough.
Consciousness returned to reality.
Luo Bing looked at Yang Fan and continued, “How should Luo Mingxuan’s parents be dealt with?”
“As long as you speak, the Luo Family will cooperate fully.”
Yang Fan did not answer immediately, instead asking in return, “Are they related to this matter?”
“I have checked the communication records and fund transfers, and there is definitely no connection. This matter was done entirely by Luo Mingxuan from start to finish,” Luo Bing affirmed.
As her voice fell, the room fell into a brief silence.
Yang Fan did not speak, just quietly looking at Luo Bing.
His gaze seemed to be confirming something, or perhaps weighing something.
Luo Bing did not dodge, quietly meeting his gaze.
Yang Fan withdrew his gaze and sighed softly, “Since they are unrelated, then forget it.”
“However, I hope the Luo Family can properly restrain the two Elders. This matter is not my fault.”
Having experienced Luo Mingxuan’s affair, Yang Fan actually preferred to eradicate the roots.
It was just that after weighing the options, he did not choose to do so.
The Luo Family wouldn’t care about Luo Mingxuan’s death.
But Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming were different; these were two true Gods.
Their value to the Luo Family was far beyond what a Luo Mingxuan could compare to.
More importantly, Yang Fan was not sure how much truth there was to what Luo Bing called “unrelated”, or if this was a test from the Luo Family.
Did the weight of his own status as a “Human Race Prodigy” truly exceed two Gods?
Since he wasn’t sure, he would take a step back for now.
Anyway, he was currently in Taichu City and had Tang Yue, a Tier 3 God, protecting his path.
For a short time, there was no need to worry about the other party retaliating.
As for the future when he truly stepped into the God Realm, if the other party still harbored resentment, it wouldn’t be too late to make a move then.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan gradually calmed down.
Some things weren’t that they couldn’t be done, but they shouldn’t be done to the absolute extreme.
Using another’s knife to kill was fine.
Using momentum to suppress others was also fine.
But once that “limit” was crossed, it would easily backfire on oneself.
In fact, Yang Fan was overthinking this matter, or rather, he hadn’t fully realized his own value.
Cultivating in Taichu City and breaking through to Demigod in less than half a year—this kind of talent was enough to drive a force like the Luo Family crazy.
If he really proposed eradicating the roots, all the Gods of the Luo Family would stand on his side.

“Besides this matter,” Luo Bing spoke, trying her best to keep her tone steady, “the Family also asked me to hand over 100,000 Divinity Points, as well as an A-grade resource building—a Spiritual Vein.”
Speaking of this, a flash of envy couldn’t help but cross her eyes.
Resources of this level would make even Gods tempted.
She was very clear that this was no longer “cultivation” in the normal sense, but a gamble.
The investment Yang Fan alone received had already exceeded the sum of all geniuses of the Luo Family’s generation combined.
“I’ll give the Spiritual Vein to you,” Yang Fan said.
Luo Bing was stunned, as if she had heard wrong.
“As for the Divinity Points, you take 40,000, Luo Rou takes 40,000, and 10,000 for each of my parents.”
The air fell silent for a fraction of a second, and Luo Bing was completely dumbfounded.
A Spiritual Vein... given to her?
That was an A-grade resource building, a strategic resource capable of directly changing the cultivation environment of a Divine Kingdom.
Even if she wanted to buy one, she couldn’t; the Divine Shop had none in stock at all.
As for 40,000 Divinity Points, Luo Bing had never even touched wealth of this scale.
If used for her own development, it would be enough to leap her into the top ranks at Tianshui University.
Her breathing paused slightly, and her gaze fell on Yang Fan, complicated to the extreme.
Luo Bing suddenly realized that what Yang Fan was giving her right now even exceeded the Luo Family’s total investment in her over all these years.
Deep down in her heart, an indescribable emotion slowly welled up.
The slight dissatisfaction she originally held toward her father’s “forced arrangement” quietly loosened at this moment.
In this world, are there any men who could be so generous to their other half?
Luo Bing lightly bit her lip, her eye sockets heating up slightly.
“I don’t want to go to school so soon; let me accompany you for another month.”
At this moment, this iceberg beauty, usually as cold and aloof as frost, could barely suppress her emotions.
She was truly moved.
“This man loves me too much; I can’t throw tantrums like before anymore,” Luo Bing secretly decided.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression was slightly startled.
He hadn’t expected that giving away a few resources he didn’t need would have such a good effect on flirting with his wife.
The development of the Divine Kingdom naturally took time, and there wouldn’t be any risks in the short term.
Returning to Taichu City didn’t seem to need to be so hasty.
“Rather than that, why not...”
Yang Fan’s eyes narrowed slightly. Looking at the ample chest before Luo Bing, he suddenly felt that staying on this Xinghan Resort Planet for a bit longer wouldn’t be bad either.
The perspective shifted.
Inside the Luo Family territory in Yang County, the atmosphere had returned to normal.
Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming had their confinement lifted and returned to their residence.
The room was quiet.
Rao Mingming’s expression was somewhat dim, carrying an uncontrollable exhaustion and sadness between her brows.
However, Luo Xuan only let out a long breath, as if unloading a certain pressure, and his expression instead became a bit more relaxed.
“That rebellious son Luo Mingxuan... died well!”
Hearing this, Rao Mingming trembled slightly, looking at Luo Xuan in disbelief.
“We are Gods with infinite Lifespan. Without this Genius offspring, there will be another.”
Luo Xuan stood with his hands behind his back, his gaze calm.
“Our Divine Kingdom is the fundamental base.”
Rao Mingming was silent for a moment, unable to help asking, “Then what about Yang Fan?”
Luo Xuan smiled lightly, his tone appearing even more indifferent.
“What is mere vengeance for a killed son?”
“Between Gods, emotions are never used as the basis for decision-making. Interests are the only standard.”
Luo Xuan paused, his gaze deepening a bit.
“The Family Head did the right thing. If I were in that position, I would have made the exact same choice.
If Yang Fan can grow up, he will definitely lead the Luo Family a step further, and everyone will benefit by then.”
Luo Xuan’s words were extremely rational, even cold.
As if the so-called “Bloodline kinship” here was merely a variable that could be calculated and traded off.

After hearing this, the slight sorrow in Rao Mingming’s heart was gradually suppressed, but she still said hesitatingly, “I’m afraid we have already offended Yang Fan now. What should we do about this?”
“If we’ve offended him, we’ll find a way to resolve it.
Yang Fan is in Taichu City, and we can’t reach him. But his parents are still in Yang County.”
“Starting from them, it might not be impossible to ease relations.”
“In any case, the misunderstanding must be resolved. If operated properly, we might even be able to establish a connection through this.”
Speaking of this, Luo Xuan’s tone carried a trace of anticipation.
“Borrowing Yang Fan’s momentum, it might not be impossible for us to go a step further. In the future, we might even break through to a Tier 2... or even Tier 3 God.”

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Child is Born — — Yang Chengrou
paragraphs: One month later.
Outside Taichu City.
Yang Fan and Tang Yue returned together.
Arriving at the courtyard entrance, Tang Yue looked at Yang Fan with a slightly odd expression.
She hesitated for a moment, but still did not say anything unnecessary.
“Your Highness, I will head back first.”
Yang Fan nodded.
Tang Yue turned and left, but could not help a flurry of complicated thoughts welling up in her heart.
One month, a full month.
How precious time in Taichu City was, every single minute and second was enough to widen the gap between Geniuses.
Yet Yang Fan had stubbornly stayed in the Vacation Planet hotel for a full month.
Tang Yue could not stand it anymore; this was not relaxing, it was clearly... indulging in pleasure.
God-Kingdom development, Formation insights, resource trading, and exchanges with Geniuses from all sides—things that should have been prioritized, Yang Fan had not done any of them.
Tang Yue had even hinted at it a few times indirectly, but Yang Fan just smiled and never took the bait.
As time went on, she stopped talking much about it.
After all, Yang Fan was not her junior, and the path of God-Kingdom development mainly relied on oneself.
This Your Highness was different from all the Geniuses she had ever seen.
After returning to the courtyard, as soon as Yang Fan sat down, the prompt from Yang Yi sounded in his mind.
“Application for purchase: One hundred immortal nurturing towers, fifty Spiritual Veins.”
Yang Fan glanced at it, his expression as usual.
“Application approved.”
He had long grown accustomed to applications of this level.
Almost every few days, similar prompts would appear, and his handling method remained the same as always—approve all of them.
Under the blessing of Evolution Talent, he did not need to delve into those complex and unorthodox paths; he just needed to let Yang Yi invest in the God-Kingdom in the most orthodox and secure way.
After all, his investment returns were amplified by a hundred times to begin with.
The investment in believers thus became extremely simple—
As long as it was good, use it.
As long as it was expensive, equip it.
Nowadays, the biggest expenses within the God-Kingdom were mainly concentrated on Medicinal Pills.

Most of these Medicinal Pills came from high-order Cultivation God-Kingdoms, including Taixuan Nourishing Spirit Pills, Nine-Turn Body Tempering Pills, Xuanyuan Qi Condensation Pills, Purple Mansion Meridian-Opening Pills, True Spirit Guiyuan Pills...
The grades of these Medicinal Pills were not low, so their prices were naturally staggering.
For this reason, Yang Fan specially made a statistical analysis once.
Calculated by real-time, in just one month, his consumption on Medicinal Pills was close to sixty million Divinity Points.

The reason it was so expensive was because under Evolution Talent, this actually corresponded to the total resource consumption of the believers within the God-Kingdom for a full three thousand years.
Because resources were far too abundant, when distributing them, Yang Yi did not even bother to distinguish between Genius Ranks anymore.
All believers were uniformly given maximum rations.
Spirit Stones were unlimited, spiritual grain was unlimited, Dragon meat was provided as standard supply, and Medicinal Pills were likewise distributed according to demand.
If not for considering the limits that the Physical Body could bear, those Mortal-level believers could even swallow high-tier Medicinal Pills infinitely.
It could be said that the living standards of the believers in the God-Kingdom now far exceeded the vast majority of Divine Beings in reality, and even quite a few demigods found it hard to match.
And even so, the God-Kingdom expenditures were still less than half of its total income.
The reason was also very simple.
First, he earned enough.
Second, the current overall strength of the believers was still not strong enough.
The higher the strength of the believers, the more terrifying the consumption of resources.
As the strength of the believers improved, resource expenditures would also increase geometrically.
Perhaps one day, income and expenses would gradually tend towards a balance.
By that time, what Yang Fan needed to consider would no longer be “how to spend money like crazy”, but rather continuing to expand more God-Kingdom assets.
Just as Yang Fan finished processing the previous application, the voice of Yang Yi sounded in his mind again.
“Application for expansion: Martial Arts system construction.”
“Application content: Wonder Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena, quantity increased to fifty.”
“Application approved.”
The voice of Yang Yi continued to sound.
“Application for purchase: B-grade building prison-suppressing body-refining tower (similar to an immortal nurturing tower building), priced at 1000 Divinity Points.”

“Through the superposition of gravitational fields and Spiritual Pressure, continuously temper the Physical Body, enhance tendon and bone strength as well as Qi and blood upper limits, while also possessing martial enlightenment auxiliary effects.”
“Application quantity: Twenty.”
“Application approved.”
After a moment, another prompt sounded.
“Application for building: Wonder building myriad manifestation battle stele, priced at ten thousand Divinity Points.”

“Gathering Battle Intent and Martial Dao traces for believers to comprehend Martial Skills and Cultivation Techniques, it can enhance practical combat comprehension ability, and strengthen the fit between the Physical Body and willpower.”
“Application quantity: One.”
“Application approved.”
A series of resource mobilizations were all completed in an instant.
For Yang Fan, as long as it was an investment used for the growth of believers, there was almost nowhere that needed weighting.
Since funds were sufficient, the only correct choice was to transform them into strength.
If resources were just piled up there, they were completely meaningless in themselves.
Only by being consumed and transformed could they truly generate value.
Otherwise, no matter how much wealth there was, it was nothing more than a pile of burdens that no one could guard.
After all, wealth was never the source of power.
It was merely a byproduct permitted to exist by power.
Another month passed.
On this day, Yang Fan received a message from Luo Chengfeng.
“Come to the Virtual World once, coordinates ”
Yang Fan put on his helmet, his consciousness connected, and the next instant he appeared in a single hospital ward.

Luo Chengfeng stood to the side, his expression carrying a rare gentleness; Luo Rou lay on the hospital bed, her complexion slightly weak, but unable to hide the tenderness between her eyebrows and eyes; Yang Tiexin and Sun Rong were also by the side, joy that could not be suppressed on their faces.
And by the bedside, an infant was lying quietly.
Yang Fan was slightly stunned, “Born?”
Luo Chengfeng chuckled: “Born not long ago, we were just waiting for you.”
The gaze of Yang Fan landed on Luo Rou, his tone slowing down a bit, “You have worked hard.”
“Then you have to compensate me.” Luo Rou said softly.
“How to compensate?”
Luo Rou raised her chin slightly, gesturing to the child by the bedside, “You come up with the name.”
“And—” She paused for a moment, her tone turning a bit more serious: “Take your last name.”
“Take my last name?” Yang Fan was slightly dazed.
According to the original contract, this child should have taken the Luo last name.
“This is the meaning of Grandfather.” Luo Rou said.

Luo Chengfeng nodded, “Whose last name the child takes is a minor matter, once he Awakens his God-Kingdom, regardless of his Talent, he will enjoy First-Class Genius treatment from the Luo Family, you do not need to overthink it.”

Upon hearing this, Yang Fan naturally understood in his heart that the Luo Family had even considered such details, unwilling to let him have a trace of the feeling of being a “kept man”, so as to avoid any lingering resentment in his heart.
Luo Chengfeng glanced at the two of them, suddenly smiling and saying: “Alright, us old folks will not disturb you two anymore, we are taking the child outside.”
Sun Rong and Yang Tiexin also smiled and chimed in: “You young couple chat.”
The three of them quickly exited the Virtual World.
Inside the ward, only Yang Fan and Luo Rou were left.
Luo Rou smiled and said: “Come on, pick a name.”
“This... I am not very good at it.” Yang Fan dry-coughed.
Luo Rou raised an eyebrow: “Give it a try.”
Yang Fan thought seriously for two seconds, “Then... call him Yang San?”
The air instantly quieted down.
Luo Rou stared at him for a glance, then unceremoniously rolled her eyes.
“Are you serious?”
Yang Fan remained expressionless: “Simple, easy to remember.”
Luo Rou could not help laughing out loud, then shook her head, “Forget it, I will do it instead.”
She lowered her head to glance at the child, her gaze softening down, “Let us call him—Yang Chengrou.”
“What do you think?”
“Sure.” Yang Fan nodded and said.
All the details inside the ward were extremely realistic, with almost no difference from reality.
After Yang Fan reached out to tease the child, he placed him back by the bedside.
“You get some good rest.”
Luo Rou suddenly spoke up: “Husband, those forty thousand Divinity Points you gave me before were too many, I only used two thousand.”
“Now the God-Kingdom is recovering very quickly, within a year, it should be able to return to the level it was at during university.”
“I heard that consumption in Taichu City is very high, can you use these resources right now? I can transfer the rest back to you.”

After hearing this, Yang Fan smiled and gently rubbed the head of Luo Rou, “No need, you need to Breakthrough to a demigod as soon as possible. Afterward, think of a way to charge towards becoming a deity, you still have to accompany me for a lifetime in the future.”
Luo Rou was slightly stunned, her gaze unconsciously softening down.
“Alright.”

Luo Chengfeng glanced at the two of them, suddenly smiling and saying: “Alright, us old folks will not disturb you two anymore, we are taking the child outside.”
Sun Rong and Yang Tiexin also smiled and chimed in: “You young couple chat.”
The three of them quickly exited the Virtual World.
Inside the ward, only Yang Fan and Luo Rou were left.
Luo Rou smiled and said: “Come on, pick a name.”
“This...
I am not very good at it.” Yang Fan dry-coughed.
Luo Rou raised an eyebrow: “Give it a try.”
Yang Fan thought seriously for two seconds, “Then... call him Yang San?”
The air instantly quieted down.
Luo Rou stared at him for a glance, then unceremoniously rolled her eyes.
“Are you serious?”
Yang Fan remained expressionless: “Simple, easy to remember.”
Luo Rou could not help laughing out loud, then shook her head, “Forget it, I will do it instead.”
She lowered her head to glance at the child, her gaze softening down, “Let us call him—Yang Chengrou.”
“What do you think?”
“Sure.” Yang Fan nodded and said.
All the details inside the ward were extremely realistic, with almost no difference from reality.
After Yang Fan reached out to tease the child, he placed him back by the bedside.
“You get some good rest.”
Luo Rou suddenly spoke up: “Husband, those forty thousand Divinity Points you gave me before were too many, I only used two thousand.”
“Now the God-Kingdom is recovering very quickly, within a year, it should be able to return to the level it was at during university.”
“I heard that consumption in Taichu City is very high, can you use these resources right now?
I can transfer the rest back to you.”
After hearing this, Yang Fan smiled and gently rubbed the head of Luo Rou, “No need, you need to Breakthrough to a demigod as soon as possible.
Afterward, think of a way to charge towards becoming a deity, you still have to accompany me for a lifetime in the future.”
Luo Rou was slightly stunned, her gaze unconsciously softening down.
“Alright.”

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Foundation Establishment Believers, Gathering
paragraphs: Yang Fan exited the Virtual World.
The instant his consciousness returned to reality, his expression suddenly changed.
The Divine Kingdom — — had undergone a change.
The next moment, he clearly felt a surge of power gushing from within his body, as if a certain Bottleneck had been broken through once again.
” Foundation Establishment Realm believers! ” Yang Fan’s face revealed a look of excitement.
It is a double blessing today!
A Foundation Establishment Realm believer was born within the Divine Kingdom.
This change directly drove an overall tier leap.
Yang Fan could clearly perceive that his overall strength had become at least twenty percent stronger.
Without hesitation, Yang Fan’s consciousness directly entered the Divine Kingdom.
” Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (1), Qi Refining Realm (200,000), Martial Disciple Realm (30,000), Tier 5 Being (120 million), Tier 4 Beings (180 million), Tier 3 Beings (380 million), Tier 2 Beings (500 million), Tier 1 Beings (1.5 billion), Mortal (1.5 billion)
Occupation: Alchemist (20,000) (Capable of refining Qi Gathering Pills, Blood Essence Pills, Bone Strengthening Pills...)
Dependent: Adult Elf (660,000)
Technique: Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 230 million (Reality provides 0.53 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Spiritual Vein X500 (A-grade), Alchemy Tower X50 (B-grade), hundred herb spirit pivot academy X20 (B-grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower X20 (B-grade), immortal nurturing tower X500 (B-grade)...

Wonders: Penglai Island X1000 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain X5000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion X10000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena X50 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele X1
Assets: Dragon Fish fry (100 million)... “
Ever since absorbing the Divine Kingdom Core last time, Yang Fan had not continued to increase investments in the Divine Kingdom.
Today’s Divine Kingdom no longer needed to rely on simply stacking resources to boost yields. More importantly, it was about improving the overall quality.
Spiritual Qi density, Cultivate environment, combat system, believer structure — — improving the Cultivate speed of believers through these was the most important thing.
After several months of accumulation, the overall combat power of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom believers had increased by five to six times.
With the appearance of Foundation Establishment Realm believers, the strength of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation had ascended to yet another level.
His gaze swept across the entire Divine Kingdom as he muttered to himself, ” Perhaps... I can go to the Primordial Battlefield and give it a try. “
Consciousness returned to reality.
Just as Yang Fan was preparing to enter the Virtual World, his wristwatch suddenly lit up.
A group message popped up.
Sima Bang: ” Brothers, I’ve broken through to Demigod! Yuexiang Pavilion, drinks are on me! “
Ye Jianfeng: ” Congratulations. “
Wen Yushui: ” Congratulations, I’ll be right there. “
Yang Fan glanced at it and similarly replied, ” Congratulations, I’ll head over right now. “
The Primordial Battlefield could be entered at any time, but Young Master Sima’s gathering was not easy to refuse.
Yuexiang Pavilion.
Inside the private room, the three of them had already arrived a step earlier.
Sima Bang sat in the master seat, looking spirited, his brows full of unconcealable complacency.
Ye Jianfeng sat to the side with a calm expression, wearing his usual polite smile.
Wen Yushui sat slightly further back, her posture noticeably lower, her gaze occasionally glancing toward the door with a hint of loneliness in her eyes.
The door was pushed open, and Yang Fan walked in.
Almost the instant he stepped in, Ye Jianfeng’s expression paused.
Ye Jianfeng’s gaze locked onto Yang Fan, his pupils slightly contracting, ” You... “
Before he could even speak, Sima Bang had already stood up.
” Holy crap, Brother Yang! You’ve also broken through to Demigod? When did this happen? Why didn’t you say so earlier? “
Wen Yushui was likewise stunned, and the look she gave Yang Fan noticeably changed.
Unlike the Virtual World, the aura of a Demigod powerhouse simply could not be concealed.
” I just broke through not long ago, ” Yang Fan said modestly.

Although the few present didn’t live far apart, they usually concentrated on developing their Divine Kingdoms, communicating mostly through the Virtual World when things arose, and rarely met in reality.
Wen Yushui lowered her head, her gaze complex.
Even Yang Fan, someone with an ordinary family background, had broken through, yet she... hadn’t even touched the threshold of a Demigod.

In Tiannan City, Wen Yushui was the apple of the Wen family’s eye, an S-rank Genius whom everyone envied. But after coming to the Primordial Academy, in less than a year, she had already felt tremendous peer pressure.

Back on the high stage, surrounded by stars, her Talent was her halo; but when stepping into a higher world, she finally understood that so-called Geniuses were merely Mortals being remeasured in a different place.
The true gap did not lie in how high one once stood, but whether, after the halo faded, one was still strong enough to support oneself.
Sima Bang said eagerly, ” Come, come, come, sit down quickly! “
Being able to break through to Demigod as a freshman meant his potential could rank near the top among Human Race Prodigies, and Yang Fan’s status in his heart had also risen considerably.
Yang Fan took a seat further inside.
Ye Jianfeng slowly spoke at this moment, ” Brother Yang, your strength... did you really just break through? “

As the earliest among the four to break through to Demigod, his progress over these past few months had been equally immense, coupled with his S-rank Talent ” Myriad Sword Physique “, his perception far exceeded that of ordinary Demigods.
Exactly because of this, Ye Jianfeng felt something was amiss.
Yang Fan’s faint aura was simply too strong, even unreasonably strong, faintly giving him a sense of oppression.
This feeling even made Ye Jianfeng somewhat doubt whether his own judgment was wrong.
Yang Fan was slightly startled; he hadn’t expected Ye Jianfeng’s Mental Energy to be so strong!

The Demigod Realm could not be concealed, but Yang Fan combined Cultivation with Martial Arts, coupled with the Major Achievement stage of the Indestructible Golden Body Technique, which allowed him to control himself to the ultimate degree.
Under normal circumstances, ordinary Demigods shouldn’t be able to see through his depth.
” Just a bit lucky, ” Yang Fan merely smiled and didn’t answer directly.
Ye Jianfeng’s eyes showed some hesitation, but he didn’t continue probing.
Inside the private room, the atmosphere quickly became lively.
Sima Bang raised his wine glass and smiled, ” Right, Brother Ye, what is your current score in the Primordial Battlefield? “
” Over 1.9 millionth place. “

” You broke 2 million so fast? Awesome, ” Sima Bang gave a thumbs-up and said, ” I’m only over 2.0 millionth place. I take the Martial Route, so my believers’ Physical Bodies can take the beating, allowing me to last a bit longer. But when all is said and done, I’m still at the bottom. “
” For a first-time participant, this score is already pretty good. “
Afterwards, Ye Jianfeng turned his gaze to Yang Fan, ” What about Brother Yang? “
” Haven’t gone yet, ” Yang Fan stated bluntly.
The air fell slightly silent.
” Haven’t gone yet? ” Sima Bang was stunned, then slapped the table, ” How do you manage to hold back! Go and try it right now, it’s only a matter of a few minutes anyway. “
As he spoke, he directly raised his hand and called out, ” Bring a virtual helmet! “
Before long, a staff member brought one over.
Seeing this, Yang Fan found it hard to decline further, so he took the helmet and put it on.
Consciousness connected.
The outline of Taichu City rapidly unfolded before his eyes.
Familiar spatial coordinates locked on.
The next moment, Yang Fan appeared in the Primordial Battlefield zone.
A cold, Mechanical voice sounded:
” Identity detected — — Freshman student, Yang Fan. Do you wish to connect to the Divine Kingdom and materialize believers? “
” Yes, ” Yang Fan nodded.
” Connection complete. “

chapters.title: Chapter 132: School Ranking: 890,000
paragraphs: The next instant, space trembled, and a massive Aura suddenly appeared on the Primordial Battlefield.
Foundation Establishment Realm: one person; Qi Refining Stage: 200,000; Martial Apprentice Realm: 30,000; all remaining believers were Tier 5 Beings.
Boom——
The moment these believers descended simultaneously, a powerful sense of oppression permeated the entire Primordial Battlefield.
Compared to their first entry, the believers’ strength had improved by N tiers.
Mid-air, Yang Er’s consciousness slowly emerged, looking down at the entire scene.
“Deploy the Ten Kings of Hell Formation!”
An order was given.
Almost at the same time, all the believers moved.
The Qi Refining Stage believers quickly occupied the outer main Formation positions. The Martial Apprentice Realm believers filled in to stabilize the Formation.
The Tier 5 Beings served as the basic Formation foundations, densely spreading out.
As for the sole Foundation Establishment Realm powerhouse, he took a step forward and landed directly at the core eye of the Formation.
The Ten Kings of Hell Formation activated.
A C-rank Array at the Great Success stage displayed might that long ago far surpassed the combat power of these tens of millions of believers themselves.
Formation patterns emerged from the ground, intertwined with black and red, resembling the convergence of blood and Evil Qi.

From inside out, layer upon layer stacked. The Auras of the tens of millions of believers were inherently chaotic and complex. Yet at this moment, it was as if they were grasped by an invisible giant hand.
Condense. Suppress. Gather.
A monstrous Evil Qi soared into the sky, and between heaven and earth, an illusory figure seemed to appear.
That was a blurry and huge figure wearing an imperial crown with hanging beads. Its face was invisible, and merely its outline appearing carried endless pressure.
It was like an adjudicator from the netherworld—the shadow of Yanluo.
It stood above the Formation, overlooking the battlefield.
Countless Auras gathered beneath its feet, as if the entire military Formation had become an extension of it.
Yang Fan stood in mid-air, his gaze falling upon the grand Formation below, and he muttered softly: “The Ten Kings of Hell Formation truly lives up to being a C-rank Array, so strong.”
“I just don’t know how long it can last!” Some interest grew in Yang Fan’s eyes.
The battlefield trembled.
The first wave of alien beings appeared.
Apes, wolf demons, tiger beasts, lion prides... densely packed, surging from all directions like a flood.
With almost no pause, they directly crashed into the grand Formation.
But before truly contacting the grand Formation, a terrifying wave of Qi erupted from within the array, pushing outward horizontally like an invisible giant wall.
The Tier 1 and Tier 2 beings of the first wave didn’t even touch the edge of the Formation before being collectively blown away.
Flesh and blood filled the air, instantly cleared out.
The second wave followed closely behind, mostly Tier 3 and Tier 4 beings already, and their numbers even skyrocketed to fifty million.
Auras churned, covering the sky and earth.
“Yanluo suppresses and kills.” Yang Er’s voice rang out in mid-air.

The Formation shook, and the black and red Qi suddenly pressed down, resembling the overturning of heaven and earth. Large swathes of alien beings were directly crushed into pieces, making it difficult even to leave behind complete corpses.
The entire battlefield seemed to be slaughtered by a giant hand, neat and decisive.
The third and fourth waves descended consecutively, their numbers continuously stacking, and the entire Primordial Battlefield gradually became stained red with blood.
However, the Ten Kings of Hell Formation operated stably, and its Aura even grew stronger the more it accumulated.
Qi Refining Stage alien beings finally appeared, thousands of Auras erupting simultaneously, their momentum soaring abruptly.
Yang Er quickly gave the order: “Ten Halls Open the Gates, Blood Prison Guides the Slaughter.”
The array rings rotated, and the inner and outer Auras connected instantly, a more condensed killing intent erupting from within the array.
The moment the Qi Refining Stage alien beings touched the edge of the Formation, streams of black and red blades slashed out from within the array.
“Yanluo Slashes the Soul.”
“Hell Overwhelms.”
“Yellow Springs Draws Down.”
Three instructions were issued one after another, and the killing intent of the Formation stacked layer upon layer.
Thousands of Qi Refining Stage alien beings didn’t even have the chance to truly break through the Formation before being rapidly beheaded and annihilated.
Twenty breaths, thirty breaths.
Time ticked by bit by bit, Yang Fan’s expression gradually turning serious: “A quarter of an hour has passed...”
Yang Fan didn’t expect that his current self could actually last this long.
When he first participated in the Primordial Battlefield, his believers hadn’t even lasted ten breaths.
The battlefield trembled again, and ten alien figures descended simultaneously—Foundation Establishment Realm.
Not only that, but the total number of the alien army had already broken through two hundred million, and among them, the existences at the Qi Refining Stage exceeded ten million.
Solely speaking of hard strength, the alien army had completely crushed Yang Fan’s believers.
However, that illusory figure of Yanluo above the sky became increasingly solid.
The imperial crown with hanging beads hung low, its Aura grim and desolate, as if a true judgment had descended.
Yang Er’s voice began to grow urgent: “Adjust the array positions!”
“Activate—Ten Halls Combined Slaughter!”
The Formation shook violently, and the entire space seemed to be squeezed downwards, large swathes of alien beings being directly crushed.
But with the joining of alien beings at the Foundation Establishment Realm, gaps appeared in the grand Formation.
“The flank gap is expanding!”
“Position filling failed!”
“Reallocate nodes—”
Yang Er’s instructions began to show slight disorder.
Facing the enemy forces pouring in simultaneously from all directions, the demand for computing power skyrocketed, and he began to struggle to keep up with the rhythm.
“Activate—Myriad Ghosts Devour Spirits! Ten Halls Combined Slaughter! Blood Prison Guides Slaughter! Yanluo Slashes the Soul!”
The Formation continuously erupted with lethal moves, but the loopholes were also expanding bit by bit.
Yang Fan saw this in his eyes without making a sound.
He knew very well that if he were to replace him for this level of battlefield command, it would only be even more chaotic.
Yang Er had already done very well; it was simply not his strong suit.
The core ability of an exploratory high-level Intelligent Life was resource collection, not battlefield command.
Time continued to move forward, one and a half quarters of an hour.
Finally——the Formation foundations fractured.
The Ten Kings of Hell Formation completely collapsed under continuous high-intensity operation.
The moment that huge illusory figure of Yanluo shattered, countless alien beings frantically poured in like a breached flood, beginning to slaughter his believers.
“This assessment has ended: Student: Yang Fan, Identity: Demigod, Divine Kingdom Talent: Tenfold Time Sequence, School Ranking: 890,000”
The intelligent prompt tone suddenly paused for an instant, as if forcibly interrupted by something.
Immediately following, an entirely different voice sounded.
No longer a cold Mechanical synthesis, but an aged voice carrying real emotions.
“An S-rank Talent, a freshman with Tenfold Time Sequence actually broke into the top one million of the whole school. Development speed is not bad, congratulations!”
The voice was not loud, yet it seemed to fall directly into the depths of consciousness.
Yang Fan’s entire body trembled slightly, his mind tightening.
This was definitely not Intelligent Life, but a powerful deity.
This was the Primordial Battlefield, yet the other party could directly take over the authority of this place; obviously they were not an ordinary deity, at least a higher-up of Primordial Academy.
Yang Fan did not dare to neglect, cupping his fists and bowing toward the void: “Junior Yang Fan greets Senior.”
The surroundings were empty, and he couldn’t see a figure, yet he could clearly feel that a gaze was watching him.
“My surname is Gu, and my given name is Yuan, and I am a board member of Primordial Academy. You can address me as—Senior Gu Yuan.”
“Greetings, Senior Gu Yuan.” Yang Fan’s expression turned solemn.
Senior Gu Yuan chuckled lightly, “According to the rules, for entering the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield, the rewards are distributed by Intelligent Life. I would not show myself.”
“However, you brat... are a bit special.”
“An S-rank Talent with Tenfold Time Sequence actually has this kind of development speed. Over on the Intelligent Life side, you have already been labeled as a ‘Potential Peerless Prodigy’.”

Yang Fan didn’t expect that his current self could actually last this long.
When he first participated in the Primordial Battlefield, his believers hadn’t even lasted ten breaths.
The battlefield trembled again, and ten alien figures descended simultaneously—Foundation Establishment Realm.
Not only that, but the total number of the alien army had already broken through two hundred million, and among them, the existences at the Qi Refining Stage exceeded ten million.
Solely speaking of hard strength, the alien army had completely crushed Yang Fan’s believers.
However, that illusory figure of Yanluo above the sky became increasingly solid.
The imperial crown with hanging beads hung low, its Aura grim and desolate, as if a true judgment had descended.
Yang Er’s voice began to grow urgent: “Adjust the array positions!”
“Activate—Ten Halls Combined Slaughter!”
The Formation shook violently, and the entire space seemed to be squeezed downwards, large swathes of alien beings being directly crushed.
But with the joining of alien beings at the Foundation Establishment Realm, gaps appeared in the grand Formation.
“The flank gap is expanding!”
“Position filling failed!”
“Reallocate nodes—”
Yang Er’s instructions began to show slight disorder.
Facing the enemy forces pouring in simultaneously from all directions, the demand for computing power skyrocketed, and he began to struggle to keep up with the rhythm.
“Activate—Myriad Ghosts Devour Spirits!
Ten Halls Combined Slaughter!
Blood Prison Guides Slaughter!
Yanluo Slashes the Soul!”
The Formation continuously erupted with lethal moves, but the loopholes were also expanding bit by bit.
Yang Fan saw this in his eyes without making a sound.
He knew very well that if he were to replace him for this level of battlefield command, it would only be even more chaotic.
Yang Er had already done very well; it was simply not his strong suit.
The core ability of an exploratory high-level Intelligent Life was resource collection, not battlefield command.
Time continued to move forward, one and a half quarters of an hour.
Finally——the Formation foundations fractured.
The Ten Kings of Hell Formation completely collapsed under continuous high-intensity operation.
The moment that huge illusory figure of Yanluo shattered, countless alien beings frantically poured in like a breached flood, beginning to slaughter his believers.
“This assessment has ended: Student: Yang Fan, Identity: Demigod, Divine Kingdom Talent: Tenfold Time Sequence, School Ranking: 890,000”
The intelligent prompt tone suddenly paused for an instant, as if forcibly interrupted by something.
Immediately following, an entirely different voice sounded.
No longer a cold Mechanical synthesis, but an aged voice carrying real emotions.
“An S-rank Talent, a freshman with Tenfold Time Sequence actually broke into the top one million of the whole school.
Development speed is not bad, congratulations!”
The voice was not loud, yet it seemed to fall directly into the depths of consciousness.
Yang Fan’s entire body trembled slightly, his mind tightening.
This was definitely not Intelligent Life, but a powerful deity.
This was the Primordial Battlefield, yet the other party could directly take over the authority of this place; obviously they were not an ordinary deity, at least a higher-up of Primordial Academy.
Yang Fan did not dare to neglect, cupping his fists and bowing toward the void: “Junior Yang Fan greets Senior.”
The surroundings were empty, and he couldn’t see a figure, yet he could clearly feel that a gaze was watching him.
“My surname is Gu, and my given name is Yuan, and I am a board member of Primordial Academy.
You can address me as—Senior Gu Yuan.”
“Greetings, Senior Gu Yuan.” Yang Fan’s expression turned solemn.
Senior Gu Yuan chuckled lightly, “According to the rules, for entering the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield, the rewards are distributed by Intelligent Life.
I would not show myself.”
“However, you brat... are a bit special.”
“An S-rank Talent with Tenfold Time Sequence actually has this kind of development speed.
Over on the Intelligent Life side, you have already been labeled as a ‘Potential Peerless Prodigy’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 133: S-Rank Building divine weapon world-forging platform
paragraphs: Yang Fan did not reply, only listening quietly.
Senior Gu Yuan continued, “However, your performance just now was not due to a powerful combat-type S-rank Talent, but rather relied on a C-rank Array at the Great Success stage.”
“Your Comprehension Ability is indeed good, but if you rely solely on this to get the evaluation of a ‘Peerless Prodigy’, it is not enough.”
His tone was calm, without any belittling, as if he were simply stating a fact.
“Since I have already stepped forward, the rewards still need to be mentioned,” Senior Gu Yuan said in a calm voice.
“I give you three choices:
First, ten million Divinity Points.
Second, I will select an S-Rank Building of the resource type for you.
Third, join the Gu Family.”

Without waiting for Yang Fan to reply, Senior Gu Yuan continued to add, “As long as you join the Gu Family, I will directly reward you with a Yellow-grade Secret Realm for your independent use. Furthermore, I will grant you a hundred-year usage right of a Spirit Vein Planet.”
In addition, for subsequent resource investment, Cultivate support, and battlefield protection, you will enjoy the same treatment as the Prodigy of the Gu Family.

When Senior Gu Yuan said this, a hint of confidence appeared in his tone, “By joining the Gu Family, the resources you can obtain will be a hundred or even a thousand times that of the first two options.”
“The conditions differ so much; it seems this Senior thinks very highly of me, what a pity.” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
Different from Yang County, Yang Fan now had starting capital and did not want to be bound by a large Family.
Senior Gu Yuan certainly did not know Yang Fan’s thoughts; in his view, Yang Fan had no reason to refuse him.

Possessing an S-rank Talent like Tenfold Time Sequence that burned resources extremely fast, as long as he was not a foolish person, he should know how to choose. After all, this was an invitation from the Gu Clan, one of the Five Great Giants.
Moreover, given the potential Yang Fan was currently displaying, within four years of university, he indeed had a chance to impact a “Peerless Prodigy”.
Precisely because of this, Senior Gu Yuan would offer such investment conditions.
Yang Fan said in a serious tone, “I choose the second one, an S-Rank Building of the resource type.”
In the Void Realm, a trace of imperceptible surprise appeared in Senior Gu Yuan’s voice, “Oh? Can you tell me why?”
“This Junior temporarily has no plans to join any large Family, and does not quite like being restricted.” Yang Fan’s answer was very direct, without beating around the bush.
Senior Gu Yuan was silent for a moment, then chuckled lightly, “Understandable, young people always have their own thoughts.”
“However, if you have any intentions in the future, you can contact the people of the Gu Family at any time.”
“With your Talent, you need a large amount of basic resources to support you. In this regard, the Gu Family is very suitable for you.”
The other party’s tone remained gentle, but he did not persuade him further.
At this moment, Senior Gu Yuan also made a judgment in his heart.
Born in a remote place with limited knowledge, he would make this nearly “willful” decision in front of the choices given to him.
In this era, which top Prodigy did not rely on a large Family? Without resources, no matter how strong the Talent, it was just empty talk.
Four years of university time were enough for Yang Fan to clearly realize this point.
When he saw his friends’ divine kingdoms expanding rapidly under resource blessings while he gradually struggled, he would naturally understand what he had missed today.
The so-called choice was sometimes just confidence limited by one’s vision.
The investment contract for a Human Race Prodigy did not require Senior Gu Yuan to step forward. If it were anyone else from the Gu Family, they could not give Yang Fan such conditions.
In Senior Gu Yuan’s view, Yang Fan had missed a great Opportunity this time.
Opportunity never only depended on whether it appeared.
It depended even more on whether a person had the ability to recognize it and hold onto it.
Strength, Luck, and vision were all indispensable.
Senior Gu Yuan did not say much more, “Since that is the case, this S-Rank Building is yours.”
“S-Rank Building divine weapon world-forging platform.” A piece of information was transmitted into Yang Fan’s consciousness.
Afterward, Senior Gu Yuan’s tone shifted slightly, “Since I have come, let me give you a small suggestion.”
“Your performance in the Primordial Battlefield just now—your command was too poor.”
“Your Intelligent Life is not good at large-scale combat dispatching. You should have noticed this as well.”
“Being able to comprehend a C-rank Array to the Great Success stage, your Comprehension Ability can be considered top-notch in the history of the Primordial Academy.”
“In future tests of the Primordial Battlefield, you can try commanding yourself. Your results might improve further.”
In Senior Gu Yuan’s view, being able to persist for so long in the battle just now entirely relied on the blessing of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation.
Setting aside the Formation, the overall strength of Yang Fan’s believers could only be considered mediocre. If commanded properly, the results should have been able to improve quite a bit.

Of course, Senior Gu Yuan did not know that this Formation was not “comprehended” by Yang Fan in the first place. If Yang Fan were truly allowed to command personally, the result would only be worse, even inferior to letting the believers perform on their own.

“No matter how strong your Comprehension Ability is, it is only an advantage in the early stage. With the development of the divine kingdom, the believers will eventually comprehend the essence of the Formation, do not become complacent.”

“In future participation in Divine Kingdom War, as gods, it is impossible for us to command personally all the time. It is recommended to be equipped with a combat-type advanced Intelligent Life. This is the core of large-scale warfare.”
Yang Fan nodded, cupping his hands in salute, “Thank you for your guidance, Elder Gu.”
Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to reality, and he slowly took off the helmet.
As soon as he raised his head, Sima Bang had already crowded over, opening his wrist watch to start checking.
“Why did it take so long?” Sima Bang muttered while operating, “Brother Yang, could you be deliberately dragging out time, wanting to stage an effect of me having great results? I want to see—”
Before he finished speaking, his voice abruptly stopped. His whole body froze in place.
Sima Bang subconsciously rubbed his eyes, then lowered his head to stare fixedly at the wrist watch, his fingers even sliding across the screen with some force.
“No... did I read it wrong?”
He suddenly raised his head, lowered it again, and looked a second time.
The expression on Sima Bang’s face had completely changed.
Shock, bewilderment, and even a trace of doubting life itself.
“Take a look, you guys!” His voice even became slightly distorted, “Am I seeing things?”
Ye Jianfeng and Wen Yushui had also noticed something was wrong, and simultaneously opened their wrist watches to check.
A few seconds later.
No one spoke, and the private room was frighteningly quiet. It was as if even the sound of breathing was suppressed.
“I didn’t read it wrong, did I?” Sima Bang stared at the screen, then looked at the two of them, his voice tight.
Ye Jianfeng did not answer.
Wen Yushui also did not make a sound.
The answer was already written in their respective expressions.
The next moment——
“Bang!”
Sima Bang slammed his hand hard on the table, causing the entire table top to vibrate, and the dishes on top were directly shaken into the air.
He saw his whole body stand up, his eyes full of irrepressible excitement, “Brother Yang——no!”
He grabbed Yang Fan’s shoulder, his tone almost shouting out.
“Old Yang! You are too fierce! Directly entering the top one million, how on earth did you do it?”
At this moment, Sima Bang had not a shred of composure of a great Family’s descendant left, and he was so excited as if he had discovered something incredible.
The tone of his speech also unconsciously shortened the distance between him and Yang Fan.

There was no longer the arrogance of the eldest young master of the Sima Family from before, nor the courtesy between peers, but rather with obvious closeness and importance. There was even a faint sense of treating Yang Fan as “one of us”.

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Rules of Divine Kingdom War
paragraphs: Ye Jianfeng stood to the side, looking at Yang Fan with a solemn gaze.
Wen Yushui lowered her head, her expression complex and filled with a sense of loss.
Ye Jianfeng spoke, “Brother Yang, you truly hide your depth well.”
At this moment, his gaze fell on Yang Fan, but ripples were already stirring in his heart.
That vague feeling from before was indeed correct; Yang Fan’s strength even exceeded his expectations.
Barely halfway through the first semester of freshman year, he had already broken into the top one million of the Primordial Battlefield. This speed far surpassed both him and Sima Bang.

At their level, they were already considered at the forefront among the Human Race Prodigy, but Yang Fan’s potential was even higher, and if he took another step forward, he might even be rated as a Peerless Prodigy.
Thinking of this, Ye Jianfeng restrained the bit of Genius-born self-confidence in his heart.
He stood up, raised his cup, and said, “Congratulations, Brother Yang.”
Seeing this, Sima Bang immediately stood up with a smile, “Right, right, right, congratulations! But don’t be so polite, we’re all brothers.”
As he spoke, he directly handed another cup of wine into Yang Fan’s hand. “Come, let’s drink together.”
The three of them clinked glasses and drained them in one gulp, and the atmosphere finally warmed up completely.
However, Wen Yushui, who was sitting to the side, appeared somewhat awkward, keeping her head down without speaking.
In the Primordial Academy, potential almost equaled status.
Among the three of them now, she had clearly fallen behind a step.
A few months ago, she was still everyone’s “Little Sister Wen,” but now a rift had already formed.
The reality of Taichu City was always more direct and colder than the outside world.
Returning to his seat, holding his dinner plate, Sima Bang began to plan for the future while eating.
“The three of us are already demigods now. Let’s pull in a few more reliable brothers, and then we’ll go fight a Divine Kingdom War together!”
Hearing the four words “Divine Kingdom War,” Yang Fan’s eyes instantly lit up.
“Divine Kingdom War?” Yang Fan leaned forward slightly. “Is it the school’s Alien Divine Kingdom Zone?”
“What are you thinking!” Sima Bang almost choked and quickly waved his hand. “Is that a place the current us can touch?”

“Those Alien Demigods kept in captivity by the Primordial Academy are more outrageous than the last, and to cultivate powerhouses, the rule is one-on-one combat—don’t even think about cooperating with classmates. Only seniors in their third and fourth years have the courage to participate.”
“Us going right now? That’s courting death.”
The air paused slightly. Yang Fan nodded, feeling secretly relieved in his heart.
He hadn’t expected the Alien Demigods kept by the school to be strong to this extent. Fortunately, he had been smart before and stayed low to develop for a wave.
“Then what Divine Kingdom War were you talking about?” Yang Fan continued to pursue the question.
This time, before Sima Bang had time to speak, Ye Jianfeng beside him had already taken over the conversation.
“The coordinates of Alien Divine Kingdom mainly come from two channels.”
“First, the military. As long as you enlist, the Virtual World can connect to the Human Federation’s military merit System, which records a massive amount of Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.”

“The military has been fighting year-round, so their information is the most comprehensive—every Alien Divine Kingdom’s strength, troop types, and danger Rank are clearly marked. Plus, there is support. It’s relatively safe.”
Yang Fan nodded. “Then the second type?”
“The Divine Shop.”
“The Divine Shop?” Yang Fan asked in confusion. “Demigod coordinates... can be bought?”
Yang Fan had never seen this kind of thing in the Divine Shop before; wasn’t it just supplies that could be freely purchased there?

Ye Jianfeng glanced at him and said somewhat speechlessly, “After your Breakthrough to demigod, you haven’t carefully browsed the Divine Shop? Your permissions have already changed, and quite a few companies run businesses in this area.”

“I really haven’t browsed it much.” Yang Fan explained awkwardly, “Intelligent Life has always been helping me allocate resources, and after arriving in Taichu City, many building-type resources are no longer purchased from the Divine Shop.”

Ever since his Breakthrough to a demigod, his divine kingdom had ushered in rapid development. If not for being invaded by that demonic monkey demigod and experiencing the thrill of absorbing a Divine Kingdom Core, he wouldn’t have even thought about proactively waging a Divine Kingdom War, and naturally hadn’t researched this aspect.

Sima Bang laughed heartily. “Understood, understood. Old Yang probably just broke through to a demigod not long ago, so it’s normal not to know. Furthermore, the coordinates within the Divine Shop are different from the military’s; the information is very vague, and the danger level is definitely not low.”

Ye Jianfeng nodded and added, “As believers of the Qi Refining Stage are born, the divine kingdom gains the ability to explore outward, and many demigods will proactively send believers out to scout. Over time, a business was born—the trafficking of Divine Kingdom coordinates.”

“There are introductions in the Divine Shop, but the prices are ridiculously expensive. The stronger the divine kingdom, the cheaper it is, while the weaker it is, the more expensive it becomes. Its price far exceeds the resource value of the divine kingdom itself.”
Yang Fan frowned. “Why is that?”

“What is truly valuable has never been resources, but the Divine Kingdom Core. Once this thing is obtained, it is immediately absorbed and basically never circulates in the market.” There was a trace of yearning in Ye Jianfeng’s eyes.
“Swallowing the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core will directly expand the area of the divine kingdom. As long as one can become a god, they will possess endless Lifespan.”
“The larger the area of the divine kingdom, the resources, believers, industries it can carry... all grow exponentially. That is not a one-time yield.”
Hearing Ye Jianfeng’s explanation, Yang Fan naturally understood.
As long as a god does not fall, the marginal benefits brought by the Divine Kingdom Core are equivalent to being endless.
While the reclamation work after the Divine Kingdom War ended was certainly important, the core of the war was still plundering the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment, then suddenly asked, “Then if believers explore outward... will they encounter a god’s divine kingdom?”
As soon as the words left his mouth, Sima Bang and the other two all looked at him simultaneously, their expressions somewhat peculiar. They didn’t seem to expect Yang Fan to ask such a question.
Sima Bang was stunned for a moment, then grinned and started laughing.
“Old Yang, oh Old Yang, did you skip all the divine kingdom theory classes of your nine-year compulsory education?”
Yang Fan: “...”

Sima Bang didn’t keep him in suspense and patiently explained, “Divine Being, demigods, low-tier gods, Mid-tier God, High-tier God. The divine kingdoms of every tier are forcibly separated by the power of Law.”
“This is an extremely strong restriction. If gods could randomly run over to plunder demigods’ Divine Kingdom Core, this world would have long been thrown into complete chaos.”
“Us young leeks wouldn’t even have the qualification to develop; we’d directly be objects of harvest.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan likewise agreed in his heart. That was indeed the case; if a god could descend upon the demigod zone, it wouldn’t be a battle, but a dimensional reduction strike.

Sima Bang spread his hands. “When we send believers to explore outward, it is impossible to invade a god’s divine kingdom. The rules do not allow it; this is protection for the weak, just like the Laws of heaven and earth.”
Speaking to this point, Sima Bang suddenly changed the topic. “However, this doesn’t mean that there’s a hundred percent guarantee you won’t be targeted by a god.”
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan frowned.
Sima Bang’s expression became somewhat uncertain as he said, “I can’t explain the specifics clearly either, I just heard family members mention it.”
“There was once a Peerless Prodigy of our Human Race who was directly obliterated by an Alien God during the demigod stage, without even having the chance to grow up.”
