Yang Fan had never seen this kind of thing in the Divine Shop before; wasn’t it just supplies that could be freely purchased there?
Ye Jianfeng glanced at him and said somewhat speechlessly, “After your Breakthrough to demigod, you haven’t carefully browsed the Divine Shop?
Your permissions have already changed, and quite a few companies run businesses in this area.”

“I really haven’t browsed it much.” Yang Fan explained awkwardly, “Intelligent Life has always been helping me allocate resources, and after arriving in Taichu City, many building-type resources are no longer purchased from the Divine Shop.”
Ever since his Breakthrough to a demigod, his divine kingdom had ushered in rapid development.

If not for being invaded by that demonic monkey demigod and experiencing the thrill of absorbing a Divine Kingdom Core, he wouldn’t have even thought about proactively waging a Divine Kingdom War, and naturally hadn’t researched this aspect.
Sima Bang laughed heartily.
“Understood, understood.
Old Yang probably just broke through to a demigod not long ago, so it’s normal not to know.
Furthermore, the coordinates within the Divine Shop are different from the military’s; the information is very vague, and the danger level is definitely not low.”
Ye Jianfeng nodded and added, “As believers of the Qi Refining Stage are born, the divine kingdom gains the ability to explore outward, and many demigods will proactively send believers out to scout.
Over time, a business was born—the trafficking of Divine Kingdom coordinates.”
“There are introductions in the Divine Shop, but the prices are ridiculously expensive.
The stronger the divine kingdom, the cheaper it is, while the weaker it is, the more expensive it becomes.
Its price far exceeds the resource value of the divine kingdom itself.”
Yang Fan frowned.
“Why is that?”
“What is truly valuable has never been resources, but the Divine Kingdom Core.
Once this thing is obtained, it is immediately absorbed and basically never circulates in the market.” There was a trace of yearning in Ye Jianfeng’s eyes.
“Swallowing the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core will directly expand the area of the divine kingdom.
As long as one can become a god, they will possess endless Lifespan.”
“The larger the area of the divine kingdom, the resources, believers, industries it can carry... all grow exponentially.
That is not a one-time yield.”
Hearing Ye Jianfeng’s explanation, Yang Fan naturally understood.
As long as a god does not fall, the marginal benefits brought by the Divine Kingdom Core are equivalent to being endless.
While the reclamation work after the Divine Kingdom War ended was certainly important, the core of the war was still plundering the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
Yang Fan pondered for a moment, then suddenly asked, “Then if believers explore outward... will they encounter a god’s divine kingdom?”
As soon as the words left his mouth, Sima Bang and the other two all looked at him simultaneously, their expressions somewhat peculiar.
They didn’t seem to expect Yang Fan to ask such a question.
Sima Bang was stunned for a moment, then grinned and started laughing.
“Old Yang, oh Old Yang, did you skip all the divine kingdom theory classes of your nine-year compulsory education?”
Yang Fan: “...”
Sima Bang didn’t keep him in suspense and patiently explained, “Divine Being, demigods, low-tier gods, Mid-tier God, High-tier God.
The divine kingdoms of every tier are forcibly separated by the power of Law.”
“This is an extremely strong restriction.
If gods could randomly run over to plunder demigods’ Divine Kingdom Core, this world would have long been thrown into complete chaos.”
“Us young leeks wouldn’t even have the qualification to develop; we’d directly be objects of harvest.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan likewise agreed in his heart.
That was indeed the case; if a god could descend upon the demigod zone, it wouldn’t be a battle, but a dimensional reduction strike.
Sima Bang spread his hands.
“When we send believers to explore outward, it is impossible to invade a god’s divine kingdom.
The rules do not allow it; this is protection for the weak, just like the Laws of heaven and earth.”
Speaking to this point, Sima Bang suddenly changed the topic.
“However, this doesn’t mean that there’s a hundred percent guarantee you won’t be targeted by a god.”
“What do you mean?” Yang Fan frowned.
Sima Bang’s expression became somewhat uncertain as he said, “I can’t explain the specifics clearly either, I just heard family members mention it.”
“There was once a Peerless Prodigy of our Human Race who was directly obliterated by an Alien God during the demigod stage, without even having the chance to grow up.”

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Loading Buildings, Heaven and Earth Furnace
paragraphs: “Weren’t the rules restricting it?” Yang Fan’s pupils contracted slightly.
Sima Bang’s tone paused, as if he was weighing his words.

“If a demigod’s divine kingdom tier is the ‘Lower Realm’, then a god’s divine kingdom is in the ‘Upper Realm’. If Upper Realm believers want to ‘descend to the mortal world’, they need to pay a terrifyingly heavy price, which only happens in very rare circumstances.”

“Don’t think too much. At our level, it’s not enough for an Alien God to spend such a huge price to target us. Just develop with peace of mind,” Sima Bang said in a softened tone. “Most of the opponents faced in a Divine Kingdom War are of the same tier.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell silent, his mind churning with thoughts.
With his SSS-Rank Evolution Talent, the speed of his growth was destined to get faster and faster, and in the future, he might even surpass everyone of this generation.
At that time, would he still be able to remain safe and sound like this?
The invasion by the demon monkey demigod could only be considered as him having good luck; if it were any other alien race, his divine kingdom would be in danger.
Yang Fan’s fingers tightened slightly, and suddenly, he had more thoughts about his future.
Charging forward blindly might not be right; moving forward while staying alive is what matters.
In this world, geniuses were never lacking. What was lacking were geniuses who could live to the end.

One’s sharpness could be dazzling for a moment. But the one that could truly walk to the end was never the brightest blade, but the one that was hidden the deepest, polished the longest, and never broke.
A thought suddenly arose in Yang Fan’s heart—perhaps he should be a bit slower, a bit steadier, and a bit more cautious.
Because only by living long enough would one be qualified to go further.
After pondering for a moment, Yang Fan threw out another question, “When believers explore outward... will they encounter a Human Demigod?”
“Of course they will. Divine kingdom rules are only divided by tiers, not by races.”
“Our Human Race is merely one of the thousands of races in this Universe, so the probability of running into the same race isn’t high.”
“However, if we really run into each other, most will still give some Face. After all, we’re of the same race; there’s no need to fight to the death right off the bat.”

“Of course, one cannot be without defenses against others. The Human Race is no exception. Don’t let strangers approach your Divine Kingdom Core area, and definitely don’t let them see any high-value buildings.”
“We haven’t graduated yet, and we are indeed protected by the Federation, but the premise is that you can get the other party’s information and survive.”

“If the strength gap is too large and you let the other party directly swallow your Divine Kingdom Core, at that time you won’t even know ‘who killed you’. Even the highest Intelligent Life of the Federation won’t be able to retrieve any records, making it hard to appeal,” Sima Bang reminded him.
Although the Federation had legal restrictions, they could only handle problems in reality. The divine kingdom was in another dimension, where only strength mattered.
Staying alive was the most important thing. Relying on the law, even if justice was obtained, what use was justice if it came late?

After finishing the last plate of meat, Sima Bang said, “Don’t think too much for now; we don’t need to worry about the Divine Kingdom War for the time being. We’ve just achieved a Breakthrough as demigods, and now is the explosive growth stage for believers. Sharpening the axe won’t delay the work of woodcutting. I plan to consider invading an Alien Divine Kingdom during my sophomore year.”
“When our strength improves and we take action then, the risks will indeed be much smaller,” Ye Jianfeng nodded in agreement.

“At that time, we can act together. Everyone chips in to buy coordinates, explores together, and shares the risks. The Divine Kingdom Core and resources can be distributed according to work,” Sima Bang said.
Participating in a Divine Kingdom War alone carried too high a risk. Teaming up was the mainstream.
Whether it was large-scale combat with alien races at The Frontline or launching a Divine Kingdom War from the rear via divine kingdom coordinates, people basically traveled in company.
Family, classmates, acquaintances—as long as they trusted each other, they could cooperate.
With more people, although resources had to be shared, the fault tolerance was high, and efficiency was also high.
Yang Fan did not respond, only listening quietly.

At this moment, he already had completely different thoughts. With the blessing of a hundredfold time flow rate from the SSS-Rank Evolution, the recovery speed of the military forces in Yang Fan’s divine kingdom far exceeded that of ordinary people.
Others needed to team up because their troop strength was limited and their fault tolerance was too low.
As for Yang Fan, he could completely hold off a hundred with one; the more he acted alone, the more advantages he would have.
More importantly, cooperation meant fighting together, jointly allocating resources, and exposing more information.
His own troop structure, development route, and divine kingdom coordinates were all likely to be known by these “friends”.
To others, cooperation reduced risk. But to Yang Fan, it instead reduced profits and increased other risks.
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly, this thought flashing through his heart without showing a single trace on the outside.
When that time truly arrived, he could just find an excuse to decline.
Having eaten and drunk to his heart’s content, Yang Fan stood up to say goodbye to the others, then returned to his small courtyard.
“Yang Yi, help me query the specific information about the divine weapon world-forging platform,” Yang Fan said.
As the command was issued, the specific information instantly appeared inside Yang Fan’s wrist-watch:
[divine weapon world-forging platform (S-Rank): Price: 10,000,000 Divinity Points (Out of stock in the Divine Shop)

Originating from an Advanced Cultivation God-Kingdom, it seals the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire within. This fire is no ordinary fire; it is condensed from the power of rules and the Spiritual Qi Origin, and can be freely transformed into various forging forms such as metal, fire, thunder, and Yin and Yang. Its flames can refine the essence of all things—whether it is spiritual ores, divine weapons, or demon bones, they can all be repeatedly quenched, reconstructed, and sublimated, ultimately transforming into the basis of weapons.

Once the divine weapon world-forging platform is activated, it will automatically generate tens of millions of forging rooms. Each forging room operates independently, uniformly controlled by the main platform, which automatically allocates furnace fire intensity and material ratios, greatly reducing the failure rate, and can recycle and recast failed products without causing resource waste.
Only believers with the “Blacksmith” profession can enter the forging rooms.
The divine weapon world-forging platform can batch-produce high-tier standard weapons, and its theoretical limit can forge S-Rank divine weapons.

Evaluation: The divine weapon world-forging platform is a top-tier war resource of a divine kingdom. The weapons it forges are enough to cover the long-term combat consumption of hundreds of billions of believers.]
“As expected of an S-Rank Building,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but exclaim in admiration.

Being able to support hundreds of billions of believers in long-term combat—although the introduction didn’t give specific output data, based on this point alone, for a long time to come, he would no longer need to worry about the weapons needed for the Divine Kingdom War.
The weapons produced by the Spirit Weapon Workshop were mostly low-tier weapons of D-grade and below, and the output of C-grade weapons was extremely limited.
Now, Foundation Establishment Realm powerhouses had already been born in his divine kingdom, yet he only had a bare reserve of ten thousand sets of B-grade weapons on hand.
Senior Gu Yuan clearly saw the shortcomings in his weapons and equipment, which was why he handed this divine weapon world-forging platform over to him in the form of a reward.
With a flash of his thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the divine kingdom.
The next moment, he directly chose to load the divine weapon world-forging platform.
Above that open space expanded by devouring the Divine Kingdom Core, space twisted slightly.
An illusion that seemed to carry a scorching will slowly appeared from the Void Realm.
First came the outline; the mountain-like heavy base of the forging platform solidified inch by inch.
Following that was the internal structure. Countless complex and ancient patterns lit up like Bloodline, intertwining layer by layer and interlocking with each other.
Boom—
The moment the final core array pattern took shape, the entire divine weapon world-forging platform completely descended!
A flash of dazzling white fire ignited from its center! —Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire!
In a split second, the Spiritual Qi of the entire divine kingdom seemed to be stirred by an invisible giant hand, beginning to surge violently.
The temperature rose sharply. The air became dry and scorching, as if a sun had been forcibly placed upon the earth.
Heatwaves spread out layer by layer; plants curled slightly, fine white mist rose from the lake surface, and even the distant rocks faintly exuded a scorching heat.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: War-Type High-Tier Intelligent Life
paragraphs: Yang Fan’s consciousness hung high in the sky, clearly sensing all these changes.
“Is this the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire? This temperature is a bit troublesome!” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
In just a moment, the sensory temperature of the entire divine kingdom had risen by three or four degrees.
The Mortal believers were the first to be unable to withstand it, beginning to stir restlessly, drenched in sweat, and showing expressions of discomfort.
An S-Rank Building with such a violent aura as the divine weapon world-forging platform was obviously too overpowered for Yang Fan’s current divine kingdom.
The Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire was originally born for forging, but the energy it radiated had already begun to inversely affect the entire divine kingdom’s ecology.
Right at this moment, Yang Yi’s voice sounded calmly.
“Master, I suggest applying to purchase one thousand B-Rank defense buildings, the nine profound ice tower, at a unit price of thirty Divinity Points.”

“This building can not only enhance the overall defense System of the divine kingdom, but its continuously released cold Qi can also effectively neutralize the excess heat overflowing from the divine weapon world-forging platform.”
“Application approved.” Yang Fan nodded.
One thousand nine profound ice towers had a total price of thirty thousand Divinity Points, which was almost the majority of net worth for the vast majority of demigods.
But to Yang Fan, it was merely normal consumption.

“According to data, the divine weapon world-forging platform can automatically forge C-Rank weapons, equipped with an internal fully automated mining System, and can connect to ten large mineral veins simultaneously. I apply to simultaneously purchase supporting mineral vein resources.”
“Approved.”
“Applying to sell the Spirit Weapon Workshop and small mineral veins.”
“Approved.”

“Considering the long-term development of the divine kingdom, I suggest adding a Blacksmith professional System. I apply to increase the budget of the Primordial Academy to specially cultivate believers’ blacksmithing skills.”

Yang Fan was silent for a moment, then spoke: “Increase the daily budget of the Primordial Academy to two thousand Divinity Points, advancing Alchemy and forging simultaneously. I want to have a batch of believers who can truly enter the divine weapon world-forging platform to craft high-tier weapons in the shortest possible time.”
Ever since Yang Fan’s Breakthrough into a demigod, the development speed of the divine kingdom could almost be described as “out of control”.
The overall strength of the believers had long since skyrocketed hundreds of times. And after strength increased, equipment naturally had to keep up.

Even if they were only believers in the Qi Refining Stage, if they could be fully equipped with a complete set of B-Rank equipment, facing someone in the same Realm without any equipment, it would be enough to form a crushing momentum.
Combat power was never just about the Realm; Martial Skills, equipment, physique, and Cultivation Technique were all the keys to victory or defeat.

Ever since taking out a loan through Elephant Loan, Yang Fan had poured almost all his energy into the investment and expansion of the divine kingdom. The completion of the believers’ “combat power System” had instead been intentionally or unintentionally ignored by him.
Until this moment, Yang Fan truly realized that this was the most obvious shortcoming in his divine kingdom.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Yi’s voice was crisp and neat.
As expected of a high-tier Intelligent Life, the moment the words fell, all tasks had been completed.
The Spirit Weapon Workshop and small mineral veins were all listed for sale.
One thousand nine profound ice towers had already been placed everywhere in the divine kingdom.
The cold Qi was like mist, slowly dispersing, forming a counter-surge with the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire released by the divine weapon world-forging platform.
The originally sweltering air quickly dropped back down. The temperature was stabilized in the most suitable range for survival and cultivation.
Meanwhile, around the divine weapon world-forging platform, ten large mineral veins had completed their arrangement.
The mountains bulged, and the veins of the mineral deposits were clearly visible.
Accompanied by low Mechanical roars, rows of fully automated mining devices began to operate.
The Ores were quickly mined, sorted, and cut. Then, through crisscrossing conveyor belts, they were continuously transported into the interior of the divine weapon world-forging platform.
Flames surged, smelting, forging, and quenching were completed in one go.
Yang Fan could even clearly perceive that C-Rank weapons were continuously being manufactured. Endless, almost without pause.
In this era, the vast majority of Divine Beings taking the logistics route had to repeatedly weigh even F-Rank weapons, hesitating to purchase them for a long time.
A batch of low-tier weapons often meant months or even years of resource accumulation.
And at a higher level, C-Rank weapons were merely mass-produced “consumables” on an assembly line, numbering in the tens of thousands and piling up like mountains.
Even before they could be used, they were already about to be phased out and updated.
Resources never disappeared. They were simply concentrated in the hands of a few people in various ways.
The weak calculated meticulously, living solely to survive one more day.
With a wave of the strong person’s hand, there were tens of thousands of troops.
This was a class that was almost impossible to ever cross.
People in the world each had their own paths; some were content with the established trajectory, while others risked everything trying to rewrite their fate.
Yang Fan was no sage, and he could not pity all living beings; he was merely gripping that glimmer of possibility belonging to himself tightly amidst the wind and waves.
Class was like a mountain that would not collapse on its own; one could only climb, crash, and endure step by step to change the present and change oneself.
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly, and he said in a calm tone: “Yang Yi, help me pull up the specific information of the war-type high-tier Intelligent Life.”
Naturally, he would not ignore Senior Gu Yuan’s suggestion.

In the Primordial Battlefield, commanding a scale of just ten-million-level believers had already revealed Yang Er’s limit. And in a true Divine Kingdom War, the deployed troops would only be even more terrifying.
Since resources were abundant, he shouldn’t wait for problems to appear before making up for them; naturally, he had to take precautions beforehand.
[War-Type High-Tier Intelligent Life (Fourth Tier): Price 10,000 Divinity Points

An intelligent individual constructed with war logic by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, capable of completing battlefield deductions, troop dispatch, and firepower distribution in an extremely short time, accurate to the optimal usage method of every single believer and every single weapon.

Facing complex combat situations, it can simultaneously conduct multi-threaded decision-making, correct tactical deviations in real-time, and make the overall combat efficiency increase exponentially.
It has a built-in variety of combat modules, which can be freely switched according to the battlefield environment.

At the same time, this unit can connect with other intelligent Systems of the divine kingdom, taking over resources such as defense buildings, fighter jet Formations, and Formation nodes, achieving true all-domain war synergy.

Evaluation: Ten thousand armies as one, attacks and conquests in order; a single thought for dispatching, combat power doubles. With such an Intelligent Life sitting in command, the divine kingdom will no longer be a place of scattered soldiers, but a true war machine.]
The price of the war-type high-tier Intelligent Life was not cheap at all, being a full hundred times more expensive than Yang Er.
Yang Fan merely glanced at the price, but wasn’t surprised in his heart. The closer Intelligent Life leaned toward the “war” direction, the rarer it was and the more expensive the price.
However, given his current financial resources, ten thousand Divinity Points were nothing, and there was no need to hesitate.
“Help me purchase it.” Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“Yes.”
The instant Yang Yi responded, a red ball of light quietly emerged within the divine kingdom.

Although the selling price was as high as ten thousand Divinity Points, its essence was no different from Yang Yi and Yang Er. It still lacked a physical body, being merely a Soul-like conscious entity.
“Master, please choose an external appearance and personality, and name me.” The red ball of light slowly floated in front of Yang Fan.
“Middle-aged male. Decisive and belligerent personality. Name yourself Yang San,” Yang Fan said.

Even if they were only believers in the Qi Refining Stage, if they could be fully equipped with a complete set of B-Rank equipment, facing someone in the same Realm without any equipment, it would be enough to form a crushing momentum.
Combat power was never just about the Realm; Martial Skills, equipment, physique, and Cultivation Technique were all the keys to victory or defeat.
Ever since taking out a loan through Elephant Loan, Yang Fan had poured almost all his energy into the investment and expansion of the divine kingdom.
The completion of the believers’ “combat power System” had instead been intentionally or unintentionally ignored by him.
Until this moment, Yang Fan truly realized that this was the most obvious shortcoming in his divine kingdom.
“Yes, Master.” Yang Yi’s voice was crisp and neat.
As expected of a high-tier Intelligent Life, the moment the words fell, all tasks had been completed.
The Spirit Weapon Workshop and small mineral veins were all listed for sale.
One thousand nine profound ice towers had already been placed everywhere in the divine kingdom.
The cold Qi was like mist, slowly dispersing, forming a counter-surge with the Heaven and Earth Furnace Fire released by the divine weapon world-forging platform.
The originally sweltering air quickly dropped back down.
The temperature was stabilized in the most suitable range for survival and cultivation.
Meanwhile, around the divine weapon world-forging platform, ten large mineral veins had completed their arrangement.
The mountains bulged, and the veins of the mineral deposits were clearly visible.
Accompanied by low Mechanical roars, rows of fully automated mining devices began to operate.
The Ores were quickly mined, sorted, and cut.
Then, through crisscrossing conveyor belts, they were continuously transported into the interior of the divine weapon world-forging platform.
Flames surged, smelting, forging, and quenching were completed in one go.
Yang Fan could even clearly perceive that C-Rank weapons were continuously being manufactured.
Endless, almost without pause.
In this era, the vast majority of Divine Beings taking the logistics route had to repeatedly weigh even F-Rank weapons, hesitating to purchase them for a long time.
A batch of low-tier weapons often meant months or even years of resource accumulation.
And at a higher level, C-Rank weapons were merely mass-produced “consumables” on an assembly line, numbering in the tens of thousands and piling up like mountains.
Even before they could be used, they were already about to be phased out and updated.
Resources never disappeared.
They were simply concentrated in the hands of a few people in various ways.
The weak calculated meticulously, living solely to survive one more day.
With a wave of the strong person’s hand, there were tens of thousands of troops.
This was a class that was almost impossible to ever cross.
People in the world each had their own paths; some were content with the established trajectory, while others risked everything trying to rewrite their fate.
Yang Fan was no sage, and he could not pity all living beings; he was merely gripping that glimmer of possibility belonging to himself tightly amidst the wind and waves.
Class was like a mountain that would not collapse on its own; one could only climb, crash, and endure step by step to change the present and change oneself.
Yang Fan’s gaze narrowed slightly, and he said in a calm tone: “Yang Yi, help me pull up the specific information of the war-type high-tier Intelligent Life.”
Naturally, he would not ignore Senior Gu Yuan’s suggestion.
In the Primordial Battlefield, commanding a scale of just ten-million-level believers had already revealed Yang Er’s limit.
And in a true Divine Kingdom War, the deployed troops would only be even more terrifying.
Since resources were abundant, he shouldn’t wait for problems to appear before making up for them; naturally, he had to take precautions beforehand.
[War-Type High-Tier Intelligent Life (Fourth Tier): Price 10,000 Divinity Points

An intelligent individual constructed with war logic by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, capable of completing battlefield deductions, troop dispatch, and firepower distribution in an extremely short time, accurate to the optimal usage method of every single believer and every single weapon.

Facing complex combat situations, it can simultaneously conduct multi-threaded decision-making, correct tactical deviations in real-time, and make the overall combat efficiency increase exponentially.
It has a built-in variety of combat modules, which can be freely switched according to the battlefield environment.

At the same time, this unit can connect with other intelligent Systems of the divine kingdom, taking over resources such as defense buildings, fighter jet Formations, and Formation nodes, achieving true all-domain war synergy.
Evaluation: Ten thousand armies as one, attacks and conquests in order; a single thought for dispatching, combat power doubles.
With such an Intelligent Life sitting in command, the divine kingdom will no longer be a place of scattered soldiers, but a true war machine.]
The price of the war-type high-tier Intelligent Life was not cheap at all, being a full hundred times more expensive than Yang Er.
Yang Fan merely glanced at the price, but wasn’t surprised in his heart.
The closer Intelligent Life leaned toward the “war” direction, the rarer it was and the more expensive the price.
However, given his current financial resources, ten thousand Divinity Points were nothing, and there was no need to hesitate.
“Help me purchase it.” Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“Yes.”
The instant Yang Yi responded, a red ball of light quietly emerged within the divine kingdom.
Although the selling price was as high as ten thousand Divinity Points, its essence was no different from Yang Yi and Yang Er.
It still lacked a physical body, being merely a Soul-like conscious entity.
“Master, please choose an external appearance and personality, and name me.” The red ball of light slowly floated in front of Yang Fan.
“Middle-aged male.
Decisive and belligerent personality.
Name yourself Yang San,” Yang Fan said.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Coordinates of the Divine Kingdom, Fountain of Life
paragraphs: Ever since the last time the “random” summon produced Yang Er in the appearance of a child, he had learned his lesson; it was better not to leave such matters to luck.

If another cute, jade-carved little boy were to appear, when the Divine Kingdom War began... on the battlefield, a seemingly harmless and adorable child standing before arrays of hundreds of millions of troops, waving his hand to direct operations...
Just thinking about that scene made Yang Fan feel it was too contradictory and out of character.
The next moment, the red ball of light began to shrink and condense, its outline rapidly forming.
In just a few breaths, a figure was already standing in the sky.
It was a middle-aged man with a posture as straight as a spear.
He wore a dark black battle armor with cold, rigid lines that faintly shimmered with a metallic luster.
The whole person seemed to have walked out of the depths of the battlefield, carrying an aura of slaughter that had not yet dissipated.
The next instant, the other party raised his right hand and crisply executed a military salute.
“Yang San greets the Master!” His voice was loud and clear, like the initial beating of battle drums.
“Please grant me the secondary command authority over believers. I will lead a grand army to fight across the myriad nations for my Lord!”
Yang Fan looked at Yang San before him, a flash of satisfaction crossing his eyes.
“Very good, the secondary command authority has been opened to you. Go and train the troops well; there will be a time for you to display your grand ambitions.” Yang Fan said.
“Understood!” Yang San saluted once more.
Returning to the Real World.
Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Virtual World.
The interface unfolded, and he tapped lightly on the Divine Shop, typing into the search box: “Divine Kingdom Coordinate”.
The next moment, the System prompt emerged:
“Citizen Yang Fan, current strength: Demigod.”
“Starting to retrieve Alien Demigod Divine Kingdom coordinate service agencies.”

After a brief loading period, a list of information slowly unfolded: “Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd., Xingyue Coordinate Trading Group, Universal Divine Domain Exploration Center, Deep Space Coordinate Resources Co., Ltd.”
Unlike previous resource purchases, the Divine Shop did not directly display the purchase prices of Divine Kingdom coordinates, but instead listed companies that provided the corresponding services.
Behind each name was attached a string of coordinate portals.
With a light tap of his fingertip, Yang Fan’s consciousness was sucked into it.
“Welcome to Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd. Intelligent Life Xiao Na at your service.” A mechanically synthesized voice appeared, devoid of emotional fluctuation.
At the same time, a translucent blue light and shadow was constructed in front of Yang Fan.
It was not in an anthropomorphic form, but rather a set of constantly changing data streams and structural models.
The surrounding environment was also extremely modern, with metal and light screens interweaving, and information flows sliding silently through the air.
On the long table, tea snacks, drinks, and fruits were all readily available, and the service was extremely professional.
“I need Alien Divine Kingdom coordinates.” Yang Fan stated directly.
“Request received.” Xiao Na responded extremely quickly, and the next moment, four clear classification modules unfolded in the air, neatly arranged.
[High-Risk Coordinates]
Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
Race: Sea Serpent Race
Estimated Combat Power: A
Estimated Divine Kingdom Defense Buildings: A
Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Rank: B
Rating: High-Risk
Price: 1 Million Divinity Points
Description: Incomplete intelligence, potential existence of hidden high-tier combat power, extremely low survival rate.
[Dangerous Coordinates]
Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
Race: Black Armored Beetle Race
Estimated Combat Power: B+
Estimated Divine Kingdom Defense Buildings: B
Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Rank: B
Rating: Dangerous
Price: 3 Million Divinity Points
Description: Equipped with a complete defense System, stable troop scale, moderate risk exists.
[Normal Coordinates]
Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
Race: Rock Spirit Race
Estimated Combat Power: B
Estimated Divine Kingdom Defense Buildings: C
Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Rank: B-
Rating: Normal
Price: 6 Million Divinity Points
Description: Relatively complete intelligence, clear combat power structure, suitable for standard Divine Kingdom War.
[Safe Coordinates]
Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
Race: Goblin
Estimated Combat Power: D+
Estimated Divine Kingdom Defense Buildings: D
Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Rank: C
Rating: Safe
Price: 10 Million Divinity Points
Description: Multiple rounds of reconnaissance completed, lowest risk, clear profit structure, recommended for newly promoted Demigods to purchase.
The information on the light screen was very comprehensive, divided into four Ranks.
Although the coordinates were all masked, they were very abundant, with information numbering up into the thousands.

“According to our records, this is the esteemed guest’s first time patronizing Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd. Coordinate prices are inversely proportional to risk. Please make your selection based on your own strength and risk tolerance.” Xiao Na continued.
Looking at the listed prices of these Divine Kingdom coordinates, Yang Fan still couldn’t help but feel a shock in his heart.
It was too expensive, simply outrageously expensive!
Nowadays, his Divine Kingdom’s monthly output was already as high as 200 million Divinity Points, and all of this was built upon the Evolution Talent and long-term compound compounding.
Under this nearly “cheating” development model, his Divine Kingdom assets had long since expanded to an exaggerated degree, even richer than the vast majority of low-tier gods.
Yet even so, when he saw the prices of “Safe Coordinates” easily reaching tens of millions of Divinity Points, he still felt a trace of shock.
This price, placed on an ordinary Demigod, was almost equivalent to several hundred times their entire net worth.
Don’t look at how financially strong Yang Fan was now, where tens of millions of Divinity Points were nothing.
You must know that a normal Demigod’s Divine Kingdom assets combined probably wouldn’t even amount to 100,000 Divinity Points.
Demigods like Zhan Yunxiao and Luo Tietie probably only had around a few thousand Divinity Points of movable circulating funds in their hands.

Yang Fan could almost conclude that, excluding aristocratic scions with deep backgrounds like Sima Bang, the vast majority of Demigods would never acquire Divine Kingdom coordinates through this method.
The reason was very simple; the cost-performance ratio was too low.
The “safer” a Divine Kingdom was, the more limited its internal resources tended to be.
Aside from the Divine Kingdom Core, the resources recovered through pioneering development were probably not even enough to cover a fraction of the coordinate purchase price.
This was not an investment at all, but rather exchanging a huge cost for a “relatively safe” path of Divine Kingdom expansion.
“I will come back to purchase them next time.” Yang Fan stood up and said.
“We welcome the esteemed guest’s return.” Xiao Na’s voice remained steady, without a trace of fluctuation, as if all transactions were merely established procedures.
The next instant.
Space receded, and Yang Fan’s consciousness returned to the Real World.
Divine Kingdom coordinates could be bought at any time, but before that, the first thing Yang Fan needed to do was to strengthen the power of his believers.
Even when a lion hunts a rabbit, it uses all its strength. How much more so for a Divine Kingdom War.
Currently, his Divine Kingdom only had one Foundation Establishment Realm believer.
The divine weapon world-forging platform had just been put into operation, and the equipment System had not yet taken shape.
Rashly dispatching troops under such circumstances was by no means a wise move.
Once the dispatched believers were completely wiped out, his Divine Kingdom coordinates would also be completely exposed to the opponent, and that would be a fatal hidden danger.
With the Evolution Talent, safety was always the top priority.
Yang Fan had already made up his mind to lay low for a while longer, waiting for the overall strength of his believers to reach another level before making a move.
By then, directly choosing the safest Divine Kingdom coordinates would be the correct solution.
Time quietly slipped away.
One day in the Real World, under the blessing of the Evolution Talent, a hundred years had already passed in the Divine Kingdom.
Three more Foundation Establishment Realm believers were added!
Four days later, under the continuous investment of the Primordial Academy, a thousand Qi Refining Stage Blacksmiths were successfully nurtured within the Divine Kingdom.
Furthermore, they successfully forged a B-grade weapon for the first time.
Five more days passed.
Within the settlement of the Elf Race, the aura of life suddenly fluctuated.
Under Yang Yi’s continuous and massive deployment of Moon Wells and Sun Springs, the Fountain of Life was finally born, and three of them appeared at once.
In Yang Fan’s view, this result was even a bit unlucky; given the number of Moon Wells and Sun Springs in his Divine Kingdom, the Fountain of Life should have been born long ago.
Yang Fan only glanced at it, and his heart didn’t have much fluctuation.

According to the introduction of the Fountain of Life, a Divine Kingdom had an extremely low probability of giving birth to one every thousand years, but for Yang Fan, the Real World was only ten days.
Such a “rare” probability was directly smoothed away by time in his Divine Kingdom.
Moreover, with his current Divine Kingdom assets, the Fountain of Life could no longer be considered a core asset, at best just a small unexpected pleasant surprise.
Yang Fan made no extra adjustments; the three Fountains of Life were still placed within the territory of the Elf Race.
However, the Water of Life condensed by the Fountain of Life was a strategic resource, extremely precious for healing wounds even for Foundation Establishment Realm believers.
Therefore, Yang Yi exercised divine authority on behalf of the gods and issued a Divine Decree: “The Water of Life must not be arbitrarily taken and used by the Elf Race.”
All of this was in preparation for the future Divine Kingdom War ahead of time.
As for these details, Yang Fan didn’t pay much extra attention to them.
Healing resources were never just limited to the Water of Life.
With his current financial resources, various kinds of Medicinal Pills in the Divine Shop could be purchased in large quantities at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: War Preparation
paragraphs: One month, two months, three months quietly passed.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan could almost clearly perceive that he was growing stronger every moment.
On its original Foundation, the Divine Kingdom had once again crossed nearly nine thousand years of time.
Now the Foundation Establishment Realm believers had broken through the number of three thousand, and the Qi Refining Stage believers had soared to over three million, an astonishing scale.
Throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, the combat power was no longer what it used to be.
With a slight movement of his thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom once again.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (3214), Qi Refining Realm (3.11 million), Martial Disciple Realm (670,000), Tier 5 Beings (150 million), Tier 4 Beings (250 million), Tier 3 Beings (610 million), Tier 2 Beings (700 million), Tier 1 Beings (2 billion), Mortals (1 billion)
Occupations: Alchemist (70,430) (Able to refine Qi Gathering Pill, Blood Origin Pill, Bone Strengthening Pill...), Blacksmith (43,900) (Can batch-forge B-grade weapons)
Dependents: Adult Elf (1.89 million)
Techniques: Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 510 million (reality provides 1.67 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well x500,000, Sun Spring x500,000, Fountain of Life x52, divine weapon world-forging platform (S-grade), Spiritual Vein x1000 (A-grade), Alchemy Tower x100 (B-grade), hundred herb spirit pivot academy x50 (B-grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x50 (B-grade), immortal nurturing tower x1000 (B-grade), Special Building Enlightenment Stone x1000...

Wonders: Penglai Island x1000 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x5000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x10000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x100 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x1

Assets: Dragon Fish fry (x100 million), Large Mineral Vein x10, Spirit Stone (), Dragon meat (), spiritual grain (), various Medicinal Pills (), various spirit fruits (), various herbs and Spirit Plants (), B-grade weapons (), C-grade weapons ()”

Three full months had passed, and the total return on investment of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom reached 600 to 700 million Divinity Points, but his working capital only grew from 200 million to 500 million.
Earning a lot meant spending just as much!

During this period, aside from continuously expanding various assets, Yang Yi’s true bulk of consumption still concentrated on cultivation resources such as Medicinal Pills, dragon meat, and spiritual grain.
With the continuous improvement of the believers’ overall strength, resource consumption also climbed to an astonishing level.

According to Yang Yi’s calculations, every three thousand years in the Divine Kingdom, the consumption required solely for the believers’ cultivation already reached as high as 100 million Divinity Points.
This number could be called terrifying.
On the premise of a population of less than ten billion, even some low-tier gods could never have their divine kingdom consumption reach this degree.
Ultimately, it was because the working capital in Yang Fan’s hands was overly abundant.
With too much working capital, under Yang Yi’s allocation, the resource investment in believers was almost pulled to the limit.
Spirit Stones were supplied without limit; high-tier Medicinal Pills were continuously invested; all kinds of auxiliary cultivation resources came in a steady stream.
As long as the believers had demands and it was beneficial to the enhancement of their strength, Yang Yi would invest resources without hesitation.
There was no upper limit and no restraint.
The reason for this was also very simple; even with such consumption, resources still exceeded demand.
Unlike most demigods and gods who maintained a state of “budget equilibrium” or even a slight deficit,
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was definitely an anomaly among anomalies.
These three months of observation also made Yang Fan gradually realize one thing: resources were never enough for the development of the Divine Kingdom.
As the number of Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment believers continued to increase, even the fixed asset income of 200 million Divinity Points per month could still be completely consumed.
As the believers grew stronger and stronger, revenue and expenditure would gradually balance, and Yang Fan would sooner or later have to reduce investment.

When all was said and done, it was because the investment development speed of his Divine Kingdom was too fast, while the strength of the believers had not kept up. Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before Yang Fan would have to worry about resource issues again.

Yang Fan was not anxious about this; right now, the believers’ cultivation environment was indeed somewhat “overly” opulent, and appropriately tightening resource investment and screening believer investment was instead a reasonable adjustment.
Furthermore, high-intensity resource injection was essentially “trading resources for time.” And for Yang Fan, time was precisely the thing he needed to worry about the least.
The Divinity Points that the Divine Kingdom’s believers could provide daily had already reached the threshold of breaking through to a god, but this was not the limit of a demigod.
Unlike Divine Beings ascending to demigods, “providing one Divinity Point daily” was no longer the upper limit, but merely the minimum standard.

There was only one true condition for a Breakthrough, and that was to launch a Divine Kingdom War to devour the Divine Kingdom Core, allowing one’s own Divine Kingdom area to break through 100 million square kilometers.
Everything was ready!

Yang Fan no longer hesitated. His consciousness connected to the Virtual World, entering Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd. once again, and directly spent 10 million Divinity Points to purchase a “Safe-grade” Divine Kingdom coordinate.
With a thought from Yang Fan, his consciousness sank into the Divine Kingdom.
The next instant, heaven and earth opened up, and a vast military array came into view.
Above the earth, a full 100 million believers stood arranged in Formations, their auras linked into one—the Ten Kings of Hell Formation!
At the core-most position, a thousand Foundation Establishment Realm believers occupied the eye of the Formation, their auras as steady as mountains, resembling a divine needle calming the sea.
In the circle outside them, one million Qi Refining Stage believers were distributed at the core nodes, their auras connecting with each other, spiritual power rising and falling like tides.
Further out were dense ranked beings, stacked in layers and carpeting the earth.
Under Yang San’s command, the entire grand Formation operated as one.
“Hum—!”
Uniform shouts suddenly exploded from all directions.
As the Formation operated, Yin Qi gathered. In the sky, blurry and majestic phantoms faintly emerged one after another.
Perceiving Yang Fan’s arrival, Yang San instantly stopped his actions.
Swish!
The figure instantly vanished, and when it reappeared, it was already standing before Yang Fan.
Yang San’s figure stood straight, and without any hesitation, he executed a military salute, “Master!”
“The current Divine Kingdom combat Formation has completed reorganization. The total number of believer soldiers available for external expedition is 500 million.”

“Among them, Foundation Establishment Realm: 1,000 people; Qi Refining Stage: 1 million people; Martial Apprentice Realm: 500,000 people; Tier 5 Beings: 100 million; Tier 4 Beings: 200 million; Tier 3 Beings: 200 million.”
“The entire army is divided into five major phalanxes, ready for battle at any time!”
As the voice fell, it carried an irrepressible Battle Intent.
Yang Fan’s gaze swept across the entire military array. The equipment of these drafted elites had completed a comprehensive update.

Foundation Establishment, Qi Refining, and Martial Apprentice were all fully equipped with complete sets of B-grade weapons, while the rest of the beings of various tiers were uniformly equipped with C-grade weapons.
Under the weapon supply of the divine weapon world-forging platform, the overall combat power of his believers had risen to yet another level compared to before.
“You only mobilized less than one-fifth of the troops?” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised.

“Reporting to Master, the essence of a Divine Kingdom War is a long-term war of attrition. While the outgoing troops are certainly important, what is even more crucial is logistical supply and the replenishment of troop sources.”
Yang San’s tone was steady and clear-cut: “The Divine Kingdom itself is the Foundation of everything. We must retain a sufficient population for reproduction to continuously replenish troops.”
“If too many troops are committed all at once, once large-scale losses are encountered, it will impact the believer population structure and even affect the overall operation of the Divine Kingdom.”
“In addition, the Divine Kingdom still needs to retain defensive strength to prevent others from taking advantage of a lapse.”
“Evaluating the Divine Kingdom’s current defense system, after consulting with Yang Yi, committing one-fifth of the troops is already a high-intensity combat configuration.”

sentences.text: One month, two months, three months quietly passed.
Under the blessing of the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan could almost clearly perceive that he was growing stronger every moment.
On its original Foundation, the Divine Kingdom had once again crossed nearly nine thousand years of time.
Now the Foundation Establishment Realm believers had broken through the number of three thousand, and the Qi Refining Stage believers had soared to over three million, an astonishing scale.
Throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, the combat power was no longer what it used to be.
With a slight movement of his thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom once again.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (3214), Qi Refining Realm (3.11 million), Martial Disciple Realm (670,000), Tier 5 Beings (150 million), Tier 4 Beings (250 million), Tier 3 Beings (610 million), Tier 2 Beings (700 million), Tier 1 Beings (2 billion), Mortals (1 billion)
Occupations: Alchemist (70,430) (Able to refine Qi Gathering Pill, Blood Origin Pill, Bone Strengthening Pill...), Blacksmith (43,900) (Can batch-forge B-grade weapons)
Dependents: Adult Elf (1.89 million)
Techniques: Ten Kings of Hell Formation (C-grade, Major Achievement)...
Divinity Points: 510 million (reality provides 1.67 Divinity Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well x500,000, Sun Spring x500,000, Fountain of Life x52, divine weapon world-forging platform (S-grade), Spiritual Vein x1000 (A-grade), Alchemy Tower x100 (B-grade), hundred herb spirit pivot academy x50 (B-grade), prison-suppressing body-refining tower x50 (B-grade), immortal nurturing tower x1000 (B-grade), Special Building Enlightenment Stone x1000...

Wonders: Penglai Island x1000 (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain x5000 (Deployed), Dragon Marsh Water Mansion x10000 (Deployed), Worlds Number One Martial Arts Arena x100 (Deployed), myriad manifestation battle stele x1

Assets: Dragon Fish fry (x100 million), Large Mineral Vein x10, Spirit Stone (), Dragon meat (), spiritual grain (), various Medicinal Pills (), various spirit fruits (), various herbs and Spirit Plants (), B-grade weapons (), C-grade weapons ()”

Three full months had passed, and the total return on investment of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom reached 600 to 700 million Divinity Points, but his working capital only grew from 200 million to 500 million.
Earning a lot meant spending just as much!

During this period, aside from continuously expanding various assets, Yang Yi’s true bulk of consumption still concentrated on cultivation resources such as Medicinal Pills, dragon meat, and spiritual grain.
With the continuous improvement of the believers’ overall strength, resource consumption also climbed to an astonishing level.

According to Yang Yi’s calculations, every three thousand years in the Divine Kingdom, the consumption required solely for the believers’ cultivation already reached as high as 100 million Divinity Points.
This number could be called terrifying.
On the premise of a population of less than ten billion, even some low-tier gods could never have their divine kingdom consumption reach this degree.
Ultimately, it was because the working capital in Yang Fan’s hands was overly abundant.
With too much working capital, under Yang Yi’s allocation, the resource investment in believers was almost pulled to the limit.
Spirit Stones were supplied without limit; high-tier Medicinal Pills were continuously invested; all kinds of auxiliary cultivation resources came in a steady stream.
As long as the believers had demands and it was beneficial to the enhancement of their strength, Yang Yi would invest resources without hesitation.
There was no upper limit and no restraint.
The reason for this was also very simple; even with such consumption, resources still exceeded demand.
Unlike most demigods and gods who maintained a state of “budget equilibrium” or even a slight deficit,
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was definitely an anomaly among anomalies.
These three months of observation also made Yang Fan gradually realize one thing: resources were never enough for the development of the Divine Kingdom.
As the number of Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment believers continued to increase, even the fixed asset income of 200 million Divinity Points per month could still be completely consumed.
As the believers grew stronger and stronger, revenue and expenditure would gradually balance, and Yang Fan would sooner or later have to reduce investment.
When all was said and done, it was because the investment development speed of his Divine Kingdom was too fast, while the strength of the believers had not kept up.
Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before Yang Fan would have to worry about resource issues again.

Yang Fan was not anxious about this; right now, the believers’ cultivation environment was indeed somewhat “overly” opulent, and appropriately tightening resource investment and screening believer investment was instead a reasonable adjustment.
Furthermore, high-intensity resource injection was essentially “trading resources for time.” And for Yang Fan, time was precisely the thing he needed to worry about the least.
The Divinity Points that the Divine Kingdom’s believers could provide daily had already reached the threshold of breaking through to a god, but this was not the limit of a demigod.
Unlike Divine Beings ascending to demigods, “providing one Divinity Point daily” was no longer the upper limit, but merely the minimum standard.

There was only one true condition for a Breakthrough, and that was to launch a Divine Kingdom War to devour the Divine Kingdom Core, allowing one’s own Divine Kingdom area to break through 100 million square kilometers.
Everything was ready!
Yang Fan no longer hesitated.

His consciousness connected to the Virtual World, entering Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd. once again, and directly spent 10 million Divinity Points to purchase a “Safe-grade” Divine Kingdom coordinate.
With a thought from Yang Fan, his consciousness sank into the Divine Kingdom.
The next instant, heaven and earth opened up, and a vast military array came into view.
Above the earth, a full 100 million believers stood arranged in Formations, their auras linked into one—the Ten Kings of Hell Formation!
At the core-most position, a thousand Foundation Establishment Realm believers occupied the eye of the Formation, their auras as steady as mountains, resembling a divine needle calming the sea.
In the circle outside them, one million Qi Refining Stage believers were distributed at the core nodes, their auras connecting with each other, spiritual power rising and falling like tides.
Further out were dense ranked beings, stacked in layers and carpeting the earth.
Under Yang San’s command, the entire grand Formation operated as one.
“Hum—!”
Uniform shouts suddenly exploded from all directions.
As the Formation operated, Yin Qi gathered.
In the sky, blurry and majestic phantoms faintly emerged one after another.
Perceiving Yang Fan’s arrival, Yang San instantly stopped his actions.
Swish!
The figure instantly vanished, and when it reappeared, it was already standing before Yang Fan.
Yang San’s figure stood straight, and without any hesitation, he executed a military salute, “Master!”
“The current Divine Kingdom combat Formation has completed reorganization.
The total number of believer soldiers available for external expedition is 500 million.”

“Among them, Foundation Establishment Realm: 1,000 people; Qi Refining Stage: 1 million people; Martial Apprentice Realm: 500,000 people; Tier 5 Beings: 100 million; Tier 4 Beings: 200 million; Tier 3 Beings: 200 million.”

We must retain a sufficient population for reproduction to continuously replenish troops.”
“If too many troops are committed all at once, once large-scale losses are encountered, it will impact the believer population structure and even affect the overall operation of the Divine Kingdom.”

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Destroy Your Believers, Seize Your Foundation
paragraphs: Yang Fan nodded after listening, then raised his hand and snapped his fingers lightly.
Hum—
High in the sky, a curtain of light unfolded.
The information of the Divine Kingdom coordinates slowly projected outward.

” [Safe Coordinates] Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates: YT-0087-γ-0987. Race: Goblin. Estimated Combat Power: D+. Estimated Divine Kingdom Defense Buildings: D. Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Rank: C. Rating: Safe. Price: 10 Million Divinity Points. Description: Multiple rounds of reconnaissance have been completed, risk is lowest, revenue structure is clear, recommended for newly promoted Demigods to purchase. “
Yang Fan’s gaze fell on the light curtain, his tone calm yet carrying a hint of unquestionable oppression: ” This is our target this time. Do not let me down. “
” Please rest assured, Master! ” Yang San’s Battle Intent suddenly surged in his eyes.

” According to the big data evaluation of the Human Federation, our current comprehensive combat power is already in the upper-middle tier of the Demigod level. I have confidence in taking down this Alien Divine Kingdom. “
Yang Fan did not say anything more, only nodding slowly, ” Go. “
The next moment, Yang San raised his right hand, and the Divine Kingdom coordinates in the sky turned into a stream of light that plunged straight into his pupils!
In an instant, his eyes seemed to reflect another world.
Immediately following that, Yang San waved his hand fiercely!
” Entire army—assemble!!! “
Boom!!!
An army of five hundred million believers responded simultaneously!
The formation instantly reorganized, and countless figures converged into one place like a torrent.
The next instant, space vibrated, and a dazzling light appeared. A full five hundred million troops disappeared within the light!

Yang Fan’s consciousness still stayed in place. At this moment, he could clearly perceive that a bidirectional space channel invisible to the naked eye had appeared on the periphery of his Divine Kingdom.
The other end connected precisely to that Goblin Alien Divine Kingdom.
He also understood in his heart that once the Divine Kingdom War began, there was no way back.
Whether the entire army retreated or all his believers were wiped out, his Divine Kingdom coordinates would be completely exposed in the opponent’s eyes.
The only way was to annihilate the opposing god and obtain the Divine Kingdom Core; only this could ensure the safety of the coordinates.
Yang Yi and Yang Er appeared at the same time.

” Master, I apply to purchase an A-Rank Breeding Card. As the Divine Kingdom War begins, believer losses are inevitable, and we need to stockpile troops in advance. ” Yang Yi bowed slightly, his tone calm as always.
” Granted. ” Yang Fan nodded in agreement.

With the Hundredfold Evolution Talent, he was not worried about the troop recovery speed. But under the condition that the living space for believers was sufficient, the earlier the Breeding Card was invested, the more valuable it would be.
After all, believers needed time to grow. Once large-scale casualties occurred on The Frontline, he couldn’t possibly push Mortals who had not yet cultivated directly onto the battlefield.
That wasn’t replenishing troops; that was sending them to their deaths.

Yang Er spoke right after: ” Master, I apply to deploy ten million Tier 2 believers to enter the target Divine Kingdom in advance, following behind the main army to gradually carry out resource extraction and preliminary land reclamation. “
” At the same time, I apply for ten Divinity Points to purchase basic land reclamation tools. “
” Granted. “
Thus, the division of labor was clear.
Yang San commanded the army and was responsible for frontal warfare.
Yang Yi controlled the rear and allocated resources and supplies.
Yang Er was responsible for post-war land reclamation and resource collection.
The three high-level Intelligent Life forms each performed their own duties.

As for Yang Fan himself, he was quite relaxed. At this moment, he had already returned to reality, leaning back in his chair with his legs crossed. He casually picked up a spiritual fruit and took a bite, then picked up a cup of self-produced Monkey Wine from his Divine Kingdom and took a light sip.
Even with his consciousness returned to reality, as long as he was willing, he could clearly perceive Yang San’s current sights, sounds, and thoughts.
The perspectives were completely synchronized, just like watching a livestream.
The scene shifted.
The Alien Goblin Divine Kingdom.
This realm was obviously “barren”, its Spiritual Qi sparse, not even one-thousandth of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
In the air, there was a trace of turbidity and clutter; the ground was rugged and vegetation was sparse.
Large areas were still exposed rock and soil, and the occasional woods also appeared chaotic and disordered.
The entire Divine Kingdom looked as if it had just been promoted to a Demigod not long ago and hadn’t had time to properly manage it yet.
With the arrival of the five hundred million troops led by Yang San, almost at the same time, an illusory consciousness suddenly condensed on the periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
That was a Goblin Demigod, with a tall, straight figure and cold eyes.
At this moment, there was not a shred of composure on this Demigod’s face, and his eyes were filled with solemnity.
” Aliens! ” The other party suddenly spoke, their voice like tearing through the air, ” Leave my Divine Kingdom! I can erase the coordinate information—let this matter end here! “
Amidst the roar, the surrounding air vibrated violently.
Yang San only glanced at him coldly: ” Noisy. My God has ordered—destroy your believers, seize your Foundation. “
The Goblin Demigod’s expression changed drastically, and he sternly said: ” Have the god behind you come out and speak! “

” Just based on you? You are worthy of making my God appear? A Divine Kingdom heritage like yours doesn’t even have the qualification to see my God. ” Yang San hooked the corner of his mouth into a cold smile, Battle Intent burning in his eyes.
As the words fell, the five hundred million believers moved instantly!
The five major phalanxes deployed simultaneously!
The Ten Kings of Hell Formation formed with a bang! Yin Qi soared into the sky!
High in the sky, five shadows of the kings of hell slowly condensed. The coercion was like a mountain, and space was rustling and trembling!
Seeing this scene, the Goblin Demigod’s expression sank completely.

Staring intently ahead, his voice lowered: ” Human God on the opposite side, I know you can hear me. This deity does not want to fight you to the death. If pushed too hard, I... am not without friends either. By then, neither of us will have it easy! “
This time, still no one responded to him.
Yang Fan in reality curled his mouth into a sneer.
The next moment, his voice directly entered Yang San’s consciousness: ” Fight directly, advance toward the Divine Kingdom Core. “
Yang Fan’s tone did not have a trace of fluctuation, because he was very clear about one thing.
People with true confidence never need to threaten. The more one has their “way out” on their lips, the more they usually have no way out left.
If he truly had sufficiently powerful allies, why would he choose to negotiate at the very first moment? Furthermore, he wouldn’t easily expose his trump card of potentially seeking help.
Moreover, Divine Kingdom coordinates have always been a god’s most core secret.
Short of a life-and-death crisis, no one would ever leak them.
Since Yang Fan awakened his Divine Kingdom, the Divine Kingdom coordinates he had known so far were only two people—Luo Rou and Zhang Pang.
Luo Rou had previously felt her life was not long, and after becoming husband and wife, she actively opened up her Divine Kingdom coordinates in exchange for Yang Fan’s trust.
As for Zhang Pang, he had signed a Subordinate God Contract with Yang Fan.
Aside from that, there was no third person.

Even the Divine Kingdom Defense War of Yang County No. 1 Middle School back then was conducted with coordinates uniformly shielded by the Intelligent Life of the Federation, which showed the importance of Divine Kingdom coordinates.
Now just a few words of threat wanted to make him retreat? How was that possible?
This was a coordinate he bought for ten million Divinity Points; he was determined to take this Goblin Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core.
” Obey my Divine God’s order! ” Yang San raised his hand abruptly! His voice exploded like thunder!
” Entire army— “
” Kill!!! “
Boom!!!
Five hundred million believers rioted simultaneously!
The five images of the kings of hell suppressed downwards with a crash!
In just a flash, the Goblin Demigod’s illusory consciousness was completely shattered!
