chapters.title: Chapter 140: Divine Kingdom War Losses
paragraphs: From deep within the Alien Demigod’s divine kingdom, a roar filled with fury echoed out.
“Bastard! So what if you are powerful? This is my home turf! You want to seize my Divine Kingdom Core—let’s see if you can withstand the attrition!”
The Goblin Demigod snorted coldly, and then his will pierced through heaven and earth as a Divine Decree thundered down:

“First, female believers are to immediately cease all activities and enter the Breeding areas to conceive offspring; male believers are granted unrestricted Breeding rights, but it is strictly forbidden to violate those who are already pregnant!”
“Second, all believers are to arm themselves immediately and commit fully to combat training, strengthening their physical fitness and battle array coordination!”
“Third, all production activities in the divine kingdom are completely suspended; all survival necessities will be uniformly supplied by divine gift!”

“Fourth, an alien race has invaded the divine kingdom. Believers of the third rank and above are to organize for war and immediately gather at the outskirts of the divine kingdom to construct defensive lines and obstruct the enemy layer by layer!”
Finally, a will as hard as iron weighed down upon the entire domain.
“This battle—is a battle for survival!”
“Swear to the death—to defend our home!”
As the Divine Decree fell, the entire Goblin divine kingdom instantly began to operate.
The originally disorganized tribes were seemingly forced into a single rope, with every individual dragged into the war.
The Goblin Demigod stood in the core area, his eyes fixed deathly on the edge of the divine kingdom, his expression cold and stern.
“I only broke through to Demigod less than fifty years ago, yet my coordinates were locked onto so quickly.”
“The opponent’s military strength far exceeds mine; even their Foundation Establishment Realm forces are of such a scale.”
He slowly exhaled, “If I can’t win in a head-on clash, then I’ll stall. I will make him retreat in the face of difficulties.”
With a thought, he quickly made a decision.
“Purchase additional defensive buildings and arrange them in layers to delay the opponent’s marching speed. My Goblin race’s greatest strength has never been combat power, but Breeding capability.”
“The longer I stall, the more obvious the advantage in a war of attrition becomes.”
Outskirts of the divine kingdom.
Yang San led the army forward, but the path ahead was far more complex than imagined.

Upon the earth, vast areas had been forcibly transformed into quagmires; stepping into them caused one to sink continuously and move sluggishly. These areas were also laced with corrosive auras that constantly eroded the Physical Body.
There were also arrow towers and bone-spike ramparts visible everywhere.
Crude but staggering numbers of defensive fortifications were layered one after another, with almost no gaps.
Most of these were only C-grade or D-grade defensive buildings; individually they weren’t strong, but their numbers were simply too great.
And the real trouble wasn’t these, but rather the Goblins’ ‘harassment tactics’.
They almost never engaged in head-on confrontation, instead setting up ambushes in advance, occupying high ground or hidden terrain to launch sudden attacks as Yang San’s army advanced.
Bows and arrows, stone-throwing, poison mist, and even suicide charges appeared in endless succession.
They would retreat immediately after hitting, never lingering in battle. A single instance wasn’t fatal, but with enough frequency, the consumption of the war chariots was not small.
However, in the face of absolute strength, the impact of such methods was ultimately limited.
The alien side lacked high-end combat power; currently, the strongest individuals appearing were only at the Qi Refining Realm.

On Yang Fan’s side, the believers didn’t just know the Ten Kings of Hell Formation, but also the Locking Heaven Array and the Extinguishing God Array, which they had long ago Cultivated to Major Achievement.
Even if it was just a vanguard squad, once they encountered an ambush, they could quickly form an array to stabilize the situation and stall for time.
By the time the main army from the rear pressed forward, there was only one outcome: the total annihilation of the alien squad.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, ten days had passed in reality.
In the Alien Divine Kingdom, ten years had already gone by.
During these ten years, although no true large-scale decisive battle broke out, small-scale conflicts never ceased.
Sneak attacks, counterattacks, tug-of-war, and advancement occurred almost every moment.
By now, the cumulative loss of believers had reached as high as two hundred million.
These were all ranked beingss, including even hundreds of thousands of believers at the Qi Refining Realm. For any ordinary Demi-god, this would be enough to make their hearts ache.
But for Yang Fan, this was merely a number.
Because during the same time, his divine kingdom had already developed for another thousand years.

After Yang San drew off the military forces, the living space for the believers within the divine kingdom expanded. With the support of the A-grade Breeding Card, the population had long since been replenished.

Now, the combat power within the divine kingdom had not only recovered to what it was before the troop deployment, but the overall strength of the believers had even increased significantly. If there were losses at the front, the divine kingdom’s vast rear would supplement them.
Even so, under the opponent’s layered obstructions, in ten whole years, Yang San had only advanced less than half the distance.
The closer they got to the core area, the greater the resistance became.
Yang Fan quietly perceived all of this and sighed softly, “Divine Kingdom War... as expected, it’s not that simple.”
“In a life-or-death moment, the opponent will throw all their resources into the war. Even if I am stronger than him, wanting to completely swallow him up is not that easy.”
At this moment, he finally understood those ‘power structures’ in reality.
Why there were various families, companies, Alliances, and squads...
Divine Kingdom War is simply not suited for going it alone!
If strengths are equal, a Divine Kingdom War won’t even start; if one has the advantage, forcibly consuming the opponent also requires paying a huge price.
Once one’s own divine kingdom’s Origin Qi is heavily damaged, one will be on edge, potentially becoming someone else’s prey at any time.
Because of this—
Cooperation has become the mainstream. And it’s not just the Human Race. The alien races are the same.

Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly. If he didn’t possess the Evolution Talent, the loss of two hundred million believers over these ten years would have been enough to make him hesitate or even retreat.
Moreover, this was only a ‘Safe Coordinate’. If it were replaced by those ‘Dangerous’ or even ‘High-risk’ divine kingdoms, the price would only be more exaggerated.
Yang Fan shook his head and didn’t think any deeper.
At least for now, he didn’t need cooperation. Relying on his Evolution Talent, he could completely be a ‘lone wolf’.
“Even if it’s a slow grind, I can still grind you to death,” Yang Fan said with a calm gaze.
According to Yang Fan’s estimation, at Yang San’s current advancement speed, it would take approximately another thirty years in the divine kingdom to reach the opponent’s core area.
Converted to reality, that was only about a month.
He wasn’t in a hurry; this kind of advancement efficiency was already quite good.
To conquer a Demigod’s divine kingdom in just over a month would be an almost impossible task if not for the nearly infinite replenishment of troops.
Time continued to flow: ten days, twenty days.
On the other side, the alien Goblin Demigod had already begun to panic.
He stood in the core of his divine kingdom, his expression gloomy.
“How is it possible? To what extent has this human divine kingdom developed? I have clearly consumed seven or eight hundred million of his troops, yet his offensive hasn’t weakened in the slightest!”
“Just how many believers does he have?! Could it be... the area of his divine kingdom has already exceeded fifty million square kilometers?”
Thinking of this, his breathing became slightly rapid.
“If that’s the case, I can’t stop him alone.”
“I cannot die. No matter how great the price, I must survive!”
With a thought, his consciousness instantly withdrew from the divine kingdom.
Several thousand light-years away.
In an unfamiliar Star Domain.
A city belonging to the Goblin race stood quietly.
This place was completely different from human cities; there was no orderly reinforced concrete. Instead, it was replaced by buildings grown from twisted giant trees.
Branches coiled and vines interlaced, forming houses and streets as if they were living things.
The air was thick with the smell of alcohol and a primitive, mixed aura.
On the streets, it was noisy and clamorous.
The sounds of arguments, laughing curses, and soft moans rose and fell.
Crude and barbaric, yet carrying a ‘vitality’ unique to this race.
Some Goblin Divine Beings didn’t even shy away, engaging in Breeding acts right at the edge of the streets, with no sense of order whatsoever.
This—was their civilization.

sentences.text: From deep within the Alien Demigod’s divine kingdom, a roar filled with fury echoed out.
“Bastard!
So what if you are powerful?
This is my home turf!
You want to seize my Divine Kingdom Core—let’s see if you can withstand the attrition!”
The Goblin Demigod snorted coldly, and then his will pierced through heaven and earth as a Divine Decree thundered down:

“First, female believers are to immediately cease all activities and enter the Breeding areas to conceive offspring; male believers are granted unrestricted Breeding rights, but it is strictly forbidden to violate those who are already pregnant!”
“Second, all believers are to arm themselves immediately and commit fully to combat training, strengthening their physical fitness and battle array coordination!”
“Third, all production activities in the divine kingdom are completely suspended; all survival necessities will be uniformly supplied by divine gift!”
“Fourth, an alien race has invaded the divine kingdom.
Believers of the third rank and above are to organize for war and immediately gather at the outskirts of the divine kingdom to construct defensive lines and obstruct the enemy layer by layer!”
Finally, a will as hard as iron weighed down upon the entire domain.
“This battle—is a battle for survival!”
“Swear to the death—to defend our home!”
As the Divine Decree fell, the entire Goblin divine kingdom instantly began to operate.
The originally disorganized tribes were seemingly forced into a single rope, with every individual dragged into the war.
The Goblin Demigod stood in the core area, his eyes fixed deathly on the edge of the divine kingdom, his expression cold and stern.
“I only broke through to Demigod less than fifty years ago, yet my coordinates were locked onto so quickly.”
“The opponent’s military strength far exceeds mine; even their Foundation Establishment Realm forces are of such a scale.”
He slowly exhaled, “If I can’t win in a head-on clash, then I’ll stall.
I will make him retreat in the face of difficulties.”
With a thought, he quickly made a decision.
“Purchase additional defensive buildings and arrange them in layers to delay the opponent’s marching speed.
My Goblin race’s greatest strength has never been combat power, but Breeding capability.”
“The longer I stall, the more obvious the advantage in a war of attrition becomes.”
Outskirts of the divine kingdom.
Yang San led the army forward, but the path ahead was far more complex than imagined.
Upon the earth, vast areas had been forcibly transformed into quagmires; stepping into them caused one to sink continuously and move sluggishly.
These areas were also laced with corrosive auras that constantly eroded the Physical Body.
There were also arrow towers and bone-spike ramparts visible everywhere.
Crude but staggering numbers of defensive fortifications were layered one after another, with almost no gaps.
Most of these were only C-grade or D-grade defensive buildings; individually they weren’t strong, but their numbers were simply too great.
And the real trouble wasn’t these, but rather the Goblins’ ‘harassment tactics’.
They almost never engaged in head-on confrontation, instead setting up ambushes in advance, occupying high ground or hidden terrain to launch sudden attacks as Yang San’s army advanced.
Bows and arrows, stone-throwing, poison mist, and even suicide charges appeared in endless succession.
They would retreat immediately after hitting, never lingering in battle.
A single instance wasn’t fatal, but with enough frequency, the consumption of the war chariots was not small.
However, in the face of absolute strength, the impact of such methods was ultimately limited.
The alien side lacked high-end combat power; currently, the strongest individuals appearing were only at the Qi Refining Realm.

On Yang Fan’s side, the believers didn’t just know the Ten Kings of Hell Formation, but also the Locking Heaven Array and the Extinguishing God Array, which they had long ago Cultivated to Major Achievement.
Even if it was just a vanguard squad, once they encountered an ambush, they could quickly form an array to stabilize the situation and stall for time.
By the time the main army from the rear pressed forward, there was only one outcome: the total annihilation of the alien squad.
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, ten days had passed in reality.
In the Alien Divine Kingdom, ten years had already gone by.
During these ten years, although no true large-scale decisive battle broke out, small-scale conflicts never ceased.
Sneak attacks, counterattacks, tug-of-war, and advancement occurred almost every moment.
By now, the cumulative loss of believers had reached as high as two hundred million.
These were all ranked beingss, including even hundreds of thousands of believers at the Qi Refining Realm.
For any ordinary Demi-god, this would be enough to make their hearts ache.
But for Yang Fan, this was merely a number.
Because during the same time, his divine kingdom had already developed for another thousand years.
After Yang San drew off the military forces, the living space for the believers within the divine kingdom expanded.
With the support of the A-grade Breeding Card, the population had long since been replenished.
Now, the combat power within the divine kingdom had not only recovered to what it was before the troop deployment, but the overall strength of the believers had even increased significantly.
If there were losses at the front, the divine kingdom’s vast rear would supplement them.
Even so, under the opponent’s layered obstructions, in ten whole years, Yang San had only advanced less than half the distance.
The closer they got to the core area, the greater the resistance became.
Yang Fan quietly perceived all of this and sighed softly, “Divine Kingdom War... as expected, it’s not that simple.”
“In a life-or-death moment, the opponent will throw all their resources into the war.
Even if I am stronger than him, wanting to completely swallow him up is not that easy.”
At this moment, he finally understood those ‘power structures’ in reality.
Why there were various families, companies, Alliances, and squads...
Divine Kingdom War is simply not suited for going it alone!
If strengths are equal, a Divine Kingdom War won’t even start; if one has the advantage, forcibly consuming the opponent also requires paying a huge price.
Once one’s own divine kingdom’s Origin Qi is heavily damaged, one will be on edge, potentially becoming someone else’s prey at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: The Final Decisive Battle
paragraphs: At the highest point in the center of the city, a high tower woven from dozens of giant trees pierced straight into the sky.
“Haguru, what’s been going on lately? You haven’t come to find me for a drink?” a slightly flippant voice rang out.
“I ran into some trouble, Girus.”
“What kind of trouble?”
“An Alien Demigod... has invaded my divine kingdom.”
The moment these words were spoken, the look in the eyes of the one named Girus changed instantly.
His original casual and loose demeanor completely vanished. He sized Haguru up from head to toe, his expression becoming solemn.
“Your divine kingdom... was invaded?”
“Yes,” Haguru sighed. “Fortunately, I had set up a large number of defensive buildings in advance.”
“At the beginning, the opponent had five hundred million troops. Now, I have worn them down to less than a hundred million.”
“But... I’m not sure how many more trump cards he has. So—I’ve come to you for help.”
As his voice fell, the air grew slightly silent.
Girus, however, showed a hint of difficulty. “It’s not that I won’t help, it’s just... I’ve also been participating in a Divine Kingdom War lately, and I really can’t spare any troops.”
“Girus, we’ve been friends since we were kids, you...”
Before Haguru could finish, Girus waved his hand and interrupted, his tone becoming perfunctory. “Your divine kingdom is currently at war, so I shouldn’t keep you. Hurry back and take command.”
“It’s just a mere hundred million aliens. With our Goblin Breeding ability, we can grind them to death even if it’s just through attrition.”
“When you’re done fighting, we’ll drink again.”
He spoke lightly, but had absolutely no intention of taking action.
“Girus, you...”
“The door is that way.”
Girus cut him off directly, his tone cold: “Please leave.”
At this moment, Haguru fell silent. Looking at the other man’s expression, a flash of disappointment and gloom flickered in the depths of his eyes.
Finally, he gritted his teeth and said, “Help me once, and both B-Grade Buildings in my divine kingdom—the Goblin Breeding Towers—will be yours.”
“Take care, I won’t see you out.” Girus didn’t even lift an eyelid.
The air turned completely cold. Haguru stood for a moment and finally said nothing more. He only let out a long sigh, turned around, and left with heavy steps.
After he left, Girus lazily leaned back in his seat, pulled a female Goblin to his side, and began to exercise while drinking wine.
“My Lord... why didn’t you agree just now?” the female Goblin asked in a low voice, her breath coming in gasps.
“Those were two B-Grade Buildings...”
Girus sneered, a flash of shrewdness in his eyes.
“You don’t understand. Haguru is a loner. Except for me, he has almost no friends.”
“And after he made a Breakthrough to become a demi-god, he became more and more cautious. Would he come to beg me if he weren’t at a dead end?”
He gave a cold laugh.
“He says there’s only a hundred million enemy troops left?”
“If it were really that simple, would he risk exposing his divine kingdom coordinates to come find me?”
Girus’s eyes narrowed slightly, his tone meaningful: “This fellow has likely been pushed to the brink.”

“Divine Kingdom Wars are exceptionally dangerous. Once I participate, my own divine kingdom coordinates are also at risk of exposure. He’s just a fair-weather friend; a mere two B-Grade Buildings aren’t worth me taking this risk.” Girus sneered, his tone full of shrewdness and indifference.
“My Lord is wise,” the female Goblin said, her face full of admiration.
She was only a Divine Being. To her, B-Grade Buildings were unattainable existences, and she had nearly let the temptation cloud her mind just now.
Girus suddenly paused, as if he had thought of something, and the corners of his mouth slowly curled up: “You did remind me of something, though.”

“Send a message to Haguru in a bit. If he’s willing, I can purchase his Breeding towers at ten percent above market price. These kinds of resource buildings are always in high demand in the Divine Shop. In his current situation—he’ll likely be tempted.”
As he spoke, he became increasingly excited, his movements becoming more vigorous, and the female Goblin’s face was filled with pain.
None who can become a demi-god are simple.
Had he not known Haguru’s divine kingdom coordinates, he might not have been able to loot him while his Origin Qi was heavily depleted.
In the evening, within the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, Haguru was focusing all his attention on commanding his believers in battle when he suddenly received a message.
When he saw the contents clearly, his face instantly became extremely ugly.
“A ten percent increase?” He sneered, his eyes full of mockery. “It’s not like I can’t sell them to anyone else, so why should I give you a bargain?”
Without the slightest hesitation, he directly listed the two B-Grade Building Goblin Breeding Towers in the Divine Shop at a price ten percent higher than the market rate.
The transaction was completed quickly, and one hundred and twenty Divinity Points were credited to his account.
Looking at this sum of capital, a ruthless glint flashed in Haguru’s eyes.
“Since you want my Divine Kingdom Core, then let’s see if you’ll feel the sting next!”
He held nothing back, pouring all his capital into the divine kingdom’s defensive system!
C-Grade Defensive Buildings were frantically laid out around the Divine Kingdom Core. The battle lines were continuously reinforced, and his forces kept shrinking back toward the core.
He was going to make a final stand at the core position!
“So many years of development, all ruined in a single day.” Haguru sighed deeply, exhaustion appearing in his eyes.
“If I can survive, perhaps I should find a Family to attach myself to. Even if I’m restricted by others—at least I won’t be isolated and helpless like I am now.”
He had already made a decision. As long as he could get through this danger, he would sell his services to a great Family and become a titular Elder.
Meanwhile, the army led by Yang San finally advanced to the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom Core.
The scene before them was completely different from the outside.
Towers stood in great numbers; twisted and thick wooden giant towers rose from the ground, densely packed with Goblin archers whose bowstrings were taut and arrowheads glinted with a faint light.
Further out were towering ancient trees woven into walls, their branches intertwining to form a thick and tough natural barrier. Like a city wall, they tightly protected the core area.

Outside the walls were vast marshes where black mud churned, accompanied by a foul stench and permeating toxic mist. With the slightest carelessness, one would sink into it and be continuously corroded.
The entire area was like a meticulously arranged fortress.
Seeing this, Yang San raised his hand to signal the army to stop.
His gaze was solemn, and he showed a rare hint of hesitation.
“Master, the defensive strength here is dozens of times greater than the outskirts, and there is a large Goblin army stationed here. This should be the site of the final decisive battle.”
“With our current troop strength, if we force an attack, even if we win, it will be a pyrrhic victory,” Yang San’s voice rang out in Yang Fan’s mind.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan’s consciousness descended into the divine kingdom.
“What are your suggestions?” Yang Fan asked.

The other party was a high-level Intelligent Life of the war type, more professional in the field of warfare than himself. Yang Fan naturally understood the principle that every profession has its specialty.

Yang San did not hesitate and quickly gave a plan: “First, apply to mobilize additional troops. In this type of siege warfare, the more sufficient the troops, the lower the overall losses. I suggest reinforcing with double the current troop strength.”
“Second, I ask Master to issue a Divine Decree to draft one hundred thousand Adult Elf to participate in the battle.”
He swept his gaze toward the towers ahead.

“The Ten Kings of Hell Formation is more suitable for an open battlefield and lacks an advantage in siege warfare. If we have Elves for long-range suppression to prioritize clearing the enemy archers, it will greatly reduce soldier casualties.”
After listening, Yang Fan nodded and then looked at Yang Yi: “Do as he says.”
“Yes, Master.” Yang Yi immediately executed the order.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Prey and Hunter
paragraphs: Right at this moment.
Above the Alien Divine Kingdom, a massive phantom slowly coalesced.
Haguru—appeared.
“Human God!” His voice carried suppressed anger and resentment.
“Is it not enough to have fought to this point? If we continue, even if you seize my Divine Kingdom Core, it won’t compensate for your losses!”
In the next moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness descended following the coordinates.
Standing above the sky, his figure grew tall, matching the other’s size.
Two demigods faced each other from a distance, the air seemingly freezing in place.
Haguru stared fixedly at Yang Fan, killing intent and hatred intertwined in his eyes: “You... finally decided to show yourself!”
Yang Fan cracked his neck, his expression calm, yet his tone was as sharp as a knife.
“Your Divine Kingdom Core—I’m definitely taking it.”

Haguru’s face darkened, and he said coldly, “The defenses here were built by spending over a hundred Divinity Points. Even if your believers are stronger and you’ve mastered a C-rank Array, so what? To break through here, you will surely suffer heavy casualties—are you really willing to pay that price?”
Hearing this, Yang Fan instead gave a light chuckle.
“Over a hundred Divinity Points?”
His gaze was indifferent, carrying a hint of mockery.
“You really are... quite poor.”
“What do you mean?” Haguru’s pupils constricted.
“Nothing.” Yang Fan waved his hand, his tone calm. “I’m just tired of wasting time with you.”
As his voice fell, he lightly snapped his fingers.
In the next instant, space shook violently! Another five hundred million believers descended with a bang!
The army was like a tide, its Aura overwhelming!
At the very back of the Formation, a hundred thousand Adult Elf stood in neat ranks, longbows in hand, their Auras sharp.
This scene caused a trace of despair to involuntarily surface in the eyes of the Goblin believers atop the city walls.
Yang Fan said no more and lowered his raised hand.
“Kill.”
Battle erupted instantly!
Under Yang San’s command, the army, like a precisely operating war machine, quickly deployed its Formation.
No less than ten Ten Kings of Hell Formations formed simultaneously!
The Formations echoed each other, Yin Qi soaring into the sky, causing the heavens and earth to change color!
Above the sky, phantoms of Yama coalesced one by one, some holding chains, others grasping Judge’s Pens, their Auras grim and their pressure like a hellish prison!
The entire battlefield was completely enveloped by an Aura of death!
“Attack!”
Yang San gave the order.
The army advanced like a landslide or a tsunami!
High on the walls, Goblin archers roared as they drew their bows, but they were a step too slow.
The elf army in the rear was already prepared, arrows notched to their bows.
Fire!
Swoosh—!!
A rain of arrows pierced the air!
Uniform and synchronized, their speed was too fast for the naked eye to track!
Streaks of light arrived later but struck first, accurately hitting the Goblin archers atop the walls!
Blood splattered! Screams rose one after another!
In terms of archery alone, how could Goblins compete with Elves?
Moreover, these were Adult Elf; their arrows were even enough to threaten those in the Qi Refining Stage!
With one volley, the firepower on the high walls was instantly suppressed! The long-range battlefield was a complete slaughter!
Meanwhile, the ground troops, bolstered by Formations, forced their way through the poison mist and marshes!
Spiritual power protected their bodies! The Formations diverted the pressure!
Even with the harsh environment, it was difficult to stop the overall momentum!
Yang San stood high in the air, his gaze calm as he continuously issued commands—
“Left wing, advance three hundred zhang and suppress the flank towers!”
“Third phalanx, push forward and hold the poison mist zone!”
“Elf units, second volley—clear the enemies on the high ground!”
The orders were concise and efficient, each step accurately striking the battlefield’s vital points.
Under his deployment, the entire army moved as naturally as his own limbs. The pace of the advance was as steady as an iron wall!
On the Goblins’ side, the defensive line was rapidly collapsing; towers were destroyed one by one, and wooden walls shattered under the impact of the Formations.
The battle line retreated step by step!
High in the sky.
Yang Fan and Haguru stood facing each other.
Below was a battlefield interwoven with blood and fire; as a large number of believers were slaughtered, Haguru’s Aura weakened visibly to the naked eye.
In contrast, Yang Fan remained calm, even somewhat indifferent.
He didn’t care about the loss of believers. To be precise, this small loss was not worth mentioning to him at all.
His main source of troops was still within his divine kingdom, ready to be deployed at any time.
However, looking at the current situation, it was no longer necessary.
This battle.
It had lasted for a full three months in divine kingdom time.

Countless believers followed one after another, with total losses exceeding three hundred million. Among them, as many as three hundred thousand Qi Refining Stage believers had fallen. The price could not be said to be small.
In the end, this “hard bone” was finally gnawed through.
The final defensive line collapsed, and the army drove straight in! They soon reached the divine kingdom’s core area.
There was no real combat power left here, only the old, weak, sick, and disabled.
With the war reaching this point, even the female Goblins, who were used as breeding tools, had been forced onto the battlefield.
Most of those remaining now were Goblin infants.
Yang San did not hesitate for a moment and ordered, “Kill them all.”
The order was cold and direct; to Yang Fan, the only value of these alien believers was to be turned into corpses.
After recycling them, they would be listed in the mall to exchange for Faith Points.
“Master.” Yang San stepped forward and handed over a green crystal. “The Divine Kingdom Core is here.”
Yang Fan reached out and took it, his palm tightening slightly.
Then he looked at Haguru and asked curiously, “Don’t you plan to make a final stand, or beg for mercy?”
Haguru was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed.
That smile carried a hint of exhaustion and a bit of relief. “Is there any point?”
“A defeat—is a defeat.”
“Your will to live isn’t very high.” Yang Fan arched an eyebrow.
Haguru looked up at the land torn apart by the flames of war, a trace of sorrow in his eyes.
“A defeat is a defeat. The world has always been like this—the strong prey on the weak.”
“Today’s outcome is simply because you are stronger. I have lived for four hundred years, being cautious all my life, yet I never expected to fall short by just a hair in the end.”

“Failure in a Divine Kingdom War means death; my passing will become your nourishment. You take my core today, but tomorrow yours might be taken as well. In the end, we are all just prey and hunters constantly moving forward on this path.”
“Finished with your last words?” Yang Fan’s tone was calm.
“Do it.”
Once the Divine Kingdom Core was in hand, the other party’s consciousness no longer possessed protection.
Yang Fan casually struck out with a palm; the Goblin Demigod’s phantom consciousness didn’t even have time to struggle before it instantly dissipated into nothingness.
“Yang Er, how many believers do you need to collect resources more efficiently?” Yang Fan withdrew his gaze and asked flatly.

“Reporting to Master,” Yang Er responded quickly, “We need one hundred Qi Refining Stage believers and one hundred thousand Tier 5 Being to clear the neutral creatures kept in the divine kingdom; additionally, a total of one hundred million second and third-rank creatures are needed for resource extraction. It is estimated that all collection can be completed within five years of divine kingdom time.”
Yang Fan nodded. “I’ll leave the rest to you.”
Compared to that Demon Monkey Demigod who had been hollowed out in advance, this Goblin divine kingdom, while not wealthy, was “complete,” possessing a certain value for reclamation.
Hunting is never just an end; it is a beginning in another sense.
A true hunter is not satisfied with just taking down the prey but will thoroughly extract all its value, transforming its flesh, blood, and resources into a part of themselves.
Only by utilizing the prey to the extreme can one be said to acknowledge and “respect” its existence.
The destiny of the weak is never to be pitied, but to be thoroughly utilized.

“Is it not enough to have fought to this point?

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Zombie System, Extra-dimensional Research Institute
paragraphs: Afterward, Yang Fan returned to the Divine Kingdom with Yang San and the rest of the believers.

Yang San stood straight and raised his hand in a standard military salute. With a solemn expression, he said, “Master, the enemy’s strength in this Divine Kingdom War was not great, yet our total losses approached one billion believers. This was a command error; please punish me.”
“It’s fine. You’ve already done very well,” Yang Fan said, waving his hand dismissively.
He had seen everything Yang San had done. Whether it was the pace of the advance, the use of Formations, or his battlefield judgment, everything could be described as precise.
If Yang Fan had commanded the battle himself, the casualties would only have been higher.

“Thank you, Master,” Yang San replied in a deep voice. Then, his tone shifted to one of contemplation. “However, through this battle, I believe our methods of aggression still need to be diversified.”

“Although the Ten Kings of Hell Formation is strong, it leans toward frontal combat. When facing a race with high reproductive capabilities that excels at stalling and harassment, our methods remain too singular.”
“What is your suggestion?” Yang Fan asked curiously.

Yang San’s gaze was calm. “Taking this instance as an example, juvenile Goblins can become warriors in ten years. Combined with their home-field advantage and guerrilla tactics, it easily forms a war of attrition. I believe we should prioritize weakening the growth capacity of their ‘Effective Forces’.”
“High-tier combat power is certainly important, but if low-tier individuals are sufficient in number and paired with geographical advantages, they can also pose a massive threat.”
“A specific plan?” Yang Fan nodded in approval.

“I suggest screening a portion of the believers with poor Aptitude and transforming them into zombies. In the future, when invading Alien Divine Kingdoms, they will be of great use,” Yang San said coldly.
As soon as he finished speaking, the air seemed to stagnate slightly.
Before Yang Fan could react, a figure had already appeared.

“Master, please do not adopt this suggestion,” Yang Yi said, his tone carrying clear opposition. “Currently, the Divine Kingdom’s Spiritual Veins are sufficient and Spiritual Qi is abundant. Even believers with poor Aptitude can enter the ranks within thirty years. Developing a Zombie System is extremely high-risk. Once it spirals out of control, it could even destroy the entire ecology of the Divine Kingdom.”
Yang San snorted coldly and countered directly, “Your database leans toward resource allocation and Divine Kingdom development; your understanding of warfare systems is too shallow.”

“According to the data, many gods of war-oriented schools have used Zombie Systems. In wars of aggression, once a zombie virus spreads in an enemy’s Divine Kingdom, it often yields extremely high strategic value.”
“The required population can be supplemented through Breeding Cards. As for ecological risks, they can be completely controlled through a closed research institute.”
Yang Yi sneered, “To introduce such an extreme system into such an excellent Divine Kingdom environment is simply too short-sighted.”
Yang San’s gaze turned cold. “We are both fourth-tier Intelligent Life, yet you remain stuck at the most basic level of resource allocation—have you never wondered why you are so cheap?”
“You...” Yang Yi’s voice faltered, clearly stung by the remark.
“Master, you cannot listen to him!”
“Master, please trust my judgment!”
The two voices rang out almost simultaneously, and a strange sense of “opposition” faintly filled the air.
Yang Fan stood there, feeling a bit bewildered. This was the first time he realized that Intelligent Life could actually argue.
Is this a conflict in their underlying code???
Yang Yi’s expression was solemn, and his tone carried a rare hint of tension.
“Although believers will never betray their god, it doesn’t mean they are just cold tools.”
“They have thoughts, emotions, and their own Souls. If you use believers to cultivate zombies, you are telling everyone: your birth was meant for death, and the future is meaningless.”

“Once this fear spreads, it will become an invisible plague, crushing faith and stifling Breeding. By then, even a grade-a breeding card will not be able to reverse this collapse of will from its roots.”

He paused slightly and said heavily, “Master, cherish your believers. Give them resources, food, and direction. Only when believers see growth and a future will they willingly fight for you. Yang San’s method is no different from killing the goose that lays the golden eggs.”
Hearing these words, Yang Fan’s expression gradually turned serious.

Yang San, however, was unfazed. Instead, he took a step forward, his gaze firm. “Master, Yang Yi’s concerns are reasonable, but for similar problems, gods have already explored solutions. If Master is willing to trust me, this matter can be fully handled by me.”
Yang Fan showed a look of hesitation.
Both Yang Yi and Yang San were his high-tier Intelligent Life forms; he did not doubt their loyalty.
It was just that their disagreement was so vast that the cost of this choice might be quite high.

Seeing Yang Fan’s hesitation, Yang San spoke again: “We can start with a small-scale trial, with Yang Yi supervising the entire process. If any signs of losing control appear, it will be terminated immediately.”
“In that case, let’s try it.”
“I request Master’s authorization for... ten million Divinity Points,” Yang San said, his tone a bit apprehensive.

As an Intelligent Life form, he naturally knew that the Divine Kingdom currently had ample funds. However, ten million Divinity Points was no small sum; most demigods couldn’t earn that much in a lifetime.
Hearing this, Yang Yi was about to object, but Yang Fan raised his hand to cut him off.
“Fine,” Yang Fan said calmly, without any hesitation.
Ten million Divinity Points—let alone a demigod, even a god would not easily hand that over to an Intelligent Life form to manage. But for Yang Fan, it wasn’t much; after all, he earned plenty.
If it could truly result in lower risks in war, it would all be worth it.
His consciousness returned to reality, but Yang Fan remained focused on the movements within the Divine Kingdom.
He was indeed curious. What exactly did Yang San want to do with ten million Divinity Points?
Keep in mind that a single A-grade Spiritual Vein only cost a little over ten thousand Divinity Points!
Soon—the answer was revealed.
Yang Fan could feel that the Divine Kingdom had purchased two A-grade buildings.

A complex of buildings that seemed to be made of countless folded spaces floated at the edge of the Divine Kingdom. Its appearance was not grand, but it exuded an indescribable depth and eeriness. Light and shadow constantly shifted on its surface, as if reality and the Void Realm overlapped here.
Its information then surfaced in Yang Fan’s consciousness:
[Extra-dimensional Research Institute, Price: 3 million Divinity Points]
Contains an independent secondary space with a total area of up to ten million square kilometers, fully synchronized with the time flow of the Divine Kingdom.
This space is constructed from special spatial Laws, possessing high closure and absolute isolation characteristics, which can effectively block the leakage of rules and energy pollution.

Due to Law restrictions, this space cannot support high-tier believers and only allows for the activity and Breeding of low-tier life forms. Therefore, it is not suitable for conventional Divine Kingdom development, but in fields such as ‘alien cultivation,’ ‘extreme environment simulation,’ and ‘warfare system experimentation,’ it possesses irreplaceable strategic value.
Its core value lies in infinite trial and error under controlled risks.
Any out-of-control system, dangerous race, or unpredictable evolutionary path can be repeatedly simulated in this independent space without causing pollution or backlash to the main Divine Kingdom.

Evaluation: The vast majority of the weaknesses, characteristics, and counter-strategies regarding various alien races in Federation textbooks originated from such research institutes. Truly top-tier gods never conduct trial and error on the battlefield—their answers have already been simulated millions of times here. If strategic research results are produced and reported to the Federation, they can be exchanged for massive amounts of Divinity Points and higher authority.

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Human Hearts Are Never Hard to Control
paragraphs: Seeing the description of this building, even Yang Fan couldn’t help but suck in a breath of cold air.
An A-grade building actually cost 3,000,000 Divinity Points.
This price was simply too ridiculous; it was equivalent to a full three hundred Spiritual Veins!
Only at this moment did Yang Fan truly realize that the price fluctuations between buildings of the same grade could be so exaggerated.
But on second thought, it wasn’t incomprehensible.
This was an independent space of ten million square kilometers. If it could accommodate high-level believers, it would be almost equivalent to creating another Divine Kingdom.
Unfortunately, only low-level life forms could exist within it.
Otherwise, even if it cost three hundred million Divinity Points, Yang Fan would never have hesitated.
In comparison, the other A-grade building seemed much more “affordable.”
[A-grade Building—River of Hope, Price: 6,000 Divinity Points]
When Mortal believers immerse themselves in it, their Aptitude information will be automatically analyzed and reported.
Aptitude is divided into three grades: Purple, Blue, and Green.
Purple is superior, Blue is medium, and Green is inferior.
It can be used to screen the potential of believers for targeted cultivation and resource allocation.

Evaluation: It can help you see “talent,” but it cannot see whether a “human heart” is resilient. Aptitude is only a probability, not destiny. So-called “hope” is often just disappointment known in advance. The Aptitude measured by this building is only a probability and is not completely accurate.]
Seeing the introduction of the River of Hope, Yang Fan nodded with satisfaction.
This building’s function was significant. Even if it wasn’t precise, just a probability was enough.
After all, the population base of the Divine Kingdom was there. When the quantity becomes large enough, probability itself is equivalent to certainty.
As the number of believers skyrockets in the future, resource investment will eventually face shortages.
At that time, precise investment will be the only answer.
Believers with higher Aptitude naturally deserve more resource allocation; it can no longer be a one-size-fits-all approach.
After purchasing these two buildings, Yang San did not stop.
Divinity Points continued to flow into the Divine Shop like water from a burst dam, and what he got in return were items that were bizarre to the extreme.
“Corpse Flower, Rotting Bone Vine, Flesh-Eating Mycelium, Gaping Blood Lingzhi, Death-Breath Moss, Corpse Oil Fruit, Black-Veined Parasitic Vine...”
Just seeing these names made a slight chill run down Yang Fan’s back.
The unit price of these things wasn’t high, but Yang San’s purchase volume was ridiculously large!
As a god, Yang Fan could clearly perceive the situation.
In just a few breaths, the land within the Extra-dimensional Research Institute had been completely occupied.
Countless eerie Spirit Plants grew and spread wildly. Among them, the Corpse Flowers covered the ground like a “sea of flowers” blooming in decay.
A full seven million Divinity Points were actually dumped into these things!
The originally lifeless Extra-dimensional Research Institute completely changed its appearance in an instant.
The air was filled with thick Corpse Qi, seemingly concentrated enough to drip.
Death Qi surged like countless invisible souls wailing in low voices.
The damp, cold atmosphere made one’s skin crawl. Dark red liquid faintly seeped from the ground, looking like blood or rotten juice.
Those Spirit Plants writhed slowly; the entire space was gloomy, oppressive, and distorted.
It was like a living ghost domain that had just been birthed.
“That’s it... all spent? You call this a small-scale trial???” Veins throbbed on Yang Fan’s forehead, and he couldn’t help but feel exasperated.
At this moment, he even had a feeling of being presented with a fait accompli. If Yang San weren’t his own Intelligent Life, he would have suspected the other party was trying to scam him.
Over ten million Divinity Points exchanged for this pile of messy junk?
If these things were planted in the Divine Kingdom, it wouldn’t take long for that originally vibrant world full of Spiritual Qi to turn into a complete dead zone.
Inside the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Yi was arguing with Yang San.

“Yang San, you’re being absolutely reckless!” Yang Yi was furious, his voice rising several octaves. “Normally, for the development of the Divine Kingdom and the growth of the believers, I calculate every bit of resources meticulously. But you...”

“Pettiness,” Yang San sneered, his tone full of contempt. “This is a war investment. As long as it succeeds, the pressure from invading alien races in the future can be reduced by at least thirty percent. Short-sighted—you don’t understand its value at all.”
“The Master already said, only a small-scale test,” Yang Yi suppressed his anger and spoke in a low voice. “I will not allow too many believers to enter the institute.”
As a fellow Intelligent Life, Yang Yi naturally understood Yang San’s plan.
Given the current ecological environment of the Extra-dimensional Research Institute, once believers entered, it wouldn’t take long before they completely lost their sanity.
Their flesh would rot, and their consciousness would collapse.
Eventually, they would turn into zombies that knew only slaughter, tearing and devouring each other.
As long as the number of believers thrown in was sufficient, they could even cultivate “Zombie Generals” capable of threatening Qi Refining Stage believers.
But the problem was, zombies were not believers after all.
They were not bound by the god, nor did they possess faith; they were more like a completely out-of-control neutral calamity. They killed whoever they saw and devoured whatever was living.
They were like a spreading “plague.” They harmed others and themselves alike.
“How about ten million Mortal believers for the first batch?” Yang San said calmly.
“Fine, but ten million believers is not a small number,” Yang Yi frowned.
“If believers die in a war against alien races, they see it with their own eyes and can understand it’s for the Divine Kingdom.”
“But if... they just disappear into thin air like this.”
Yang Yi looked up, his gaze gradually becoming sharp.
“Over time, it will inevitably spark discussion.”
“This kind of impact is uncontrollable. Do you really have a way to solve it?”
What Yang Yi excelled at was the management of the Divine Kingdom.
Back then, purchasing Corpse Flowers to cultivate the Poison Bee Queen was to solve a short-term hidden danger for the Divine Kingdom Defense War; it was just an expedient measure.
Afterward, he had unhesitatingly cleared out all the Corpse Flowers.
He had always remained wary of things like “zombies”; for low-level believers, they were an almost devastating disaster.
Now, although the Extra-dimensional Research Institute served as isolation so the zombie virus couldn’t leak out and the Divine Kingdom itself was safe,
if believers began to disappear regularly and on a large scale, it would still be a shock to the entire Divine Kingdom system.
Believers are loyal to their god. But they are not Puppets without emotions.
They won’t betray him, but they will have doubts, they will be uneasy, and they might even gradually become numb.
If it reaches that stage, how can we talk about the development of the Divine Kingdom!
“Of course there’s a way to solve it,” Yang San’s voice was soft, even carrying a hint of gentleness.
“They will become heroes.”
“Dying for the Divine Kingdom, sacrificing themselves to resist the invasion of alien races.”
“Their names will be recorded.”
“Their deaths will be given meaning.”

Yang San said seriously, “We Intelligent Life only serve the Master. These believers were also created by the Master. To sacrifice themselves for the god is their honor. As for what you worry about, I will naturally spin a good story.”
“Humans need hymns, I can provide them; they need heroes, I can shape them.”
“As for sacrifice—as long as it’s draped in the mantle of ‘righteousness,’ there will always be people who accept it gladly.”
“For individual sacrifice, one only needs to fabricate a collective honor.”
“Human hearts are never hard to control.”

An A-grade building actually cost 3,000,000 Divinity Points.
This price was simply too ridiculous; it was equivalent to a full three hundred Spiritual Veins!
Only at this moment did Yang Fan truly realize that the price fluctuations between buildings of the same grade could be so exaggerated.
But on second thought, it wasn’t incomprehensible.
This was an independent space of ten million square kilometers.
If it could accommodate high-level believers, it would be almost equivalent to creating another Divine Kingdom.
Unfortunately, only low-level life forms could exist within it.

Aptitude is divided into three grades: Purple, Blue, and Green.
Purple is superior, Blue is medium, and Green is inferior.
It can be used to screen the potential of believers for targeted cultivation and resource allocation.
Evaluation: It can help you see “talent,” but it cannot see whether a “human heart” is resilient.
Aptitude is only a probability, not destiny.
So-called “hope” is often just disappointment known in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Absorbing the Divine Kingdom Core, Hidden Dangers
paragraphs: At that moment, the River of Hope was officially loaded into the Divine Kingdom.
The earth trembled slightly as a wide river manifested out of thin air.
The river water was crystal clear, yet it faintly shimmered with a dim light.
The surface of the water was calm, with almost no ripples, like a mirror spread across the land.
Subsequently, Yang San issued a Divine Decree on behalf of the deity, his majestic voice echoing throughout the entire Divine Kingdom:
“This river shall be named the River of Hope. All those who have reached the age of ten and have not yet entered a tier may enter the river to test their Aptitude.”
“We thank our God!”
Whether they were believers on Penglai Island or on the mainland, everyone knelt down at that moment, bowing their heads in devout prayer.
Their voices converged into a tide, resonating between heaven and earth.
With the support of the hundredfold Evolution Talent, the speed of the Divine Kingdom’s Evolution was astonishing.

In reality, Yang Fan had only just picked up his teacup and taken a small sip when ten million Mortal believers with only green-grade talent had already been taken to the Extra-dimensional Research Institute by Yang San.
The believers within the Divine Kingdom were completely unaware of any of this.
The testing results from the River of Hope were not made public; all data was uploaded directly into the hands of Yang Yi and Yang San.
Those who watched their children being taken away were not only free of anxiety, but were instead excited, their faces flushed with joy.
In their eyes, this was a symbol of being “chosen,” proof of extraordinary talent, and a ticket to a higher social class.

“Old Man Li, didn’t your grandson usually Cultivate quite fast? You were bragging to me every day that he would definitely become a Tier 1 Being before he turned twenty,” one man said with a click of his tongue, his tone carrying a hint of smugness.
“How come he wasn’t chosen this time? His talent... must not be good enough!”
“Let me tell you, my grandson is a Genius among geniuses! He was personally named and taken away by the Lord Marshal!”
“When he comes back, he might even be a big shot at the fourth or fifth rank!”
“Don’t bother me, I need to Cultivate,” Old Man Li replied coldly, his expression sour.
“Hahaha!”

“When my son left, he even told me to take good care of my health,” a middle-aged man spoke with a smile, though his eyes shimmered slightly. “He said when he finishes his studies and returns, he’ll take me to live on Penglai Island.”
He looked up, as if imagining that day.
“This child has always been sensible since he was little.”

“My daughter is the same,” a woman nodded repeatedly, her face full of pride. “She said that once she becomes stronger, she can help share the deity’s burdens. We parents are just basking in their glory.”

“Sigh, my boy left in such a hurry that he didn’t even have time to say a word. He’s always so clumsy; I don’t even know if he took the protective talisman I wove for him,” someone scratched their head, their tone tinged with regret.
“But it’s fine. Being chosen is a good thing.”
“In the future, he might even leave his name in the annals of the Divine Kingdom!”
In the crowd, laughter rose and fell.
Some were proud, some were envious, and some were secretly expectant.
Everyone was rejoicing for being “chosen” and looking forward to the “future.”
Time flew by, and five days had already passed.
Yang Er’s land reclamation work was successfully completed, bringing back buildings, Spirit Plants, and various resources worth a total of eighty thousand Divinity Points.
Most of them were defensive buildings; after Yang Yi categorized them, he kept a few with high practicality and put the rest up for sale online.
This bit of profit was almost negligible to the current Yang Fan.
The reason he persisted in land reclamation was more out of respect for the “prey” and the principle of not wasting resources.
In those five days, the Divine Kingdom had evolved for nearly five hundred years.
With a thought, Yang Fan’s consciousness sank into the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Yi, Yang Er, and Yang San appeared before him almost simultaneously.
“Greetings, Master!” the three of them bowed in unison.
“I will absorb the Divine Kingdom Core first. We will discuss other matters later,” Yang Fan said succinctly.
As he spoke, he took out that Divine Kingdom Core.
Yang Fan closed his eyes and sank his consciousness into it, and a surge of majestic energy flooded into his Divine Kingdom like a torrent.
Since the last time he absorbed one, this feeling had become almost addictive.
For the past few days, Yang Fan had been suppressing this urge, and now it was finally completely released.
His life level changed once again at this moment, as if being forcibly elevated, and as if some kind of shackle had been quietly broken.
Boom—
A silent vibration spread throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, and its territory began to extend outward.
Mountains rose from the ground, rivers were generated out of thin air, and the original outline of the world began to expand.
Yang Fan slowly opened his eyes, and deep within his pupils, there seemed to be a divine light flowing.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: 11.5 million square kilometers
Talent: Omitted

Believers: Foundation Establishment Realm (5,234), Qi Refining Realm (4.11 million), Martial Apprentice Realm (1.67 million), Tier 5 Being (250 million), Tier 4 Being (300 million), Rank Three creature (400 million), Tier 2 Being (900 million), Tier 1 Being (1.2 billion), Mortal (700 million)
Occupations: Alchemist (110,000), Blacksmith (80,000)
Subordinates: Adult Elf (2.55 million)
Techniques:...
Divinity Points: 630 million (Real-world daily provision: 1.89)
Assets: Dragon Fish fry (100 million), Large Mineral Veins (10), Ordinary Zombies (100 million)”
Yang Fan let out a long breath, feeling an indescribable sense of comfort throughout his entire body. It was as if his whole being had been refined anew.

Looking at the changes on the panel, Yang Fan couldn’t help but whisper: “It only increased by five hundred thousand square kilometers. It seems the foundation of that Goblin Demigod’s Divine Kingdom was indeed a bit weak.”
With that Demi-god Demon Monkey before, Yang Fan could be said to have gotten a huge bargain.

“These ordinary zombies were actually counted in the ‘Assets’ column,” Yang Fan sighed softly. “Having paid such a high price, I wonder how much of a role they can actually play in the Divine Kingdom War.”
During these five days, Yang Fan was well aware of everything that had happened in the Divine Kingdom.
Basically, every five years in the Divine Kingdom, Yang San would draft a batch of Mortal believers with the worst Aptitude.
It started with ten million, then became twenty million, and later, even Tier 1 Beings were thrown into the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
Over the course of five hundred years, even with the continuous support of the grade-a breeding card, the total population of believers still showed a significant decline.
The number of believers consumed solely to Cultivate the zombie system had approached ten billion!
During this time, to coordinate with Yang San’s plan, Yang Yi also had to adjust the Divine Kingdom’s policies.
In addition to continuously purchasing grade-a breeding cards, Yang Yi also promulgated several Divine Decrees and systems to “encourage childbirth”:
[Those who give birth to offspring can receive extra rations and priority allocation of spiritual food resources.
Families whose number of offspring reaches a certain scale can receive high-grade Medicinal Pills to strengthen their Physique and improve cultivation efficiency.
Families with many children will be granted a “Mark of Glory,” raising their status and enjoying a higher social tier.
Outstanding families will be issued a “Multi-child Certificate” and may even be granted permission to move into the outer areas of Penglai Island.
Driven by this series of policies, the desire to give birth within the Divine Kingdom was once forcibly pulled high.
But even so, the thing Yang Yi was most worried about began to show its first signs.
Too many people had disappeared. Those believers who had once lost their children and relatives might have already died as their lifespans were exhausted.
However, suspicion and rumors were like undercurrents, continuously being passed down from one generation of believers to the next.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: The Glory of the Believers
paragraphs: Once Yang Fan had completely absorbed the Divine Kingdom Core, Yang Yi was the first to step forward.

“Master, five hundred years have passed since the cultivation of the Zombie System began, and the loss of the believer population during this period has been too immense. Now, not only the Mortal believers, but even those at the Qi Refining Realm have begun to show signs of dissatisfaction.”
Yang Yi looked up with a heavy tone, “If this continues, I fear it will shake the Foundation of the divine kingdom.”
Yang Fan did not respond immediately, instead shifting his gaze toward Yang San.
“What is your solution?”
Yang Fan didn’t care about those ordinary believers.
With his hundredfold Evolution Talent, as long as there was enough time, they would refill the entire divine kingdom like ants once more.
But the prerequisite was that the faith of these believers must not collapse.
To a god, believers were like leeks; they could be harvested and would regrow. But unless absolutely necessary, one must not touch the roots of the leeks.

“Reporting to Master, after these five hundred years of development, many rumors have indeed arisen among the believers, but it is not difficult to reverse this situation. We only need to give them ‘hope’. Regarding this, I already have a foolproof plan.” Yang San’s face was full of confidence.
“How so?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.
“I ask Master to grant me temporary authority: allow me to descend a Divine Decree to communicate with all believers.”
“I can demonstrate on the spot,” Yang San said.
Yang Fan nodded and granted the authority.
In the next moment, Yang San’s consciousness covered the entire divine kingdom.
He did not descend the Divine Decree immediately, but first explained to Yang Fan: “The first step is to package ‘disappearance’ as ‘ascension’.”
As the words fell, the Divine Decree descended with a boom.
A majestic voice swept through heaven and earth:

“All those chosen have stepped upon the path of ascension, shedding their Mortal shells to travel to higher levels of the divine domain for cultivation, while simultaneously participating in the expedition against alien races to protect the stability of the divine kingdom.”

“This journey is one-way not because they cannot return, but because the time for their return has not yet come. They shall grow in a higher world. The day of their return shall be the day they become heroes of the divine kingdom.”
“Their names shall be inscribed in the annals of the divine kingdom’s history. Their Bloodlines shall all share in the glory.”
“Those who bear more children shall receive more divine selections. The more flourishing the Bloodline, the greater the glory.”
As the Divine Decree fell, the entire divine kingdom went briefly silent.
Then, countless believers showed expressions of fanaticism.
Faith in the god had long been etched into the depths of their Souls; the believers would not doubt a Divine Decree.
Watching this scene, Yang Yi frowned slightly, a flash of disdain in his eyes.

“Drinking poison to quench thirst. Relying on a Divine Decree to temporarily appease the believers will naturally be effective in the short term, but once we continue to throw believers into the Zombie System, this trust will only collapse faster.”
“This is only the first step, making ‘disappearance’ seem meaningful so that believers still have hope.” Yang San’s tone remained flat.
“The second step is to create’survivorship bias’, something I have already prepared.”
Yang San snapped his fingers, and in the next moment, hundreds of supersonic fighter jets roared out from the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
Tearing through the sky, they turned into streaks of light, heading straight for the space above the City of Technology.
The jets slowly decelerated and hovered, the hatch doors opened, and figures slowly descended from high altitude.
When those figures actually touched the ground, the entire city instantly boiled over.
They were beings with powerful auras, most having stepped into the third rank, and there were even several fifth-rank existences.
What truly caught people’s attention was not their strength, but their identities.
Someone recognized them, their voice trembling, almost unable to believe it.
“That... is that Gouzi?”
“Wasn’t he... chosen and taken away long ago?”
“Erdan?” An old man stumbled forward, his voice hoarse, “Is it you... Erdan?”
In the crowd, those who had returned slowly raised their heads, their gazes falling on familiar yet strange faces.
When they left, they were but youths with the air of childhood still upon them, but now their faces were mature, even carrying a few traces of hardship.
Meanwhile, their parents’ hair had long since turned white, and their figures were hunched.
At this moment, time seemed to have been torn open.
“Father...”
“Mother...”
Someone’s voice trembled, and in the next moment, they knelt directly on the ground.
“Gouzi! It really is you!” An old woman rushed forward, tears streaming down uncontrollably.
“You’re finally back... Mother thought... thought I’d never see you again in this life...”
“Erdan! You brat! Where have you been all these years? You didn’t even send a word!”
“Mazi, it’s me, Wan’er”
The cries and laughter of reunion intertwined, and the entire City of Technology was immersed in the joy of a long-awaited homecoming.
Yet those who had returned each had expressions of fanaticism, their eyes carrying a light akin to religious faith.
“It’s the Marshal!”
“It was the Marshal who took us to a more powerful world!”
“The Spiritual Qi there is dense, far exceeding the divine kingdom! Medicinal Pills are supplied without limit! One day of Cultivation is worth half a month in the divine kingdom!”
“We cultivated, fought, and grew there! All to become strong as quickly as possible, so that one day we could return to protect the divine kingdom!”
Their voices carried a fanaticism that could not be faked, quickly spreading through the crowd.
Similar scenes were happening in more than one place.
In every village, every marketplace, and even on every Penglai Island, one or two ‘returnees’ appeared.
And even more strangely, their parents and relatives just happened to still be alive.
All of this seemed like a coincidence, yet it was terrifyingly precise.
For a high-level Intelligent Life, achieving this was not difficult.
Over the past few centuries, every ten years or so, Yang San had deliberately mixed a batch of purple-Aptitude Geniuses among those believers with green Aptitude.
These people were sent to the Extra-dimensional Research Institute, and naturally, they were not turned into zombies but were cultivated separately.
To make the ‘lie’ more real, Yang San had even specifically purchased Mimicry Cultivation Spaces, allowing these Geniuses to truly ‘experience’ a fictional world of cultivation.
Rather than forcibly descending a Divine Decree and commanding the believers to believe, he preferred another way.
To construct a ‘reality’ real enough that they would believe it themselves.
Then, word would spread from ten to a hundred. Eventually, it would turn into a ‘truth’ that no one questioned.
“You had this prepared long ago?” Yang Yi’s brow furrowed slightly.

“I have been preparing for this for nearly two hundred years.” Yang San’s tone was calm, even carrying a hint of self-satisfaction, “Now, believers at the Qi Refining Realm have already been cultivated in the Mimicry Cultivation Spaces. When the next batch ‘returns’, the promotional effect will be even better.”
Yang Yi fell into silence, not continuing to argue, because he clearly saw that those believers had completely believed it.
The doubt in the believers’ eyes had completely vanished, replaced by yearning, desire, and even pride.
Yang San turned to face Yang Fan and raised his hand in a standard military salute: “Master, next is the third step, binding ‘reproduction’ with ‘glory’.”
As the words fell, the authority was invoked once more.
The Divine Decree descended.

“All those who give birth to offspring are meritorious subjects of the divine kingdom. Families shall receive extra spiritual food rations and Medicinal Pill rewards. The more offspring, the more generous the rewards.”
“All those whose descendants are chosen shall receive divine grace; their parents and clansmen shall be granted residence in spiritual lands and enjoy higher-level resource allocations.”

“From this day forth, the Divine Kingdom Hero Monument is established. All those who step upon the path of ascension shall have their names carved upon the monument for all to revere. Their Bloodline shall share glory with the god!”

chapters.title: Chapter 147: The War Begins, Fission Beast
paragraphs: The Divine Decree descended, and the heavens and earth shook.
In the next moment, countless believers were completely whipped into a frenzy.
“Procreate for the Bloodline of the Divine Kingdom!!”
“Many children, many blessings! Many children bring glory!!”
“My son shall surely enter the God-Chosen!!”
“My son shall ascend the Heroic Monument!!”
“Born for the God! Die for the Divine Kingdom!!”
Fanatical shouts rose wave after wave, sweeping across the entire Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, doubt was completely drowned out, leaving only blind faith and a carefully guided sense of glory.
Having finished all this, Yang San continued, “The final step is emotional orientation.”
His tone was calm, as if he were merely stating a most ordinary strategy.

“These believers will gradually transition from their initial fear and unease to pride. They will even turn around and despise families that don’t ‘work hard’ enough at procreating.” A slight curve appeared at the corner of Yang San’s mouth.
“Of course, this process takes time. Master, please rest assured; I will continue dynamic simulations to precisely calculate the optimal believer consumption rate for cultivating the Zombie System.”
“I am confident that once stabilized, the Divine Kingdom’s population will not only refrain from decreasing but will instead see a new round of growth.”
“Believers will take pride in procreation. For the sake of this ‘glory,’ they will even proactively compress their own living space.”
After hearing all this, Yang Fan fell into a rare moment of silence as a chill slowly crept up his spine.
Yang San truly did not view these believers as ‘human’ at all.
In his calculations, everything was just a variable, just a number, just a resource that could be allocated and consumed.

As the God, the Divine Kingdom was inherently under Yang Fan’s absolute control. Those believers would never have the chance to approach the Extra-dimensional Research Institute in their entire lives.
In other words, this lie would exist forever and would never be exposed.
His believers would procreate generation after generation within this carefully constructed ‘truth,’ desperately striving for that so-called ‘glory.’
From a God’s perspective, Yang Fan naturally felt a twinge of pity.
This faint mercy only lingered in his heart for a moment before being forcibly suppressed.
In this world, strength was the prerequisite for everything.
What did the sacrifice of these ordinary believers matter?
If one day his strength was insufficient and his Divine Kingdom was breached...
At that time, no matter who they were, whether they believed or not, whether they were loyal or not—the end for all believers, including himself, would be a single word: death.
“Reporting to Master,” Yang San stepped forward, his voice steady. “After five hundred years of recovery, the Divine Kingdom’s overall strength has fully recovered and even progressed further.”
“At the same time, large-scale zombies have been successfully cultivated. I request permission to attack an Alien Divine Kingdom.”
Yang Fan nodded slightly upon hearing this.
With the support of the hundredfold Evolution Talent, the Divine Kingdom’s recovery speed far exceeded common logic; it had long since met the conditions to deploy troops again.
For any other demigod, a single Divine Kingdom War would require at least half a year or even a year of rest in reality. For Yang Fan, it only took a few short days.
“I will go purchase coordinates for a Divine Kingdom,” Yang Fan said flatly.
Yang San quickly added, “For this offensive, I suggest prioritizing an Alien Divine Kingdom that has strong reproductive capabilities but weak individual combat power, winning through sheer numbers.”
“This would better demonstrate the true value of the Zombie System.”
As he spoke, he deliberately glanced sideways at Yang Yi with a hint of subtle provocation.
Ever since the Zombie System was established, these two intelligent lives had never stopped bickering, often picking at each other.
Yang Fan had long since grown accustomed to this.
With a shift of his consciousness, he entered the Virtual World and once again clicked on the coordinates for Wanan Information Service Co., Ltd.
“Intelligent Life Xiao Na, at your service again!” the familiar voice rang out.

“I want to buy safety-grade coordinates,” Yang Fan said, getting straight to the point. “Target requirements—alien believers must have strong reproductive capabilities, primarily focusing on swarming tactics, and the weaker the individual strength, the better.”
“Searching...”
“Search complete. Honored customer, it is recommended that you purchase—”
[Safety Coordinates]
Alien Divine Kingdom Coordinates:
Race: Fission Beast
Estimated Combat Power: C
Estimated Divine Kingdom Defensive Structures: C
Estimated Divine Kingdom Asset Level: C+
Rating: Safe
Price: 9 Million Divinity Points
Description: Reconnaissance of this target has been completed. The overall risk is low. Recommended for purchase by newly ascended demigods.
“The Fission Beast race belongs to a special type of flesh-and-blood lifeform. Their reproduction does not rely on mating but rather on proliferation through fission.”

“In cases of sufficient food, they can quickly split to form entirely new individuals. Their individual consciousness is extremely weak, and those below the Rank of sentient beings possess almost no reason. Combat with this type of Divine Kingdom is essentially a war of resource attrition. The combat cycle is long, and it is recommended to carry out the subjugation in the form of small squads,” Xiao Na reminded him in a mechanical voice.
After listening to the introduction, a flash of satisfaction appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes. Without hesitation, he waved his hand and paid.
In the next moment, the coordinate information instantly flooded into his mind.
Almost at the same time, Yang San had already begun to move.
Within the Divine Kingdom, military orders were rapidly issued, and the legions completed their assembly as quickly as if they had rehearsed it countless times.
The spatial tunnel opened accordingly.
“Target locked.”
“spatial anchor points confirmed.”
Standing at the command core, Yang San’s gaze was icy. “All troops, set out.”
In the next instant, space was torn asunder, and the army teleported away.
Meanwhile, Yang Fan’s consciousness had returned to reality, but his attention followed Yang San into that Divine Kingdom that was about to be invaded.
As his vision expanded, a strange and oppressive world came into view.
There was no vegetation here. Forget forests or grasslands; even the most basic aura of life was extremely thin.
As far as the eye could see, there were only bare mountains and jagged reefs. The ground was grayish-black, cracked like it had been parched for a long time.
The air was filled with a bloody stench so thick it was nauseating, as if this entire world were soaked in flesh and blood.
The wind howled, carrying ear-piercing shrieks.
Almost at the moment the believers landed, movement appeared on the distant horizon.
Densely packed figures surged out from the gloomy surface, numbering over a million!
One had to realize this was only the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom; it was unexpected that the number of Fission Beast would be so high.
Their appearance resembled wolves, yet they were more distorted and hideous. Their muscles were turned outward as if they could tear at any moment, and they moved with a bizarre sense of ripping.
Their crimson eyes were hollow and void of reason, containing only the most primitive desire to devour.
Facing Yang Fan’s army of believers, these Fission Beast did not consider the disparity in strength; without even a probe, they began their charge.
Gazing at that alien Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh softly. “Alien races are indeed strange and varied; they have all sorts of bizarre life forms.”

Yang San did not deploy the zombie army immediately. Instead, he quickly laid down the Extinguishing God Array to clear out the Fission Beast along the way, advancing toward the opponent’s Divine Kingdom Core.
The battle erupted almost instantly. Those Fission Beast had no reason, no Formation, and no coordination; they were simply a pack of completely out-of-control mad beasts.
Hissing and roaring, they pounced in swaths.
Such a disorganized charge was meaningless against the army of believers that had already completed their Formation.
Under the suppression of the Formation, the flesh of the Fission Beast was torn apart piece by piece, and their corpses piled up like harvested weeds.
In just half a day within the Divine Kingdom, nearly a million Fission Beast were completely wiped out.
It was entirely a one-sided slaughter.
“Why didn’t he deploy the zombies immediately?” Although Yang Fan had doubts in his heart, he did not ask.
He trusted Yang San’s judgment; after all, the other party was a high-level war-type Intelligent Life.
