chapters.title: Chapter 148: Spread of the zombie virus, Appearance of the Alien Demigod
paragraphs: Time passed, and ten years had gone by within the Alien Divine Kingdom.
During these ten years, the war never ceased.

The number of Fission Beast was like a locust plague—impossible to kill off or exterminate completely. The further they advanced toward the Divine Kingdom Core, the more terrifying the resistance became.
By now, the army led by Yang San encountered Fission Beast in the billions every time.
ranked beings even began to appear among them; they were no longer completely chaotic and were already capable of simple offensive and defensive coordination.
But even so, the state of the war remained a complete crushing victory.
In ten years, the number of believer deaths did not exceed twenty million.
In a war of this scale, such losses were almost negligible.
The reason was simple: although the Fission Beast had terrifying numbers, their individual strength was far too weak.
Furthermore, they lacked intelligence and had basically no coordination.
In most cases, even if a believer was injured, it was only a minor wound.

And before the war began, Yang Yi had already prepared a large number of healing Medicinal Pills, supplemented by the Water of Life accumulated in the God-Kingdom. As long as a believer still had a breath left, they could be saved.
At this moment, Yang Fan’s consciousness re-entered the God-Kingdom.
This was because Yang San finally made a new move.
He purchased robot soldiers in bulk from the Divine Shop, while also buying a batch of special coffins from a Cultivation God-Kingdom.
Outside the Extra-dimensional Research Institute.
Thousands of transport planes were lined up neatly, covering the entire takeoff platform.
The hatches opened, and robot soldiers entered the interior of the institute, suppressing those zombies one by one and sealing them into the coffins.
The coffin lids closed, and faint runes flowed across the surface of the wood; the zombies subsequently became quiet.
Afterward, the robot soldiers hoisted them up and loaded them into the transport plane cabins in a predetermined order.
The entire process was like a precisely operating assembly line.
Soon, the first batch of transport was completed.
Engines roared as the transport planes took off one after another, lining up in formation to travel through the spatial tunnel toward the Alien Divine Kingdom.
[zombie-suppressing coffin: Price 1000 Faith Points]
[Comes with an Evil-Suppressing Talismanic Incantation, which can effectively suppress low-rank Jiangshi]
Unlike zombies, Jiangshi belong to the Corpse Cultivator System within Cultivation God-Kingdoms. Although it is somewhat niche, it is a branch of the Cultivate System.
Yang Fan had already come into contact with relevant knowledge as early as elementary school.

To be precise, Jiangshi are still considered believers, but low-rank Jiangshi have incomplete intelligence and uncontrollable behavior, which is why the business of ‘zombie-suppressing coffins’ was born.
By comparison, zombies simply cannot be compared to them; the suppression effect of these coffins on them was naturally even better.

Watching the robot soldiers carry the coffins to fill the transport planes and then fly off in neat formations to the battlefield, Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh, “High-level Intelligent Life is indeed powerful.”
“Without them, my God-Kingdom could never have developed to this stage today.”
These zombies did not distinguish between friend and foe, and on top of that, he had to maintain the ‘cognitive guidance’ for the believers.
This high-risk transport work was most suitable for emotionless robot soldiers.
The zombie-suppressing coffins from the Cultivation God-Kingdom perfectly solved the issue of losing control during the transport process.
Even the capacity of the transport planes, the dimensions of the coffins, and the loading order had all been calculated by Yang San.
Yang Fan might not have even been able to conceive of this level of coordination and scheduling, let alone execute it.

Following the coordinates, the transport planes quietly entered the Fission Beast’ God-Kingdom. They did not move toward the main battlefield but instead dispersed, flying toward the east and west sides.
Everything within the Alien Divine Kingdom flashed through Yang Fan’s mind like a series of images.
The transport planes lowered their altitude, and the autopilot System took over control.
Inside the cabin, two robot soldiers went to the cargo hold, opened the hatch, and opened a coffin.
‘Click.’
The moment the coffin lid was lifted, a zombie suddenly lunged!
Rotting arms flailed wildly as they instinctively pounced toward any object in front of them.
However, the attacks of these ordinary zombies fell upon the high-strength alloy bodies of the robot soldiers without leaving even a scratch.
The next moment, a robot soldier raised its hand, grabbed the zombie by the neck, and threw it directly out of the hatch without hesitation! The movement was crisp and efficient.
One, two, three...
The zombies were dumped out from high altitude like discarded trash, one after another.
Once the deployment was finished, the coffin lids were closed again, ready for a second use.
In the high sky, those dropped zombies plummeted rapidly like lumps of flesh.
Thud! Thud! Thud!

Even though the altitude had been deliberately controlled, many zombies still crashed directly into the jagged rock walls, their bones shattering as they turned into piles of rotting remains on the spot.
Before they could even begin to’serve their purpose,’ they had completely lost their ability to move.
But those zombies that were lucky enough to survive twisted and stood up the moment they hit the ground, roaring while searching for targets.
The scent of rotting flesh spread quickly, and the nearby Fission Beast were already being drawn over.
Low growls rose and fell, and red gazes lit up in the gloom.
The next moment, the two sides collided head-on!
No testing, no pausing. The zombies and Fission Beast slammed into each other violently!
Biting, scratching, devouring.
A Fission Beast opened its bloody maw and bit off a zombie’s arm, only to be tackled to the ground and have its throat torn open by another zombie a second later.
Neither side possessed intelligence; they slaughtered each other instinctively, the sounds of flying flesh and snapping bones ringing out continuously.
Similar scenes were playing out simultaneously in every corner of the God-Kingdom.
But at this moment, the main force of the Fission Beast was still firmly pinned down on the front lines by Yang San’s army.
The zombie crisis had quietly spread, and that alien god seemed not to have noticed yet.
“Yang Yi, what do you think?” Yang Fan spoke calmly.
“Reporting to Master, against a race that excels in reproduction like this, the zombie System is indeed remarkably effective,” Yang Yi said in a cool tone.
“However...”
“However what?” Yang Fan looked at him.
“According to the data I have consulted, these types of alien gods who rely on reproductive advantages often know their own weaknesses and have corresponding countermeasures.”

“Yang San deliberately delayed the deployment time, clearly using the main forces to draw attention. Once the opposing god reacts, the spreading effect of the zombies will be significantly weakened,” Yang Yi explained.
The Human Race could learn, and aliens could as well.
Facing a glaring weakness of their race, it was not surprising for an alien to find a solution.
But the terrifying thing about the zombie System was its transmission—and it was exponential. Just giving them one year would be enough to drag the entire God-Kingdom into the abyss.
Under Yang Fan’s gaze, the changes in the Alien Divine Kingdom had already begun; some Fission Beast became abnormal and started attacking their own kind frantically.
These Fission Beast infected by the zombie virus had even more distorted and manic movements.
Even if they were heavily wounded, with their internal organs dragging on the ground and their flesh torn open, they were still moving, still searching for targets, biting everything in sight.
The virus began to spread, one to ten, ten to a hundred.
Yang Fan snapped his fingers, and a cup of Monkey Wine appeared in his hand, as if he were watching a movie, observing this meticulously choreographed grand war drama.
Just as Yang Yi expected, in less than a month of time in the Alien Divine Kingdom, that Demi-god discovered something was wrong.
A terrifying aura suddenly descended.
Above the firmament, blood-colored Qi surged.
A massive phantom slowly coalesced, blocking the path of Yang San’s army.
That phantom looked exactly like a Fission Beast, but it had been magnified countless times. It was a full thousand meters tall, spanning across the sky.
A blood-red aura constantly radiated from it, pressing down with physical weight.
The entire space seemed to become viscous and heavy.

ranked beings even began to appear among them; they were no longer completely chaotic and were already capable of simple offensive and defensive coordination.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Crushing the Battlefield
paragraphs: The Fission Beasts below let out low growls, a display of instinctive awe.
“You Humans—how truly despicable,” the opponent spoke coldly, actually using human speech. “To minimize your losses, you’ve started deploying these disgusting things again.”
Seeing the opposing god appear, Yang Fan’s consciousness also descended along the coordinates.
Golden light erupted as a hundred-zhang-tall golden giant slowly materialized from the Void Realm, standing tall above the army and looking down upon the entire battlefield.
The Fission Beast Demigod looked up, staring fixedly at Yang Fan with cold eyes.
“Having fought to this point, you should understand that my divine kingdom isn’t so easily invaded. Continuing this will only lead to mutual destruction.”
“Retreat. From now on, we shall mind our own business.”
“Retreat?” Yang Fan chuckled, his tone carrying undisguised mockery.
“You’re dreaming. Since I’ve invaded your divine kingdom, my goal is naturally only one thing: the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“Do you really want to fight to the death?” A fierce light flashed in the Fission Beast Demigod’s eyes.
The next moment, the mountain range behind him suddenly shook. Billowing dust and smoke soared into the sky as countless Fission Beasts poured out from the mountains like a black tide.
Dense and packed, they were boundless.
One billion, two billion, three billion...
In just a short moment, the number of Fission Beasts had exceeded ten billion!
Among them, the number of Ranked Fission Beasts was staggering. They stood at the front, acting as “generals” to perform basic coordination and command.
Under their control, the beast swarms that should have been chaotic actually maintained a crude but effective Formation.
The Fission Beasts roared in unison, baring their teeth and claws at Yang Fan’s army of believers.
Above in the sky, thousands of Yao Beasts in the Qi Refining Realm hovered. Their auras were linked, faintly forming a Formation that condensed the energy of the entire battlefield into one.
“Human god, why do you think your army was able to advance here so smoothly?” the Fission Beast Demigod spoke slowly.
“That’s because I was luring you in deep. If I let my believers go all out now, your army wouldn’t even have time to retreat, and your divine kingdom would surely suffer heavy casualties.”
“I’m already giving you Face by being willing to come forward and negotiate.”
“You are strong, but I am not weak either. There’s no need for us to fight to this extent. Developing our own divine kingdoms is the right path. What do you think of my proposal?”
The Fission Beast Demigod stared at Yang Fan, waiting for his response.
At the demigod level, it wasn’t uncommon to discover each other’s divine kingdom coordinates.
But “discovery” did not equate to “starting a war.”
Unless one side possessed absolute crushing power, or teamed up with others of their race for a collective encirclement, or gambled everything on a single throw.
Otherwise, no demigod would easily risk the majority of their divine kingdom’s foundation to fight a war that might end in mutual destruction.
He had been observing in secret since the beginning of Yang Fan’s invasion. Since Yang Fan was the only demigod invading, he appeared now to try and make Yang Fan back down.
War was never the goal; resources were. The development of the divine kingdom was the goal of all gods.
Doing something despite knowing it’s impossible isn’t courage, it’s madness. And a “madman” wouldn’t make it to the level of a demigod.
The Fission Beast Demigod was convinced of this, as this wasn’t the first time someone had invaded his divine kingdom.
His race’s reproductive ability was staggering. As long as resources were sufficient, the supply of soldiers was nearly infinite. Most previous invaders would choose to retreat after seeing this.

Although the other party had exposed their divine kingdom coordinates, he had never counter-attacked. After all, neither could do anything to the other, or rather, they weren’t willing to fight to the death.
Attacking another’s divine kingdom on their home turf naturally required a greater price.

However, Yang Fan only shook his head slightly. “Soldiers are valued for their quality, not their quantity. So what if you have ten billion believers? You might not even be able to handle the army before you, yet you want to negotiate terms with me? You’re not qualified.”
As he spoke, Yang Fan nodded slightly to Yang San.
Yang San understood instantly and took a sudden step forward.
“Deploy the Great Ten Kings of Hell Formation!!!”
Boom!
The world shook, and Yin Qi surged.
Five Yama Phantoms slowly emerged from the Void Realm, hanging high in the sky like judges walking out from the depths of Hell.
An invisible pressure instantly enveloped the battlefield. Those low-rank Fission Beasts collapsed to the ground on the spot, trembling all over, not even daring to move.
Unlike the Goblins, the individual combat power of the Fission Beasts was too weak. Advancing all the way here, Yang Fan’s believers hadn’t even had a chance to deploy this Formation.
Now, facing these ten billion creatures, it was the perfect time to show them the true power of a C-rank Array at the Great Success stage!
Seeing this, the Fission Beast Demigod’s expression gradually became solemn.
“Do you really want to fight to the death?” he asked in a low voice.
“The fish will die, but the net might not break!” Yang Fan laughed loudly, his voice vibrating through the world.
“All troops, charge!!”
As his voice fell, the battle instantly erupted.

Before those low-rank Fission Beasts could even touch the edge of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation, they were blown away by the surging waves of Yin and Evil Qi within the Formation. They were swept back in swathes, flesh and blood flying, like dust kicked up by a storm.
It’s true that many ants can bite an elephant to death, but only if they can cause continuous damage to the elephant.
Under the enhancement of the Ten Kings of Hell Formation, these unranked Fission Beasts were merely throwing their lives away.
Yang San stood at the rear, his expression extremely relaxed.
This divine kingdom had long been devoured by the Fission Beasts; forests and vegetation had all vanished. All that remained was a bare and empty battlefield.
With no cover or complex terrain, this was the perfect battlefield for the Ten Kings of Hell Formation.
Compared to those cunning Goblins who were good at ambushes, these Fission Beasts that relied only on numbers were much easier to deal with.
Watching his believers being slaughtered on a massive scale, the Fission Beast Demigod did not act. He only gave Yang Fan a deep look before his consciousness slowly dissipated from the sky.
At the same time, deep within the divine kingdom, a Divine Decree suddenly descended.

“All contaminated believers, drive them into the Sea of Blood immediately! Use the power of the Sea of Blood to purify their bodies and return them to their flesh and blood Origin! Then, convert that flesh and blood Origin back into new believers!”
“All believers, heed my command! Shrink the defensive lines! Block the enemy layer by layer, using the Divine Kingdom Core as the boundary!”
“All Ranked creatures, go all out to split and reproduce!”
“I will deploy more Blood Food! Drown all invaders with numbers!!”
The Divine Decree echoed, and the entire divine kingdom thoroughly entered a full-scale wartime state.
“If ten billion isn’t enough...” the Fission Beast Demigod murmured in a raspy voice, “then twenty billion, thirty billion, or even a hundred billion!”
“If you want to swallow my divine kingdom, let’s see if you have the ability.”
In his eyes, there was killing intent, madness, and a hint of irrepressible fear.
Since becoming a demigod, he had experienced twelve divine kingdom invasions. This time, the opponent was the strongest and the most “insane.”
He knew very well that this was a true divine kingdom crisis. If he didn’t exhaust all resources to improve his believers’ combat power, his future might very well end here.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Divine Kingdom Direction — Mechanical Path
paragraphs: Time passed rapidly.
In less than half a month, the ten billion Fission Beasts were all slaughtered.
However, those one thousand Qi Refining Stage Fission Beasts had already dispersed and retreated during the Middle Stage of the battle.
Clearly, in the eyes of this Alien Demigod, no matter how many ordinary Fission Beasts there were, they were far less important than those thousand Qi Refining Realm believers.
“As long as Fission Beasts have enough food and energy, they can reproduce infinitely. Yang Er, pack up all these corpses and bring them back to the Divine Kingdom; do not leave any behind.”
Yang San’s gaze swept across the battlefield, his tone calm.
“Understood.” Yang Er nodded.
At that moment, Yang San seemed to sense something and suddenly turned his head, looking toward the west of the Divine Kingdom.
“An anomaly has appeared on the perimeter. Qi Refining Stage Fission Beasts have begun patrolling, and three transport planes were just shot down.” Yang San’s voice suddenly turned cold.
“What do we do now? Should we dispatch Qi Refining Stage believers as escorts?” Yang Er frowned.

“No,” Yang San rejected without hesitation. “The zombies are in this Divine Kingdom; even if the believers see them, they will only be treated as enemies. If they realize these zombies originate from within our Divine Kingdom, the people’s hearts will fall into chaos.”
“This matter can only be handled by robot soldiers.”
“Then what’s next?” Yang Er continued to ask.

“I have already applied to the Master to purchase Super Alloy Robot Warriors produced by high-level Mechanical Divine Kingdoms. Their combat power is comparable to the Qi Refining Stage, and they will be responsible for escorting,” Yang San said calmly.

He looked into the distance again and issued an order: “The transport planes are to continue deeper. Even if the opponent has the ability to deal with the zombie virus, so what? I won’t give him the time.”
Having said this, Yang San raised his hand and gave a sharp wave.
“Whole army, advance at full speed!! Conquer this Divine Kingdom for our God!!”
“Yes, Marshal!!” the believers shouted in unison, their voices shaking heaven and earth.

On the other side, Yang Fan was within his own Divine Kingdom. At this moment, his expression was very relaxed; after seeing the combat power of ten billion Fission Beasts, he was no longer worried about this war.
His attention was being drawn by another matter.
A silver-gray metallic body with cold, hard lines and precise joints. Its eyes glowed with a faint blue light as it stood by the transport plane, looking as if it were alive.
“So this is a Super Alloy Robot Warrior!” Yang Fan was full of curiosity.
[Super Alloy Robot Warrior, Price: 100 Divinity Points
Produced by high-level Mechanical Gods, individual combat power is comparable to the Qi Refining Stage or Martial Apprentice Realm.
Possesses absolute execution capability and can complete instructions unconditionally.
No emotions, no fear, no fatigue.
Disadvantage: Once damaged, it requires a large amount of regenerative metal for repairs, and maintenance costs are extremely high.]
“Yang Yi, a high-level Mechanical Divine Kingdom... can actually mass-produce robots at the Qi Refining Stage?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow hard.

With 100 Divinity Points, he could trade for one Qi Refining Stage combat unit. With his current wealth, if he truly wanted to expand his army, he could completely obtain millions of Qi Refining Stage combat units in a short time.
“Reporting to Master,” Yang Yi’s tone was calm, “the cost-effectiveness of this type of robot warrior is extremely low.”
“If it weren’t for the fact that this involves the Zombie System and it’s inconvenient for the believers to know, there would be absolutely no need to invest funds in them.”
“Low cost-effectiveness?” Yang Fan was stunned for a moment.
“If 100 Divinity Points were all invested in a single believer, one could easily Cultivate a Qi Refining Stage expert,” Yang Yi continued to explain.
“And these robots are not believers; they are closer to a type of special equipment and cannot provide feedback to the Master.”
“Purchasing them in bulk is meaningless.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was also slightly taken aback.
He only then realized that 100 Divinity Points was 10 billion Faith Points. Back when he was attending high school in Yang County, he wouldn’t have even dared to imagine such a number.
And now, it was being treated by him as a basic unit for ‘bulk procurement’.
Ultimately, it was because the resource output of his Divine Kingdom was now too terrifying.
In reality, his stable monthly income had already reached 200 million Divinity Points. Such a speed of making money was enough to make anyone lose their sense of reality regarding ‘money’.
To others, every bit of resource had to be meticulously calculated.
But in Yang Fan’s eyes, Divinity Points were more like a string of weightless numbers.
“I’m not interested in money...” This sentence suddenly popped into Yang Fan’s mind.
He coughed lightly, suppressing his emotions. “What is the cost of these robot warriors?”
“About 1 divinity point,” Yang Yi answered.
“Pfft.”
Yang Fan almost spat out the Monkey Wine in his mouth upon hearing that.
A cost of 1 divinity point, sold for 100 Divinity Points? This business is that profitable?

Seemingly sensing Yang Fan’s confusion, Yang Yi continued to explain: “The main cost of a Super Alloy Robot Warrior comes from regenerative metal. An individual unit costs about three tons of high-purity regenerative metal. In addition, it requires a miniature energy core, a neural conduction module, and a basic combat program chip.”
“These Materials themselves are not expensive. The reason they sell for 100 Divinity Points is that the truly scarce part is the ‘Soul Endowment’.”
“Endowing it with action logic, combat instincts, and execution capabilities—this step can only be completed by a Seventh-Rank intelligent life.”
“Seventh-Rank intelligent life?” Yang Fan frowned slightly.

“Yes.” Yang Yi nodded. “Yang Er, Yang San, and I are all Fourth-Rank intelligent lives. We each possess specialized abilities: I am responsible for Divine Kingdom development; Yang Er specializes in resource collection; and Yang San specializes in war command.”
“But essentially, we were all created with fixed abilities and a single direction. If we wish to evolve, we can only rely on a ‘Mechanical Heart’.”
Yang Yi’s tone was calm, yet it carried a hint of objective coolness.
“But the Supreme Intelligent Life of a Divine Kingdom is different. Only one Supreme Intelligent Life can exist in each Divine Kingdom.”
“They possess the ability to learn, summarize, and optimize. Much like a believer’s Cultivation, they can continuously improve themselves.”
“And only a Supreme Intelligent Life possesses true ‘creative ability’.”
“Endowing metal with ‘life’, combining matter into buildings, weapons, resources, and even creating things out of the void.”

“Different Divine Kingdom development systems have different focuses: Cultivation God-Kingdoms borrow the power of heaven and earth and excel in transformation and attack; Martial Cultivation Divine Kingdoms strengthen the Physical Body, entering the Dao through martial arts, pursuing the ultimate individual and physical sainthood; while the core of a Mechanical Divine Kingdom lies in computing power and creation.”
After listening to this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow again, and an irrepressible heat appeared in his eyes.
“If I want my Divine Kingdom to develop the Mechanical Path, is it feasible?” Yang Fan spoke slowly.
Cultivation, Martial Arts, and Mechanical—these were the three mainstream development routes of the Human Race.
Running all three in parallel to create a true composite Divine Kingdom. Yang Fan had had this idea for a long time.
However, Mechanical Divine Kingdoms were rarely encountered in reality, plus it was common knowledge that their threshold was high and the costs were terrifying.
Therefore, Yang Fan had never tried, but now it was different.
The Divine Kingdom had ample funds, and idle Divinity Points had reached as high as 600 million.
If this wealth were placed in Yang County, Yang Fan was confident that the entire Luo Family combined might not be as wealthy as he was.
In that case, why not develop a Mechanical Divine Kingdom?
